description.en:
Course Title:Microprocessor
Description:This course introduces the working principles of computer.
It puts emphasis on both hardware and software, as well as both theory
and appplication. Basically, this course covers the introduction of
general microprocessors:their architecture and operation, Assembly
language program and module program, instruction addressing mode,
instruction operation, and I/O Program and interface. More
specifically, multi-programming configuration and multi-processing
configuration are also discussed here. New topics will be added if
needed.

description.en:
Course Title:Electromagnetism
Description:This is an introductory course of electromagnetic bias on
its Engineering applications. The course is divided into five parts
(1) the static electric field, (2) the steady electric current, (3)
the static magnetic field, (4) the quari-stationary electromagnetic
field and, (5) Maxwell equations and their applications.
Besides, the course also introduces some of the optical technology.

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技三年級上學期實施選修專項分組教學，課程修畢有一學分並計入畢業學分內。由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: In first semester,  Junior students can choose to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. When they are finishing the course that can get the credit, also can account in graduate credit. For Senior level, Classes are giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh: 本課程介紹利用質量、能量守恆定律(熱力學第一定律)及均衡方程式(熱力學第二定律)，並在導入逸壓（Fugacity）觀念下，討論單成份系相平衡問題。最後延伸至多成份系統的熱力學性質的探討。此外還介紹化工程序中真實流體流動熱力學、機械能均衡、熱力學機械之設計與作功原理、熱機循環之熱力函數及熱機效率。
description.en: This course is designed as an introductory course in thermodynamics of chemical engineering.  Topics include the first and second law of thermodynamics, open and closed system, thermodynamics properties of materials, generalied correlations with real fluids and multicomponent systems.  Emphasis is placed on the chemical potential and its use in phase equilibria and chemical reaction equilibria.

syllabi.outline: An introductory course in thermodynamics of chemical engineering is offered in this course. Topics include the first and second laws of thermodynamics, open and closed systems, with additional emphasis on thermodynamic properties in phase equilibrium of solutions, general correlations with real fluids, and multi-component systems.

description.zh: 本課程屬於生物技術的基礎課程，授課內容強調基本生化原理，介紹細胞組成份〈包括核酸、蛋白質、醣類和脂質〉的化學、生物活性及代謝，並分別闡明代謝作用與基因表現的調節機轉，輔以現今生化尖端學術研究的介紹，希望能以一學期的緊密課程，讓學生瞭解現代生化科技領域的輪廓，作為日後深造或從事生化科技行業的奠基。
description.en: A one-term introductory biochemistry course that covers the biochemistry of the living state; the chemistry of amino acids, proteins, nucleic acids, carbohydrates, lipids, and steroids; energy transformations and chemical reactions in living cells; action of hormones; and self-regulation and self-replication of living organisms.

description.zh: 本課程介紹利用質量、能量守恆定律(熱力學第一定律)及均衡方程式(熱力學第二定律)，並在導入逸壓（Fugacity）觀念下，討論單成份系相平衡問題。最後延伸至多成份系統的熱力學性質的探討。此外還介紹化工程序中真實流體流動熱力學、機械能均衡、熱力學機械之設計與作功原理、熱機循環之熱力函數及熱機效率。
description.en: This course is designed as an introductory course in thermodynamics of chemical engineering.  Topics include the first and second law of thermodynamics, open and closed system, thermodynamics properties of materials, generalied correlations with real fluids and multicomponent systems.  Emphasis is placed on the chemical potential and its use in phase equilibria and chemical reaction equilibria.

syllabi.outline: 本課程前半段介紹利用質量、能量守恆定律(熱力學第一定律)及均衡方程式(熱力學第二定律)，並在導入逸壓（Fugacity）觀念下，討論單成份系相平衡問題。最後延伸至多成份系統的熱力學性質的探討。此外還介紹化工程序中真實流體流動熱力學、機械能均衡、熱力學機械之設計與作功原理、熱機循環之熱力函數及熱機效率。後半段課程介紹利用化工熱力學逸壓觀念，討論單成份系統相平衡問題，並進一步延伸至多成份系統的熱力學性質探討。此外也將說明化工熱力學在計算混合物相平衡行為所使用之熱力學模式、計算流程與方法。

description.zh: 使學生瞭解塑性變形對材料機械性質、物理性質、及化學性質之影響，實習內容如下： 1.鋼鐵、非鐵材料在各種加工度下之機械性質變化實驗；2.不鏽鋼料（18-8不鏽鋼）在各種加工度下之耐蝕性比較實驗；3. 線材之抽拉實驗，各種潤滑劑對抽拉力之影響；4.加工硬化對退火處理之組織變化，結晶粒大小之影響；5.壓軋加工下之變形實驗；6. 鍛造加工實驗；7.板材之引伸加工實驗。實驗內容主要分成兩大類，A.為材料加工製程實習，包含板材輥軋加工、棒材旋鍛實驗、線材盤元抽拉實驗、薄板沖壓實驗、塑料射出成形。B.為材料進階機械分析，包含塑性Luder's band 現象、金屬之雙晶與滑移破壞分析。
description.en: This lab course makes students understand the effects of plastic deformation upon mechanical, physical and chemical properties of metals. The course includes: 1. mechanical properties of ferrous and non-ferrous metals under different degree of plastic strain; 2. corrosion properties of 18-8 stainless steel; 3. tension tests of wires using different lubricants; 4. change of grain size with strain and annealing; 5. deformation by rolling; 6. forging; and 7. wire drawing. The main experiments will focus on: A. processes of plastic deformation including, rolling, swaging, wire drawing, plate pressing, plastic injection forming, and B. the observations of Luders’ bands, twinning, and slips in plastic deformation and fractures.

description.zh:
材料科學為工程教育的重要科技，材料的性質與特性，為現代工程
設計中佔有相當重要的地位，金屬材料的各種性質，都基於其內部
構造的變化，其內部原子聚集成規則的結晶構造，亦或聚集成非結
晶構造，其所形成的各種物理特性，由最基本的結晶構造開始了解。電子顯微鏡，破壞力學，超導性，電傳導，超塑性，動態回復，動態時效應變。差排理論、結晶核的形成與成長，合金相理論，晶界自由度，鑄造物的成核與均質化，硬化現象，固體擴散現象，破壞現象及理論，潛變的形成與原因等，充分了解金屬材料特性上的理論基礎與變化軌跡。
description.en:
Properties and characteristics of materials play important role in modern engineering design.Each property of materials is based on its transformation at inner structure,
its atoms inside converge either a regulated crystal structure or a noncrystal structure,
their physical property should be understood from the most fundamental crystalline
structure, such as electronic microscope, destructive dynamics, super-conductivity,
electronic conductivity, super-plasticity, dynamic recovery, dynamic aging strain
, dislocation theory, the formation and growth of crystalline nucleus, alloy phase
theory, crystal boundary free degree, nucleus and homogenization of casting product,
hardening phenomenon, solid diffusion phenomenon, destructive phenomenon and
theory, creep formation and its reason, all of these make student fully understand
the theory basis and change record of the metallic material characteristics.

description.zh: 塑性加工係藉塑性變形將金屬材料變化成目的形狀之金屬加工法。本課程包含：金屬塑性變形之基礎，塑性力學之基礎及各種塑性加工法之介紹，最近之塑性加工技術的進步，並涉及與塑性加工關連之成形技術及適合各種塑性加工材料之選擇。
description.en: Plastic deformation processing is a metal processing method which based on plastic deformation to transform metal material into objective shape. This course includes the foundation of metal plastic deformation, the foundation of plastic dynamics, and the introduction of all kinds of plastic deformative processing methods. The recent technology development of plastic deformation processing is related to formation technique and suitable for alternatives to all kinds of plastic deformation materials.

syllabi.outline: 塑性加工係藉塑性變形將金屬材料變化成目的形狀之金屬加工法。本課程包含：金屬塑性變形之基礎，塑性力學之基礎及各種塑性加工法之介紹，最近之塑性加工技術的進步，並涉及與塑性加工關連之成形技術及適合各種塑性加工材料之選擇。

單元四、板材輥軋加工、棒材旋鍛。

description.zh: 資源處理的主要對象為礦物，但其他有些固體與固體間或固體與液體間之分離與純化也包括在本工程之內，採用的方法：凡是各分離物間不同之物理及化學性質，皆可設法加以利用。本課程則針對其應用方法加以介紹，以期學生對資源處理有一初步及完整的認識。授課內容包括：粉粒體之簡介、篩及篩分、碎礦機之種類及應用、磨礦機之種類及應用、分級及分級機、重液選礦、浮游選礦、磁選機之種類及應用等。

description.zh: 鋼筋混凝土材料及其力學性質；鋼筋混凝土構材受到軸向力、彎曲力矩、剪力、扭轉力矩及握裹力作用時之分析；依據鋼筋混凝土設計規範之規定，將理論於梁、版、柱、基腳等構物設計之概述。

syllabi.outline: 本課程首先介紹鋼筋混凝土材料及其力學性質，並解釋鋼筋混凝土構材受到軸向力、彎曲力矩、剪力、扭轉力矩及握裹力作用時之行為與設計理論。並依據現行之鋼筋混凝土設計規範進行結構安全設計練習。本學期所學以梁構件為主，但也會針對版、柱、基礎等結構構件進行基本說明。This course firstly introduces the properties of concrete materials and their mechanic behaviors. And then the failure states of the reinforced concrete components under various loadings are introduced, such as axial force, bending moment, shear force, and torque. Finally, the current design code of reinforced concrete components is introduced and practiced with questions. The lecture is focused on beam members; however, there will be brief concept introductions for slabs, columns, footings, and other RC structures.

description.zh: 基礎工程係應用土壤力學之原理於基礎問題之分析，其內容包括下列各項：(1)基礎之定義：功用及其重要性、(2)土壤調查、(3)基礎之水、防水及開挖、(4)基礎之承載力、5)基礎之應力分析與沈陷計算(6)基腳及筏式基礎、(7)樁基、(8)墩基、(9)沈箱基礎、(10)基礎穩定處理。

description.en: This course helps to develop students' skills in managing construction projects. This course may be taken at different views in a construction management program with an emphasis on residential or commercial construction. Specific contents may include schedule management, job-site safety management, cost management, and related management topic in construction. Specific computer software may be used for construction project management. Students typically obtain the real experience from the practice special talk to gain real-world experience in planning and scheduling construction projects.

description.zh: 本課程為土木學門之基礎課程，目的在講授水文定性現象，及相關水文循環過程之定量計算理論。課程內容涵蓋地球上水的發生、循環、分佈、物理與化學特性以及和所有生物間的關係；並藉由工程觀點，依照水文循環特性進行系統化介紹，培養學生具有基礎水文能力，應用水文學原理解決人類在水資源開發所面臨的問題。
description.en: This foundational course for the civil engineering covers both qualitative hydrological phenomena elaboration and quantitative assessment theories related to the processes of hydrological cycle. It aims to prepare students with basic hydrological knowledge and skills to apply hydrology principles in problem-solving of water resources development.

description.zh: 環境規與管理是一門跨學科極為重要的整合性課程，討論內容包括：(1)環境問題與社會、(2)環境經濟學、(3)環境政策、(4)環境規劃原理與方法、(5)環境質量管理、(6)環境保護規劃技術、(7)環境影響評估、(8)土地利用與國土規劃、(9)區域性環境管理、(10)都市環境之管理、(11)環境保護管理制度、(12)自然資源與景觀維護以及永續發展之環境管理等。
description.en: Environmental Planning and Management aims to study the relationship between environmental problems and social, economics and ecology. The theory and technology of planning are also described. The environmental impact assessment is a major method for the approching of balance between economical development and environmental protection, therefore it is stressed to state it's contents and assessment methods. Further the National planning and City planning in the area of environmental espects are also described in the course. It intends to let the students realize how to have a sustainable development under the policy of environmental protection.

description.zh: 鋼筋混凝土材料及其力學性質；鋼筋混凝土構材受到軸向力、彎曲力矩、剪力、扭轉力矩及握裹力作用時之分析；依據鋼筋混凝土設計規範之規定，將理論於梁、版、柱、基腳等構物設計之概述。

syllabi.outline: 鋼筋混凝土材料及其力學性質；鋼筋混凝土構材受到軸向力、彎曲力矩、剪力、扭轉力矩及握裹力作用時之分析；依據鋼筋混凝土設計規範之規定，將理論於梁、版、柱、基腳等構物設計之概述。
syllabi.schedule:
第1周 簡介、鋼筋混凝土材料性質、基本力學複習
第2周 設計載重與設計規範 
第3-5周 單筋梁(beam)之撓曲分析與設計
第6-7周 梁設計方法與基本原理 
第8周 撓度與裂縫控制概述
第9-10周 雙筋梁之分析
第11-12周 雙筋梁之設計
第13周 混凝土剪力強度與基本原理
第14-15周 梁剪力設計與剪力筋
第16周 板(slab)分析與設計概述
第17周 獨立基礎設計(foundation design)與深梁及柱(column)分析概述
第18周 期末考試
syllabi.assessment:
三次考試，共佔75%
出席率與課堂表現成績 20%
作業 5%

description.zh: 基礎工程係應用土壤力學之原理於基礎問題之分析，其內容包括下列各項：(1)基礎之定義：功用及其重要性、(2)土壤調查、(3)基礎之水、防水及開挖、(4)基礎之承載力、5)基礎之應力分析與沈陷計算(6)基腳及筏式基礎、(7)樁基、(8)墩基、(9)沈箱基礎、(10)基礎穩定處理。
description.en: Subsurface investigations and synthesis of soil parameters for geotechnical design and analysis,concepts of shallow and deep foundation design,geotechnical design of conventional retaining walls,computerized analysis and design of soil/foundation interaction;case histories.

description.en: Fundamental theory of statically indeterminate structures;analysis of indeterminate beams,frames,and trusses by stiffness and flexibility methods;study of influence lines for beams,frames,and trusses.

syllabi.outline: This course aims to equip students with fundamental knowledge about structural analysis for beams, frames, and trusses. This semester will focus on analyses of statically determinate structures using energy and statically indeterminate structures using force and displacement methods.

Week 13-15: Slope-deflection Method
Week 16-17: Moment-Distribution Method

description.en: This course helps to develop students' skills in managing construction projects. This course may be taken at different views in a construction management program with an emphasis on residential or commercial construction. Specific contents may include schedule management, job-site safety management, cost management, and related management topic in construction. Specific computer software may be used for construction project management. Students typically obtain the real experience from the practice special talk to gain real-world experience in planning and scheduling construction projects.

description.zh: 本課程為土木學門之基礎課程，目的在講授水文定性現象，及相關水文循環過程之定量計算理論。課程內容涵蓋地球上水的發生、循環、分佈、物理與化學特性以及和所有生物間的關係；並藉由工程觀點，依照水文循環特性進行系統化介紹，培養學生具有基礎水文能力，應用水文學原理解決人類在水資源開發所面臨的問題。
description.en: This foundational course for the civil engineering covers both qualitative hydrological phenomena elaboration and quantitative assessment theories related to the processes of hydrological cycle. It aims to prepare students with basic hydrological knowledge and skills to apply hydrology principles in problem-solving of water resources development.

syllabi.outline: 學生與教授討論擬定之研究題目,在教授個別指導下,進行實驗之研究,以培養學生尋找相關資料,文獻及獨立研究的訓練,並將其研究成果撰寫成報告並公開發表練習。
syllabi.schedule:
1. 學習相關資料之搜尋與圖書館資源之運用。
2. 尋找一個自己有興趣且合乎自己未來生涯規畫之研究主題。
3. 決定研究主題後運用正確之搜尋方法，尋找相關之期刊、會議論文與專利
4. 研讀與研究主題相關之材料製備流程、儀器設備與測試資料。
5. 實際操作與研究主題相關之材料製備流程、合成物分析及儀器操作。
6. 撰寫期中期末報告。
7. 依照系內規定公開發表研究成果，並接受系內教師之評審，以修訂研究論文內容。
8. 投稿國內外之學術會議或期刊論文。

description.zh: 本課程針對各種材料（金屬、陶瓷、高分子、複合材料）之基本原理，性質及應用，做概要性的介紹。內容包括材料之晶體結構與晶體缺陷，固體材料之原子擴散，相圖與相變化，材料製程及應用，材料之物理性質（光性質、電性質、磁性質及熱性質），材料之機械性質（強度、延展性、硬度、韌性、疲勞、潛變）。
description.en: This course targets at the brief introduction to the fundamental principles, characteristics and application of the metal, ceramics, polymer and composite material. This course includes the crystal structure and defect, atomic diffusion of the solid materials, phase diagrams and phase transformation, material manufacturing process and application, the physic property (optical, electrical, magnetic and thermal property), mechanical property (strength, ductility, hardness, toughness, fatigue, and creep).

syllabi.outline:
The course is designed to provide the knowledge on quantum chemistry which will cover quantum mechanics, atomic structure, molecular orbitals, and molecular spectroscopy. This includes Schrodinger Equation, harmonic oscillator, angular momentum, hydrogen atom, theorems of quantum mechanics, electron spin and the Pauli Principle.
Outline:
1.Introduction to Modern Physics: Quantum Theory and Atomic Structure
2.	The Particle in a Box, Harmonic Oscillator, Angular Momentum, and Hydrogen Atom
3.	Theorems of Quantum Mechanics
4.	The Variation Method
5.	Perturbation Theory
6.	Electron Spin and The Pauli Principle
7.	Many-Electron Atoms
8.	Molecular Spectroscopy

description.zh: 本課程包含兩個部分。一、討論各種纖維之化學組成、合成與成形之理論，同時針對纖維之性質、纖維改質與組成、合成、成形間之關係與影響因素及檢測加以講授。 二、說明纖維之形態與微觀及巨觀結構、纖維長度分佈與斷面、密度、吸水性與膨潤性、機械性質、光學性質、熱性質，黏彈性質，及電氣性質等物理性質及其測試。
description.en: This course includes two parts. Part 1: A major object of this course is to provide a background in fiber compositions, synthesis, spinning and characterization. A second goal is to introduce factors that influence fiber compositions, formation and properties and their testing. Part 2: The course interprets the following subjects, such as: (1) Morphology of the fibers. (2) Microstructure and macrostructure of fibers. (3) Staple fiber length and cross-section. (4) Fiber density and absorption. (5) Mechanical properties. (6) Optical properties. (7) Thermal properties. (8) Fiber Viscoelasticity. (9) Electrical properties etc and their testing.

description.zh:
本課程探討現代通訊的基本原理，內容重點放在類比通訊的調變技巧與雜訊分析．課程大綱包括：
1.簡介
2.信號與系統
3.機率、隨機程序與雜訊
4.振幅調變：雙旁波帶、調幅、單旁波帶與殘旁波帶
5.角度調變：頻率調變與相位調變
6.脈波調變：脈幅調變、脈寬調變、脈位調變、脈碼調變與步差調變
7.數位通訊簡介
對於數位通訊有進一步興趣的同學可繼續選修『數位通訊系統』課程
description.en:
Fundamental principles of modern communication will be investigated in depth in this course, with emphasis on analog communications.Basic modulation techniques will be introduced with nosie analysis.Contents include
1.Introduction 
2.Signals and Systems
3.Probability ,Random Process,and Nosie
4.Amplitude Modulations:DSB,AM,SSB,and VSB
5.Angle Modulations:FMand PM
6.Pulse Modulations:PAM,PWM,PPM,PCM,and DM
7.Intorduction to Digital Communication 
Students who want to know more details sbout digital commmunication are encouraged to take the course Digital Communication Systems

syllabi.outline:
本課程探討現代通訊的基本原理，內容為類比通訊調變技術,類比訊號及數位訊號轉換技術, 與數位通訊調變技術. 重點放在這些技術的工程內容.

對於數位通訊有進一步興趣的同學可下學期繼續選修『數位通訊系統』課程, 『數位通訊系統』會著重於對數位通訊調變技術更精確的分析.

沒有修過信號與系統的同學仍然可以修本課程, 只是在前1/3學期要比較努力一下.

第15-17週 數位射頻調變技術簡介: PSK 調變, FSK 調變, QAM 調變

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技三年級上學期實施選修專項分組教學，課程修畢有一學分並計入畢業學分內。由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: In first semester,  Junior students can choose to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. When they are finishing the course that can get the credit, also can account in graduate credit. For Senior level, Classes are giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.en:
The lab course is designed for supplementing the lecture course'Communication Systems' and 'Digital Communication Systems'.sStudents can learn the principles and practive of analog and digital communication systems from laboratory experiments and projects.The cintents include
1.measuremnts of signals in time domain and frequency domain 
2.design of analog filters
3.double sideband AM systems
4.single sideband AM systems
5.FM systems
6.dessign of phase-locked-loop detectors
7.sampling and regeneration of analog signals
8.pulse amplitude modulation(PAM)systems
9.pulse coded modulation(PCM)systems
10.digital passband transmission
11.multiplexing systems
12.design and simulation of communication systems

syllabi.schedule:
1. 針對學生有興趣之研究方向，訂定與通訊網路、訊號處理領域相關的題目
2. 尋找主題相關研究資料，學生針對資料詳細研讀與討論，資料主題涵蓋
(1) 物聯網概念架構
(2) 物聯網通訊協定
(3) 機器學習建模
3. 瞭解內容後，予以細節探討，啟發學生想法
4. 針對學生想法，學習嵌入式平台使用與程式撰寫，進行相關實驗與實作
5. 將實驗結果與研究成果，彙整為報告書形式，訓練撰寫報告能力
6. 進行電子系期末專題競賽

When they are finishing the course that can get the credit, also can account in graduate credit. For Senior level, Classes are giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh: 本課程之目的為使學生瞭解生產計畫與管制的基本概念，訓練學生對於生產計畫與管制的各項方法，制度設計及改善等具有基本認識，並應用管理科學及作業研究於生產計畫與管制之研究發展。本課程包括下列主題：生產計畫與管制概論、產品設計與發展、預測、來源需求規畫、生產排程、總排程、存貨管理、豐田式管理、專案規畫與管理等。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to introduce the fundamental concepts of production planning and control.  In addition, applications of management science and operations research in production control and planning are also provided.  This course is consisted of the following subjects: introduction, product design and development, forecasting, resources requirement planning, production scheduling, total scheduling, inventory management, Toyota management, and project management.

description.zh: 本課程的目的將藉由五個面向了解企業倫理的本質，分別為：從全球化角度認知社會可接受的商業行為，將待人和善深植於良好的企業中，企業形象再造，強化職業倫理以及投資於可持續發展和有社會責任的公司。本課程亦教導學生瞭解今日快速變化工商界，符合企業倫理的公司治理原則與方式。課程的教導將朝下列五個方向進行：（1）廠商的社會責任（如：產品綠化與環境保護），（2）消費者的保護（如：產品的安全性），（3）員工的權益（如：職業健康），（4）員工對公司的責任（如：利益衝突），（5）雇主與員工關係（如：性別平等）。
description.en: The objective of this course is to appreciate the essential of Business Ethics through five main faucets: recognizing socially acceptable business conduct from the global perspectives, embedding good business in treating people nice and fair, reengineering corporate image, enhancing professional ethics, and investing in sustainable and socially responsible corporations. This course also discusses with the students the corporate governance that follows business ethics in today's changing business society. Five major categories will be covered: (1) Corporate Social Responsibility (e.g., Green product and environmental protection), (2) Consumer protection (e.g., Product safety), (3) Employee's rights and benefits (e.g., Occupational health), (4) Responsibility of employee to the firms (e.g., Conflict of interest), and (5) Employer-employee relations (e.g., Gender equity).

syllabi.outline:
課程旨在帶領學生於全球化多元的商業環境下，思維倫理在複雜的企業決策過程中所扮演之重要角色。引導學生認識企業倫理的內涵，並透過自編教材、教科書內容與個案探討，啟發學生對相關主題的興趣，體認企業倫理確實於日常生活中頻繁出現，而不僅為形而上的哲學觀。本課程擬藉由課堂的情境移轉，培養具有企業倫理的企業經理人。
本課程的目的將藉由五個面向了解企業倫理的本質，分別為：從全球化角度認知社會可接受的商業行為，將待人和善深植於良好的企業中，企業形象再造，強化職業倫理以及投資於可持續發展和有社會責任的公司。本課程亦教導學生瞭解今日快速變化工商界，符合企業倫理的公司治理原則與方式。課程的教導將朝下列五個方向進行：（1）廠商的社會責任（如：產品綠化與環境保護），（2）消費者的保護（如：產品的安全性），（3）員工的權益（如：職業健康），（4）員工對公司的責任（如：利益衝突），（5）雇主與員工關係（如：性別平等）。
The objective of this course is to appreciate the essential of Business Ethics through five main faucets: recognizing socially acceptable business conduct from the global perspectives, embedding good business in treating people nice and fair, reengineering corporate image, enhancing professional ethics, and investing in sustainable and socially responsible corporations. This course also discusses with the students the corporate governance that follows business ethics in today's changing business society. Five major categories will be covered: (1) Corporate Social Responsibility (e.g., Green product and environmental protection), (2) Consumer protection (e.g., Product safety), (3) Employee's rights and benefits (e.g., Occupational health), (4) Responsibility of employee to the firms (e.g., Conflict of interest), and (5) Employer-employee relations (e.g., Gender equity).

description.zh: 本課程在二技為品質管理。使學生瞭解品質管理的觀念、原理、領域。品管部門的組織、功能，如何管理產品或服務的品質，品管的工具、方法，如何持續改善品質的方法，品質表示法，如何評估品質管理成效，相關法令，品質管理未來趨勢。
description.en: This course lets the students understand the concepts, theories, and areas of qualify control, organization and functions of quality department.  Besides, the way to manage the products or the service quality, tools and methods of quality control, the way to improve the quality, quality representation method, evaluation of quality control, related regulations and future trends are also included.

syllabi.outline: This course enables students to understand the concepts, principles, and domains of quality management. It covers the organization and functions of the quality management department, how to manage the quality of products or services, quality management tools and methods, methods for continuous quality improvement, quality representation methods, how to evaluate the effectiveness of quality management, relevant regulations, and future trends in quality management. The course content includes quality responsibility, total quality management, basic statistics, control charts, probability theory, attribute control charts, acceptance sampling, reliability, and more.
syllabi.schedule:
Chapter 1- Modern Quality Management and Improvement
Chapter 2- The DMAIC Problem Solving Process
Chapter 3- Statistical Models or Quality Control and Improvement
Chapter 4- Statistical Inference in Quality Control and Improvement
Chapter 5- How SPC Works
Chapter 6- Variables Control Charts
Midterm exam
Chapter 7- Attributes Control Charts
Chapter 8- Determining Process and Measurement Systems Capability
Chapter 9- Time-Weighted Control Charts
Chapter 13- Basic Experimental Design for Process Improvement
Chapter 15- Basic Acceptance sampling Procedures
Final exam
syllabi.assessment: midterm 30%, final exam 40%, attendance and particiation 30%
syllabi.materials: Statistical Quality Control – A Modern Introduction; by D. Montgomery 東華書局 新月圖書

description.zh: 本課程適用於一般大專之決策分析課程。其目的在說明決策理論之基本觀念，及其在真實世界裡相關決策問題之分析。本課程授課主題包括：不考慮機率之決策問題、與機率有關之決策問題、獲取額外資訊之決策分析、效益分析、遊戲理論。相關之授課內容包括：機率分配、期望值方法、貝氏分析、完全資訊與額外資訊之期望值。
description.en:
This is an undergraduate course dealing with decison making and analysis.The objective of this course is to interpret the basic concepts of decision theory and its applications on some real world decision analysis problims.The main topics of this course include decision making without probability,decision making with probability,decison analysis with additional information,utility theory,game
theory.The related studies includes prlbability distribution,expected value approach,Bayesian analysis,expected value of perfect informatin and sample information.

syllabi.outline: This course provides an overview of the basic concepts of decision theory and their applications on the real-world decision problems. Students will learn about the identification and modeling of decision problems, the modeling and estimation of uncertainties, and the modeling and evaluation of preferences.
syllabi.schedule:
Week 1: Introduction
Week 2: Holiday (No class)
Week 3: Elements of decision problems
Week 4: Structuring decisions
Week 5: Making choices
Week 6: Sensitivity analysis
Week 7: Creativity and decision making
Week 8: Probability basics
Week 9: Mid-term exam
Week 10: Subjective probability
Week 11: Theoretical probability models
Week 12: Using data
Week 13: Monte Carlo simulation/Value of Information
Week 14: Risk attitudes
Week 15: Utility axioms, paradoxes, and implications
Week 16: Conflicting objectives I
Week 17: Conflicting objectives II
Week 18: Final exam
syllabi.assessment:
Mid-term exam: 25%
Final exam: 25%
Homework and Participation: 50%
syllabi.materials: Making hard decisions with DeccisionTools (2001) by Clemen and Reilly, Duxbury (雙葉)

description.zh: 本課程的目的將藉由五個面向了解企業倫理的本質，分別為：從全球化角度認知社會可接受的商業行為，將待人和善深植於良好的企業中，企業形象再造，強化職業倫理以及投資於可持續發展和有社會責任的公司。本課程亦教導學生瞭解今日快速變化工商界，符合企業倫理的公司治理原則與方式。課程的教導將朝下列五個方向進行：（1）廠商的社會責任（如：產品綠化與環境保護），（2）消費者的保護（如：產品的安全性），（3）員工的權益（如：職業健康），（4）員工對公司的責任（如：利益衝突），（5）雇主與員工關係（如：性別平等）。
description.en: The objective of this course is to appreciate the essential of Business Ethics through five main faucets: recognizing socially acceptable business conduct from the global perspectives, embedding good business in treating people nice and fair, reengineering corporate image, enhancing professional ethics, and investing in sustainable and socially responsible corporations. This course also discusses with the students the corporate governance that follows business ethics in today's changing business society. Five major categories will be covered: (1) Corporate Social Responsibility (e.g., Green product and environmental protection), (2) Consumer protection (e.g., Product safety), (3) Employee's rights and benefits (e.g., Occupational health), (4) Responsibility of employee to the firms (e.g., Conflict of interest), and (5) Employer-employee relations (e.g., Gender equity).

syllabi.outline:
課程旨在帶領學生於全球化多元的商業環境下，思維倫理在複雜的企業決策過程中所扮演之重要角色。引導學生認識企業倫理的內涵，並透過自編教材、教科書內容與個案探討，啟發學生對相關主題的興趣，體認企業倫理確實於日常生活中頻繁出現，而不僅為形而上的哲學觀。本課程擬藉由課堂的情境移轉，培養具有企業倫理的企業經理人。
本課程的目的將藉由五個面向了解企業倫理的本質，分別為：從全球化角度認知社會可接受的商業行為，將待人和善深植於良好的企業中，企業形象再造，強化職業倫理以及投資於可持續發展和有社會責任的公司。本課程亦教導學生瞭解今日快速變化工商界，符合企業倫理的公司治理原則與方式。課程的教導將朝下列五個方向進行：（1）廠商的社會責任（如：產品綠化與環境保護），（2）消費者的保護（如：產品的安全性），（3）員工的權益（如：職業健康），（4）員工對公司的責任（如：利益衝突），（5）雇主與員工關係（如：性別平等）。

Five major categories will be covered: (1) Corporate Social Responsibility (e.g., Green product and environmental protection), (2) Consumer protection (e.g., Product safety), (3) Employee's rights and benefits (e.g., Occupational health), (4) Responsibility of employee to the firms (e.g., Conflict of interest), and (5) Employer-employee relations (e.g., Gender equity).

本課程的目的將藉由五個面向了解企業倫理的本質，分別為：從全球化角度認知社會可接受的商業行為，將待人和善深植於良好的企業中，企業形象再造，強化職業倫理以及投資於可持續發展和有社會責任的公司。本課程亦教導學生瞭解今日快速變化工商界，符合企業倫理的公司治理原則與方式。課程的教導將朝下列五個方向進行：（1）廠商的社會責任（如：產品綠化與環境保護），（2）消費者的保護（如：產品的安全性），（3）員工的權益（如：職業健康），（4）員工對公司的責任（如：利益衝突），（5）雇主與員工關係（如：性別平等）。
The objective of this course is to appreciate the essential of Business Ethics through five main faucets: recognizing socially acceptable business conduct from the global perspectives, embedding good business in treating people nice and fair, reengineering corporate image, enhancing professional ethics, and investing in sustainable and socially responsible corporations. This course also discusses with the students the corporate governance that follows business ethics in today's changing business society. Five major categories will be covered: (1) Corporate Social Responsibility (e.g., Green product and environmental protection), (2) Consumer protection (e.g., Product safety), (3) Employee's rights and benefits (e.g., Occupational health), (4) Responsibility of employee to the firms (e.g., Conflict of interest), and (5) Employer-employee relations (e.g., Gender equity).

description.zh: 本課程在二技為品質管理。使學生瞭解品質管理的觀念、原理、領域。品管部門的組織、功能，如何管理產品或服務的品質，品管的工具、方法，如何持續改善品質的方法，品質表示法，如何評估品質管理成效，相關法令，品質管理未來趨勢。
description.en: This course lets the students understand the concepts, theories, and areas of qualify control, organization and functions of quality department.  Besides, the way to manage the products or the service quality, tools and methods of quality control, the way to improve the quality, quality representation method, evaluation of quality control, related regulations and future trends are also included.

syllabi.outline: This course enables students to understand the concepts, principles, and domains of quality management. It covers the organization and functions of the quality management department, how to manage the quality of products or services, quality management tools and methods, methods for continuous quality improvement, quality representation methods, how to evaluate the effectiveness of quality management, relevant regulations, and future trends in quality management. The course content includes quality responsibility, total quality management, basic statistics, control charts, probability theory, attribute control charts, acceptance sampling, reliability, and more.

syllabi.outline:
設計工學（Engineering Design）是一門跨學科的領域，結合工程學和設計學的原理，旨在創造功能性、美觀且實用的產品、系統和服務。其核心在於利用科學和工程知識解決實際問題，並通過創意設計滿足用戶需求。

本課程旨在培養學生設計工學的綜合能力，涵蓋從設計規劃、服務串接、配置發展、整合設計、設計驗證到工業化的設計理論與方法應用。

課程將以工學原理為基礎，從設計流程展開，對接最新的設計趨勢，如可持續設計、數位製造、物聯網、虛擬與擴增實境（VR/AR）和用戶體驗設計等技術。這些新技術正在擴展設計工學的專業範疇。課程將通過實際演練方式加深學生對這些概念的理解。

Engineering Design is an interdisciplinary field that combines principles from engineering and design to create functional, aesthetically pleasing, and practical products, systems, and services. Its core lies in using scientific and engineering knowledge to solve real-world problems and meet user needs through creative design.

This course aims to develop students' skills in design engineering, covering design planning, service integration, configuration development, integrated design, design verification, and industrial design.

The course follows engineering principles and design processes, connecting with trends like sustainable design, digital manufacturing, IoT, VR/AR, and user experience design. These technologies expand the scope of design engineering. Through practical applications, this course will deepen students' understanding of these concepts.

description.en: Basic Knowledge for Ergonomic

syllabi.outline: 本課程目的在於奠定人因工程學理基礎與應用觀念，建立「以人為本」的產品價值觀。本課程將介紹人體之形態特徵、心理期望、動作行為等人因知識，研究人因資訊應用於工業設計實務上之設計方法或準則以獲得具安全、效率與舒適之產品或環境設計。
syllabi.schedule:
人因工程是教大家設計符合人性化的產品啦！首先會講解人體的視覺、聽覺、觸覺跟認知特性，再來學習設計控制系統、了解人體尺寸和工具的人性化需求。也會談到人機互動、自動化系統的使用體驗，還有針對一些特殊領域像通用設計、玩具設計等單元。修完這門課就能掌握評估改善使用者體驗的方法，設計出貼心又方便的人機產品囉!

Course projects are chosen to give students an opportunity to use their creative, technical and theoretical skills in a business application. The primary emphasis is on the use of a systematic process for the design and development of products.

syllabi.outline:
本課程綜合了室內設計的所有基礎課程，包括室內設計基本原理、基礎製圖、施工圖、手繪透視渲染、電腦3D渲染、建築結構、室內建築、裝飾材料、園林綠化、室內園藝等課程。 主要重點是激發創造力的培訓。 透過實際的設計練習，學生將學習設計方法和解決問題的技巧，同時開發相應的工業設計產品。
This course integrated all foundational courses in interior design, including basic principles of interior design, basic drafting, construction drawings, hand-drawn perspective rendering, computer 3D rendering, architectural structure, interior architecture, decorative materials, and courses in landscaping and interior gardening. The primary focus is on training that stimulates creativity. Through practical design exercises, students will learn design methods and problem-solving skills while developing corresponding industrial design products concurrently.

期末設計發表(第八周) PPT發表－階段設計表現評量重點40%
1.主題價值－主題命名、主題與設計創作契合度

5.平面配置整體表現－室內分區／隔間、家具／設備；室外敷地／景觀等設計創意與圖法溝通表現(需包涵天花板／燈具、弱電、冷氣配置平面)
6.色彩與材質運用創意與溝通表現

This course focuses on the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) of the United Nations. According to the design thinking method, the problem-based learning (Problem-based Learning) model, empathy analysis, problem thinking with definition, creative thinking, Through the operation of classroom lectures, ex-situ teaching, and design thinking workshops, it is expected to cultivate students' problem-solving ability, and participate in relevant design competitions or fund-raising platforms through innovative proposals.
課程大綱有四大重點
1.講述介紹SDGs、循環設計、ESG、CSR、USR及社會設計的案例，讓學生了解現有趨勢性政策，並引導各組專案朝該方向執行設計。
2.移地觀展，至松菸文化園區觀展增廣視野，目的在透過觀展，可在小組提案之前吸收不同的觀點及培養觀察力。
3.邀請新創公司業師演講-分享永續產品開發設計的歷程，讓學生能夠從實際案例中參考學習。
4.永續設計工作坊主題討論:邀請循環台灣基金會舉辦實體工作坊、用工業循環和生物循環的實際問題，讓學生思考如何改善；後續課程以(Problem-based Learning)為主軸，透過師生互動定義SDG、解決在地社會問題相關主題，並提出創新設計解方，報名SDGs、永續循環、科技應用相關主題之競賽、展覽或募資平台，創造影響力。

description.zh:
本課程分四年（八學期）教授， 四學年課程培養的核心專業能力如下: 
■	第一年 : 以建築設計的基礎為範疇。
訓練造型基礎，包括尺度、比例﹑秩序與韻律、實虛、量體與空間等造型的基本設計能力。                                                                                                                                        
■	第二年 ：以人與空間為範疇，並學習建築的內部構成要素。
在具備設計基礎能力之後，進一步接觸建築的基本向度與原理的設計練習，包括身體與空間、使用行為模式、建築物理環境、構造與結構系統、建築構成系統、建築的類型與形態。  
■	第三年 ：都市建築為主要範疇。
將建築的關注聚焦到與其連結的環境系統或城市紋理，學習從外部環境或都市理論回饋到建築的規劃設計。
第四年：即畢業設計，培養學生針對特定建築問題之探究能力，鼓勵以建築思索如何關注社會、文化與自然的課題，最終以設計方案回應之。

syllabi.outline:
本課程分三年（六學期）教授，各學年課程教授內容如下：
第一學年課程視為建築設計之基礎課題，從建築美學之觀點培養基本素養、建築模樣體驗、設計實作再造，達到建築設計基本知識之體態。並結合一年級橫向課程之實作、圖學、設計理論、全能住宅改造等課程，課程規劃以多元建構為主，其養成要點如下:

1. 美學再創造：基本美學素養養成，將感知中的聽覺、視覺、觸覺等與美學體驗再度結合，用思考轉換形式。奠定日後進入空間美學基礎。

2. 建築繪圖與表現技巧：建築相關圖學與識圖展現養成，體驗空間感受與空間掌握，美學與繪圖思考整合。

3. 空間構成與思維邏輯：將2D轉為3D，藉由點、線、面、體之基本元素，將環境觀察或是感知等邏輯分析，呈現空間的比例、尺度或透過實作技術等理論，重構思維進一步與環境共構將空間再塑。

4. 設計實務養成：為因應環境友善，與環境共存之議題如何運用在設計之中，探討行為模式、機能、線安排空間組織等等，將環境之感受能力，以空間再改造展現能力，由於重於綠材料之實作特色，因此實作養成之重要關鍵之一，需配合全能改造課程。達到創作性實務，可說是實驗性實作的特色課程。

5.材料與構築實驗：體驗材料之特性，將材料之特性發揮到極限。

This course is organized, as a three-year's program that is arranged around a pattern of six semesters. The modular teaching structure is:1. First year - An introduction to basic design problem solving : concepts of point, line, plane, and space organization : principles of unity/variety ,order ,balance , proportion ,scale , etc.; orthographic projection and axonometrics ; pattern diagramming ; and basic design consequences of human activity. 

The course as the fundamental of architectural design aims to foster basic knowledge from the perspective of architectural aesthetics, experience, and design execution. Combined with the lateral curriculum of construction, drawing, design theory, and housing renewal projects, the program built upon diversified exposures in


1. aesthetics, 
2. architectural drawings and rendering techniques, 
3. Spatial constructs and logics, 
4. Professional training, 
5. materials and experiments, 
6. communication and presentation.

本課程分三年（六學期）教授，各學年課程教授內容如下：
第一學年課程視為建築設計之基礎課題，從建築美學之觀點培養基本素養、建築模樣體驗、設計實作再造，達到建築設計基本知識之體態。並結合一年級橫向課程之實作、圖學、設計理論、全能住宅改造等課程，課程規劃以多元建構為主，其養成要點如下:

1. 美學再創造：基本美學素養養成，將感知中的聽覺、視覺、觸覺等與美學體驗再度結合，用思考轉換形式。奠定日後進入空間美學基礎。

2. 建築繪圖與表現技巧：建築相關圖學與識圖展現養成，體驗空間感受與空間掌握，美學與繪圖思考整合。

3. 空間構成與思維邏輯：將2D轉為3D，藉由點、線、面、體之基本元素，將環境觀察或是感知等邏輯分析，呈現空間的比例、尺度或透過實作技術等理論，重構思維進一步與環境共構將空間再塑。

4. 設計實務養成：為因應環境友善，與環境共存之議題如何運用在設計之中，探討行為模式、機能、線安排空間組織等等，將環境之感受能力，以空間再改造展現能力，由於重於綠材料之實作特色，因此實作養成之重要關鍵之一，需配合全能改造課程。達到創作性實務，可說是實驗性實作的特色課程。

5.材料與構築實驗：體驗材料之特性，將材料之特性發揮到極限。

This course is organized, as a three-year's program that is arranged around a pattern of six semesters. The modular teaching structure is:1. First year - An introduction to basic design problem solving : concepts of point, line, plane, and space organization : principles of unity/variety ,order ,balance , proportion ,scale , etc.; orthographic projection and axonometrics ; pattern diagramming ; and basic design consequences of human activity. 

The course as the fundamental of architectural design aims to foster basic knowledge from the perspective of architectural aesthetics, experience, and design execution. Combined with the lateral curriculum of construction, drawing, design theory, and housing renewal projects, the program built upon diversified exposures in


1. aesthetics, 
2. architectural drawings and rendering techniques, 
3. Spatial constructs and logics, 
4. Professional training, 
5. materials and experiments, 
6. communication and presentation.

syllabi.outline:
本課程分三年（六學期）教授，各學年課程教授內容如下：

第一學年—主要在教導學生對美學基本素養、空間的體驗及空間構成演練，使具備建築設計之基本能力與知識，其主要授課要點如下：
一、基本設計訓練及空間的體驗：1.設計基本原理的認識與操作。2.空間經驗的掌握與表達。
二、空間的構成：1.基本元素的應用--線、版、體。2.比例、尺度、材質與構造的訓練。3.開口及光影的表現。4.空間的界定與串連。
三、空間與造型：1.空間與造型的關係。2.量體與空間、造型。3.結構概念與空間、造型。
四、機能與組織：1.行為模式分析。2.機能與動線安排。3.空間的組織。

第二學年—主要在教導學生探討空間組織、造型與行為模式等使學生具備整合建築設計相關知識及操作之能力，其主要授課要點如下：
1.在範圍上--以各種使用性質的單棟建築為主題。
2.在設計內容上--進一步探討空間組織、造型、行為特性及模式。
3.在實質因素上--訓練對基地實質環境的認識及掌握，並著重材料、構造、設備、結構等系統的結合。
4.在實務人才的養成上--具備整合建築設計相關專業知識及操作的能力。

第三學年—主要在教導學生對環境或都市之認知，並使其具備細部設計以至整體建築設計及監造之能力，以銜接未來之實務。

syllabi.outline:
本課程分四年（八學期）教授， 四學年課程培養的核心專業能力如下: 
■	第一年 : 以建築設計的基礎為範疇。
訓練造型基礎，包括尺度、比例﹑秩序與韻律、實虛、量體與空間等造型的基本設計能力。                                                                                                                                        
■	第二年 ：以人與空間為範疇，並學習建築的內部構成要素。
在具備設計基礎能力之後，進一步接觸建築的基本向度與原理的設計練習，包括身體與空間、使用行為模式、建築物理環境、構造與結構系統、建築構成系統、建築的類型與形態。  
■	第三年 ：都市建築為主要範疇。
將建築的關注聚焦到與其連結的環境系統或城市紋理，學習從外部環境或都市理論回饋到建築的規劃設計。
第四年：即畢業設計，培養學生針對特定建築問題之探究能力，鼓勵以建築思索如何關注社會、文化與自然的課題，最終以設計方案回應之。
This four-year course will be taught within eight semesters and aims to train students in the core competencies as follows:
■ First year: foundations of architectural design
Training of fundamental modeling, including basic designing concepts such as scale, proportion, order and rhythm, solid and void, volume, and space
■ Second year: people and space, and internal elements of architecture
Beyond competency in elementary design, further practicing basic aspects and principles of architecture design, including human body and space, user behavior model, physical environment of buildings, construction and structure system, architectural composition system, architectural type and form, etc.
■ Third year: Urban architecture
Focus of environmental system or urban structure relating to architecture, which helps students apply what they have learned from the external environment or urban theory to the planning and design of buildings
■ Fourth year: Graduation project

syllabi.outline:
本課程分三年（六學期）教授，各學年課程教授內容如下：
第一學年—主要在教導學生對美學基本素養、空間的體驗及空間構成演練，使具備建築設計之基本能力與知識，其主要授課要點如下：
一、基本設計訓練及空間的體驗：1.設計基本原理的認識與操作。2.空間經驗的掌握與表達。
二、空間的構成：1.基本元素的應用--線、版、體。2.比例、尺度、材質與構造的訓練。3.開口及光影的表現。4.空間的界定與串連。
三、空間與造型：1.空間與造型的關係。2.量體與空間、造型。3.結構概念與空間、造型。
四、機能與組織：1.行為模式分析。2.機能與動線安排。3.空間的組織。

第二學年—主要在教導學生探討空間組織、造型與行為模式等使學生具備整合建築設計相關知識及操作之能力，其主要授課要點如下：
1.在範圍上--以各種使用性質的單棟建築為主題。
2.在設計內容上--進一步探討空間組織、造型、行為特性及模式。
3.在實質因素上--訓練對基地實質環境的認識及掌握，並著重材料、構造、設備、結構等系統的結合。
4.在實務人才的養成上--具備整合建築設計相關專業知識及操作的能力。

第三學年—主要在教導學生對環境或都市之認知，並使其具備細部設計以至整體建築設計及監造之能力，以銜接未來之實務。

syllabi.outline:
本課程分四年（八學期）教授， 四學年課程培養的核心專業能力如下: 
■	第一年 : 以建築設計的基礎為範疇。
訓練造型基礎，包括尺度、比例﹑秩序與韻律、實虛、量體與空間等造型的基本設計能力。                                                                                                                                        
■	第二年 ：以人與空間為範疇，並學習建築的內部構成要素。
在具備設計基礎能力之後，進一步接觸建築的基本向度與原理的設計練習，包括身體與空間、使用行為模式、建築物理環境、構造與結構系統、建築構成系統、建築的類型與形態。  
■	第三年 ：都市建築為主要範疇。
將建築的關注聚焦到與其連結的環境系統或城市紋理，學習從外部環境或都市理論回饋到建築的規劃設計。
第四年：即畢業設計，培養學生針對特定建築問題之探究能力，鼓勵以建築思索如何關注社會、文化與自然的課題，最終以設計方案回應之。
This four-year course will be taught within eight semesters and aims to train students in the core competencies as follows:
■ First year: foundations of architectural design
Training of fundamental modeling, including basic designing concepts such as scale, proportion, order and rhythm, solid and void, volume, and space
■ Second year: people and space, and internal elements of architecture
Beyond competency in elementary design, further practicing basic aspects and principles of architecture design, including human body and space, user behavior model, physical environment of buildings, construction and structure system, architectural composition system, architectural type and form, etc.
■ Third year: Urban architecture
Focus of environmental system or urban structure relating to architecture, which helps students apply what they have learned from the external environment or urban theory to the planning and design of buildings
■ Fourth year: Graduation project

description.zh: 本課程介紹室外空間設計和建造的理論、原則和方法。 通過案例研究，課程旨在擴大學生對場地規劃主要組成部分的理解。主題集中在六個前提：1。 場地規劃相關理論； 2． 場地規劃的設計順序； 3． 場地調查與分析； 4． 規劃設計方法及其評價； 5． 環境影響評價；6.案例研究。
description.en: This course introduces the theories, principles, and methods of designing and construction of outdoor spaces. Through cases studies, the courses seeks to expand the students understanding to the major components of site planning.Topics focus on six premises:1. theories in relation to site planning;2. design sequences of site planning;3. investigations and analyses of the sites;4. planning and designing methods and their evaluations;5. environmental impact assessment;6.cases studies.

syllabi.outline:
本課程主要在教授建築物外部空間的分析、規劃與營造方法，內容包括理論、實際案例說明與實作。授課主題涵蓋：1.敷地計畫之相關理論、2.敷地計畫之內容及程序、3.基地調查及分析、4.規劃方法與計畫評估（包括土地使用、外部空間、交通動線、排水、整地、植栽）、5.環境影響評估、6.案例分析。實作部分則將結合USR計劃之進行，讓學生能從實際操作與真實課題中拓展學習的深度。
This course introduces the theories, principles, and methods of analyzing and planning the exterior space of buildings. Instructional forms include lecture, case studies, and hands-on practice. The topics covered in the course are as follows: 1. Relevant theories of site planning. 2. Content and procedures of site planning. 3. Site investigation and analysis. 4. Planning methods and project evaluation (including land use, external spaces, traffic flow, drainage, landscaping). 5. Environmental impact assessment. 6. Case studies. In specific, the case study and hands-on practice of this course will be integrated with the program of USR (University Social Responsibility), allowing students to expand their learning depth through practical application and real-world issues.

description.zh: 一、 本課程目的在使同學認識與了解台灣傳統建築歷史、文化、技術之精髓所在，進而增進建築設計運用傳統建築思想與素材之能力。二、 講述內容包括台灣史前、原住民、荷西、明鄭、清代與近現代等建築之形成與型態變遷過程。三、 講述方式以幻燈片介紹為主，學期中並安排兩次實地參訪。
description.en: 1. This course is based on the belief that： to recognized and understanding of the historical 、culture and technique in the Taiwan Traditional Architecture. 2. The scope of the course are include the styles and changes in prehistorically period, aboriginal, Dutch colonialist, Ch'ing Dynasty and contemporary Taiwan Traditional Architecture. 3. The methods of the course are slides shows and to visit the historical sites

syllabi.outline: 本課程為大三（職二件四）以上修習傳統建築的專題課程。上課方式以演講為主，藉由文獻、圖片的介紹，概述台灣地區傳統建築的發展歷程，以及就其建築類型，概述其形式的社會文化根源。另外，配合傳統建築實例的參觀，期使同學除了對台灣住居文化的發展由來脈絡瞭解之外，並培養其對身處環境的關心與地方文化的涵養。

description.zh: 本課程以建築專業回應社會需求為依歸。針對台灣原住民部落之返鄉青年之居住與生產模式提出各項議題討論。藉由社區總體營造與民眾參與等方式，以一學期的進程發展新的部落建築形式與配置計畫，並在永續發展與保育並重的前提下，提出實質開發與營造施工的前期規劃。
description.en: his course introduces the theories, principles, and methods of designing and construction for local social issues in Taiwan. In this year, Focuses on the Settlements of aboriginal people, through cases studies and design practice, the courses seeks to expand the students understanding to the major components of site planning. The topics also focus on six premises:1.theories in relation to site planning;2.design sequences of site planning;3.investigations and analyses of the sites;4.planning and designing methods and their evaluations;5.environmental impact assessment and countermeasures.

syllabi.outline: 本課程教學主要是帶領同學探索建築相關的各種社會議題，並具體以實際參與之設計基地為案例，透過分組討論提出各項改善設計方案，並藉由USR計畫的參與，以一學期的進程發展新的空間形式與營造計畫，並在永續發展與保育並重的前提下，提出實質開發與營造施工的前期規劃。

description.zh:
先修課程:負責教授同意
先修課程：負責教授同意。自動控制數學基礎，物理系統的數學模式，控制器的種類，時域分析，穩定性分析，根軌跡法，頻率領域的分析，控制系統的設計。
description.en: Mathematical Foundation of Automatic Control, Mathematical Model of Physical System, Controller Type, Time-Domain Analysis, Stability Analysis, Root Locus Method, Frequency-Domain Analysis, Design of Control System.

syllabi.outline:
先修課程:負責教授同意
控制系統簡介、時域建模、多次系統簡化、時間響應、穩定性、穩態誤差、根軌跡、頻域建模、頻率響應。並將以車輛控制與電力控制為例，說明控制器的應用與設計，並將簡介軌道車輛集電弓控制與TCMS的控制觀念。
syllabi.schedule:
1	Introduction of Control System (控制系統簡介)(Ex. TCMS)
2	Dynamic Models (時域建模) (Ex. 車輛控制、電力控制、集電弓控制)
3	Review of Laplace Transform (時間響應)
4	Effect of Pole and Zero Locations (多次系統簡化)
5	Routh's Stability Criterion (穩定性)
6	Basic Properties of Feedback (穩態誤差)
7. 	Basic Properties of Feedback (Ex. 車輛控制、電力控制、集電弓控制)
8	翻轉作業期中報告
9	Midterm Exam
10	Guidelines for Sketching a Root Locus
11	Dynamic Compensations - Rootlocus
12	Dynamic Compensations - Rootlocus (for complex systems)
13	Frequency Response
14	Bode Plot (頻域建模、多次系統簡化、穩態誤差)
15	Nyquist Criterion and Stability Margin (穩定性)
16	Dynamic Compensations – Frequency Resp.
17	翻轉作業期末報告
18	Final Exam

syllabi.outline:
先修課程:物理或負責教授同意
本課程介紹流體力學，強調應用於流體機械系統的基本工程科學原理。學生將學習粘性和非粘性流體的控制積分和微分方程，並將這些方程應用於內部和外部流動。
This course provides an introduction to fluid mechanics. It stresses fundamental engineering science principles applied to fluid mechanical systems. Students will learn the governing integral and differential equations for viscous and inviscid fluids and will apply these equations to internal and external flows.

syllabi.outline:
先修課程:負責教授同意
本課程在應用計算方法來解決工程問題，重點將放在理解各種數值方法背後的基本概念，使用MATLAB環境來實現基本數值方法，以及利用複雜的數值方法來建構MATLAB函數。
This course is to teach you how to apply computational methodologies to solve engineering problems when no analytical solution exists. Emphasis will be placed on understanding the basic concepts behind the various numerical methods, implementing basic numerical methods using the MATLAB structured programming environment, and utilizing more sophisticated numerical methods provided as built-in MATLAB functions.

syllabi.outline:
Heat and Mass Transfer is a vital subject for mechanical, chemical, production, aeronautical 
and metallurgical engineering disciplines. As a result of its multidisciplinary nature, it has 
many engineering applications. This course will introduce to students basic understanding of 
heat and mass transfer processes and their application to engineering problems. T
syllabi.schedule:
Week 1.  INTRODUCTION – Typical heat transfer situations, Modes of heat transfer Introduction to laws, some heat transfer parameters 
Week 2.  CONDUCTION – Fourier’s law and thermal conductivity 1 hour 
Differential equation of heat conduction, boundary conditions and initial conditions 
Week 3.  Simple one dimensional steady state situations – plane wall, cylinder, sphere (simple and compex situations), concept of thermal resistance, concept of U, critical radius. variable thermal conductivity (exercise) 3 hours 
Week 4.  Special one dimensional steady state situations – heat generation, pin fins Other fin configurations (exercise) 
Week 5.  Two dimensional steady state situations 
Transient conduction Lumped capacitance model One dimensional transient problems – analytical solutions One dimensional Heisler charts Product solution 
Week 6.  Numerical methods in conduction Steady state one dimensional and two dimensional problems One dimensional transient problems – Explicit and implicit 
Week 7.  RADIATION Basic ideas, spectrum, basic definitions 1 hour 
Laws of radiation, black body radiation, Planck’s law, Stefan Boltzman law, Wien’s Displacement law, Lambert cosine law 
Week 8.  Convection heat transfer
FORCED CONVECTION Concepts of fluid mechanics  
Differential equation of heat convection  
Week 9. Mid term
Week 10.  Laminar flow heat transfer in circular pipe – constant heat flux and constant wall temperature, thermal entrance region, Turbulent flow heat transfer in circular pipe, pipes of other cross sections  
Week 11.  Heat transfer in laminar flow and turbulent flow over a flat plate, Reynolds analogy, Flow across a cylinder and sphere, flow across banks of tubes, impinging jets 
Week 12.  NATURAL CONVECTION Introduction, governing equations,Vertical plate – Pohlhausen solution, horizontal cylinder, horizontal plate, enclosed spaces  
Week 13.  HEAT EXCHANGERS Types of heat exchangers, LMTD approach – parallel, counter-flow, multi-pass and cross flow heat exchanger, NTU approach – parallel, counterflow, shell and tube, cross flow heat exchanger 
Week 14.  Condensation and Boiling Dimensionless parameters, boiling modes, correlations, 
Week 15.  Forced convection boiling, laminar film condensation on a vertical plate, turbulent film condensation  
Week 16.  Mass Transfer Analogy between heat and mass transfer, mass diffusion, Fick’s law of diffusion, boundary conditions, 
week 17.  steady mass diffusion through a wall, transient mass diffusion, mass convection, limitations of heat and mass transfer analogy. 
Week 18 final term

description.zh: 本課程將介紹冷凍工程，以及其設計，內容涵蓋如下：冷凍工程原理，冷凍系統之設備，各種冷凍系統之設計，冷凍負荷計算，冷媒管路之設計與計算，冷凍庫之設計。
description.en: This course introduces the refrigeration engineering and its system design; the contents cover the following topics: the principles of refrigeration engineering, the equipment and designs of different refrigeration systems, refrigeration load calculations, design and calculation of refrigerant piping, and refrigeration storage design.

syllabi.outline:
本課程屬於流體力學之應用學科，課程內容著重於如何將流體力學的基本原理應用到廣泛使用之流體機械上。其中各章節將介紹各種常用流體機械之結構、操作原理及其分類、相關之流體力學基本原理、定律，以及特性曲線之使用。透過本課程之介紹期望使學生能對流體機械之工作有深刻的瞭解，並知曉如何設計相關之流路或管線以及選用適當之流體機械。教材大綱: 分流力(基本定律、管流、流體量測)、水力機械(泵、水輪機)、空氣機械(送風機、風車)、排量型機械等四大主題來教學。
This course belongs to the applied discipline of fluid mechanics. The content of the course focuses on how to apply the basic principles of fluid mechanics to widely used fluid machinery. Each chapter will introduce the structure, operating principle and classification of various commonly used fluid machinery, related basic principles and laws of fluid mechanics, and the use of characteristic curves. Through the introduction of this course, students are expected to have a deep understanding of the work of fluid machinery, and know how to design related flow paths or pipelines and select appropriate fluid machinery.
This course belongs to the applied discipline of fluid mechanics. The content of the course focuses on how to apply the basic principles of fluid mechanics to widely used fluid machinery. Each chapter will introduce the structure, operating principle and classification of various commonly used fluid machinery, related basic principles and laws of fluid mechanics, and the use of characteristic curves. Through the introduction of this course, students are expected to have a deep understanding of the work of fluid machinery, and know how to design related flow paths or pipelines and select appropriate fluid machinery. Textbook syllabus: Four major themes for teaching are shunt force (basic law, pipe flow, fluid measurement), hydraulic machinery (pump, turbine), air machinery (blower, windmill), and displacement machinery.

description.zh: 本課程介紹語言教學與學習原則，語言習得理論，和語言習得領域重要研究發現。期能建立學生應用語言學知識與日後相關研究的基礎。課程涵蓋主要內容包括：母語習得理論與實踐、第二語言(外語)習得理論與實踐、母語習得與第二語言(外語)習得之相同與相異處、影響語言習得重要因素(情性因素與社會文化因素)、語言學習者策略、對比分析、錯誤分析、語言溝通能力、閱讀理論與實踐、 寫作理論與實踐。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to provide an overview of the current state of second language acquisition studies and to familiarize students with major language acquisition theories and fundamental principles of language learning and teaching.  The topics that this course primarily deals with include: theories of first language acquisition; theories of second language acquisition; current issues in language acquisition; age and acquisition; learning styles and learner strategies; affective factors in second language acquisition; socio-cultural factors in second language acquisition; learner language and error analysis; communicative competence; the reading process; and the writing process.

description.en: This course is designed to enable students to develop the principles and skills necessary for public speaking. Included will be guidelines for giving a speech and displaying body language, and practices for prepared speech and impromptu speech.

syllabi.outline:
Course Title:		Public Speaking and Debates
Credit Hours:		2
Instructor’s Name:	Dr. Yun-Hua Yang
Contact E-Mail:	yhyang@ntut.edu.tw
Office: 	        General Education Building Rm.805 / Extension: 3941
Term Offered:		Fall, 2024
Course Description: 	This course aims to establish the foundation for English-major students to deliver public speeches in English. Students learn to select topics, collect essential information, analyze the audience, organize materials, improve delivery skills, distinguish different types of speeches, and further to evaluate their own and others’ speeches. Each student is expected to deliver at least 3-4 individual speeches, and 2-3 debates. Speech topics will be discussed and assigned to students. Any modifications of the speech topics will have to be approved by the instructor. All student speech sessions must be videotaped.(see note 1) 
Course Requirements: 	Students’ responsibilities in this class include:
(1)	Attending class regularly and to arrive on time: 
(2)	Delivering speeches as scheduled: 
i.	Students who are scheduled to give an in-class speech (for official grading) need to record a pre-speech on the scheduled day. (see note 2)
ii.	Make-up speech will be only allowed when the failure to perform is due to an officially excused absence or incidents under extreme circumstances
iii.	The ideal time duration for each speech is 4 to 6 minutes. The minimum length of speech time is 3 minutes, and the maximum 6. Violation of the time limit (less than 3 and more than 6) constitutes a failure w/o points awarded. The time length for debates will vary due to the different formats employed.
iv.	It is essential to comply with the prescriptive requirements for each speech. Failure to follow will result in disqualification to complete the speech 
(3)	Submitting to the instructor a speech file with inclusion of the outlined speech as well as the full-length speech script (with citation and references), the speech evaluation sheet, the self-evaluating commentaries of both the current and previous speeches, and also blank A-4 size lined sheets for notes and feedbacks(see Appendix 1 & 2) when presenting the speech. Students who do not have the file ready and fail to comply with the outline format requirements (sampled and specified below_Appendix 3) forfeit the right to deliver the speech and hence receive zero points.  
(4)	Student speakers are also required to display their outline slide(s) during the speech. 
(5)	Evaluating one’s own speech (by the self-evaluation guideline): Student speakers are required to watch their own videotaped speeches (both pre-speech and in-class speech) observe their own speeches, and compile all speech and debate evaluation for submission. Students are strongly advised to use their own videotaping devices for both the pre and in-class speeches. Post-class recordings will be arranged and produced in the Lab, if necessary. A complete portfolio (preferably on compact disc) including all recordings is required for submission at the semester end.

description.zh: 本課程介紹研究方法和論文寫作知識，期能培養學生獨立研究和撰寫學術報告、論文的基本能力。主要分為三部份：（一）研究內涵與步驟,（二）主要的研究方法,（三）如何撰寫英文論文及報告。涵蓋主題包括：運用圖書館資源選擇研究主題、研究計劃的撰寫、問卷調查法、訪問法、觀察法、田野工作研究方法、文獻資料分析法（內容分析法）、個案研究法、相關研究法、實驗法、文學研究法，研究報告論文格式與寫作要領，如何撰寫文獻探討，參考書目寫法等。
description.en: This course aims at providing students with the fundamental knowledge and competence that they will need in doing research and writing research papers.  Its main purpose is to familiarize students with methods, procedures, and techniques that are applicable to quantitative and qualitative research as well as to improve their ability to write research papers.  The main topics for instruction include: the research process; major research methods; and the structure of a research paper.  The research methods primarily studied include the experimental method, descriptive research, ethnography, case study, observation, survey research (questionnaire and interviews), content analysis/documentary analysis, and critical approaches to literature.

syllabi.outline: This course aims at providing students with the fundamental knowledge and competence that they will need in doing research and writing research papers.  Its main purpose is to familiarize students with methods, procedures, and techniques that are applicable to quantitative and qualitative research as well as to improve their ability to write research papers.  The main topics for instruction include: the research process; major research methods; and the structure of a research paper.  The research methods primarily studied include the experimental method, descriptive research, ethnography, case study, observation, survey research (questionnaire and interviews), content analysis/documentary analysis, and critical approaches to literature.
syllabi.schedule:
1. Introduction to Research:
Different types of research / What is a research paper? 
2. Research Design:
What makes a good research question? / Online resources
3. Data Collection & Coding: 
Audio- and video-recorded data, experiments, questionnaires & interviews, observation, etc. 
4. Using Computers to Study Texts:
Corpora & discourse analysis; compiling your own corpus
5. Analyzing Quantitative Data & Statistics
6. Analyzing Qualitative Data 
7. APA Style & Citing Sources
8. Project Presentation

description.zh: 經理需要以現代管理必要的 "資訊-基礎"來支持，俾使達到和滿足(相遇)他們的組織目標。管理資訊系統(MIS) 是整合使用者和機構系統，用以提供一個組織之操作支援，管理分析，和決策功能。我們以學習資訊工作者的角色，幫助經理滿足(相遇)組織目標， 以及檢查資訊系統的特徵，使經理工作更容易順暢。學習主題：透過資訊系統獲取策略優勢、透過資訊系統應用，支持經理和執行、管理固有的冒險，俾使發展和資訊系統應用、獲得和實踐技術性領導
description.en: The need for information-based support for managers is increasing as the modern management imperatives of reach and to meet their organization's goals. A management information system (MIS) is an integrated user + Machine system that provides information to support operations, management analysis, and decision- making functions in an organization. We will also look at the role in formation play in helping managers meet goals by examining the characteristics of information systems that make managers' job easier. Topic of learning:‧Acquiring strategic advantage through information systems.‧Supporting managers and executives through IS applications.‧Managing the risk inherent in developing and using IS applications.‧Attaining and practicing technological leadership.

description.zh: 本課程主要了解行銷研究的本質與特性，掌握行銷研究要領，進而具備規劃與執行行銷研究的能力，包含下列：行銷研究的環境與基本觀念，網路資料庫介紹，資料蒐集模式與方法，問卷設計與抽樣，量表製作，資料分析，研究成果呈現與溝通。
description.en: This course aims to help participants understand the nature and features of marketing research, realize how to conduct marketing research, and develop a toolset for the planning and implementation of marketing research. It has the followings: Background of Marketing Research, Introduction to Marketing Research, Database and Data Collection: Types and Methods, Measurement Instruments and Sampling, Data Analysis, Communicating with Research Users

syllabi.outline: This course is meticulously designed to enhance undergraduate students' understanding and proficiency in leveraging marketing research for informed decision-making. The technological advancements of the 21st century, notably the advent of the Google search engine, the proliferation of social media, and the integration of artificial intelligence (AI), have profoundly reshaped our world. Since 2022, generative AI has become a dominant force in human life. Throughout this course, we will explore global market trends and their implications for career advancement. Emphasis will be placed on qualitative marketing research analysis, with in-depth case studies, theoretical frameworks, and methodological applications examined in class.

description.zh: 深入探討財務報表分析課題之相關研究，說明並解釋在財務報表資料下所引導的財務資訊的需求與供給，財務報表上會計數字的經濟與財務意涵，以及財務報表資訊與其相關管理決策之應用。
description.en: The objects are that providing an intensive study of financial statement analysis, describing and explaining those demand and supply forces underlying the provision of financial statement data, and addressing the implications of accounting number derived from financial statement and the financial information related to the managerial decisions.

在授課過程或課堂討論充分的對話是有效學習的關鍵, 主動與建設性的互動與是學習者最基本的權與義務. 重點在於表達，並無絕對的對或錯, 而是在於希望透過學生彼此斷地提出問題與回答問題, 讓相同或相的剖析與了解相互激盪, 使得授課或討議題可以持續且深入地討, 進而釐清關鍵問題.

 以下幾點可作為衡是否有效地進主動與建設性的與: (1)積極傾聽, (2)勇於表達與議題攸關且具附加價值的意, (3)建設性地質疑, 以及(4)整合或揉合相
同或相的述; 總體表現將反映在「課程與」的成績上

考試目的在於測試學習者對個別觀與整體架構的解程, 包括課程講授, 教科書閱, 以及課堂討等內容, 以衡個別差, 並作為教學溝通效果之依據.
考試是測試學習者應該知道的課程內容, 只要有積極與課程學習者, 無須過憂慮.

description.zh: 訓練學生應用統計套裝軟體進行資料整理、陳列、分析、解釋及統計推論，以建立學生使用統計套裝軟體進行統計資料分析之能力。課程主題包括敘述統計之圖表製作、假設檢定、信賴區間、變異數分析和迴歸模型。學期末，學生應能以標準統計分析程序，分析商業資料，並根據統計分析之結果，建議可行之企業決策。
description.en:
This course reviews and expands upon core topics in probability and
statistics through the study and practice of data analysis. Topics
include numerical and graphical summaries of data, hypothesis testing,
confidence intervals, analysis of variance, and regression. Upon
completion of this course, students should be able to think critically
about data and apply standard statistical inference procedures to draw
conclusions from such analysis.

description.zh: 本課程之設計，以介紹資料庫之概念與技術為主。課程重點為關聯式資料庫的相關概念與技術。本課程包括下列主題：資料庫系統簡介、紀錄儲存與檔案組織、索引檔案結構、關聯性模型、關聯性幾何及演算、SQL查詢語言、關聯式資料庫設計、功能相依性、正規化處理、查詢語言最佳化處理、資料庫系統技術。進階主題包含物件導向資料庫、多媒體資料庫、分散式資料庫、資料庫之平行操作相關問題等。
description.en: This course is designed to introduce concepts and skills essential in the database systems. Relational database will be the main focus with related topics such as relational model, design concepts, and structured query language. The topics to be covered include: introduction to database systems, record storage and file organizations, indexed structures for files, the relational model, relational algebra and calculus, SQL, conceptual and logical design for relational database, functional dependencies, normalization, query optimization and database technology. Advanced topics include object-oriented database, multimedia database, distributed database, and concurrent operations on database.

description.zh: 先修課程：普通物理、工程數學。 從黑體輻射之頻譜分析開始，引入量子化的概念；進而推出物質與波動之二象性。經由波爾之半古典的氫原子模型，結合量子化的概念以解釋原子結構，並引入薛丁格方程式所求得之波函數與電子之空間機率的關係。再由原子進而推廣至分子及固態物理之能帶理論，應用能帶理論於解釋固態晶體之光、電及熱學等特性，並介紹半導體之應用的基本原理。
description.en: From the analysis of the spectrum of black-body radiation, the concept of quantization is introduced and the duality of matter and wave is also introduced. Combining the idea of quantization and the semi-classical hydrogen model of Bohr, the structure of atom is described. Solving the Schrodinger equation, the deduced wave function is related to the probability of finding the electron in space. The concept of atom is expanded to the molecular and the energy band theory of solid state physics. The energy band theory of solid state physics is applied to account the optical, electrical, and thermal properties of solid states, also the fundamental principles of semiconductors are introduced.

description.en: This course introduces the fundamental characteristics of lasers and the applications of lasers in optics. It includes the experiments of the temporal and spatial characteristics of lasers, the mode distribution of lasers, interference, diffraction, and the abberations of lenses.

syllabi.outline: 光電實驗的目的在使同學能藉由各個實驗的操作體驗光電工程系所開設光電專業課程的內容，以了解光的基本特性、光電之相關應用、及熟悉各種光電元件和儀器之操作。課程設計共分6個單元、含20個實驗，上下學期各操作3個單元、各含10個實驗。而上學期的光電實驗(一)是以光電的基礎理論的相關實驗為主。

description.zh: 本課程內容在於特定文化的探掘與介紹，並藉由實務操作、專題演講等方式，延伸文化的認識與應用。課程目的在於使同學深入特定領域的文化內涵與特色，並進一步學習相關知能、技術，從而與業界實務接軌。
description.en: This course focuses on the exploration and introduction of specific cultures, and promotes the understanding and application of culture through practical exercises and lectures. The purpose of the course is to provide students with a deeper understanding of the cultural connotations and characteristics, and to further learn relevant knowledge and techniques to connect with industry practices.

description.zh: 本課程始自ㄧ系列關於「古代哲學」的演講，特別著重於自然主義哲學家的思想，如泰利斯、巴門尼德斯、赫拉克利圖斯，與德摩克利圖斯。藉此讓我們得以瞭解下述議題: 宇宙的基本物質、變化問題，與原子論。接下來，我們會探討希臘哲學，著重於:辯士學派、蘇格拉底、柏拉圖，與亞里斯多德。我們接著探討希臘化時期的學說: 如犬儒主義、斯多葛主義、伊比鳩魯學派、新柏拉圖主義，與神祕主義。最後我們轉向中世紀哲學，再接著探討文藝復興與巴洛克時期的思想。
description.en: The course starts with a series of lectures on ancient philosophy with an emphasis of thoughts presented by the Naturalistic philosophers who initiate our research interest in the Nature and our surroundings such as Thales, Parmenides, Heraclitus, and Democritus.  By doing so we would learn the following important topics such as the basic matter of the universe, the problem of change, and atomism.  We then shall move onto Greek philosophy with a particular look at the following philosophers: the Sophists, Socratics, Plato, and Aristotles.  Afterwards, we will study the theories and accounts during the Hellenistic period such as Cynicism, Stoicism, Epicureanism, Neo-Platonism, and Mysticism. We then will turn to Medieval philosophy, followed by a close look at thoughts appeared in the Renaissance and Baroque era.

By doing so we would learn the following important topics such as the basic matter of the universe, the problem of change, and atomism.  We then shall move onto Greek philosophy with a particular look at the following philosophers: the Sophists, Socratics, Plato, and Aristotles.  Afterwards, we will study the theories and accounts during the Hellenistic period such as Cynicism, Stoicism, Epicureanism, Neo-Platonism, and Mysticism. syllabi.outline:
「口語溝通策略與演練」課程旨在於訓練學生的口語溝通技巧，並培養精準的表達能力。口說與閱讀和思考有密切的關係，因此本課程設計以發想力、邏輯思考力、表達力及批判思考力的訓練為基礎，並結合肢體語言和聲調的技巧，使學生能於有趣的教學現場中獲得口語溝通的技巧和表達經驗。
This course aims to introduce different skills related to oral communication strategy, which includes personal communication, power point and oral presentation, stories narration, critical thinking strategies, and the communication ways of TED.

description.zh: 博物館學課程目的在於培養並建構學生對於博物館發展之史觀，透過理論與實務，讓學生學習及了解博物館的功能性、意義與重要性、價值觀轉變以及後現代性和發展趨勢等議題，使同學對於博物館學有一基礎認識。
description.en: This course aims to cultivate and construct students' historical points of view. Students can learn and understand the function, significance and importance, value transformation, postmodernity, and development trends of museums through theory and practice so that students can have a basic understanding of museology.

syllabi.outline:
課程目的在於培養並建構學生對於博物館發展之史觀(historical point of 
view)。課程中將搭配學理論述與實務經驗等，培養學生學習下列相關知識。首先了解博物館定義為何？如何發生與演變，闡明博物館於社會、政治、經濟及宗教等時代演進中博物館概念的發生與建立、性質與功能的變化，及其與社會文化思潮之聯繫；其次，分別由歷史及當代不同文化類型形塑出的博物館，掌握不同文化下博物館樣貌形塑的差異性；最後，透過實際參訪與實務經驗的輔助，了解博物館作為文化機構所賦予之意義與重要性，並透過對博物館教育、觀眾研究及社會議題之關注了解博物館之價值觀轉變以及後現代性，並論及博物館與當代人類學之族群關係、歷史記憶、文化觀光等議題，使同學對於博物館學有一基礎認識。

1.了解博物館的功能性並透過理論與實務之結合掌握要點
2.透過博物館分類了解博物館作為文化機構所賦予之意義與重要性
3.透過博物館觀眾及社會議題之關注了解博物館之價值觀轉變以及後現代性
4.由歷史/當代角度了解全球博物館發展趨勢

description.zh: 當代飾品設計及製作是一門以實作為主，實務講述為輔的設計性課程。透過實務教學進行，提供學生基礎金工珠寶的製作能力並進行應用。課程旨在結合金屬工藝與多元媒材的當代趨勢，引導學生系統性的完成作品後，將透過展演形式發表成果。
description.en: This course will use a combination of lectures, demonstrations, and practical experiences to educate the student in the basic skills required to work as a member of jewelry design discipline. This class will also be an introduction to the multiple media of design. Contemporary Jewelry Design will provide an overview of the professional world of Jewelry design through a practical exhibition.

description.zh: 課程旨在介紹實驗影像的關鍵理論，說明導演與藝術家是如何使用視覺與聲音技術向影像本質提問，以啟動視覺之外感官知覺，進而擴展影像的語言。從早期歐洲前衛電影、城市電影、實驗影像，到台灣近年電影，關切在觀看裡的感官知覺經驗，以回應當代視覺文化裡，數位藝術、新媒體與沈浸式影像創作等的興起。
description.en: The course aims to introduce the key theories of experimental images. Filmmakers and artists employ audio-visual techniques to investigate the nature of images itself, intending to explore sensual perception beyond visuality and expanding the realm of images. Beginning from the early European avant-garde cinema, city symphonies, experimental images to recent Taiwanese films, this course focuses on sensory perception in spectatorship, in response to the emergence of digital art, new media, immersive images, and so on.

syllabi.outline: 課程旨在介紹實驗影像的關鍵理論，說明導演與藝術家是如何使用視覺與聲音技術向影像本質提問，以啟動視覺之外感官知覺，進而擴展影像的語言。從早期歐洲前衛電影、城市電影、實驗影像，到台灣近年電影，關切在觀看裡的感官知覺經驗，以回應當代視覺文化裡，數位藝術、新媒體與沈浸式影像創作等的興起。

description.zh: 陶藝造型是一門以實作為主，實務講述為輔的陶藝設計創作課程。透過實務教學進行，提供學生陶瓷工藝廣泛多元視角的文化創新課程。課程旨在結合陶藝造型能力與陶瓷設計產出思維，從介紹陶藝發展、材料種類、技法使用，到進入實作，並導入工藝生活的精神。學生系統性的完成作品後，將透過展演形式發表成果。
description.en: The Ceramics modeling is a clay creation course supplemented by theory and practice. Through practical teaching, it provides a cultural innovation viewpoint with a wide range of perspectives on the ceramics craftsmanship. The course aims to combine the forming skills of ceramic art with the design thinking, from the ceramic art development, material knowledge, to techniques, and the introducing of the idea of craft in life. After the students have systematically completed the work, they will orginize a group exhibition to show the result.

syllabi.outline:
課程以循序漸進的方式，協助學生在陶瓷產品設計上所需能力支持及思維釐清。加強同學在材料運用上的廣度及深度，並學習自行發展主題性創意產出。課堂上以個別指導及分組討論的模式，協助學生發展自我的創作脈絡，以建立自我在產出概念及創意思考上的模式。
課程針對同學在陶瓷成型技術與知識基礎訓練之後，有異於過往以陶藝創作思維及思想批判性為主軸的教育模式，改以陶瓷拉坯文化傳承及鶯歌產業人才創生之社會問題導向，課程內容包括認識鶯歌陶藝發展意識、地方產業沒落問題、地方創生政策、及其他有關文化永續與社會實踐的視野。切入工藝創生與陶瓷文化永續之議題，輔助學生建立工藝與社會人文議題關連性之整合概念。

協助同學探究如何發展自我的文化美學認同，自行尋找答案並解決問題，建立自行發展地方創意性工藝產品設計的能力，捏塑陶藝領域中美感與鶯歌市場接軌的可行性，為本教學預期之培育目標，以引發動機與發現陶藝文化認同之人才培力為出發點。

description.zh: 財務報表所反映的是企業的經營績效，不同的產業有不同的特質、不同的經營環境，即使在相同的產業中，企業若採行不同的競爭策略，在財務報表上也會有不同的表現。本課程的主要目的是要使學生了解如何透過財務報表，來評估企業的經營績效與價值。本課程將介紹以下內容：1) 基本財務報導與特別科目的報導與分析 2) 基本分析理論 3) 償債能力、獲利能力、經營能力、資本結構、現金流量的分析 4) 特殊行業的財務報表分析 5) 探討我國最近發佈的7號、34號及35號會計準則公報對企業與投資人的影響。
description.en: The goal of this course is to help students evaluate the performance and measure the values of firms by financial statements. The topics of this course includes 1) financial reports and analysis of special accounting subjects; 2) basic financial statement analysis; 3) solvency, profitability, business performance, financial structure and cash flow analysis; 4) financial statement analysis of special industries 5) recent developments of GAAP.

syllabi.outline:
This course is designed to develop students the ability to interpret and analyze financial statements and use these financial numbers to evaluate a firm's value. Topics covered in the course include: (1) the mechanics of financial statements, (2) the influence of industry structure on a firm's profitability, (3) accounting analysis, (4) earnings forecasting, and (5) valuation based on forecasted accounting numbers. The course is aimed at anyone whose career might involve working with financial data. Throughout the course, we will focus on the interpretation, evaluation, and application of financial accounting concepts and theory. We will emphasize communication skills, critical thinking, decision-making skills, and real-world issues in financial accounting.
本課程旨在培養學生解釋和分析財務報表並使用這些財務數據評估公司價值的能力。課程內容涵蓋的主題包括：(1) 財務報表運作的機制、(2) 產業結構對公司獲利能力的影響、(3) 會計分析、(4) 獲利預測、以及 (5) 基於預測會計數據衡量公司價值。本課程適用於任何未來想投入分析財務數據的人。在整個課程中，我們將重點放在財務會計概念和理論的解釋、評估和應用。我們將強調溝通技巧、批判性思考、決策技巧和現實世界中的財務會計議題。

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在介紹企業倫理的意涵及其與一般倫理的差異，並深入探討與臺灣和國際社會相關的倫理議題和案例。透過討論問題和互動交流，學生將培養道德判斷能力和國際視野，以應對企業倫理所面臨的挑戰。

1. 導論
   - 瞭解倫理、道德、企業倫理和一般倫理的基本觀念
   - 探討企業倫理在現代社會中的重要性

2. 倫理教育與道德發展
   - 探究企業倫理教育的推行和道德發展的過程
   - 討論校園倫理教育、倫理意識、決策和判斷等相關議題

3. 倫理判斷與教學操作
   - 探討倫理判斷的教學方法和操作
   - 分析行政倫理、非政府倫理和職場倫理等相關議題

4. 企業社會責任與環境保護
   - 瞭解企業社會責任的概念和實踐
   - 探討環境保護的倫理議題和企業公民責任的重要性

5. 跨國企業的倫理挑戰
   - 分析跨國企業所面臨的倫理議題和挑戰
   - 探討永續發展和社會責任型投資的相關議題

課程結構以對應目次中的章節來進行，並在每個章節中安排相關的倫理案例和討論問題，以促進學生的學習和思考。此外，課程結尾包含選擇題和問題研討，供學生進行自我測驗和答問，以鞏固所學知識。

description.zh:
區塊鏈由比特幣為代表的1.0，經過以太坊的智能合約為代表的2.0，進入以設計超級帳本或結合物聯網、人工智慧的3.0階段。在各產業的應用也逐漸廣泛，已呈現多元研究及發展的面向，也代表產業型態將因為區塊鏈的發展而發生重大的變革。
本課程在帶領學生了解區塊鏈的核心技術、特性，以及目前在各產業的應用實例，並透過從發行數字貨幣到撰寫智能合約的商業應用，看見區塊鏈未來的發展。
description.en:
Blockchain is represented by Bitcoin 1.0, and after 2.0 represented by Ethereum's smart contracts, it enters the 3.0 stage of designing a super ledger or combining the IoT and AI. The application in various industries is gradually becoming more and more extensive, and it has presented a multi-faceted research and development orientation. It also represents that the industry type will undergo major changes due to the development of the blockchain.
This course leads students to understand the core technology and characteristics of blockchain, as well as current application examples in various industries, and sees the future development of blockchain through the commercial application from issuing digital currency to writing smart contracts.

name.en: Foreign Exchange Markets: Theories and Practices

description.zh: 本課程教授內容包括外匯理論與實務操作，課程內容包括： 1. 探討有那些因素會影響匯率的波動以及均衡匯率的決定，並以實務案例，引導學生得以學習到外匯交易的知識，並懂得結合外匯交易的理論與實務來建置自己的外匯交易策略，進行正確的外匯投資操作。2. 透過對外匯市場交易之思考、探討、批判與洞察，來打造最適合的外匯交易策略，進而提升外匯專業之操作能力。
description.en: This course prepares students to effectively analyze, assess, and trade foreign currency in the FOREX spot market. Topics presented during the course include: models of success and historical evidence on buying and selling patterns, how to understand volatility of return on the foreign currency exchange, the price behavior of currency, and technical tools for analysis including Japanese Candlesticks and Bar charts. The course focuses on foreign exchange market, major players in the FOREX market, spot and forward market, currency futures and options, foreign exchange exposure and risk, FOREX traders and trading, technical analysis in the FOREX market, profiles of the world’s major currencies and their characteristics. Students will also explore and use the various trading platforms in use on the spot market today and will complete a project in which they will maintain and trade a practice account over the length of this course and track their performance, trading behaviors, and motivat

description.zh: 本課程之目標在於介紹使用者經驗設計之理論與應用。藉由本課程的學習，學生能習得互動設計過程中所需要之關鍵概念 - 以使用者經驗為中心之設計。課程以人-機-境之架構為基礎進行相關知識之講授，並透過案例之研討、方法之操作以及設計實務之進行了解其應用。課程內容包含人物誌、使用者經驗與需求、互動環境、使用者研究以及認知心理基礎等。教學將以課堂講授、個案研討以及方法操作以及設計執行等方式進行，並以作業繳交以及分組討論與發表為評量方式。
description.en: This course is focused on introducing the theories and application of User Experience Design (UXD). In this course, students can understand the key element, UX, of interactive design. This course is set up under the structure of Human-Machine-Scenario theory, and executed through case studies, method simulation and design practice. The contents include personas, user experience and requirements, interactive scenario, user research and cognitive psychology. The course is preceded by means of lecturing, case studies, and design practice. Students are evaluated by design work, group discussion and presentation.

description.zh: 本課程旨在整合應用程式與設計，完成具互動媒體設計作品。為達成此目標，本課程培養學生熟悉與整合互動設計的理論、方法與應用，以具互動性的媒體設計議題，訓練學生獨立創作或分組合作設計，藉此訓練學生創意思考、應用科技與新知的實作能力，同時也可結合產學合作專案於教學活動內，達到務實致用的目標。
description.en: This course applies design and programming into interaction design projects relating to media design. To achieve this goal, students will familiarize the theories, methodology and implications of interactive media design in this course. By interaction design issues, students create and implement ideas by brainstorming through independent study or cooperative learning. For competition without any gap, industry-academic cooperation is one way to prepare student’s critical competencies same as the desired competencies required by the industry.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在以專題設計方式，訓練學生確認並建立需求、發展設計選擇方案、製作設計的互動形式、設計評估的專業知能，並以設計專案方式演練完整之設計過程。學生經由分組合作或獨自創作完成一媒體設計主題。上學期課程以題目釐定、資料蒐集、分析調查、設計定義、構想發展、程式設計、雛型製作等活動為教學內容；下學期則進行觀察測試、使用性評估、程式調校、專刊編輯、展示佈置以及設計報告提交等為教學內容，以培養學生具備互動設計專題製作之專業知能。
Through project design, the course prepares students to confirm the needs of design, develop alternatives of media design projects, create interactive modes, and evaluate design performance through independent study or cooperative learning. The course's learning materials in the first semester include subject clarification, data collection, analysis and investigation, design definition, concept development, programming, and prototyping. In the second semester, learning materials of the course include observation and testing, usability evaluation, programming debug, report editing, exhibition and design report submission. Accordingly, students will be ready for professional competencies of interaction design projects.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在以專題設計方式，訓練學生確認並建立需求、發展設計選擇方案、製作設計的互動形式、設計評估的專業知能，並以設計專案方式演練完整之設計過程。學生經由分組合作或獨自創作完成一媒體設計主題。上學期課程以題目釐定、資料蒐集、分析調查、設計定義、構想發展、程式設計、雛型製作等活動為教學內容；下學期則進行觀察測試、使用性評估、程式調校、專刊編輯、展示佈置以及設計報告提交等為教學內容，以培養學生具備互動設計專題製作之專業知能。
Through project design, the course prepares students to confirm the needs of design, develop alternatives of media design projects, create interactive modes, and evaluate design performance through independent study or cooperative learning. The course's learning materials in the first semester include subject clarification, data collection, analysis and investigation, design definition, concept development, programming, and prototyping. In the second semester, learning materials of the course include observation and testing, usability evaluation, programming debug, report editing, exhibition and design report submission. Accordingly, students will be ready for professional competencies of interaction design projects.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在整合應用程式與設計，完成具互動媒體設計作品。為達成此目標，本課程培養學生熟悉與整合互動設計的理論、方法與應用，以具互動性的媒體設計議題，訓練學生獨立創作或分組合作設計，藉此訓練學生創意思考、應用科技與新知的實作能力，同時也可結合產學合作專案於教學活動內，達到務實致用的目標。
This course applies design and programming into interaction design projects relating to media design. To achieve this goal, students will familiarize the theories, methodology and implications of interactive media design in this course. By interaction design issues, students create and implement ideas by brainstorming through independent study or cooperative learning. For competition without any gap, industry-academic cooperation is one way to prepare student’s critical competencies same as the desired competencies required by the industry.

description.zh: 中文課程共分四年三階段授課。 第一、二年以華語教學為主，授課重點為：（一）華語基本句型句法；（二）華語基本會話；（三）生活語言；（四）標音系統。第三年(一學期)，除延續第一、二年華語授課重點外，以段落朗讀和基本認字為主要訓練，並給與中國文字書寫訓練。 第四年(一學期)，加強會話能力，認字與閱讀能力，並傳授中國文化。
description.en: The course of Chinese is categorized as three individual stages for four years. In the first year, the course focuses on: (a) Basic Sentence Patterns, (b) Basic Conversation, (c) Languages in the Real Life and (d) the phonetic system for the Chinese language. In the second and the third year (one semester), the training focuses on paragraph reading and term/character recognition-in addition to the teaching themes set in the first year. Writing courses are also added during this stage. In the fourth year (one semester), we add more emphasis on the conversational ability, term/character recognition and reading ability. More culture-related information will be included.
