description.zh: 以英語語言、教學法、及學生在專業領域的英語需求為主軸，專業英文ESP 系列課程涵蓋以下關鍵面向：學術英文、專業實踐/應用英文、內容和語言整合英文教學，議題與趨勢，以及語言技巧能力。 此系列課程專為本校大二修習校訂共同英文的學生設計，強化英語能力，並應用英文於專業領域之發展。
description.en: Drawing upon the English language, pedagogy, students’ needs for English in specialized domains, the ESP series encompass the following key dimensions: English for general academic purposes, English for professional practice / application, content and language integrated learning, issues and trends, and integrative language skills for testing and communication. The courses are designed for the second year (sophomore), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English competence and become more proficient in their fields of study.

description.zh: 本課程是針對有志從事文化創意產業的學生而設計的創意策略與企劃課程。課程從廣告的基本概念開始說明，如產品的開發策略、市場規模估計、競爭產品的研究和分析、消費者行為研究、SWOT、3C等。本課程的目的是以創新思考和市場行銷概念引導學生，並鼓勵學生從當前的創意產業中，發掘潛在機會，以創造新鮮且有趣的想法。
description.en: This course is a strategy and general project management for students interested in pursuing careers in the cultural and creative industry. The course starts from the basic concepts and functions in the advertising, such as the development of product strategy, market size estimation, competitor identification and analysis, consumer behavior research, SWOT, 3Cs, and so on. This course aims to guide students equipped with innovation thinking and marketing sense. Additionally, the course drives students to look through potential opportunities in the creative industry and to implement new and interesting ideas.

syllabi.outline:
本門課程將以基礎軟體應用與提升實務能力為主，透過Adobe Photoshop、 Illustrator以及配合現代科技GAI的發展，帶領同學學習如何利用製作影像來表達或呈現自己的想法，訓練軟體操作能力，培養設計美感。
The course will focus on fundamental software applications and enhance practical skills. Students will learn how to create images to express and present their ideas through the use of Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator and the integration of modern technology like Generative AI (GAI). This course aims to develop software proficiency and cultivate a sense of design aesthetics.

description.zh: 課程規劃教授近代工藝設計的演進歷程，並融入工藝時尚跨界合作之案例介紹,協助學生認識當代設計思潮並體會工藝產品的機能與造形之美。配合當前文化創意產業政策與時尚產業的發展，瞭解工藝設計與時尚趨勢之未來發展。
description.en: The course introduces the evolution of modern craft design, and integrates the case of cross-border cooperation between craftsmanship and fashion. It aims to help students understand contemporary design and experience the beauty of function and form. In addition, the course cooperates with the cultural and creative industry policy and the development of the fashion industry, trying to help students explore the future of craft design and fashion.

syllabi.outline:
1.介紹東西方工藝設計的本質及近代的演進歷程，並配合工藝設計名作介紹，認識當代設計思潮。

description.zh: 本課程旨在經由對文化經濟學的認知，解讀文化經濟的發展邏輯與運行機制，建構文化經濟知識體系，期能為文化市場與文化產業發展提供理論基礎與思維座標。課程主要內容，一為在經濟邏輯運行下的文化活動，諸如文化產品、文化事業、文化資本、文化產業、文化市場等；另一為經濟活動所反映與體現的文化因素，以及對經濟運行產生作用的思維價值等。
description.en:
The course aims through awareness of cultural economics to interpret the development logic and operating mechanism of cultural economy and to construct a cultural economic knowledge system, and is expected to provide the theoretical basis and thinking coordinates for the development of cultural markets and cultural industries.
The main content of the course is economic logics underpinned cultural activities, such as cultural products, cultural business, cultural capital, cultural industries and cultural markets; on the other hand, cultural factors reflected and experienced by economic activities, as well as the value of thinking which plays an important role in economic activities.

syllabi.outline:
有別於一般多以傳統教室為教學場域的教育模式，本課程係以鶯歌為實作場域，透過現地踏察與深度訪談，引導學生盤點場域在地的文化資源，著眼於鶯歌陶瓷工藝永續發展之利基，試圖開發場域文化品牌與經營模式，以建立鶯歌陶瓷文化永續發展之基礎與共識，強化學生在文化傳承與文化永續之實踐力。
本課程對應【鶯歌陶瓷培力與科技驅動計畫】USR計畫，需進行移地教學，且產出內容及課程進度需共同參與。本課程以場域實作為主，因應內容與場域，課程將彈性安排，請衡量自我學習時間掌控，再行選課。本課程對應SDGs 11永續城市與社區。

name.en: Course Description Seminars on the Aesthetics of Life

description.zh:
「生活美學」是文化生活發展的重要內核，也是文化產業化、產業文化化過程中必要關涉的範疇與議題，本課程旨在探索中國歷代文化生活的重要元素及其呈現模式，取材雅富美感的行為文化，進而尋覓發展成為體驗經濟模式的途徑，達到由文化復育到文化設計的目的。「生活美學」是現代人據各家美學定義所推論出的新名詞，專應用於生活；「文化設計」乃取用生活美學諸元素，作人際禮儀的規劃設計。透過提煉、體驗設計與推廣，實現傳承古風、用古於今、達到充實且深刻的現代生活美學追求。
      課程的規劃結合三個面向，將人際互動需求、「茶」與「香」的美席設計、茶鄉文化實務再造三者連結，作實驗性文化美學設計。期擬提供人情交流重整的精緻平台，並可望成為一項跨域連結新創產業的前導。
description.en:
Life Aesthetics is the kernel of cultural life; it has become integral in the process toward cultural industrialization and industrial culturalization. Life aesthetics is not only inscribed in our cultural experiences, but also affiliated with the "creative life," 
This course will examine the important elements constituting cultural lives across different dynasties in Chinese history and investigate their patterns of presentations. By integrating old with new, tradition with modernity, cultural heritage with contemporary practices, students are empowered in their imagination and creativity in cultural designs, This course comprises three stages. the focus is primarily on the ideas of heaven and mankind and their correlativity, including concepts of solar terms and rhythm of life, permanence and non-permanence, patriarchal clan system and people's beliefs and ethics. The course ends with presentations of students' application projects.

description.zh: 本課程的設計，以培訓學生動手實作能力為核心，進而建構智能製造範疇的3D建模能力，培養學生未來在職場中的競爭力。綜合加法加工的3D成型列印技術與減法加工的CNC 3軸加工技術，結合國際市場上的通用專業軟體，進行系統化的單元講解，連結幾何物件，導入產業中常見的3D建模設計，再經由同學間的團隊合作，建構起完整的組合件產品。
description.en: The design of this course focuses on training students' hands-on ability, and then constructs 3D modeling ability in the field of intelligent manufacturing. The course teaches from the foundation of professional software to strengthening the integrated 3D and CNC 3-axis machining technology. The teaching objectives are fully introduced into the common 3D modeling design in the industry, and a complete product is constructed by encouraging teamwork among students.

syllabi.outline:
課程簡介

3 D建模與智能製造課程，讓學生透過親自動手實作學習知識與技能。課程引導學生認識自造者運動，以3 D列印應用與未來可能性為主體，透過一邊做一邊學習的方式，運用網路搜尋資源，認識現在的數位自造概念，然後能將自己的想法具體畫出，完成本課程後，有能力運用3D列印機輸出自己的作品。課堂以講授、小組討論、實際操作進行，同學也要“經常”上台簡單分享想法。
syllabi.schedule:
每週課程內容

第一週：9/9 課程介紹與學生互動

本週將介紹課程進行方式，包含會使用到的機器設備，作業項目、評分方式，同學也將用這一堂課程相互認識，讓老師理解選這堂課的期望。
選出課程小助理2位：收作業、傳達訊息等
本週作業：填寫課程回饋，請介紹自己並提出想要學習的目標。

第二週：9/16  1分鐘電梯簡報技巧ANSVA

本週將邀請李情老師帶領學生做簡單的口頭發表練習ANSVA，學生分成小組，針對數位自造議題，模擬1分鐘電梯簡報分享的技巧。
本週作業：填寫課程問卷，並提出學習到的心得

第三週：9/23日 3D列印作品賞析
本週將分享3D列印樣品，透過討論及互動的方式認識3D列印的可能性。本週也將介紹一些網路上的資源網站，讓同學可以自行搜尋實用的資源網站
本週作業：找到1-2個喜歡的3D資源網站，介紹並說明喜歡的原因

本週將介紹給同學自造者運動概念，並透過播映電影紀錄片『自造世代』讓同學對於這個議題有更深入之認識。
本週作業：選定影片中最有印象的一個故事，介紹並說明喜歡的原因

切片軟體、3D列印輸出說明

syllabi.outline:
This course is an introductory investment course. Topics covered in this course include: (1) the functioning of financial instruments and markets, (2)  the risk-return relationship, (3) portfolio theory, (4)  behavioral finance and technical analysis, (5) fundamental analysis, (6) stock and bond valuations, and (7) derivatives markets. In the first six weeks, Dr. Chen will cover the first two topics, while Dr. Wu will cover the other topics from the seventh week. Throughout the course, we will focus on the interpretation and application of investment concepts and theory. We will emphasize communication skills, critical thinking, decision-making skills, and real-world issues in financial markets. Our goal is to offer students an essential knowledge of investment and the capability to apply investment theories in practical scenarios.
本課程是投資學入門課程。課程主題涵蓋：(1) 金融工具和金融市場的運作，(2) 風險與報酬關係，(3) 投資組合理論，(4) 行為財務學與技術分析，(5) 基本面分析，(6 ）股票和債券評價，以及（7）衍生性商品市場。前六週將由陳鴻崑老師負責講授前兩個主題。從第七週開始，吳聲昌老師將負責講授其餘章節。在整個課程中，我們將重點放在投資概念和理論的解釋和應用。我們將強調溝通技巧、批判性思考、決策技巧和金融市場的現實問題。我們的目標是為學生提供基本的投資知識以及將投資理論應用於實際場景的能力。

description.zh: 值此一網際網路和數位經濟時代，資料通訊與網路已經顯著影響企業經營、管理及決策與策略規劃同時也影響人們之生活及活動。它的應用非常廣泛、無所不在且多元。 商業公司及企業可以運用資料通訊及網路化資訊系統來提升競爭優勢及執行績效、經營者決策及客戶服務效率與全球化商務、產品及服務。資料通訊可以在各種設置上以有線及無線的方式使用。因此，本課程的開課目標旨在學習並瞭解資料通訊及網路之基本原理、基礎建設、技術、管理及企業應用等之議題。本課程主要探討之主題包括 (1)資料通訊基本原理、(2)資料傳輸技術、(3)網路應用、(4)有線及無線區域網路、(5) 有線及無線廣域網路、(6)網際網路與TCP/IP、(7)網路安全、(8)網路設計、(9)網路管理、(10)分散資料處理、(11)主從、內部網路與雲端運算、(12)第四代行動網路和往後世代等。
description.en: In this era of Internet economy, businesses and enterprises may leverage data communications (DC) and networked information systems to enhance competitive advantages, streamline managerial decision making, and customer services. DC may be adopted in a variety of devices on both wire and wireless modes. Consequently, the objectives of this course aim to study the issues of fundamentals, infrastructure, technologies, management and business applications on data communications and networks. The major topics of this course contains (1)Fundamentals of DC,   (2)Technologies of data transmission, (3)Network applications, (4)Wired and wireless local area networks, (5)Wired and wireless wide area networks, (6)The Internet and TCP/IP, (7)Network security, (8)Design networks, (9)Network administration, (10)Distributed data processing, (11)Client/Server, Intranet, and cloud computing, (12)Fourth generation (4G) Mobile networks and onwards.

syllabi.outline:
企業網路常遭遇的問題及先進的網路應用等議題建構課程內容，並配合專題實作或問題解決方式實作，規畫進行業界參訪及邀請業界專家示範，將目前最新進的技術知能及企業現場之網路議題介紹給學生，讓其能獲得更新更深入的學習體驗，提昇學習理解，進而培育學生以所學技術去解決企業網路應用及問題的能力，進而促進合作學習與分析企業資料通訊及網路架構之規畫、設計與實現。
本課程規劃課程以8週來教授課堂上的理論知識，另外10週將以實作工作坊、業界講師協同教學等相關活動。
We construct course content on topics such as common problems encountered by enterprise networks and advanced network applications, and coordinate with the implementation of special topics or problem-solving methods. We plan to conduct industry visits and invite industry experts for demonstrations, so as to integrate the latest technical knowledge. and corporate on-site network issues are introduced to students, so that they can obtain newer and more in-depth learning experiences, improve learning understanding, and then cultivate students' ability to use the learned technologies to solve corporate network applications and problems, thereby promoting cooperative learning and analysis Planning, design and implementation of enterprise data communication and network architecture.
This course is planned to teach theoretical knowledge in the classroom for 8 weeks, and the other 10 weeks will include practical workshops, collaborative teaching by industry lecturers, and off-campus visit-related activities.

description.zh: 以英語語言、教學法、及學生在專業領域的英語需求為主軸，專業英文ESP 系列課程涵蓋以下關鍵面向：學術英文、專業實踐/應用英文、內容和語言整合英文教學，議題與趨勢，以及語言技巧能力。 此系列課程專為本校大二修習校訂共同英文的學生設計，強化英語能力，並應用英文於專業領域之發展。

description.zh: 本課程之目標在於介紹人機介面設計過程中所需了解之相關專業知識，配合設計實務的操作，使學生能充分了解使用者介面設計的流程以及相關的應用，始其具有能進行人機使用者介面實務製作的能力。課程內容包含介面設計概念模式、介面使用性、人機介面設計程序、使用者需求、介面原型設計、介面設計原則以及使用者測試等。教學將以課堂講授、個案研討以及實作等方式進行，並以報告繳交與課堂發表及作品為評量依據。
description.en: This course is focused on introducing the knowledge for human-computer interaction (HCI) design, accompanying with design practice. This will allow students to understand the process of user interface design and related application, so as to be capable of practical interface design. The contents include conceptual model, interface usability, HCI process, user requirements, interface prototyping, principles of interface design and user testing. The course is preceded by means of lecturing, case study and practical work, and evaluated by students' reports, oral presentation and design work.

In the practical part, the course is based on Arduino and electronic circuits, using interactive programming to guide students in designing and implementing interactive devices.

syllabi.outline:
1990年起，科技的快速變化讓生活更加便利，然而，在物質世界中，這種便利需要與思想的提升相配合。因此，激進設計（Radical Design）、批判性設計（Critical Design）、推測設計（Speculative Design）、論述設計（Discursive Design）與設計幻象（Design Fiction）等開始陸續興起。這些設計作為獨立話語權的機制，將意識與思想透過概念設計的形式傳遞出來，成為思想傳播的媒介管道，並成為當代設計在思想上的特殊指標。這類概念設計在實踐過程中，以當下的社會議題（STEEP）為探討和解決的對象，從社會（Society）、科技（Technology）、經濟（Economy）、環境（Environment）、政治（Politics）等方面尋找不同時代下的潛在發展信號，並應用哲學、科學、史學等跨領域的交叉學科知識，來進行設計學的思想實驗。本課程以推測設計為背景，主要以過去、現在、未來進行分類，並透過前瞻科技段來解決問題，必然會與不同科系的交流和咨詢相結合，整合設計學與未來學，創建在未來趨勢與科技變化下需要提升和進步的意識形態的新視野。

Since 1990, the rapid changes in technology have made life more convenient. However, convenience in the material world requires some enhancement in thought. As a result, Radical Design, Critical Design, Speculative Design, Discursive Design, and Design Fiction have gradually emerged, using design as a mechanism of independent discourse to convey awareness and thought through conceptual design. This has made design a special indicator of contemporary thought. In practice, these types of conceptual designs explore and address current social issues (STEEP) by identifying potential development signals from Society, Technology, Economy, Environment, and Politics. They also apply interdisciplinary knowledge from philosophy, science, history, and other fields to conduct thought experiments in design. This course uses speculative design as its background, categorizing it into past, present, and future, and solving problems through forward-looking technology. It necessarily involves exchanges and consultations with different disciplines, integrating design and futures studies to create new ideological perspectives that need to be enhanced and advanced under future trends and technological changes.

description.zh: 本課程之目的在於介紹互動媒體設計所需之故事腳本設計相關知識與其應用。在以使用者情境設計導向的基礎架構下，本課程的內如包含敘事性方法、創意思考方法、互動腳本企劃以及互動腳本撰寫等。修習此課程之學生可學習互動情境劇本設計之原理與實作模擬，並具備業界所需之互動媒體設計實務之企劃與分析能力。在以實務操作、課堂腦力激盪與討論的方式下，學生的評量採報告與作業的繳交以及課堂討論成績為主。
description.en: The course aims to introduce knowledge and application relevant to storytelling and script planning. Under the structure of user oriented scenario design, this course includes narrative methods, creative thinking methods, interactive script planning and writing. Students will be capable of interactive scenario script design, planning and analyzing for interactive media practice. By means of practical work, in-course brainstorming and discussion, students are evaluated by reports, assignment and course discusstion.

syllabi.outline:
本課程之目的在於介紹互動媒體設計所需之故事腳本設計相關知識與其應用。 課程規劃主要著重在"設計方法"以及"設計思維(Design Thinking)的實際操作演練;希望透過本課程讓同學們以互動體驗實作的方式來建構設計概念發展的模式。 課程內容包含敘事性方法、創意思考方法、互動腳本企劃以及互動腳本撰寫及實作等。修習此課程之學生可學習互動情境劇本設計之原理與實作模擬，並具備業界所需之互動媒體設計實務之企劃與分析能力。在以實務操作、課堂腦力激盪與討論的方式下，學生的評量採報告與作業的繳交以及課堂討論成績為主。

說故事與腳本企劃作為互動系大二視覺傳達組的必修課程，旨在訓練同學創意的敘事方式與多媒體腳本企畫執行。在課程大綱中。本學期課程的實務專題預計以USR專案: 原住民部落安居構築與綠色樂業推動計畫；南投仁愛鄉賽德克東岸部落之耆老口述歷史故事影像化專題，在課程中藉由多次與部落耆老訪談和USR團隊專任助理的資料提供協助、讓同學們實作影片敘事作品。

本課程鏈結SDG3所探討的良好健康和福祉及SDG5-性別平等的主題。授課教師本身為USR- 原住民部落安居構築與綠色樂業推動計畫的共同主持人，負責第三期USR 賽德克東岸部落的互動行銷規畫與實踐項目，在此計畫最後半年的階段將收斂部落人物誌。故此次課程亦將以” 現代賽德克故事”作為專題，預計在課程中開闢兩個講次談SDG3/5相關的概念和東岸部落的過去現在與未來，另安排一次東岸部落的耆老與部落青年訪談，進行人物誌的影像語音資料蒐集。

The course aims to introduce knowledge and application relevant to storytelling and script planning. Under the structure of user oriented scenario design, this course includes narrative methods, creative thinking methods, interactive script planning and writing. Students will be capable of interactive scenario script design, planning and analyzing for interactive media practice. By means of practical work, in-course brainstorming and discussion, students are evaluated by reports, assignment and course discussion.

The visual organization of design elements including line, plane, volume, and the analysis of their abstract relationships and principles of order are studied.

syllabi.outline:
本課程以敘事性設計的邏輯思維為主體，通過產品設計中設計物件的調研法來展開。從敘事的背景中發現問題，進行事件分析、物關係和使用者特性的剖析，從而在實驗場中培養理論、文化語境和實踐的深度。主要課程分為兩部分。第一部分是設計研究（Design Research）課程，其中包括體驗設計研究和情感化設計的系統理論研究等。在上述課程研究過程中，透過各組的研究專題來進行設計實踐，協助增加研究的多樣性。第二部分是文化敘事的創新設計研究。這部分以敘事學為基礎，將過去的史料與在地發生的事件等，分類為正史、偏史、小說與傳說等，具備故事性質的敘事內容與產品設計語境結合，鍛煉設計師根據不同的故事本源來採集素材，掌握情境中的使用者體驗，其中包含使用者的背景調研、問題分析、使用者性格與習慣等，從中延展出文化產品的另一個層次。在研究的過程中，利用設計尋找文化脈絡，同時將文化根基反饋在設計作品上。

This course centers on the logical thinking of narrative design, using research methods in product design to structure the coursework. It begins with identifying problems through narrative contexts, analyzing events, object relationships, and user characteristics to develop a deep understanding of theory, cultural context, and practical application. The course is divided into two main parts:

Firstly, there is the Design Research segment. This includes experiential design research and system theory research on emotional design. Throughout these research processes, students engage in design practice through individual research projects, enhancing various research dimensions.

Secondly, there is innovative design research in cultural narrative. This segment is grounded in narratology, categorizing historical data and local events into official history, unofficial history, legends, and folktales. These narrative contents with storytelling elements are combined with the context of product design. Students are trained to gather data based on different storylines, understanding user experiences in various scenarios. This includes user background research, problem analysis, and examining user characteristics and habits, extending product design to another level. During the research process, design is used to find cultural contexts, and cultural foundations feedback into the design objects.

description.zh: 本課程旨在講授動畫的企劃與設計，以及其製作原理與應用。透過對網路、動畫、遊戲、及其他數位媒體的討論，使同學了解動畫的設計製作流程、腳本撰寫、軟體應用等。
description.en: This course is focused on the introduction of animation planning and design, as well as its principle and application. Through the study on the internet, animation, game and other digital media, students can understand the design process of animation, story drafting and software application.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在講授動畫的企劃與設計，以及其製作原理與應用。透過對網路、動畫、遊戲、及其他數位媒體的討論，使同學了解動畫的設計製作流程、腳本撰寫、軟體應用等。

透過理論講解和操作示範介紹電腦動畫的原理和方法。除了功能的訓練之外同時也著重動畫的美感、創造性、表演性等等運用面的需求。
使用軟體是以3Ds Max為主，在熟悉3ds max工具的同時，更明確的認清原創為藝術創作的首要目標，以利用此軟體多元並高度的掌控性，重組現實世界的運行法則，像是重力、光影、質感等，並企圖創造出各種感知進化的契機。此動畫課程除了包含進階的建模、材質與運算，將加入角色製作與攝影機語言的敘述搭配空間與物件造形所傳達之視覺感知，將時間性的美感與張力融入創作。

description.zh: 近年來網頁技術的快速發展，網頁設計也從傳統的後台PHP進展到以HTML5+CSS3+Javascript技術為主的前端工程。此外，UI／UX的協同設計也是建立一個好的網頁的重要部分。 本課程旨在教導學生使用HTML5+CSS3+Javascript技術進行現代化的網頁設計，課程內容以靜態網頁的版面設計為主，包含RWD的響應式跨平台網頁設計。其中也涵蓋了UI／UX的概念建立。期待同學能經由這門課建立前端工程需要的基本技能。
description.en: In recent years, the rapid development of web technology, web design has also progressed from the traditional platform- PHP to HTML5+ CSS3 + Java script technology-based, front-end engineering. In addition, the collaborative design of the UI/UX is an important part of building a good Web page. This course is designed to teach students to modernize web design using HTML5-CSS3-Javascript technology, with a focus on static web layout and responsive cross-platform web design with RWD. It also covers the concept building of UI/UX. Expect students to establish the basic skills needed for front-end engineering through this course.

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技一、二年級實施專項分組教學，由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh: 中文課程共分四年三階段授課。 第一、二年以華語教學為主，授課重點為：（一）華語基本句型句法；（二）華語基本會話；（三）生活語言；（四）標音系統。第三年(一學期)，除延續第一、二年華語授課重點外，以段落朗讀和基本認字為主要訓練，並給與中國文字書寫訓練。 第四年(一學期)，加強會話能力，認字與閱讀能力，並傳授中國文化。
description.en: The course of Chinese is categorized as three individual stages for four years. In the first year, the course focuses on: (a) Basic Sentence Patterns, (b) Basic Conversation, (c) Languages in the Real Life and (d) the phonetic system for the Chinese language. In the second and the third year (one semester), the training focuses on paragraph reading and term/character recognition-in addition to the teaching themes set in the first year. Writing courses are also added during this stage. In the fourth year (one semester), we add more emphasis on the conversational ability, term/character recognition and reading ability. More culture-related information will be included.

description.zh: 近年來網頁技術的快速發展，網頁設計也從傳統的後台PHP進展到以HTML5+CSS3+Javascript技術為主的前端工程。此外，UI／UX的協同設計也是建立一個好的網頁的重要部分。 本課程旨在教導學生使用HTML5+CSS3+Javascript技術進行現代化的網頁設計，課程內容以靜態網頁的版面設計為主，包含RWD的響應式跨平台網頁設計。其中也涵蓋了UI／UX的概念建立。期待同學能經由這門課建立前端工程需要的基本技能。
description.en: In recent years, the rapid development of web technology, web design has also progressed from the traditional platform- PHP to HTML5+ CSS3 + Java script technology-based, front-end engineering. In addition, the collaborative design of the UI/UX is an important part of building a good Web page. This course is designed to teach students to modernize web design using HTML5-CSS3-Javascript technology, with a focus on static web layout and responsive cross-platform web design with RWD. It also covers the concept building of UI/UX. Expect students to establish the basic skills needed for front-end engineering through this course.

syllabi.outline:
近年來網頁技術的快速發展，網頁設計也從傳統的後台PHP進展到以HTML5+CSS3+Javascript技術為主的前端工程。此外，UI／UX的協同設計也是建立一個好的網頁的重要部分。 本課程旨在教導學生使用HTML5+CSS3+Javascript技術進行現代化的網頁設計，課程內容以靜態網頁的版面設計為主，包含RWD的響應式跨平台網頁設計。其中也涵蓋了UI／UX的概念建立。期待同學能經由這門課建立前端工程需要的基本技能。
In recent years, the rapid development of web technology, web design has also progressed from the traditional platform- PHP to HTML5+ CSS3 + Java script technology-based, front-end engineering. In addition, the collaborative design of the UI/UX is an important part of building a good Web page. This course is designed to teach students to modernize web design using HTML5-CSS3-Javascript technology, with a focus on static web layout and responsive cross-platform web design with RWD. It also covers the concept building of UI/UX. Expect students to establish the basic skills needed for front-end engineering through this course.

description.zh: 以英語語言、教學法、及學生在專業領域的英語需求為主軸，專業英文ESP 系列課程涵蓋以下關鍵面向：學術英文、專業實踐/應用英文、內容和語言整合英文教學，議題與趨勢，以及語言技巧能力。 此系列課程專為本校大二修習校訂共同英文的學生設計，強化英語能力，並應用英文於專業領域之發展。
description.en: Drawing upon the English language, pedagogy, students’ needs for English in specialized domains, the ESP series encompass the following key dimensions: English for general academic purposes, English for professional practice / application, content and language integrated learning, issues and trends, and integrative language skills for testing and communication. The courses are designed for the second year (sophomore), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English competence and become more proficient in their fields of study.

Statement (if-else, goto or switch statement), 4. Loop (for, while and do while), 5. Statements of subprograms (Parameters Called by Value and Address), 6. Array (including character array), 7. Pointer, string, 8.Structure and union, 9. Files (Input/Output)

This course aims to introduce the basic knowledge of Python programming. The course covers fundamental concepts of the Python language, data structures, functions, and modules. Students will be able to master Python programming and apply it to solve real-world problems.

description.zh: 本課程之目標是希望充實同學在基礎力學之專業知識，與大二材料力學等課程能夠相銜接，同時能夠瞭解力學在工程上之簡單應用。課程內容包含：向量與質點平衡、力系的平衡、摩擦、面積矩與質量慣性矩、結構分析、虛功法。
description.en: The goal of this course is to enrich students' professional knowledge in basic mechanics, to be able to connect with sophomore materials mechanics and other courses, and to understand the simple application of mechanics in engineering. The course content includes: vector and particle balance, Equilibrium of force system, friction, area moment and mass moment of inertia, structural analysis, virtual work method.

description.zh:
一、本課程凡十六學分，供學生前四年修習之用。
二、本課程教學目標旨在透過適當選文，增進學生閱讀、鑑賞與寫作能力，誘使學生對我國重要典籍及傳統文化有一粗淺認識，並從而培植其人文素養，啟發其愛國、愛家、愛人之情操。
三、本課程所選範文，類別遍於經史子集，時代該及古今。編者於每篇選文，除有生字、難詞、典故之註釋，提意、出處、著作背景之說明，而作者生平、作品、風格及其地位、事功，亦有簡要之評述。
四、本課程亦講授公文及書信。公文之內容包括函、簽、公告、報告等各類常用公文的作法與寫作要領，並兼及處理公文之注意事項。書信之內容包括傳統及現代書信的寫法與寫作要領，並兼及便條與做為便條使用之名片的寫法。
description.en:
a) The course is designed for the students to study in the first four years, with a sum total of 16 credit hours. 
b) Course Objective: Through proper readings, the students will increase their ability to read, write and even appreciate literary works, and better understand significant books of ancient times and of traditional culture. With better development of humanity, they are likely to have more sense of loving the country, family and people. 
c) The Readings are adopted from a diversity of sources, including Classics, History Books, individual writings and literary anthology-ancient or modern. In addition to the explanation and discussion of vocabulary items, difficult words, classic allusions, main ideas, origin and the time background of the articles, a brief comment is also made on the authors' life, their works, literary styles/status. 
d)The course is to teach students how to write and handle official correspondences and social letters.

description.zh: 此專科英文課程共四年：專一、專二、專三、專四。其課程目標為培養學生獨立閱讀、進階寫作與口語溝通能力，並培育學生逐漸成為獨立的語言學習者。教學採符合溝通互動取向與全語言哲學的教學法，並依學生特點和課堂文化做適當教學調整與輔助。學生經由大量閱讀具知識性、趣味性、適合其程度的作品，經由經常參與角色扮演、分組討論、口頭報告與短文寫作等學習活動，逐漸提昇語言溝通能力與善用學習策略來解決問題的能力。
description.en: This junior-college English program consists of four-year English courses, with the purposes to develop fluency in reading and writing, and to improve listening and speaking abilities. The communicative approach and the whole language philosophy are thus adopted to implement the curriculum. In these courses, students have plenty of opportunities to take part in role-plays, oral presentations, pair work, small-group discussions and whole-class discussions for communicative purposes; they have good opportunities to express their feelings and thoughts in their essays and journal entries. A variety of reading, writing, and oral communication tasks are provided with a view to developing students' reading, writing, and oral communication skills, and to facilitating their using appropriate, effective learning strategies to accomplish learning tasks. In a word, the purpose of this curriculum is to motivate students to learn English, and to help them gradually become confident and competent use

description.zh: 「全民國防教育法」自民國95年2月開始施行，以國際情勢、國防政策、全民國防、防衛動員、國防科技五大主軸作為全民國防教育的課程規畫。「國際情勢」單元，主要論述區域安全與兩岸情勢發展，培育學生宏觀的國際視野；更進一步說明在全球化浪潮下，國際重要的安全議題及我國的因應之道。「國防政策」單元，在論述我國國防政策內涵及大陸政策的發展，使學生認識當前國防政策施政方針，增進國防安全知識；並介紹我國國家安全法制與危機管理機制，藉此體認國家安全的重要性，加強全民國防意識。「全民國防」單元，主要論述國家意識及全民防衛的概念、內涵與重要性，並介紹國防與經濟、文化、心理的關聯，讓學生理解國防事務其實與生活息息相關，加強全民國防意識，增進對國家的認同。「防衛動員」單元，在探討全民防衛動員的意義與功能，說明全民防衛動員對國家安全的重要性；並介紹青年服勤動員內涵，讓學生體會自己在全民防衛動員體系中所扮演的角色，進而涵養愛國意識，深化全民國防共識。「國防科技」單元，主要使學生了解武器系統概況，並認識國防科技發展與我國國防產業現況，引發對國防科技的興趣，進而認同國防、支持國防。
description.en: In order to meet the requirement of Act of All-Out Defense Education put into action in February 2006, the curriculum of All-Out Defense Education Military Training planned by Ministry of Education is divided into five areas: International Situations, National Defense Policies, Civil Defense, Defense Mobilization, and Military Technology. In International Situations, the object is to cultivate students’ broader international perspectives through discussing Asian-Pacific regional security and the development of cross-strait relation. In Civil Defense, the object is to let students aware that national defense affairs are closely related to their daily life. In Defense Mobilization, the object is to let students recognize their roles all-out defense mobilization system. In Defense Technology, the main object is to let students overview the development of weapon systems, and understand the current development of the nation’s defense technology and defense industry.

syllabi.schedule:
1.國家意識
上課週數：2
單元主題：國家意識的意義與重要性、國家認同、我國的國家認同問題、國家意識與民族精神的建構
2.全民防衛
上課週數：1
單元主題：安全概念的轉變、人類安全與國家安全、全民國防的重要性、全民國防的效益
3.經濟與國防
上課週數：1
單元主題：經濟發展與國家安全、經濟安全對國家安全的影響、我國的經濟安全威脅、國防科技發展與經濟
4.文化與心理
上課週數：1
單元主題：文化的意義與作用、文化認同、民族認同與國家安全、心理戰對國家安全的影響、中國大陸對我國的文化與心理戰略
5.我國安全情勢與全民國防
上課週數：1
單元主題：非傳統安全情勢與全民國防、亞太安全情勢與全民國防、兩岸情勢與全民國防
6.全民國防與教育
上課週數：1
單元主題：全民國防教育的內涵、全民國防教育的戰略價值、全民國防教育的執行成效
7.亞太重要安全議題
上課週數：1
單元主題：中國大陸軍事現代化與軍事崛起、朝鮮半島的衝突與危機、東海領土爭議、南海情勢、美中印太戰略對峙的演變
8.國際重要安全議題
上課週數：1
單元主題：網路與資訊安全威脅、大規模毀滅性武器持續擴散、國際恐怖主義的威脅、糧食安全與氣候變遷、人口流動與非法移民、能源安全
9.武裝衝突法及日內瓦公約
上課週數：1
單元主題：武裝衝突法及日內瓦公約的緣起與簡介、武裝衝突法及日內瓦公約的規範與基本倫理
10.軍人禮節與警衛勤務
上課週數：1
單元主題：軍人禮節的目的、軍人禮節的種類與要求、警衛勤務的目的與意義、警衛勤務任務的職責、編組與執行要領、警衛勤務失職處分
11.軍紀教育（含申訴制度）
上課週數：1
單元主題：軍人義務及權利、軍紀定義、要素與要求、申訴制度、1985諮詢服務專線及國軍官兵權益保障會
12.軍法教育
上課週數：1
單元主題：認識軍法、陸海空軍懲罰法、陸海空軍刑法、軍事審判法─平、戰時軍人犯罪之審判及量刑區別、軍法案例分析與介紹
13.愛國教育
上課週數：1
單元主題：軍隊紀律對國軍建軍與備戰的重要性、軍隊教育與實踐對部隊戰力的影響
14.軍事訓練課程-基本教練操作及討論講評
上課週數：2
單元主題：單兵徒手基本教練（立正、稍息、敬禮、蹲下、起立、齊步走、停止間轉法）
15.測驗
上課週數：2

description.en: The teaching goal is to establish students’ healthy lifestyle, sportsmanship, teamwork and exercise habit. In First, Second, and Third grade students are taught many sport skills in the same class. In Fourth grade, we are offering specific sports to the students, like Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Tennis, Tai Chi Chuan, Physical Fitness and martial arts. Students can choose they are interested.

description.zh: 本課程在介紹及闡述化學原理及物質之性質，強調現代化學理論及概念之導入。介紹的內容包括有效數位、氣體、計量化學、原子結構、化學鍵、物質狀態改變、合成的高分子材料、熱力學、化學平衡、酸鹼理論與氧化還原反應、核化學。
description.en: -The course is to introduce the principles of chemistry and the properties of matter with emphasis on modern chemical theory and conceptual problems. Individual topics include significant figures, gas, stoichiometry, atomic structure, chemical bonding, and the states of matter, changes of states, synthetic polymer materials, thermodynamic, chemical equilibrium, acid-base theory and oxidation-reduction reactions, nuclear chemistry.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，培養學生邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習微積分及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.多項式，2.不等式及其應用，3.直角坐標及函數，4.三角函數及其應用，5.複數，6.平面之圓錐曲線，7.指數及對數函數，8.向量，9.矩陣，10.三度空間的基本觀念，11.數列與級數，12.排列組合與機率。
description.en: The course aims at: developing comprehension of algebra, trigonometry, analytical geometry, activating capabilities of logic inference and induction, enlightening confidence and independence, strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and graph, furnishing a sound basis for future specialty including Calculus. The content includes: 1.Polynomial, 2.Inequalities and its Application, 3.Rectangular Coordinate System and Functions, 4.Trigonometric Functions and its Application , 5.Complex Numbers, 6.Conic Section, 7. Exponential and Logarithmic Functions, 8.Vectors, 9.Matrix, 10.Elementary Concept of Three Dimensional Space, 11.Sequences and Series, 12.Permutation, Combination and Probability.

description.zh: 本課程以深入淺出的方式帶領學生了解發生在生活週遭的故事，自大架構的歷史發展出發，以物質文化、日常生活、宗教祭儀、農村發展、都市變遷等不同面向的人事物作為案例分析與討論，同時搭配人文地理學相關概念，包含地方感、文化地景、區域發展等，使學生理解人文與環境之間的互動關係，進而對於當代社會樣貌能有更深入的觀察與認識。
description.en: This course introduces different concepts of history and geography. Case studies related to material culture, daily life, religious ceremonies, rural and urban transition are offered for understanding the historical connections between human being and environment. Some geographical concepts, includes sense of place, cultural landscape, regional development are also applied in this course to help students to examine the relationship between history and geography, and culture and nature.

description.zh: 本課程目的在啟發學生英語聽力，分析及思辨能力。本課程自報紙，雜誌及電視選取豐富的教材, 以訓練聽力及筆記的技巧。 此外，在課堂上將討論一些有爭議性的或者有趣的議題，以培養學生獨立思辨能力。
description.en: The course aims to develop the student's listening techniques and critical thinking in English. A variety of texts will be selected from newspapers, magazines and T.V. to reinforce listening training and note-taking skills. Besides, some controversial or interesting issues will be discussed in class to encourage the student's independent and critical thinking.

syllabi.schedule:
第一週  教學內容簡介、工場安全規則、安全衛生教育訓練講解與說明、實施學生分組、開工與收工的工作分配、領取刀具與工具、實習材料預備與分配。
第二週  量具介紹，游標卡尺、游標高度規原理、使用例與保養。
第三週  高速車床的構造與操作練習；車刀款式介紹，車刀各角度介紹。
第四週  車削練習：四爪夾持；車刀架設與校正；切削速度、進刀量、切削深度選擇，自動進刀使用。
第五週  車削練習：階級、端面車削練習。
第六週  車削練習、尺寸控制：游標卡尺量測，進給手輪刻度使用。
第七週  銑床介紹：銑床工件夾持、虎鉗校正、銑刀裝設、轉速變換練習。
第八週  銑削練習：六面體加工。
第九週  銑削練習：直槽加工。
第十週  銑削練習：斜槽加工。
第十一週  銑削練習：直斜槽加工綜合練習。
第十二週  鑽床介紹，工件夾持；鑽頭、絲攻與鉸刀介紹。
第十三週  鑽床加工：畫線、鑽孔、攻牙、鉸孔練習。
第十四週  銲接教學環境與設備介紹、教學內容簡介、銲接工場安全規則說明 。
第十五週  銲接實習：起弧與平銲練習(平銲直線練習)           
第十六週  綜合操作
第十七週  綜合操作與測驗、實習報告繳交。
第十八週  期末考試：工場整理，機器保養。

1.各單元加工實習成績（平均）佔50％

description.zh: 「全民國防教育法」自民國95年2月開始施行，以國際情勢、國防政策、全民國防、防衛動員、國防科技五大主軸作為全民國防教育的課程規畫。「國際情勢」單元，主要論述區域安全與兩岸情勢發展，培育學生宏觀的國際視野；更進一步說明在全球化浪潮下，國際重要的安全議題及我國的因應之道。「國防政策」單元，在論述我國國防政策內涵及大陸政策的發展，使學生認識當前國防政策施政方針，增進國防安全知識；並介紹我國國家安全法制與危機管理機制，藉此體認國家安全的重要性，加強全民國防意識。「全民國防」單元，主要論述國家意識及全民防衛的概念、內涵與重要性，並介紹國防與經濟、文化、心理的關聯，讓學生理解國防事務其實與生活息息相關，加強全民國防意識，增進對國家的認同。「防衛動員」單元，在探討全民防衛動員的意義與功能，說明全民防衛動員對國家安全的重要性；並介紹青年服勤動員內涵，讓學生體會自己在全民防衛動員體系中所扮演的角色，進而涵養愛國意識，深化全民國防共識。「國防科技」單元，主要使學生了解武器系統概況，並認識國防科技發展與我國國防產業現況，引發對國防科技的興趣，進而認同國防、支持國防。
description.en: In order to meet the requirement of Act of All-Out Defense Education that put into action in February 2006, the curriculum of All-Out Defense Education Military Training planned by Ministry of Education is divided into five sections: International Situations, National Defense Policies, Civil Defense, Defense Mobilization, and Military Technology. In International Situations, the object is to cultivate students’ broader international perspectives through discussing Asian-Pacific regional security and the development of cross-strait relation. In Civil Defense, the object is to make students aware that national defense affairs are closely related to their daily life. In Defense Mobilization, the object is to let students recognize their roles in all-out defense mobilization system. In Defense Technology, the main object is to let students overview the development of weapon systems, and understand the current development of the nation’s defense technology and defense industry.

name.en: English Communication and Application I (ECA Courses)

description.zh: ECA 課程專為大一非英語母語的學生設計，加強英語語言技能，特別強調溝通能力和社會、文化、及專業實務應用。 通過整合四種語言技巧能力（閱讀、聽力、口語和寫作），將課堂英語文教學連結至與實務溝通情境之英語文使用。以下為課程設計及教學法之主軸：溝通語言教學（CLT）、任務型導向（TBL）和內容導向教學（CBI），培養學生的英語語言能力為進階專業英文之基礎。
description.en: The ECA courses are designed for the first-year (freshman), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English language skills, with particular emphasis on communicative competence and practical application in social, cultural and professional contexts. By integrating the four skills (reading, listening, speaking and writing), the primary objective is to connect the classroom ELT with the real-life communicative situations. To that end, the courses adopt the following approaches: communicative language teaching (CLT), task-based learning (TBL), and content-based instruction (CBI), building a holistic pedagogy to English instruction and developing students’ English language proficiency for the next level ESP courses.

description.zh:
本課程目標乃是協助學生透過有意義之社區服務活動，認識服務學習理念，從服務學習中體驗服務的意義，深化學習的領域、擴大自己的生活範疇與生命歷練。
課程內容：包含三大類
（一）志願服務基礎課程：選取志願服務相關主題，由授課教師於課堂上講述。可包含服務學習理論、內政部志願服務法所訂定之六大主題（志願服務的內涵、志願服務倫理、自我了解及自我肯定、志願服務經驗分享、志願服務法規之認識、志願服務發展趨勢），或非營利組織、服務機構之介紹等等。
（二）社區服務：選擇服務機構前往服務，於本學期內完成授課教師所規定服務時數或內容。
（三）課堂討論與反思：學生必須進行服務經驗分享與討論，並撰寫與繳交服務日誌、心得報告。
description.en:
This course is geared to expand and intensify students' learning beyond classroom by introducing service learning as an integral part of holistic life learning experience. Apart from class work, students will be able to not only understand the significance of services and experience the true value of such learning through various forms of community work. The course is designed to deepen their learning and life experience.
I. Core curricula of services: The course is structured on the framework of six themes in service learning by theory and practice as well as legal regulations regarding community services enacted by the Ministry of the Interior. The six themes respectively are: significance of service; standards of service; self-comprehension and affirmation; sharing service experience; service law and trends; and non-profit and service organizations.
II. Community service: Students select or be arranged to service organizations and are responsible for completing service assignments

syllabi.outline: 服務學習(SERVICE-LEARNING)為一種將「服務」與「學習」相互結合的一門課程，強調服務與學習目標同等重要，以達「互惠」之功效，是一種「從做中學」(Learning by doing)的學習經歷！透過事先規劃的社會服務過程中得到啟發及省思，並藉由反思引導學生獨立思考與關注社會議題，讓學生運用課堂所學服務他人與貢獻社區，並在過程中不斷地自我成長，學習課堂中學不到的知識、經驗與價值觀，所以服務學習是學校教育中非常重要的一環！臺北科大為發揮誠樸精勤之校訓，養成學生主動積極、負責自律、勤勞服務、互助合作之美德，鍛鍊周詳規劃、領導統馭之能力，精進服務學習課程之效果，達到關懷弱勢、縮短貧富差距、落實社會正義及完成學生、家庭、學校、社區、與社福單位五贏之目標。

name.en: First step to achieving the goals of universities and Engineering Ethics

description.zh: 大學入門是針對大一新生所開授之全校性課程。用以協助學生:(一)認識高等教育的理念、目的與價值(二)有效學習(三)涵養正視困境並妥適因應能力。藉以實踐自我鍛鍊，自我掌握，自我經營並建構宏觀視界的高等教育宗旨。依據提供服務準則,工程師們須以誠實公平公正正當和奉獻保護公共健康,安全及幸福。工程師們必須以專業標準的行為履行最高的倫理準則。本課程以（1）工程倫理概述（2）衝突與抉擇（3）守則與解說（4）個案分析，提供學生瞭解及研析。
description.en: "First step to achieving the goals of universities" is a campus-wide course provided for all of the first-year students at this school. The course is designed to help first-year students to achieve the following aims and objectives:(1) understanding the basic idea, goals, and fundamental value of higher education at college level;(2) learning proper study attitudes and methods effectively;(3) cultivating the required abilities and skills of responding appropriately to setbacks and difficult situations in order to acquire self-knowledge, self-control, and self-management. Accordingly, the services provided by engineers require honesty, impartiality, fairness, and equity and must be dedicated to protection of the public health, safety and welfare. syllabi.outline:

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

description.zh: 「全民國防教育法」自民國95年2月開始施行，以國際情勢、國防政策、全民國防、防衛動員、國防科技五大主軸作為全民國防教育的課程規畫。「國際情勢」單元，主要論述區域安全與兩岸情勢發展，培育學生宏觀的國際視野；更進一步說明在全球化浪潮下，國際重要的安全議題及我國的因應之道。「國防政策」單元，在論述我國國防政策內涵及大陸政策的發展，使學生認識當前國防政策施政方針，增進國防安全知識；並介紹我國國家安全法制與危機管理機制，藉此體認國家安全的重要性，加強全民國防意識。「全民國防」單元，主要論述國家意識及全民防衛的概念、內涵與重要性，並介紹國防與經濟、文化、心理的關聯，讓學生理解國防事務其實與生活息息相關，加強全民國防意識，增進對國家的認同。「防衛動員」單元，在探討全民防衛動員的意義與功能，說明全民防衛動員對國家安全的重要性；並介紹青年服勤動員內涵，讓學生體會自己在全民防衛動員體系中所扮演的角色，進而涵養愛國意識，深化全民國防共識。「國防科技」單元，主要使學生了解武器系統概況，並認識國防科技發展與我國國防產業現況，引發對國防科技的興趣，進而認同國防、支持國防。
description.en: In order to meet the requirement of Act of All-Out Defense Education that put into action in February 2006, the curriculum of All-Out Defense Education Military Training planned by Ministry of Education is divided into five sections: International Situations, National Defense Policies, Civil Defense, Defense Mobilization, and Military Technology. In International Situations, the object is to cultivate students’ broader international perspectives through discussing Asian-Pacific regional security and the development of cross-strait relation. In Civil Defense, the object is to make students aware that national defense affairs are closely related to their daily life. In Defense Mobilization, the object is to let students recognize their roles in all-out defense mobilization system. In Defense Technology, the main object is to let students overview the development of weapon systems, and understand the current development of the nation’s defense technology and defense industry.

description.zh: ECA 課程專為大一非英語母語的學生設計，加強英語語言技能，特別強調溝通能力和社會、文化、及專業實務應用。 通過整合四種語言技巧能力（閱讀、聽力、口語和寫作），將課堂英語文教學連結至與實務溝通情境之英語文使用。以下為課程設計及教學法之主軸：溝通語言教學（CLT）、任務型導向（TBL）和內容導向教學（CBI），培養學生的英語語言能力為進階專業英文之基礎。
description.en: The ECA courses are designed for the first-year (freshman), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English language skills, with particular emphasis on communicative competence and practical application in social, cultural and professional contexts. By integrating the four skills (reading, listening, speaking and writing), the primary objective is to connect the classroom ELT with the real-life communicative situations. To that end, the courses adopt the following approaches: communicative language teaching (CLT), task-based learning (TBL), and content-based instruction (CBI), building a holistic pedagogy to English instruction and developing students’ English language proficiency for the next level ESP courses.

syllabi.outline:
本課程教授商業領域知識以及實務應用。修習本課程之學生，將習得中高階英語素養以及商務溝通基本知識。課程內容包含: 基礎商業概念、重點時事商業議題、基本商業字彙，和廣泛商業實務用語。
The course is designed for students who wish to strengthen English competence as well as increase their knowledge in business-related issues and expertise in future business practice. All students enrolled in this course are expected to be equipped with high-intermediate level of English proficiency as well as basic knowledge of effective business communication. This course covers rudimentary business concepts, important current business events, essential business terms, and English use in business practice.

本課程目標乃是協助學生透過有意義之社區服務活動，認識服務學習理念，從服務學習中體驗服務的意義，深化學習的領域、擴大自己的生活範疇與生命歷練。
課程內容：包含三大類
（一）志願服務基礎課程：選取志願服務相關主題，由授課教師於課堂上講述。可包含服務學習理論、內政部志願服務法所訂定之六大主題（志願服務的內涵、志願服務倫理、自我了解及自我肯定、志願服務經驗分享、志願服務法規之認識、志願服務發展趨勢），或非營利組織、服務機構之介紹等等。
（二）社區服務：選擇服務機構前往服務，於本學期內完成授課教師所規定服務時數或內容。
（三）課堂討論與反思：學生必須進行服務經驗分享與討論，並撰寫與繳交服務日誌、心得報告。
description.en:
This course is geared to expand and intensify students' learning beyond classroom by introducing service learning as an integral part of holistic life learning experience. Apart from class work, students will be able to not only understand the significance of services and experience the true value of such learning through various forms of community work. The course is designed to deepen their learning and life experience.
I. Core curricula of services: The course is structured on the framework of six themes in service learning by theory and practice as well as legal regulations regarding community services enacted by the Ministry of the Interior. The six themes respectively are: significance of service; standards of service; self-comprehension and affirmation; sharing service experience; service law and trends; and non-profit and service organizations.
II. Community service: Students select or be arranged to service organizations and are responsible for completing service assignments

syllabi.outline: 服務學習(SERVICE-LEARNING)為一種將「服務」與「學習」相互結合的一門課程，強調服務與學習目標同等重要，以達「互惠」之功效，是一種「從做中學」(Learning by doing)的學習經歷！透過事先規劃的社會服務過程中得到啟發及省思，並藉由反思引導學生獨立思考與關注社會議題，讓學生運用課堂所學服務他人與貢獻社區，並在過程中不斷地自我成長，學習課堂中學不到的知識、經驗與價值觀，所以服務學習是學校教育中非常重要的一環！臺北科大為發揮誠樸精勤之校訓，養成學生主動積極、負責自律、勤勞服務、互助合作之美德，鍛鍊周詳規劃、領導統馭之能力，精進服務學習課程之效果，達到關懷弱勢、縮短貧富差距、落實社會正義及完成學生、家庭、學校、社區、與社福單位五贏之目標。

description.zh: 大學入門是針對大一新生所開授之全校性課程。用以協助學生:(一)認識高等教育的理念、目的與價值(二)有效學習(三)涵養正視困境並妥適因應能力。藉以實踐自我鍛鍊，自我掌握，自我經營並建構宏觀視界的高等教育宗旨。依據提供服務準則,工程師們須以誠實公平公正正當和奉獻保護公共健康,安全及幸福。工程師們必須以專業標準的行為履行最高的倫理準則。本課程以（1）工程倫理概述（2）衝突與抉擇（3）守則與解說（4）個案分析，提供學生瞭解及研析。
description.en: "First step to achieving the goals of universities" is a campus-wide course provided for all of the first-year students at this school. The course is designed to help first-year students to achieve the following aims and objectives:(1) understanding the basic idea, goals, and fundamental value of higher education at college level;(2) learning proper study attitudes and methods effectively;(3) cultivating the required abilities and skills of responding appropriately to setbacks and difficult situations in order to acquire self-knowledge, self-control, and self-management. Accordingly, the services provided by engineers require honesty, impartiality, fairness, and equity and must be dedicated to protection of the public health, safety and welfare. This course offers (1).Description of engineering ethics (2).Conflict and selection (3).Rule and explanation (4).Case study for student studied.

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

description.zh: 「全民國防教育法」自民國95年2月開始施行，以國際情勢、國防政策、全民國防、防衛動員、國防科技五大主軸作為全民國防教育的課程規畫。「國際情勢」單元，主要論述區域安全與兩岸情勢發展，培育學生宏觀的國際視野；更進一步說明在全球化浪潮下，國際重要的安全議題及我國的因應之道。「國防政策」單元，在論述我國國防政策內涵及大陸政策的發展，使學生認識當前國防政策施政方針，增進國防安全知識；並介紹我國國家安全法制與危機管理機制，藉此體認國家安全的重要性，加強全民國防意識。「全民國防」單元，主要論述國家意識及全民防衛的概念、內涵與重要性，並介紹國防與經濟、文化、心理的關聯，讓學生理解國防事務其實與生活息息相關，加強全民國防意識，增進對國家的認同。「防衛動員」單元，在探討全民防衛動員的意義與功能，說明全民防衛動員對國家安全的重要性；並介紹青年服勤動員內涵，讓學生體會自己在全民防衛動員體系中所扮演的角色，進而涵養愛國意識，深化全民國防共識。「國防科技」單元，主要使學生了解武器系統概況，並認識國防科技發展與我國國防產業現況，引發對國防科技的興趣，進而認同國防、支持國防。
description.en: In order to meet the requirement of Act of All-Out Defense Education that put into action in February 2006, the curriculum of All-Out Defense Education Military Training planned by Ministry of Education is divided into five sections: International Situations, National Defense Policies, Civil Defense, Defense Mobilization, and Military Technology. In International Situations, the object is to cultivate students’ broader international perspectives through discussing Asian-Pacific regional security and the development of cross-strait relation. In Civil Defense, the object is to make students aware that national defense affairs are closely related to their daily life. In Defense Mobilization, the object is to let students recognize their roles in all-out defense mobilization system. In Defense Technology, the main object is to let students overview the development of weapon systems, and understand the current development of the nation’s defense technology and defense industry.

description.zh: ECA 課程專為大一非英語母語的學生設計，加強英語語言技能，特別強調溝通能力和社會、文化、及專業實務應用。 通過整合四種語言技巧能力（閱讀、聽力、口語和寫作），將課堂英語文教學連結至與實務溝通情境之英語文使用。以下為課程設計及教學法之主軸：溝通語言教學（CLT）、任務型導向（TBL）和內容導向教學（CBI），培養學生的英語語言能力為進階專業英文之基礎。
description.en: The ECA courses are designed for the first-year (freshman), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English language skills, with particular emphasis on communicative competence and practical application in social, cultural and professional contexts. By integrating the four skills (reading, listening, speaking and writing), the primary objective is to connect the classroom ELT with the real-life communicative situations. To that end, the courses adopt the following approaches: communicative language teaching (CLT), task-based learning (TBL), and content-based instruction (CBI), building a holistic pedagogy to English instruction and developing students’ English language proficiency for the next level ESP courses.

description.zh:
本課程目標是協助學生透過校園環境整理及打掃體驗活動，認識勞作教育之理念，從勞作課程中養成同學不怕苦、不怕難與不怕髒的企業家精神，使學生透過實際的勞作課程，培養學生手腦並用，勤勞愛物的觀念，培養學生健全的人格、良好品德、正確的價值觀及刻苦耐勞的工作態度。
課程內容：包含四大階段
（一）勞作教育理念介紹：選取勞作教育相關主題，由授課教師於課堂上講述。可包含勞作教育意義、勞作教育前測作業說明
（二）勞作教育實作階段：勞作課程分三項不同情境施作。
（三）課堂討論與反思：學生必須於各實作階段課程進行討論與反思，並撰寫心得報告、完成後測作業。
（四）期末成果分享：勞作教育期末成果分享，並辦理獎勵工作。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to introduce the idea of labor service to students. Students who take this course have to participate in the campus cleaning activities. This is to help students building up: (i) the team-work abilities; (ii) the concepts of ethics; (iii) the abilities of concerning the society. In addition, the course would help students to develop the accurate attitudes in the daily life and the healthy personalities. Furthermore, this course would also help students to enrich the sense of humanities. Four stages are included in this course: (i) the introduction of the labor service, (ii) the field work studies, (iii) the class discussions, and (iv) sharing of the experiences of the labor service.

syllabi.outline:
期望學生透過校園環境整理及打掃體驗活動，認識勞作教育之理念，並從實作課程中養成同學不怕苦、不怕難與不怕髒的企業家精神，同時建立學生手腦並用，勤勞愛物的觀念，培養學生健全的人格品德、正確的價值觀及刻苦耐勞的工作態度。

Students are expected to understand the concept of labor education through campus environment maintenance and cleaning activities. Through hands-on courses, students will develop an entrepreneurial spirit of not fearing hardship, difficulty, or dirt. Additionally, the activities aim to instill the values of diligent work, care for belongings, and the simultaneous use of both hands and mind. These experiences will help cultivate well-rounded character, correct values, and a strong work ethic in students.
syllabi.schedule:
第一階段：勞作教育理念介紹
由授課教師於課堂上講述勞作教育的意義及學期課程內容。
第二階段：實作體驗及反思
透過校園及外圍環境整理，讓同學們體驗不怕苦、不怕難與不怕髒的精神，並於體驗後進行討論及撰寫反思單，啟發同學多元思考。
第三階段：期末成果分享
學期末彙整學期課程剪影，並回顧反思學習成果。

Phase 1: Introduction to Labor Education Concepts
The instructor will explain the significance of labor education and the course content for the semester during class.

Phase 2: Practical Experience and Reflection
Through the organization of the campus and surrounding environments, students will experience the spirit of not fearing hardship, difficulty, or dirt. After the experience, students will participate in discussions and write reflection papers to inspire diverse thinking.

Phase 3: End-of-Semester Outcome Sharing
At the end of the semester, a compilation of course highlights will be presented, and students will review and reflect on their learning outcomes.

description.en: "First step to achieving the goals of universities" is a campus-wide course provided for all of the first-year students at this school. The course is designed to help first-year students to achieve the following aims and objectives:(1) understanding the basic idea, goals, and fundamental value of higher education at college level;(2) learning proper study attitudes and methods effectively;(3) cultivating the required abilities and skills of responding appropriately to setbacks and difficult situations in order to acquire self-knowledge, self-control, and self-management. Accordingly, the services provided by engineers require honesty, impartiality, fairness, and equity and must be dedicated to protection of the public health, safety and welfare. This course offers (1).Description of engineering ethics (2).Conflict and selection (3).Rule and explanation (4).Case study for student studied.

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分，11.級數，12.常微分方程。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes : 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration, 11.Infinite Series, 12.Ordinary Differential Equation.

syllabi.outline:
CALCULUS (I):
This course aims at developing comprehension of derivation and integral、activating capabilities of logic inference and induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content of Calculus(I)
includes: 1.Functions and Models, 2.Limits and Derivatives, 3.Differentiation Rules, 4.Applications of Differentiation, 5.Integrals, 6.Applications of integration, 7.Techniques of integration  8. Futher Applications of Integration, 9.Parametric equations and polar coordinates  10. Sequences, Series, and Power series, 11.Vectors and the geometry of space 12.Partial derivatives 13.Multiple integrals

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

description.zh: 本課程的目的是為了：1.驗證物理理論之真實性，2.培養同學認真的科學態度與方法，3.培養同學數據處理的能力，4.啟發同學自行設計解決量度問題的方法。課程之施行分為上下兩學期，每一學期為一學分三小時。上學期的內容偏重力學、波動、熱力、流力之實驗，下學期的內容則偏重電磁、光學、近物之實驗。
description.en: In this course there will be 1 credit for each of two semesters, and 3 laboraborial hours per week. The first semester experiments involve mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, and waves, etc.. The second semester experiments contains electromagnetics, optics, and modern physics, etc.. The purposes of this course are 1: to identify the physical laws, 2:to cultivate the ability of data reduction of students, 4: to instruct the students solving the problems of measurements of measurements by self-designments.

description.zh:
本課程涵蓋以下主題：
1.數字的進制轉換以及二進制表示方式
2.布林代數式與函數
3.數位電路化簡技巧，如卡諾圖與製表法

description.en:
This course covers the following topics:
1. Number representation, number bases and base conversions, and binary codes
2. Boolean algebra and functions, canonical forms
3. Combinational design techniques: K-maps, tabulation method
4. Combinational logic circuits: adders/subtractors, comparators, multiplexors/demultiplexors, and decoders/encoders
5. Programmable logic circuits: read-only memory/programmable read-only memory (ROM/PROM), programmable logic devices (PLD), and programmable logic arrays (PLA)
6. Sequential logic circuits: state machine

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技一、二年級實施專項分組教學，由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh: 「全民國防教育法」自民國95年2月開始施行，以國際情勢、國防政策、全民國防、防衛動員、國防科技五大主軸作為全民國防教育的課程規畫。「國際情勢」單元，主要論述區域安全與兩岸情勢發展，培育學生宏觀的國際視野；更進一步說明在全球化浪潮下，國際重要的安全議題及我國的因應之道。「國防政策」單元，在論述我國國防政策內涵及大陸政策的發展，使學生認識當前國防政策施政方針，增進國防安全知識；並介紹我國國家安全法制與危機管理機制，藉此體認國家安全的重要性，加強全民國防意識。「全民國防」單元，主要論述國家意識及全民防衛的概念、內涵與重要性，並介紹國防與經濟、文化、心理的關聯，讓學生理解國防事務其實與生活息息相關，加強全民國防意識，增進對國家的認同。「防衛動員」單元，在探討全民防衛動員的意義與功能，說明全民防衛動員對國家安全的重要性；並介紹青年服勤動員內涵，讓學生體會自己在全民防衛動員體系中所扮演的角色，進而涵養愛國意識，深化全民國防共識。「國防科技」單元，主要使學生了解武器系統概況，並認識國防科技發展與我國國防產業現況，引發對國防科技的興趣，進而認同國防、支持國防。
description.en: In order to meet the requirement of Act of All-Out Defense Education that put into action in February 2006, the curriculum of All-Out Defense Education Military Training planned by Ministry of Education is divided into five sections: International Situations, National Defense Policies, Civil Defense, Defense Mobilization, and Military Technology. In International Situations, the object is to cultivate students’ broader international perspectives through discussing Asian-Pacific regional security and the development of cross-strait relation. In Civil Defense, the object is to make students aware that national defense affairs are closely related to their daily life. In Defense Mobilization, the object is to let students recognize their roles in all-out defense mobilization system. In Defense Technology, the main object is to let students overview the development of weapon systems, and understand the current development of the nation’s defense technology and defense industry.

name.en: English Communication and Application I (ECA Courses)

description.zh: ECA 課程專為大一非英語母語的學生設計，加強英語語言技能，特別強調溝通能力和社會、文化、及專業實務應用。 通過整合四種語言技巧能力（閱讀、聽力、口語和寫作），將課堂英語文教學連結至與實務溝通情境之英語文使用。以下為課程設計及教學法之主軸：溝通語言教學（CLT）、任務型導向（TBL）和內容導向教學（CBI），培養學生的英語語言能力為進階專業英文之基礎。
description.en: The ECA courses are designed for the first-year (freshman), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English language skills, with particular emphasis on communicative competence and practical application in social, cultural and professional contexts. By integrating the four skills (reading, listening, speaking and writing), the primary objective is to connect the classroom ELT with the real-life communicative situations. To that end, the courses adopt the following approaches: communicative language teaching (CLT), task-based learning (TBL), and content-based instruction (CBI), building a holistic pedagogy to English instruction and developing students’ English language proficiency for the next level ESP courses.

description.zh:
本課程目標是協助學生透過校園環境整理及打掃體驗活動，認識勞作教育之理念，從勞作課程中養成同學不怕苦、不怕難與不怕髒的企業家精神，使學生透過實際的勞作課程，培養學生手腦並用，勤勞愛物的觀念，培養學生健全的人格、良好品德、正確的價值觀及刻苦耐勞的工作態度。
課程內容：包含四大階段
（一）勞作教育理念介紹：選取勞作教育相關主題，由授課教師於課堂上講述。可包含勞作教育意義、勞作教育前測作業說明
（二）勞作教育實作階段：勞作課程分三項不同情境施作。
（三）課堂討論與反思：學生必須於各實作階段課程進行討論與反思，並撰寫心得報告、完成後測作業。
（四）期末成果分享：勞作教育期末成果分享，並辦理獎勵工作。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to introduce the idea of labor service to students. Students who take this course have to participate in the campus cleaning activities. This is to help students building up: (i) the team-work abilities; (ii) the concepts of ethics; (iii) the abilities of concerning the society. In addition, the course would help students to develop the accurate attitudes in the daily life and the healthy personalities. Furthermore, this course would also help students to enrich the sense of humanities. Four stages are included in this course: (i) the introduction of the labor service, (ii) the field work studies, (iii) the class discussions, and (iv) sharing of the experiences of the labor service.

name.en: First step to achieving the goals of universities and Engineering Ethics

description.zh: 大學入門是針對大一新生所開授之全校性課程。用以協助學生:(一)認識高等教育的理念、目的與價值(二)有效學習(三)涵養正視困境並妥適因應能力。藉以實踐自我鍛鍊，自我掌握，自我經營並建構宏觀視界的高等教育宗旨。依據提供服務準則,工程師們須以誠實公平公正正當和奉獻保護公共健康,安全及幸福。工程師們必須以專業標準的行為履行最高的倫理準則。本課程以（1）工程倫理概述（2）衝突與抉擇（3）守則與解說（4）個案分析，提供學生瞭解及研析。
description.en: "First step to achieving the goals of universities" is a campus-wide course provided for all of the first-year students at this school. The course is designed to help first-year students to achieve the following aims and objectives:(1) understanding the basic idea, goals, and fundamental value of higher education at college level;(2) learning proper study attitudes and methods effectively;(3) cultivating the required abilities and skills of responding appropriately to setbacks and difficult situations in order to acquire self-knowledge, self-control, and self-management. Accordingly, the services provided by engineers require honesty, impartiality, fairness, and equity and must be dedicated to protection of the public health, safety and welfare. This course offers (1).Description of engineering ethics (2).Conflict and selection (3).Rule and explanation (4).Case study for student studied.

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分，11.級數，12.常微分方程。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes : 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration, 11.Infinite Series, 12.Ordinary Differential Equation.

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

syllabi.outline:
此課程旨在使學生理解自然界中常見的物理現象，進而領會物理-生活-科技之關聯。教學以工程背景學生所需要的物理基礎搭配實務探討來進行。主題涵蓋力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學等物理相關的觀念與應用。
This course aims to enable students to understand common physical phenomena in nature and then understand the connection between physics, life and technology. The teaching is based on the physical foundation required by students with engineering background and practical discussions. Topics cover physics-related concepts and applications such as mechanics, thermodynamics, acoustics, electromagnetism, and optics.

6. Sequential logic circuits: state machine

description.zh: 「全民國防教育法」自民國95年2月開始施行，以國際情勢、國防政策、全民國防、防衛動員、國防科技五大主軸作為全民國防教育的課程規畫。「國際情勢」單元，主要論述區域安全與兩岸情勢發展，培育學生宏觀的國際視野；更進一步說明在全球化浪潮下，國際重要的安全議題及我國的因應之道。「國防政策」單元，在論述我國國防政策內涵及大陸政策的發展，使學生認識當前國防政策施政方針，增進國防安全知識；並介紹我國國家安全法制與危機管理機制，藉此體認國家安全的重要性，加強全民國防意識。「全民國防」單元，主要論述國家意識及全民防衛的概念、內涵與重要性，並介紹國防與經濟、文化、心理的關聯，讓學生理解國防事務其實與生活息息相關，加強全民國防意識，增進對國家的認同。「防衛動員」單元，在探討全民防衛動員的意義與功能，說明全民防衛動員對國家安全的重要性；並介紹青年服勤動員內涵，讓學生體會自己在全民防衛動員體系中所扮演的角色，進而涵養愛國意識，深化全民國防共識。「國防科技」單元，主要使學生了解武器系統概況，並認識國防科技發展與我國國防產業現況，引發對國防科技的興趣，進而認同國防、支持國防。
description.en: In order to meet the requirement of Act of All-Out Defense Education that put into action in February 2006, the curriculum of All-Out Defense Education Military Training planned by Ministry of Education is divided into five sections: International Situations, National Defense Policies, Civil Defense, Defense Mobilization, and Military Technology. In International Situations, the object is to cultivate students’ broader international perspectives through discussing Asian-Pacific regional security and the development of cross-strait relation. In Civil Defense, the object is to make students aware that national defense affairs are closely related to their daily life. In Defense Mobilization, the object is to let students recognize their roles in all-out defense mobilization system. In Defense Technology, the main object is to let students overview the development of weapon systems, and understand the current development of the nation’s defense technology and defense industry.

一、防衛動員基本概念

name.en: English Communication and Application I (ECA Courses)

description.zh: ECA 課程專為大一非英語母語的學生設計，加強英語語言技能，特別強調溝通能力和社會、文化、及專業實務應用。 通過整合四種語言技巧能力（閱讀、聽力、口語和寫作），將課堂英語文教學連結至與實務溝通情境之英語文使用。以下為課程設計及教學法之主軸：溝通語言教學（CLT）、任務型導向（TBL）和內容導向教學（CBI），培養學生的英語語言能力為進階專業英文之基礎。
description.en: The ECA courses are designed for the first-year (freshman), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English language skills, with particular emphasis on communicative competence and practical application in social, cultural and professional contexts. By integrating the four skills (reading, listening, speaking and writing), the primary objective is to connect the classroom ELT with the real-life communicative situations. To that end, the courses adopt the following approaches: communicative language teaching (CLT), task-based learning (TBL), and content-based instruction (CBI), building a holistic pedagogy to English instruction and developing students’ English language proficiency for the next level ESP courses.

syllabi.outline:
課程重點：(1)藉由適合其程度的教材加強學生必備的基礎文法觀念和句型結構；(2)使學生確切把握閱讀要領以及充分瞭解寫作的各種技巧，重心在生字、片語、句法的解釋和基本寫作技巧的分析；(3)熟悉英語人士日常生活情境及與學生將來就業環境相關之會話及適當之應對方式；(4)透過練習加強聽、說、讀、寫的知能及表達。
This course is designed (1) to strengthen students' previously required knowledge in English with basic grammatical ideas and sentence patterns reviewed through reading materials appropriate to their levels; (2) to develop reading skill by giving explanation of difficult words, phrases, and syntax, as well as analysis of basic writing skill; (3)to  familiarize students with useful expressions in conversation and build up their confidence in cross-cultural communication; (4)to reinforce the competence and performance of listening, speaking, reading and writing by practice.
syllabi.schedule:
Week 1: Course overview & Getting to Know Each Other
- Activities: Self-introductions, Ice-breaker games, pair discussions
- Task: Write a brief paragraph about yourself.

Week 2: Presentation Skills
- Activities: Group work & discussions
- Task: make a presentation about your favorite topic.

Week 3-4: Making New Friends
- Reading: Does birth order determine personality?
- Grammar & Quiz: Gerunds & infinitives
- Activities: Pair practice, topic discussions
- Task: Write a paragraph describing a good friend or a soul mate
- Presentation Skills

Week 5-6: Sharing Life Experiences 
- Reading: The ways we greet each other
- Grammar & Quiz: the simple pst & the present perfect
- Activities: Pair practice, topic discussions
- Task: Write about a memorable experience
- Presentation Skills

Week 7: Keys to Success
- Activities: Group work & discussions
- Task: Deliver a speech

Week 8-9: Midterm Project 

Week 10-11: Talking about Movies
- Reading: What is it about our favorite movies?
- Grammar & Quiz: the present perfect-other uses
- Activities: Pair practice, topic discussions
- Task: Write a two-paragraph review of a movie
- Presentation Skills

Week 12-13: Away from Home
- Reading: H2H (MyHouse = YourHotel)
- Grammar & Quiz: the future with "will" and "be going to"
- Activities: Pair practice, What Will They Do?
- Task: Write a review of one kind of accommodation
- Presentation Skills

Week 14: Oral practice
- Activities: Group work & discussions
- Task: Create a podcast show

Week 15-16: Looking Good
- Reading: Teens Anonymous
- Grammar & Quiz: Quantifiers for indefinite quantities and amounts
- Activities: Pair practice, topic discussions
- Task: Write a letter of response to someone asking for advice
- Presentation Skills

Week 17-18: Final Project

description.zh:
本課程目標是協助學生透過校園環境整理及打掃體驗活動，認識勞作教育之理念，從勞作課程中養成同學不怕苦、不怕難與不怕髒的企業家精神，使學生透過實際的勞作課程，培養學生手腦並用，勤勞愛物的觀念，培養學生健全的人格、良好品德、正確的價值觀及刻苦耐勞的工作態度。

description.en: The purpose of this course is to introduce the idea of labor service to students. Students who take this course have to participate in the campus cleaning activities. This is to help students building up: (i) the team-work abilities; (ii) the concepts of ethics; (iii) the abilities of concerning the society. In addition, the course would help students to develop the accurate attitudes in the daily life and the healthy personalities. Furthermore, this course would also help students to enrich the sense of humanities. Four stages are included in this course: (i) the introduction of the labor service, (ii) the field work studies, (iii) the class discussions, and (iv) sharing of the experiences of the labor service.

description.zh: 大學入門是針對大一新生所開授之全校性課程。用以協助學生:(一)認識高等教育的理念、目的與價值(二)有效學習(三)涵養正視困境並妥適因應能力。藉以實踐自我鍛鍊，自我掌握，自我經營並建構宏觀視界的高等教育宗旨。依據提供服務準則,工程師們須以誠實公平公正正當和奉獻保護公共健康,安全及幸福。工程師們必須以專業標準的行為履行最高的倫理準則。本課程以（1）工程倫理概述（2）衝突與抉擇（3）守則與解說（4）個案分析，提供學生瞭解及研析。
description.en: "First step to achieving the goals of universities" is a campus-wide course provided for all of the first-year students at this school. The course is designed to help first-year students to achieve the following aims and objectives:(1) understanding the basic idea, goals, and fundamental value of higher education at college level;(2) learning proper study attitudes and methods effectively;(3) cultivating the required abilities and skills of responding appropriately to setbacks and difficult situations in order to acquire self-knowledge, self-control, and self-management. Accordingly, the services provided by engineers require honesty, impartiality, fairness, and equity and must be dedicated to protection of the public health, safety and welfare. This course offers (1).Description of engineering ethics (2).Conflict and selection (3).Rule and explanation (4).Case study for student studied.

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分，11.級數，12.常微分方程。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes : 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration, 11.Infinite Series, 12.Ordinary Differential Equation.

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

syllabi.outline:
此課程旨在使學生理解自然界中常見的物理現象，進而領會物理-生活-科技之關聯。教學以工程背景學生所需要的物理基礎搭配實務探討來進行。主題涵蓋力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學等物理相關的觀念與應用。
This course aims to enable students to understand common physical phenomena in nature and then understand the connection between physics, life and technology. The teaching is based on the physical foundation required by students with engineering background and practical discussions. Topics cover physics-related concepts and applications such as mechanics, thermodynamics, acoustics, electromagnetism, and optics.

The purposes of this course are 1: to identify the physical laws, 2:to cultivate the ability of data reduction of students, 4: to instruct the students solving the problems of measurements of measurements by self-designments.

description.en:
This course covers the following topics:
1. Number representation, number bases and base conversions, and binary codes
2. Boolean algebra and functions, canonical forms
3. Combinational design techniques: K-maps, tabulation method
4. Combinational logic circuits: adders/subtractors, comparators, multiplexors/demultiplexors, and decoders/encoders
5. Programmable logic circuits: read-only memory/programmable read-only memory (ROM/PROM), programmable logic devices (PLD), and programmable logic arrays (PLA)
6. Sequential logic circuits: state machine
