syllabi.outline:
分享30年以上的技術經驗在半導體，電子材料，軟磁材料和特殊鋼產業。主要的應用是電動車，智慧手機，AI ， 5G通訊，電子，汽車，航太，太陽能及風電。能幫助學生了解台灣產業優勢，進而激發學生對材料研究與產品開發的創新思維，強化對學術或產業職涯的規劃。
To share 30+ years of technical experience in various industries like semiconductors, electronic materials, soft magnetic materials, and specialty steels for applications on EV, smartphones, AI, 5G communication, electronics, automobiles, aerospace, solar, and wind. It will help students understand the industrial strengths of Taiwan, inspire their materials innovation in research and product development, and pursue their careers for the future.

description.en: This course focuses the contemporary developments in the study of the structure of carbon compounds and the mechanism of their reactions. Selected topics such as natural product, heterocyclic compound, stereochemistry, aromaticity, reaction intermediates, peptides synthesis and photochemistry will be included.

本課程的目的在於教導已具有大學有機化學基礎之研究所學生，更進一步的了解及深入的有機化學內容，並簡單描述及介紹各種已知的反應與機理，以期能訓練學生對有機化學研究上，對於新的反應能自行推導反應機理，對有機反應能有更進一步的深入了解。

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技一、二年級實施專項分組教學，由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

syllabi.outline:
"Chinese" is the course where we make full use of our native languages to enjoy literary works, to enrich our cultural taste, to develop our thinking and even to elevate human cultivation. This course is ONLY served to INTERNATIONAL students who are at very beginning level. Exchange students are welcome to take it if it has vacancy. Students are with motivation to study Chinese.
This course is for beginners who start learning Chinese. We'll teach from Pinyin, Hanyu Pinyin is our main material to start our pronunciation. Then daily conversation to real life. Listening and speaking are the most skills for this stage. 
For promoting the bilingual ideal, you'll interact with local students. Teacher would do differentiated instruction, you could work with diverse culture in class as well. Enjoy more than 2 different cultures.

syllabi.outline:
本學期將從詩的背景與脈絡介紹，並列舉幾位著名詩人的詩為例。教學目標為學習詩的特色並欣賞其美感。將教授如何從詩的形式，提出其意境及修辭，並進一步運用。
與其說是一門中文課，不如說是心理與生活的課程。且從歷史人物的生命，借鏡於個人生活，在欣賞與反思中，尋出自己的人生道路。請慎選此門課程，以開放、探索的心情，其間將可能反轉你的生涯。
本課程僅供已通過考試之僑生，若未通過考試而選，恐無法由系統選入。
Fist semester : forms and rhetoric. Release your real feeling.
This semester will introduce the background and context of poetry, and give examples of poems by several famous poets. The teaching goal is to learn the characteristics of poetry and appreciate its beauty. It will teach how to present the artistic conception and rhetoric from the form of poetry and further apply them.
It is not so much a Chinese class as it is a psychology and life course. And learn from the lives of historical figures and personal lives, and find your own life path through appreciation and reflection. Please choose this course carefully and with an open and exploratory attitude, as it may turn your life around.
This course is only for overseas students who have passed the exam. If you do not pass the exam, you may not be able to be selected through the system.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分，11.級數。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration, 11.Infinite Series.

This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

第十一週~第十四週   微分的應用 (Applications of Differentiation)

第十五週~第十八週  積分的概念和計算

syllabi.assessment:
1. 上課請親自簽名於座位表上，請勿代簽。 
2. 每出席一次完成簽到得總成績4分，繳交當次出席的心得報告再加4分；若該次專討未出席，不得繳交心得報告，或該次專討為碩博士上台報告，亦不繳交心得。 
3. 心得報告繳交基本份數為六份，六份皆以手寫 300 字稿紙之心得報告（稿紙手寫寫滿，不用刻意空行），並將報告拍照成 pdf檔或 jpg檔，於上課當日至隔日下午17 點前(第三或四周開始可上傳)，上傳至網路 i 學園，逾時不接受補交。 
4. 心得報告繳交除六份外，每多寫一份報告加總成績2分，至多可多繳二份報告。 
5. 上課後一周內，由主持老師之研究室同學製作心得檔案，於中走廊張貼海報，檔案經指導教授審閱修正後，請將電子檔傳楊先生信箱，並於信中註記學號姓名，可抵一份心得報告。
6. 上課週數若遇不可預期因素而停課，將適情況予以調整計分方式。
7. 請假規則：（於系網列印填寫專討用請假單）
8. (1)事假：務必於上課前填妥請假單並檢附相關證明，並請指導教授簽名繳回系辦，逾時視同曠課。
9. (2)病假：請於事後一周內填妥請假單，並檢附正式就診證明，請指導教授簽名繳回系辦，逾時視同曠課。
10.期中、期末考週均不上課，將不另行通知。
11.請隨時注意系走廊電視牆或系網頁公佈上課相關訊息。(題目&上課地點)
12.本學期欲提出寒畢同學，需事先登記，並安排於12/25上台報告論文初稿，方能申請提出口試。

description.zh: 學生與教授討論擬定之研究題目,在教授個別指導下,進行實驗之研究,以培養學生尋找相關資料,文獻及獨立研究的訓練,並將其研究成果撰寫成博士論文及發表於國際期刊。
description.en: To make students able to carry out independent study in master level. Students will be assigned a research topic. An independent experimental design, data analysis, doctoral thesis writing, and paper publication are necessary for this course.

description.zh: 同學們在修過第一年所開的所有的必修課之後，從第三個學期開始，在指導老師的引領下，必須開始著手準備碩士論文的撰寫: 選擇論文題目，收集資料，通過論文大綱審查，開始撰寫論文. . .等等的步驟。從第三個學期開始須修二期之「論文」課程。在論文口試委員們接受該論文並在文件上簽名後，同學們可同時拿到六個學分，完成本碩士課程"論文"這一項的要求。
description.en: After completing all the required courses in the first year, every student is encouraged to initiate the working process toward the completion of his/her MA thesis under the supervision of an advisor. Starting from the third semester, it is required for the student to register for "Thesis" for two semesters.  The "Thesis" courses aim to lead graduate students through the process of preparing, writing and completing an MA thesis.  After the committee members agree on the acceptability of the thesis and sign the official document, the student will get a total of 6 credits for "Thesis," fulfilling part of the requirement for a MA degree.

description.zh: 研究生在教授的指導下，針對工業設計相關特定研究主題進行研究，並將研究成果寫成論文。其內容包括研究方法、理論分析及研究結果﹙含結論與建議﹚。本課程主要目的在提供學生開啟個人對於工業設計領域相關議題的獨立研究能力。因此，本課程將包含如何建構研究設計、寫作與參考文獻的能力。
description.en: Graduate students are required to complete specific research topic under the restriction of their advisor. The results should be written as a thesis. The thesis focuses on the fields in "industrial design", and includes research methodology, theory background and conclusive result or findings. The aims of this course are to provide students with opportunity to initiate personal research into industrial design related topic. Therefore, the course includes a training of developing research, writing and bibliographic skills.

description.en: In the first year graduate students are requested to determine design creation and research topic under the supervision of their advisor. Graduate students who are chosen the fields of design creation should be developed creation principle, design process and practical work. The results of design creation are considered as research thesis. Graduate students who are focus on the research of interactive media design should be undertaken the results of research as a thesis. The content of thesis includes introduction, literature review, research design and approaches, results and discussion, conclusion and suggestions. The aims of this course are to provide students with opportunity to initiate personal research into industrial design related topic. The course includes a training of developing research, writing up and references. To design creation groups. The collaborative capability is in need of the cultivation of ability during the process.

description.zh: 本課程之設計，在介紹學生資訊安全的概念，並瞭解相關的技術與應用。本課程包括下列主題：資訊安全簡介、傳統加密法、私鑰加密技術、公鑰加密技術與雜湊函數、訊息認證編碼與協定、認證系統、電子郵件安全技術、網際網路協定安全技術、全球資訊網安全技術、系統安全技術、防火牆系統等。
description.en: This course is designed to provide students with the knowledge and techniques essential in information security. The topics to be covered include: introductions to information security, conventional encryption, private key technologies, public key technologies and hash functions, message authentication code and protocols, authentication systems, Kerberos, X.509 7, E-Mail security, PGP, S/MIME, IP security, Web security, SHTTP, SSL (Secure Session Layer), system security, and firewall systems.

description.zh: 人類在從事數學演算、推理交談、觀察等各類動作時，均展現出 "智慧"的現象。人工智慧即是利用電腦結合基本理論在有限度的範圍內從事上述各項工作，其中涵蓋了－自然語言了解、機器人學、電腦視覺、類神經網路、專家系統、自動化定理證明等，而本課程則主要在於提供必要之基礎，主要內容包括：1.搜尋法則，2. 命題與敘述邏輯，3. 定理證明，4. 知識系統與知識表達， 5. 機器學習， 6. 基因與演化計算，7. 智慧型代理人。
description.en: Artificial intelligence seeks to introduce the elements of intelligence into programs and systems in application domain. Topics will include 1. Searching methods 2. Propositional and Predicate logic 3. Theorem Proving 4. Knowledge-based systems and representation of knowledge 5. Machine learning, 6. Genetic algorithms and evolutionary computing, 7. Intelligent agents.

description.zh: 本課程為教育大數據微學程之進階課程，主要介紹資料探勘概念與原理，包括: 資料前處理、關聯分析、分類、分群，並運用實際工具如: Weka, Python等，針對教育大數據進行分析。透過程式練習以及期末專題，能讓學生深入理解教育資料分析的基本原理以及實際工具的應用。
description.en: This course is one of the advanced courses in the Micro Courses on Educational Big Data. It introduces the basic concepts and principles of data mining, including: data preprocessing, frequent pattern mining, classification, and clustering. Also, students need to use tools such as Weka and Python for educational big data analytics. With the programming exercises and term project, students will be able to learn the fundamental ideas of educational data analysis and real applications with practical tools.

●Potential threats for software development 
●Malware detection
●Web application security
●Mobile App security: iOS, Android
●Vulnerabilities in Apps
●App Security testing: static, dynamic
●Reverse engineering

description.en:
英文概述
English Description 	This course aims to provide practical training on security tools, such as network packet sniffer, network audit log analysis, etc. Operations on Cyber Defense Exercises (CDX) platform for practical attack/defense exercises are trained in classes. Students can better understand the real application scenarios on information security techniques. Course contents including:

●TCP/IP protocols
●Packet sniffer
●Network audit log analysis
●CDX cloud security attack/defense platform
●Web security: SQL injection, XSS attack, etc.
●Penetration test
●Vulnerability assessment and test: port scanning tools
●Intrusion detection: snort tools

syllabi.outline:
本課程除了介紹技術的原理之外，更著重在實際資安檢測工具的使用，以Kali Linux虛擬機實際進行實作分析與演練，讓學生能更了解技術原理的真實應用情境。課程內容包含：
●計算機網路回顧
●網頁安全
●滲透測試
●弱點評估及測試工具
●入侵偵測工具

In addition to introducing the principles of technology, this course also focuses on the use of actual security detection tools. It uses the Kali Linux virtual machine for actual implementation analysis and drills, so that students can better understand the real application scenarios of technical principles. Course content includes:

●Computer Network Review
●Web security: SQL injection, XSS attack, etc.
●Penetration test
●Vulnerability assessment and testing tools
●Intrusion detection tools

description.zh: 研究生在教授的指導下，針對工業設計相關特定研究主題進行研究，並將研究成果寫成論文。其內容包括研究方法、理論分析及研究結果﹙含結論與建議﹚。本課程主要目的在提供學生開啟個人對於工業設計領域相關議題的獨立研究能力。因此，本課程將包含如何建構研究設計、寫作與參考文獻的能力。
description.en: Graduate students are required to complete specific research topic under the restriction of their advisor. The results should be written as a thesis. The thesis focuses on the fields in "industrial design", and includes research methodology, theory background and conclusive result or findings. The aims of this course are to provide students with opportunity to initiate personal research into industrial design related topic. Therefore, the course includes a training of developing research, writing and bibliographic skills.

description.zh: 碩士學位論文寫作
description.en: A student must write a thesis to fulfill the partial requirements for the Master degree.

description.zh: 研究生在第一年必須選定指導教授，以決定設計創作或論文寫作的方向，從事設計創作的研究生必須發展創作理念、創作過程與實作說明，最後彙整創作報告形同於研究論文；從事論文寫作的研究生針對互動媒體設計的相關主題進行研究，並將研究成果撰寫成為論文，其內容包含緒論、文獻探討、研究設計與實施、研究結果與討論、結論與建議等。本課程目的旨在培養獨立企劃研究能力，建構研究設計與研究寫作的能力，對設計創作組而言，過程中培養協同合作的能力是必須具備的要項。
description.en: In the first year graduate students are requested to determine design creation and research topic under the supervision of their advisor. Graduate students who are chosen the fields of design creation should be developed creation principle, design process and pr92tical work. The results of design creation are considered as research thesis. Graduate students who are focus on the research of inter92tive media design should be undertaken the results of research as a thesis. The content of thesis includes introduction, literature review, research design and appro92hes, results and discussion, conclusion and suggestions. The aims of this course are to provide students with opportunity to initiate personal research into industrial design related topic. The course includes a training of developing research, writing up and references. To design creation groups. The collaborative capability is in need of the cultivation of ability during the process.

description.en: The purpose of this course is to improve students' practical ability. Students must use summer vacation to practice in machinery, vehicles, refrigeration and air conditioning related institutions, participate in training provided by off-campus cooperative enterprises or R&D institutions, and learn the operation of professional technology. After the internship period expires, the internship institution must issue an internship certificate and performance assessment. Students must write an internship experience report, and then the instructor will write the internship achievement report to the department for preservation and score based on the student's experience report and on-site interview and evaluation.

description.en: This course is an introduction to the study and practice of fundamental principles of design in terms of creative arts, relationship between art and engineering, and the importance of aesthetics applying to design.

syllabi.outline:
EMI Course: All class material will be delivered in English. All submitted works and presentation shall be in English as well.
以美學入門為基礎，觀察日常生活美學的可能，進而達到提升美學的培養。
課程將著重於各個產業別對於”美“的建構，探討各面向”美“的改造及創新等。以大眾美學為觀察目標進而達到在各專業裡推廣”美“的最終目的。
課堂活動及討論為佔總成績百分之五十。
Base on introduction to aesthetics.  By daily observation of our surroundings and environment, students are asked to take a closer look to our living world.  Class will focus on case studies of aesthetic application and renovation on various design fields.  The goal of the class is to develop the daily behavior to living environment attention and eventually promoting aesthetic standards in every profession. 
Class will include individual presentation and group discussion.
In class exercise/ discussion counts major part of the grades.

description.zh: 為增進本校工程相關科系學生之基礎數學能力，本課程希望在18小時中，能使學生對基礎數學有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習微積分之數學基礎。課程內容包括：1. 數與式、2. 不等式、3. 直角坐標系、4. 直線、5. 圓錐曲線、6. 指數與對數、7. 三角函數、8. 向量。
description.en: With the purpose for improving the comprehension in fundamental mathematics for students who major in Engineering, and for building up solid background of Calculus for students' future training, it is planned to have this course. This 18 hours course aims at developing comprehension of basic mathematics、activating capabilities of Logic、strengthening the abilities of computing with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1. Numbers、Functions and Equations, 2. Inequalities, 3. Rectangular Coordinates, 4. Lines, 5. Quadratic Equations, 6. Exponents and Logarithms, 7. Trigonometric Functions , 8. Vectors.

description.zh: 本課程主要在研討傳統的結構化語言的編譯技術。課程所所涵蓋的內容包括有： - 語句上的分析、語句分析器的製作 - 由上而下的組譯器製作 - 由下而上的組譯器製作 - 語意分析 - 機器碼之產生與暫存器之配置 - 資料流分析的理論與應用 - 程式碼最佳化處理。課程的實施，將以基本編譯技術為主，作深入的介紹。學習所得的觀念與技術，將利用一個實驗性語言編譯器的實作來貫穿。因此，程式規畫實作，將在這個課程中，佔有相當大的比重。
description.en: This course discusses issues in the compilation of conventional block-structured languages, as listed below. - lexical analysis, scanner generators; - top-down parsing, LL(1) parsers; - bottom-up parsing SLR, LALR, LR(1) parsers, parser generators; - semantic analysis; - code generation and register allocation, code generator generators; - dataflow analysis: theory and practice; - code optimization. There will be a significant programming component to the course

description.zh: 讓學生習得3D 材質編修電腦軟體之技能，俾能將工業設計產品進行材質模擬與色彩計劃。
description.en: The study of materials edit computer software which could apply materials simulation and color plan on industrial design products.

syllabi.outline:
課程將習得電腦2D影像編輯及繪圖軟體在視覺設計、產品與空間設計等跨領域設計的多元表現技能。

隨著AI技術進步，圖像表現也在不斷演進。如何利用結合AI技術與圖像編輯技法具體呈現AI概念，會是新時代設計師的必備能力。

本課程以Photoshop 為主要表現工具，實現電腦視覺設計在概念溝通、圖像表達、造型發展、情境表現、之於AＩ輔助溝通能力上的設計應用力。

The course will lead students to acquire the multi-expression application skills of computer 2D image editing and drawing software in the fields of visual communication, product and space design.

As the era of AI generation arrives, the techniques for visual representation are continuously evolving. How to concretely present concepts through the collaboration of visual creation tools and AI is a challenge for designers in the new era

Using Photoshop as the main expression software tool, realize the design application force of computer vision-aided design in concept communication, image expression, modeling development, and situational expression.

description.zh: 本課程教授商品化實務概念並由學生實際操作，如何以一貫作業完成市場銷售商品。由消費者洞察開始，教導學生如何從消費者行為找到需求，進而思考產品設計動機。設計過程中涵蓋專利，製造與營運思維，最後以實際商品設計呈現。
description.en:
The purpose of this course is study the concept of commercialization and how to sale the products to marketing through the consistent process.
It’ll ask student to find the consumer's requirements from observation, then think and confirm the design purpose. The design process will include patent, manufacture, operating thinking, and commodity design.

name.zh: 設計師的生成式AI提示工程

description.zh:
在不斷變化的設計領域，人工智慧 (AI) 正在改變設計師的工作方式。這種轉變不僅將人工智慧視為一種工具，而且將其視為協作夥伴，透過智慧和適應性重塑設計流程。隨著人工智慧在設計中的作用不斷擴大，一項關鍵技能出現了--提示工程 prompt engineering。課程中將介紹生成式AI的最新版本工具, ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Midjourney, Stable Diffusion等工具進行 Prompt Engineering；並且學習如何用自己的資料訓練 ChatGPT。除此之外，更指導學生如何讓ChatGPT 成為自己的學習教練，在未來不斷變化的科技趨勢中不斷成長；並讓學生參與人工智慧倫理議題、版權和隱私的對話討論。

學生將學習：
1.使用當前最新版本的生成式AI工具與提示工程
2.使用生成式AI 輔助設計流程
3.使用生成式AI進行研究與資料分析
4.使用OpenAI API Playground與建立簡單的應用程式
5.使用生成式AI創作作品行銷影音與數位分身
6.使用人工智慧的倫理議題、版權、隱私和未來影響
description.en:
AI is redefining designer work in the evolving design field, emerging as both a tool and collaborator, enhancing design with its adaptability. The rise of AI in design highlights the importance of prompt engineering. This course explores cutting-edge generative AI tools for prompt engineering and training ChatGPT with personal data. It aims to teach students how to use ChatGPT as a learning coach, adapting to new tech trends. Additionally, it includes discussions on AI's ethical considerations, copyright, and privacy.
Students will learn to use the latest generative AI tools and engage in prompt engineering to aid the design process, conduct research, and analyze data. They will utilize the OpenAI API Playground to build simple applications, create marketing content, digital avatars, and videos. Additionally, they will discuss ethical issues, copyright, privacy, and the future impact of artificial intelligence.

syllabi.outline:
This course aims to train students to become new-age designers proficient in using generative AI technology. Through an in-depth study of generative AI's basic principles and applications, students will master various AI-assisted design tools, such as ChatGPT, Midjourney, etc. The course focuses on developing students' prompt engineering skills so that they can effectively guide AI tools to produce desired design results. The course is dedicated to helping students seamlessly integrate AI technology into traditional design processes while cultivating cross-domain capabilities through practices such as AI-assisted programming and web development. The course encourages innovative thinking and inspires students to explore creative applications of AI technology in the design field. Through group projects, students will develop teamwork and project management skills. On the other hand, we focus on cultivating students’ ethical awareness of the application of AI technology and their ability to continue learning to remain competitive in the rapidly developing field of AI technology. This course aims to comprehensively enhance students’ design capabilities in the AI era and fully prepare them for the digitally transformed workplace.

Students will learn:
1. Use AI tools such as ChatGPT for design creation
2. Write effective prompts to guide AI to generate desired content
3. Leverage AI technology for image and 3D generation
4. Integrate AI tools into existing design workflows
5. Use AI-assisted programming to design and complete small projects
6. Assess and address ethical and legal issues in AI applications

本課程旨在培養學生成為能夠熟練運用生成式 AI 技術的新時代設計師。通過深入學習生成式 AI 的基本原理與應用，學生將掌握各種 AI 輔助設計工具，如 ChatGPT、Midjourney 等。課程重點培養學生的提示工程技能，使其能夠有效引導 AI 工具產生所需的設計成果。課程致力於幫助學生將 AI 技術無縫整合到傳統設計流程中，同時 AI 輔助程式設計和網頁開發等實踐培養跨領域能力。課程鼓勵創新思維，激發學生探索 AI 技術在設計領域的創新應用。通過小組專案，學生將培養團隊合作精神和專案管理能力。另一方面，注重培養學生對 AI 技術應用的倫理意識，以及持續學習的能力，使其能夠在快速發展的 AI 技術領域中保持競爭力。總體而言，本課程旨在全面提升學生在 AI 時代的設計能力，為他們在數位化轉型的職場中做好充分準備。
學生將學習：
1. 運用 ChatGPT 等 AI 工具進行設計創作
2. 編寫有效的提示以引導 AI 生成所需內容
3. 利用 AI 技術進行圖像和 3D 生成
4. 將 AI 工具整合到現有設計工作流程中
5. 使用 AI 輔助程式設計並完成小專案
6. 評估和應對 AI 應用中的道德和法律問題

description.zh:
培養學生透過實證數據支持的方法來分析與解決設計問題。課程將以循證設計過程，包括如何收集、分析和應用研究數據以進行設計決策。學生將學習多種研究工具和方法及如何將這些方法應用於設計項目中。課程將通過講座、實務工作坊與研究調查使學生實際應用循證設計原則，並持續優化設計解決方案。
課程學到的能力包括：
1.循證設計的基本原則：理解循證設計的理論基礎和實踐應用，依據不同的設計主題應用適合的研究方法來輔助制定設計決策。
2.研究方法和工具的運用：掌握使用各種研究工具和技術，包括質性和量化研究方法，以收集和分析數據。
3.洞察設計優化方向：培養批判性思考能力，評估研究數據並能夠基於數據提出合理的設計解決方案。

description.zh: 本課程通過理論介紹虛擬實境（Virtual Reality, VR）的概念與應用範圍，接續將3D環境建構的方法導入實踐操作，再透過專題設定進行內容創作，最終完成研究驗證的工作。課程目的是訓練學生在VR空間展示與設計研究端的流程，諸如3D環境設計、VR空間與內容建構、VR內容輸出與展示等能力。最終，學生可基於這些能力應用於各種虛擬空間的展示設計。
description.en: In this course, I will introduce the concept and scope of application of Virtual Reality (VR) via the theory, and then introduce the method of 3D environment construction into practical operation. Furthermore, this course will be showed how to creates content through a thematic setting, and finally completes the work of research and verification. The purpose of the course is to train students in the process of VR space display and design research, such as 3D environment design, VR space and content construction, VR content output, and display capabilities. Finally, students can apply these abilities to the display design of various virtual spaces.

name.en: Special Topics on Living Environment Design

description.zh: 本課程之目標在於研討生活環境設計之相關研究專題，以文獻研讀、論文研讀討論以及個案研究為重點，藉由密集討論、書面報告以及設計專題之之研究與實作，學生可以有效率地交換意見，獲得更深入而廣泛的體驗，並具備研究、分析、實作之能力。本所結合設計、藝術、人文、木工等各領域的學生，整合培育創新設計專業人才，因此，本課程之另一主要學習目標為建構一多元領域交互學習的環境，以專題導向式為學習模式，可分別組合具各種專長的研究生，協同完成生活環境設計專題的研究，或是透過生活環境設計個案研討、生活環境設計專題創作的方式進行。教學將以課堂講授、論文研討與發表以及專題實作為主，並以報告、分組討論與發表以及實作作品為評量方式。
description.en: The objective of this course is to discuss research topics related to living environment design, focusing on literature study, thesis study and discussion and case studies, through intensive discussion, written report and research and practice of design topics, students can exchange opinions efficiently, gain more in-depth and extensive experience, and have the ability to research, analyze and practice. Therefore, another major learning objective of this course is to construct a multi-field interactive learning environment, which can be combined with graduate students with various specialties to collaborate on research on living environment design topics, or through case studies on living environment design. Teaching will focus on classroom lectures, thesis discussions and presentations, and thematic facts, and will be evaluated by reports, group discussions and presentations, and practical works.

（一）一般教材

(1)教授重點，內容不夠詳實。

syllabi.sdgs: SDG11：永續城市與社區（Sustainable Cities and Communities）
syllabi.notes:
SDG11：建構具包容、安全、韌性及永續特質的城市與鄉村
「永續城市」目標，在於透過住居、運輸、防災、環保、資訊建設、社會安全、民眾參與、文化傳承等不同面向，建構具包容、安全、韌性及永續特質的城市與鄉村。
本課程透過理解設計史上的精彩作品，透過政治、宗教、技術、文化、氣候和地理因素影響下的背景梳理，利用設計思維的文化傳承，進而達到建構具包容、安全、韌性及永續特質的城市與鄉村的目標。

description.zh: 本課程的目的是協助研究生準備進行有關設計創造力開發、創意設計手法與設計方法論等主題之碩士論文研究或實務專題設計，提供各種理論工具與個案演練。課程內容包括(1)人工智慧、心理學、人類學和語言學等導向之設計創造力研究，以及(2)規則式與案例式推理、基模類比與聯想、產品俗民誌、模式語言和體驗劇本等創意設計手法演練。
description.en: The objective of this course is to help the graduate students whose topics of master's theses or graduate projects are related to creativity development, creative design skills and methodology, to prepare their preliminary studies. This course provides the necessary theoretical tools and case studies, and its contents contain (1) design creativity research based on artificial intelligence, psychology, anthropology and linguistics, as well as (2) exercises of creative design techniques: rule-based reasoning and case-based reasoning, schematic analogy and association, product ethnography, pattern language and experiential scenario.

name.zh: 微奈米量測系統與技術

description.zh:
微奈米量測工程技術為是現代科技發展之重要前瞻技術，它將探討有效尺寸在微奈米等級範圍之精密量測儀器與技術. 本課程將涵括下列各項現代精密量測主題:
1.近代光電量測系統與技術
2.量測統計原理
3.量測信號處理
4.三次元座標量測系統與技術
5.雷射干涉系統與技術
6.影像量測系統與技術
7.微奈米量測系統與技術-干涉術、相位移術、調變術、光共焦 及   自動聚焦術
8.微奈米量測系統與技術--掃瞄探針顯微鏡(SPM), STM, AFM 及   SNOM.
9.奈米粉體量測系統與技術
10.量測實驗
11.小型量測儀器之專題製作

description.en: This course let students to understand the embedded system and learn the skill to design the hardware and software of embedded system. description.zh: 超快雷射由於其脈衝寬度在皮秒(10-12)之下，它在軍事科技、工業應用、生醫檢測與學術研究所扮演的角色日益重要，本課程將介紹超短脈衝雷射的種類，尤其著重在光纖短脈衝雷產生的原理、脈衝壓縮的技術與超短脈衝寬度與相位量測的技術，此外也將介紹超快雷射的各種應用包括光譜量測、泵-探量測與非線性光學量測等技術。
description.en: Due to relative short pulse below one picosecond, ultrafast lasers have been widely used in various fields including military, industry, biomedical diagnosis and scientific research.  In this course, it will introduce various kinds of the ultrafast lases, especially on the principle of mode-locked fiber generation, pulse compression technique and the method of the ultrashort pulsewidth measurement as well as phase retrieval.  Various applications of ultrafast laser including fluorescence, pump-probe and nonlinear optical measurement have also been introduced in this course.

syllabi.outline:
超快雷射由於其獨特的特性，包括超短的脈衝寬度(寬度小於皮秒)、寬的頻寬與超高的強度，因此它在軍事科技、工業應用、生醫檢測與學術研究所扮演的角色日益重要，本課程除了介紹雷射產生的原理和各種超短脈衝雷射與其短脈衝產生的原理、脈衝壓縮與超快量測的技術，此外也將介紹超快雷射的應用包括生醫檢測、微加工、泵-探量測與非線性光學量測等技術。

For the unique properties, including ultra-short pulse duration (narrower than pico-second)、broad bandwidth and relatively high intensity, the ultrafast lasers have been widely used in military, industrial, biological diagnosis and scientific research.  The course will introduce the principle of laser、species of ultrafast laser、mechanism of mode-locked pulse generation、pulse compression technique and ultrafast measurement technique。 In addition, it will introduce the application of ultrafast laser such as biological diagnosis、micro-machining、pump-probe measurement and nonlinear optical measurement.

description.zh: 先修課程：電磁學、工程數學、近代物理。   由電磁學之理論推展光波之運行，並經由近代物理之量子論推導出之原子及分子能階與固態晶體之能帶理論，加以說明電磁波與物質間之作用。介紹共振腔、活化性介質及各種雷射之激發形式等雷射三個基本組成。並針對雷射光之種類、特性及其應用，加以說明。
description.en: Combining the propagation of optical wave been deduced from the electromagnetic theory and the quantum theory introduced by modern physics such as energy level of atom and molecular and the energy band of solid state, the interaction between electromagnetic wave and matter is introduced. The three fundamental components of laser: resonator, active medium, and pumping method are explained. Also the types, characteristics, and applications of various laser are introduced.

description.zh: 本課程主要是讓同學學習智慧顯示與感測相關的理論與瞭解相關產業動向，除了透過相關產業導師的教導與實地工廠的參訪，讓同學在最短的時間內對台灣智慧顯示與感測有初步的認識，此外，本課程也包含各種液晶元件的實作與其相關光電特性的量測與應用，讓同學能將理論與實務合而為一。
description.en: The main goal of this course is to teach students the theories and related industrial trends of intelligent displays and sensors. This will be achieved through lectures by industry experts and visits to factories, allowing students to gain a basic understanding of the relevant industries in Taiwan within a short period of time. The course will also include hands-on projects focusing on various LCD components and related optoelectronic properties measurement and application. By combining theory and practice, students can gain a comprehensive understanding of intelligent displays and sensors.

description.zh: 奈米科技在近年來有極快的進展，因此在本課程將介紹最新的奈米材料，包含有量子點、奈米碳材(富勒烯、奈米碳管、石墨烯)、二維奈米材料(二硫化鉬與金屬化)等，對於這些奈米材料的物理、化學與光電特性以及製程方法做進一步的介紹，以期許可以帶給同學當今最新的奈米化技術與科技知識。
description.en: Nanotechnology has a great progress in recent years. This class will introduce the latest information about nanomaterials and their applications. The nanomaterials include quantum dots, fullerene, carbon nanotube, graphene and molybdenum disulfide (MoS2). Their physical, chemical and optoelectronic properties will be comprehensively introduced. We expect to bring the knowledge of newest nanomaterials and technologies to students.

syllabi.outline:
奈米科技與半導體製程技術在近年來受到極大的重視，因此在本課程將介紹半導體基礎與最新的奈米技術，內容包含有基礎電子電路學與半導體製程，以及奈米材料(如奈米碳管、石墨烯、二維奈米材料等)，期許可以帶給同學當今最新的奈米化技術與半導體相關之科技知識。

Nanotechnology and semiconductor manufacturing processes have received significant attention in recent years. Therefore, this course will introduce the fundamentals of semiconductors and the latest nanotechnology. The content includes basic electronic circuitry and semiconductor manufacturing processes, as well as nanomaterials such as carbon nanotubes, graphene, and two-dimensional nanomaterials. The aim is to provide students with the latest knowledge in nanotechnology and semiconductor-related technologies.

syllabi.schedule:
主題選擇與討論：

第1至2週：介紹課程目標與內容，引導學生選擇研究主題，討論各種可能的研究方向。
文獻回顧：

第3至6週：教導學生如何進行文獻回顧，搜尋相關文獻，閱讀與理解先前研究的成果，並撰寫文獻回顧部分。
研究方法與設計：

第7至10週：介紹不同的研究方法與設計，包括定量、定性、實驗、問卷調查等，指導學生選擇適合的方法，並撰寫研究方法部分。
資料收集與分析：

第11至14週：指導學生進行資料收集，例如實地調查、實驗執行、問卷調查等，並學習適當的資料分析技術，如統計分析、質性分析等。
結果呈現與討論：

第15至18週：引導學生分析研究結果，撰寫研究結果報告，討論研究發現的意義與影響，並與文獻回顧部分進行比較與討論。
撰寫與終稿：

第19至20週：指導學生進行專題研究報告的撰寫，包括引言、文獻回顧、研究方法、結果與討論、結論等部分，並完成最終版本的報告。
成果展示：

第21至22週：安排學生進行成果展示，例如口頭報告、海報展示等，分享他們的研究成果與發現。
評量與評分：

整個學期：根據學生的參與度、作業完成情況、研究報告品質等進行評量與評分。
課程進度可以根據學校的學期長度和每週上課時數進行調整，同時要考慮到彈性，以應對可能出現的延遲或加速的情況。

description.en: This course introduces the elements of multimedia design, including text, graphics, video, animation, and audio, as well as the applications of the integration of those elements.

syllabi.outline: In recent years, advancements in multimedia technology have made it a challenging and interdisciplinary field of research, encompassing areas such as computer science, communications, physics, mathematics, engineering, and the humanities and social sciences. The challenges and goals of information technology in the 21st century will focus on the diversification and plurality of multimedia content, intelligent applications and services, and interdisciplinary integration. Considering this, the course aims to cultivate students’ understanding of multimedia technology and its applications, exploring the integration of the Internet and embedded systems. Students will learn multimedia systems' design principles and standards, enabling them to create multimedia products and extend to emerging applications of integrated multimedia information systems. The course covers a wide range of topics including an introduction to multimedia, text media, audio media, image media, video media, web media, animation media, virtual reality, internet of things, biological information systems, training in innovative thinking, and various other technologies and their applications.
syllabi.schedule: Introduction to multimedia, text media, audio media, image media, video media, web media, animation media, virtual reality, internet of things, biological information systems, and training in innovative thinking.

description.zh: 本課程概念為數位化產品設計與開發介紹，為使學生明白數位化產品設計與開發在現代產業中的重要性，課程重點將介紹出版編輯觀念之基礎認識，讓學生增進對數位出版流程的理解，在設計過程中兼顧學理介紹與實務應用。另外探討數位劇本之優點、特性、設計步驟與要領、講述策略、核心技術、未來趨勢等。

description.zh: 如何藉由商務模型的分析，建置數位化協同產品設計與開發環境，並說明資料管理、構型管隨著網路時代的來臨，不但造成數位化協同產品設計與開發觀念的興起，也造成數位化協同平台技術逐漸成熟，並且將同步工程觀念的實現更往前邁進一大步。本課程是從數位化協同產品設計與開發概念之介紹開始，使學生明白數位化協同產品設計與開發在現代製造業中的重要性，接著介紹理與工作流程管理等相關實務應用觀念。
description.en: Information and network technologies have promoted the traditional concurrent engineering to the next generation. The collaborative e-design and e-development concept has been more popular in industries. This course is introduced from the concept of collaborative product design and development to help students understanding the importance of collaborative e-design and e-development in modern industries. Furthermore, the business model analysis method is provided to construct the collaborative environment of e-design and e-development. In addition, some real cases of data management, configuration management, and workflow management are mentioned.

description.zh: 本課程主要介紹自動化光學精密檢測相關技術，內容包括如下：前言，精密量測概論，機器視覺原理，二維光學檢測技術及實習，三維光學檢測技術及實習，影像處理與人工智慧技術運用，智慧型量測系統及應用，系統整合之相關技術，產業相關技術應用，及結論。
description.en: This subject is arranged to introduce the principles and techniques required in Automatic Optical Inspection (AOI). The subject includes the following subtopics: introduction to precision metrology and machine vision, the measurement principles and methods used in the 2D AOI, the measurement principles and techniques used in the 3D AOI, image processing and artificial intelligence methods used in automatic inspection, intelligent measurement systems, AOI system integration and conclusion.

syllabi.outline:
本課程主要介紹自動化光學精密檢測相關技術，內容包括如下：前言，精密量測概論，機器視覺原理，二維光學檢測技術及實習，三維光學檢測技術及實習，影像處理與人工智慧技術運用，智慧型量測系統及應用，系統整合之相關技術，產業相關技術應用。
[▲修課學生務必具備C++ and Python程式語言基礎(C++ and Python is required during the hand on class), 需自備筆電
This course aims to introduce the concept, methodology, and algorithms of Automatic Optical Inspection and machine vision as well as the hardware and software used by automatic optical inspection. The object is to provide a fundamental understanding upon automatic optical inspection so that the students can quickly apply what they have learned to solve quality inspection problems. The course is particularly suitable for students who are interested in the subject of automatic optical inspection.

description.zh: 本課程適合修過工程數學及基礎熱流的大學生選修。使用Ansys 或其他商用軟體，來計算一維穩態，一維暫態，二維穩態，二維暫態，之熱傳導問題，邊界層之偶合性流場問題，燃燒場之數值計算，電子熱傳相關系統。
description.en: This course is suitable for the undergraduate students who have taken fundamental courses of engineering mathematics and thermofluid sciences. description.en: This course aims to introduce green technologies and their influences on human life in the 21st century. The contents consist of the most important topics about the clean energy and energy conservation technologies. The clean energy technology consists of wind energy, solar energy, hydraulic energy, earth interior energy, bioenergy, roadway energy, sound energy, fuel cell, electric vehicles, and so on. The energy conservation technology consists energy save buildings, variable frequency air-condition, etc.. The environmental protesting technology includes carbon recapture etc.. This course will talk the technical principles and their general developing situations.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在建立學生對於機械最佳化設計之基本概念，包含如何將設計問題的物理模型以數學模型形式建立目標函數，並依照給定限制條件求解目標函數之極值或最佳化值問題。課程內容共分為五個部分：(1) 最佳化設計中目標函數的數學分析基礎、(2) 常用之一維搜尋最佳化方法、(3) 無限制多維問題的最佳化方法、(4) 限制問題的最佳化方法、(5) 機械最佳化設計實例分析。
This course aims to establish the basic concept of mechanical optimization design for students, including how to establish the mathematical model of objective function from the physical model, and solve the problem by finding the extremum or the optimal value of the objective function according to the given constraints. The course content is divided into five parts: (1) Mathematical analysis basis of objective function in optimization design, (2) Commonly used one-dimensional optimization method, (3) Optimization method for unlimited multi-dimensional problem, (4) The optimization method of the restriction problem, (5) Example of the mechanical optimization design.

description.zh: 本課程將以問題導向學習的模式，學習設計思考的五個核心步驟：同理心分析、問題定義、創意發想、雛型發展、驗證評估。並透過實際案例的分析與操作，學習互動設計跨領域創新的方法。本課程的主要目標在於提供學生：1.了解互動設計的方法與步驟；2.探討互動設計跨領域創新的方法與操作模式；3.透過實務案例的操作累積互動設計的執行經驗。
description.en: This course will use Problem-based Learning method to teach the five kernel steps of design thinking including the following: Empathize, Define, Ideate, Prototype, and Test. It will also help students in knowing the interdisciplinary innovation methods of interaction design by case studies and real case operation. The main course goals include the following: gain an understanding of the methods and steps of interaction design; explore the methods and operation models for the interdisciplinary innovation of interaction design; and gain the experiences of interaction design by real cases analysis and operation.

syllabi.outline:
Design thinking is a powerful approach to new product development that begins with understanding unmet customer needs. It’s a human-centered design process that approaches problem-solving with understanding the user needs. Design thinking encompasses concept development, applied creativity, prototyping, and experimentation. When design thinking approaches are applied to business, the success rate for innovation has been seen to improve substantially.

Design-driven companies such as Apple, Coca-Cola, IBM, Nike, Procter & Gamble, and Whirlpool have outperformed the S&P 500 over the past 10 years by an accumulated 211% in what's called the Design Value Index—a portfolio of 16 publicly traded companies that integrate design thinking into corporate strategy. According to a 2016 report from the Design Management Institute, this marks the third consecutive year the index has shown an excess of 200% over the S&P 500.

The Design Thinking course will lead participants through a step by step, design thinking process. To be considered successful, innovations have to solve the three key dimensions of Desirability, Feasibility, and Viability.

Desirability: Is this product or service addressing a real customer need?
Feasibility: Can we develop a solution that is technically feasible and better than competitors?
Viability: Is there a viable business model around this product or service?

This course will use Problem-based Learning (PBL) method to teach the five kernel steps of design thinking including the following: Empathize, Define, Ideate, Prototype, and Test. It will also help students in knowing the interdisciplinary innovation methods of interaction design by case studies and real case operation. The main course goals include the following: gain an understanding of the methods and steps of interaction design; explore the methods and operation models for the interdisciplinary innovation of interaction design; and gain the experiences of interaction design by real cases analysis and operation.

description.zh: 服務設計的方法乃是透過相關資源做適當的規劃與組織，已提昇使用者與服務提供者間之服務及互動的品質。其主要的架構與方法乃在於了解使用者的行為、需求及動機後，創造具友善性、競爭性、及相關性的使用者經驗。本課程將以服務設計的概念與方法為核心，以使用者需求及經驗的創造為基礎，探討並分析不同的互動技術的適用情境及其發展與應用領域。
description.en: Service design is the activity of planning and organizing related resources of service in order to improve its quality and the interaction between service provider and users. The backbone of service design methodologies is to understand the behavior of the users, their needs and motivations, so that to create user-friendly, competitive and relevant service to the users. The service design concepts and methodologies and user experience analysis are used in this course for discussing the developments and applications of interactive technologies in the aspects of various scenarios and application fields.

syllabi.outline: Service design is the activity of planning and organizing related resources of service to improve its quality and the interaction between service providers and users. Service design concepts and methodologies and user experience analysis are used in this course to discuss the developments and applications of interactive technologies in various scenarios and application fields.

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意。介紹精密機電系統之基本架構包括機械系統(如機架、基礎、導程與軸承、動力傳遞系統等)及控制系統(如製程控制、數值控制、幾何資料處理、進給驅動器、位置量測系統、機器監視與診斷等)，探討先進精密機電系統(如工具機、機器人、FMS、CIM、微機電系統等)。
description.en: This course will give an introduction to basic components of the precision mechatronic system including mechanical systems (e.g. machine frame, machine foundation, bearings and guides, power transmission etc.) and control systems (e.g. process control, numerical control, geometric data processing, driving systems, position measurement system, automatic manufacturing monitoring and diagnostics, etc. ). Studies of advanced precision mechatronic systems including machine tools, robotics, FMS, CIM , micro- electro- mechanical systems (MEMS) and so on.

於2009年，ASTM定義了積層製造，並將此積層製造分成七大類型，本課程將對它進行光機電原理
說明，並以積層製造系統的應用及系統的研發為主要授課方向。
description.en: ASTM Committee F42 on Additive Manufacturing Technologies was formed in 2009. The myriad process names into seven standardized terms. In this course, the principle of the additive manufacturing technology in terms of its opto-electro-mechanical-system will be discussed. The application and the system development of additive manufacturing are the major topics of this course.

syllabi.outline:

This course includes the principle of additive manufacturing process, classifications, process parameters, and the systems. The application of additive manufacturing will also introduce together with practice works. Two mini projects need to complete during this semester.

description.zh: 本課程介紹電子顯微鏡之結構，成像及繞射原理，以及在材料科學方面之應用，課程內容包括穿透式電子顯微鏡之構造，電磁透鏡與成像原理，電子繞射原理，繞射圖型分析，試片之製作方法。掃描式電子顯微鏡之構造及成像原理。EDS及WDS之X光光譜測量。
description.en: The course introduces the structure of a electron microscope, the theories of image forming and diffraction, the applications of materials science.  The course contents include structure of the transmission electron microscope, the electromagnetic lens and theory of image formation, theory of electronic diffraction, analysis of diffraction pattern, and the preparation of test sample.  The structure and principle of forming image for a scanning electron microscope, the X-ray spectrography of EDS and WDS are also included in this course.

description.zh:
先修課程：負責教授同意
表面現象, 介面反應等與近代高科技技術, 如鍍膜工程,表面處理, 腐蝕, 磨潤, 微機電, 感測器, 半導體技術等息息相關, 且日益重要。表面分析是原子層次的相關研究, 它包括振動, 電子或離子頻譜分析, 微技術等之應用。主要的項目包含, 表面形貌觀察( SEM, BSEM, AFM ), 成份分析( 光譜分析, 質譜分析, EDX ), 結構分析( XRD, AES, ESCA, XPS ), 鍵結分析( Raman光譜, FTIR ), 表面粗糙度, 膜厚, 附著力, 內應力等膜之特性分析。
description.en:
Surface phenomena and processes occurring at interface are becoming increasingly important in a wide variety of industrial applications including the areas of films coating surface treatments, conclusion, triobology, microelectronics, sensors and semi-conductor technologies.  Accompanying this is an ever-growing need for surface characterization allowing better definition of processes occurring at a microscopic level.
Surface analysis is the use of vibration, electron or ion spectroscopic and microscopic techniques for the study of material at the atomic level, it includesSEM, AFM, XRD, EDX, ESCA, XPS, AES, Raman Spectrum, and FTIR analysis.

description.zh: 本課程將以做中學的概念，也就是技術實作+AI輔助教學的方式進行，內容主要是介紹光學成像技術與應用，特別是針對航太領域使用的光學技術，當然也適用於一般民生工業用途。例如：衛星遙測、流體顯像、太空測距等，以實際應用需求導入相關原理與技術介紹，搭配電腦軟體輔助學習，內容包括：光束成像、光波成像、光學成像元件精密加工、光學成像實務應用技術等項目，將安排專業教授及業師搭配授課，授課分成兩學期實施，上學期講授光束成像，下學期講授光波成像。
description.en: This course will be conducted using the concept of learning by doing, which is a combination of technical practice and AI-assisted teaching. The content mainly introduces optical imaging technology and its applications, especially optical technology used in the aerospace field, such as satellite remote sensing, flow visualization, space ranging, etc. Of course, it is also suitable for general industrial applications. The course will introduce relevant principles and technical introductions according to practical application needs, and computer software will be used for learning. The content includes beam imaging, wave imaging, precision processing of optical imaging components, practical application technology of optical imaging, and other topics. Professional professors and industry experts will be arranged to teach the course, which will be divided into two semesters. The first semester will cover beam imaging, and the second semester will cover wave imaging.

syllabi.outline:
本課程將以做中學的概念，也就是技術實作+AI輔助教學的方式進行，內容主要是介紹光學成像技術與應用，特別是針對航太領域使用的光學技術，當然也適用於一般民生工業用途。例如：衛星遙測、流體顯像、太空測距等，以實際應用需求導入相關原理與技術介紹，搭配電腦軟體輔助學習，內容包括：光束成像、光波成像、光學成像元件精密加工、光學成像實務應用技術等項目，將安排專業教授及業師搭配授課，授課分成兩學期實施，上學期講授光束成像，下學期講授光波成像。
This course will be conducted using the concept of learning by doing, which is a combination of technical practice and AI-assisted teaching. The content mainly introduces optical imaging technology and its applications, especially optical technology used in the aerospace field, such as satellite remote sensing, flow visualization, space ranging, etc. Of course, it is also suitable for general industrial applications. The course will introduce relevant principles and technical introductions according to practical application needs, and computer software will be used for learning. The content includes beam imaging, wave imaging, precision processing of optical imaging components, practical application technology of optical imaging, and other topics. Professional professors and industry experts will be arranged to teach the course, which will be divided into two semesters. The first semester will cover beam imaging, and the second semester will cover wave imaging.

description.zh: 本課程以落地產業應用技術主題，導入德國工業大學任務導向學習模式，課程教導學生從建置雲端資料庫伺服器到撰寫三機一體網頁控制程 式進行工廠 CPS 產銷戰情資訊管理系統，串聯工廠人機物料及生產線與 品管，並實務教導開發 AI 瑕疵檢測模型，再利用人機操控 PLC 達到機聯網，進行工廠整廠資訊連線。
description.en: The theme of this course is industrial application technology, and it introduces the task-oriented learning model of the German University of Technology. The course teaches students from building a cloud database server to writing a three-in-one web control program for factory CPS production and sales information management system, connecting factories Human-machine material, production line and quality control, and practical teaching and development of AI defect detection model, and then use human-machine control PLC to achieve machine networking, and conduct factory-wide information connection.

syllabi.outline:
工業4.0智能工廠因為大量使用電腦資訊流進行智慧控制達到產線無人化境地，雲端資料庫技術是智能工廠的核心技術，從智慧排單到網頁控制，達到智能聯網與控制。本課程以落地產業應用技術主題，導入德國工業大學任務導向學習模式，課程教導學生從建置雲端資料庫伺服器到撰寫三機一體網頁控制程式進行工廠CPS產銷戰情資訊管理系統，串聯工廠人機物料及生產線與品管，再利用人機操控PLC達到機聯網，進行工廠整廠連線。
Industry 4.0 intelligent factory because of the heavy use of computer information flow for intelligent control to achieve the production line unmanned situation, cloud database technology is the core technology of intelligent factory, from smart single to web control, to achieve intelligent networking and control. This course to the landing industry application technology-based, imported into the German University of Technology task-oriented learning model, the course teaches students from the construction of a cloud database server to write a three-machine integrated web control program for factory CPS production and marketing information management system, series factory man-machine materials and production lines and quality control, and then use human-machine control PLC to achieve machine networking, factory-wide factory connection.

description.zh: 本課程之目標為依人力職能需求，參考國內外之先行經驗，整合智能化生產所需之知識與技能訓練，以淬鍊出一套務實之智能化生產課程。本課程將涵蓋工業4.0-智能化生產所需相關基礎技術之教學與實作課程，包括物聯網基礎技術與應用實例、雲端服務系統與資訊安全技術、巨量資料管理、分析、及應用實例、智慧化企業與工廠管理系統與應用、自動化與機器人技術及應用等等。
description.en: The goal of this course is to meet the needs of the manpower function, with reference to the previous experiences from domestic and abroad groups. This course will cover the topics related to the basic technology required for intelligent production, including the basic technology and application examples of the Internet of Things, the cloud service system and information security technology, the huge amount of data management, Intelligent enterprise and factory management systems and applications, automation and robot technology and applications, and so on.

syllabi.outline: 本課程涵蓋廣泛之工業4.0-智能化生產所需相關基礎技術，包括工業革命簡史、人工智慧演算法、物聯網基礎技術與應用實例、雲端服務系統與資訊安全技術、巨量資料管理、分析、及應用實例、智慧化企業與工廠管理系統與應用、自動化與機器人技術及應用等等。

週次	單元主題
第一週	智能化生產簡介/
四次工業革命簡史與內容，工業四點零概論:互聯網、物聯網、巨量資料(大數據)、雲端運算、人工智慧、自動化與機器人。
第二週	人工智慧的過去與現在:三次人工智慧熱潮、決策樹、專家系統、類神經網路，運用與困境。
第三週	當代人工智慧原理:巨量資料的影響、深度學習、開源程式TensorFlow、Keras簡介。
第四週	物聯網基礎技術與應用:
物聯網基礎架構概論: 物聯網基本詞彙定義/物聯網協定層架構/物聯網功能及技術現況與發展方向。軟硬體設計與整合規劃: 各式感測器與基本原理/網路層技術與相關標準/應用層技術與相關標準

第七週	雲端服務系統與資訊安全技術:

第九週	期中考
第十週	巨量資料管理、分析、及應用:
巨量資料應用實例: 智慧應用原則/資料分析與推薦系統
第十一週	智慧化企業與工廠管理系統與應用:
E化製造系統架構: E化製造系統構成要素與名詞定義/E化製造優劣分析
第十二週	智慧化企業與工廠管理系統與應用:
製造執行系統(MES)功能與應用: 製造執行系統(MES)之定義與功能/製造執行系統(MES)之現有架構與發展方向
第十三週	智慧化企業與工廠管理系統與應用:
製造執行系統(MES)功能與應用: 製造執行系統(MES)之優劣分析

第十五週	自動化與機器人技術與應用:

第十六週	自動化與機器人技術與應用:

description.zh:
先修課程：負責教授同意。
本課程主要介紹幾何光學與Coherent光學兩部份之基本概念與應用﹐提供機械領域的學生有關光的知識﹐讓機械領域的學生有能力加入機光電技術整合。本課程首先介紹幾何光學﹐幾何光學雖然簡單﹐卻是光學應用最普遍的知識﹐接著進入Coherent光學原理與應用介紹﹐Coherent光學在光量測技術部份佔了非常重要的地位﹐透過本課程的訓練﹐學生將可更順利的進入光學實驗室工作﹐當然﹐本課程也適合其他對光學有興趣的學生來修習。
description.en: The lectures in this course include two main parts, the geometrical and the coherent optics. Due to the future high technology, the optomechatronics, needs the cooperation of knowledge among the optics, the electrics, and the mechanics. This course gives the students of mechanical engineering the chance to participate in this work group. The lecture will first show the students the geometrical optics which is simple but important in the field of optical application. The coherent optics is the main part in this course which occupies the most optical technique of measurement. After the course the students should have the enough knowledge to work in the optical laboratory. Certainly, this course is also useful for all students who are interest in the area of the optics.

description.zh: 奈微米工程於生物醫學之應用日趨重要，量測與操作工具的開發與實際的生醫應用對象的大小尺寸具有密切的相關性，對於生物系統的充份瞭解是工程表現的重要過程之一。在此課程中將配合本校實驗室目前之相關研究設備進行原理講解與應用討論，包括之項目將由分子、細胞到組織之感測、分析與操縱。選修學生須依下列重點：奈微米生醫感測系統、奈米生醫材料、奈米生醫光電以及實驗室晶片等領域選擇期中期末報告之題目與計畫內容，主要要求在尋求創新思考方向，以求在原理或應用上的突破，積極推動跨領域與技術先進之整合性研究。
description.en: Nano/micro engineering in bio-medicine applications has become increasingly important. The development and operation of measurement tool for biomedical applications has a close correlation to the actual size of the object. In this course we will explain the principles of devices and discuss the applications based on the school's research laboratories, including sensing, analysis and manipulation of molecules, cells, and tissues. Students will be required to do a project about Nano-micron biomedical sensor systems, nano-biomaterials and nano-biomedical areas such as optical and lab-chip. The interim and final report should devote to the topic and plans in the search for the direction of Creative Thinking with a view to the breakthrough of theory or application, and actively promote the integration of advanced interdisciplinary research and technology.

The application of nano-micron engineering in biomedicine is becoming more and more important. The development of measurement and operation tools is closely related to the size of actual biomedical application objects. A full understanding of biological systems is one of the important processes of engineering performance. In this course, the principle explanation and application discussion will be carried out with the current research equipment in our laboratory, including the sensing, analysis and manipulation of molecules. Elective students should choose the topics and project content of the mid-term report in the fields of nano-micron biomedical sensing system, nano-biomedical materials, nano-biomedical optoelectronics, and laboratory chips. The main requirement is to seek innovative thinking , In order to seek breakthroughs in principles or applications, and actively promote integrated research across fields and advanced technologies.

name.en: Principle and application of fuel cell

description.zh: 本課程由機械工程的角度出發，結合基礎電化學原理，介紹燃料電池的基本原理及種類，由最新市場發展現況導入，介紹燃料電池的發展歷史及最新現況，同時說明提升燃料電池效率及壽命的關鍵影響因素，結合實作方式深入了解燃料電池特性。
description.en: This course is based on the principle of mechanical engineering and electrochemical theory to introduce the basic principles and types of fuel cells. From the latest development in the global market, the course will introduce the fuel cell history and the latest products of fuel cells. The improvement of fuel cell efficiency and lifetime will be explained through   fundamental theory and experiments.

This class explains basic principles and classifications of fuel cell from mechanical aspect.
Current development and history of the fuel cell will be introduce in the next step. Finally, how to improve cell efficiency and lifetime are the most important topics. Simple experiments will be implemented in the class to help student understand.

description.zh: 本課程以“智能工業生產教學工廠”為學習場域，整間工廠完全由北科大跨系所老師帶領學生自行建置，產線包括加工區、精密量測區、線上品管區、組裝區、自動倉儲，從接受訂單到智能化排單、加工、量測、品管、組裝、倉儲，所有雲端伺服器與程式軟體完全由學生自行架設與撰寫，是一條完全無人化的關燈展示生產與教學工廠。上課方式是廠商針對智能工廠各個工作細節具體提出實務需求，再由上課老師帶學生助教以此些問題作為上課基礎，教導學生共同解決，學生以班級為單位進入工廠實作學習，課程由負責建置“智能工業生產教學工廠”的老師依其專長領域分工合作開課，依據老師負責建置的部分及其專長進行分工教學，學生分組由個別老師帶領指導，學生將可依序學到完整工廠技術，學期結束再由各專長老師依照學生分組指導學生進行專題報告，學生的專題報告將以個別老師專長協助解決的問題撰寫報告，這樣的設計可以讓學生深入了解與探討如何解決問題。
description.en: This course is based on the intelligent manufacturing system education factory. The intelligent factory is completely built by ourselves and is the only one self-built factory in Taiwanese universities. The intelligent manufacturing system has seven areas, central server, reception, automatic warehouse, manufacturing, measuring, on-line quality control, and assembly. In process, we receive the raw materials and scanned by QR code scanner. After scanned, the raw materials are transported to the warehouse and wait for producing order. If the producing order received, the raw materials will be sent through all seven machines, where a finished component will be manufactured. One component from that batch will be sent to the measuring area for complete quality control, and the remaining compone.

description.zh: 炸藥與爆破工程應用於岩石爆破，為採礦及大地工程的基本作業。本課程之目的在介紹炸藥性質、炸藥反應原理、爆材特性及應用、爆破設計及施工並兼及爆破作業之環境控制。
description.en:
The blasting engineering course focuses on the introduction of explosives and their properties and characteristics, 
explosives and blasting theories, drilling and blasting 
design and operations, and environemtnal control of 
blasting.

syllabi.outline: The blasting engineering course focuses on the introduction of explosives and their properties and characteristics, explosives and blasting theories, drilling and blasting design and operations, and environmental control of blasting.
syllabi.schedule:
第1週 Introduction 
第2週 Basic knowledge of explosive and blasting
第3週- makeup of a commercial explosive and basic properties and hazards of commercial
第4週- Understand and recognise the common explosives available in the surface mining industry.
第5週 Assess the safety aspects, benefits and limitations of these explosives to make the correct selection of explosives for a particular application
第6週Blast design - Understand basic blasting terms and identify the rock characteristics that affect selection of explosives and blast design.
第7週Blast design - Understand the principles of how explosives break rock, Calculate a powder factor for any given blast
第8週 Blast design - Design a blast from basic principles
第9週 期中考
第10週 Prime and charge - Outline the key safe handling procedures for loading and priming explosives
第11週 Prime and charge - Decide what size, type and number of primers to use under different conditions and Safely charge explosives into blastholes
第12週 Initiation system hook up - 
第13週Shotfiring
第14週 Storage and transport
第15 週Environmental control of blasting - Recognise the effect of major rock jointing and structure on blast performance and specify ways of avoiding problems
第16 週Environmental control of blasting - modify blasthole charging to suit the geology
第17週 Misfire treatment
第18週 期末考

description.zh: 本課程將討論材料凝固熱力學、材料凝固動力學、平衡及非平衡狀態下材料的凝固現象與凝固界面之溶質濃度分佈情形。課程最後會介紹凝固學在工業界的應用實例：單晶成長與鑄造工程。
description.en: This lecture will first discuss the Thermodynamics and Dynamics for Solidification in Materials under equilibrium and non-equilibrium states. Second, we will discuss the Solidification behavior and solutes distribution at the interface between solid and liquid. Finally, we will briefly introduce the applications of Solidification in industry cases: Single Crystal Growth and Casting engineering.

syllabi.schedule:
課程進度:
課程進度由各專題指導教授訂定
本課程之目的是訓練並教導學生如何發掘及思考問題，以及設計實驗或理論模式來解決問題。包括相關國際學術論文閱讀、實驗設計與進行、分析儀器操作、成果分析、討論與結論等，並依照本校碩士論文格式書寫成結果報告。此外，本課程亦培養同學發表論文的基本禮節及準備技巧等事項。本課程以小組團隊合作為原則，每組至少三人，施行規範詳列如後：
1.  本課程為兩學期共二學分、六小時(三下必修、四上選修各一學分三小時)。
2.  每位學生須於三年級下學期開學後兩週內選定專題指導教授與研究課題，學生可與數位教授討論後，視其個人興趣及教授之專長與研究方向來決定研究課題。
3.  專題研究之進行方式由指導教授擬訂。
4.  上課時間: 由於此課程以特定研究題目為主，因此每組成員至少須每兩週與其指導教授報告研究進度並討論研究結果。
5.  研究進行期間所使用之儀器及設備等，須依照並遵守該儀器設備負責老師之規定使用之。
6.  每一學期舉行一次研究或成果報告，由所有指導教授列席評審指導。各組專題研究成果發表為期末考前二至三週。
7.  成果發表施行: 每組以20分鐘為限，其中包括口頭報告及回答問題。男、女同學須著正式服裝。
8.  修課學生須全程參與成果發表。
9.  專題研究成果報告各佔學期總成績之50%，平時分數佔50%。
10.  各組須於報告前備妥其報告內容摘要，並於報告前一週彙整並繳交至授課教師處。
11.  期末書面報告須於上台報告後一週內，經專題指導教授批閱簽名後，繳交至本課程授課老師處。

description.zh: 本課程將介紹電腦輔助工程計算的工具與案例，引導學生使用電腦輔助工程軟體進行資源工程領域的研發設計與計算，課程以COMSOL MULTIPHYSICS為主要操作環境，另並用如EXCEL / VBA、MATLAB或SOLIDWORKS等軟體進行分析、導入或導出，探討案例包括流體力學、熱傳、質傳、電鍍、腐蝕、電池等，學生將能了解數學模擬的觀念、基礎建模的邏輯以及電腦輔助工程計算的研發模式。
description.en: This course will introduce the tools and cases of computer-aided computation and guide students in using software to solve engineering problems. The course takes COMSOL MULTIPHYSICS as the main operating environment and might use software such as EXCEL/VBA, MATLAB or SOLIDWORKS etc. by importing or exporting various model formats. Topics include fluid mechanics, heat transfer, mass transfer, electroplating, corrosion, batteries, etc. Students will be able to understand the concept of mathematical simulation, the basic logic of modeling, and the R&D process of computer-aided engineering.

description.zh: 寶石業為台灣新興的工業之一，集地質學、礦物學、結晶學、切割技術、商業行為及藝術美感於此門學問，寶石礦物的物理及化學性質和鑑定，寶石礦物的生成和產狀及其地理公布，如何加工，銷售行為如何進行，珠寶的設計方式及製造。寶石礦物之顏色分類，內含物之特色，光學現象之表現。人造寶石之製造與辨認，均讓學習者有能力鑑定其真偽，價值與市場行為。
description.en: Introduction the physics and chemistry properties of gemstones.

syllabi.outline: 寶石業為台灣傳統的工業之一，更是許多新科技和產業的交點。寶石學集地質學、礦物學、結晶學、切割技術、商業行為及藝術美感於一門學問，包含了寶石礦物的物理及化學性質和鑑定，寶石礦物的生成和產狀及其地理公布，如何加工，銷售行為如何進行，珠寶的設計方式及製造。寶石礦物之顏色分類，內含物之特色，光學現象之表現。本課程主要涉及四個方面的內容：一、總論，主要介紹寶玉石的概念、分類與特性、評價標準、物性、來源等; 二、講述寶石的特點與品鑒，其中包括鑽石、紅/藍寶石、祖母綠、金綠寶、海藍寶石、石榴子石、尖晶石、碧璽、水晶、橄欖石以及其它寶石等特點與評價; 三、介紹翡翠、軟玉、歐泊、石英質玉、獨山玉、蛇紋石玉、綠松石（土耳其玉）以及印章石等特點與評價; 四、有機寶石，如珍珠、象牙、珊瑚、琥珀等的鑒定與評價。 通過本課程學習，全面瞭解寶玉石的分類與特性、評價標準與來源，掌握寶石、玉石和有機寶石的化學組成、結晶學特徵、物理性質、典型的鑒定特徵，懂得利用常見寶玉石的鑒別方法品鑒寶石、玉石和有機寶石，瞭解各種寶玉石的佩戴習俗和保養方法。 讓學生理解自然界與思想、文化、科學之間的相互關係，擴大學生想像思維，培養學生的理論與現實結合能力。

description.zh: 嵌入式系統目前愈來愈普遍。它將會大大地影響我們的生活方式。可攜式裝置如智慧型手機、掌上型電腦、以及所謂的IA裝置如家用網路閘道器、數位視訊錄影機、和常見的遊戲機都是屬於嵌入式系統的範疇。在本課程中,我們將會討論何謂嵌入式系統、嵌入式系統的形式、以及如何建構一個嵌入式系統。由於嵌入式系統包含硬體及軟體的議題，我們也會探討相關的主題。 本課程的先修課程包含計算機組織與結構、C程式語言、資料結構、系統程式、以及作業系統。課程主要內容如下：嵌入式系統簡介與概論、嵌入式精簡指令集結構、ARM指令集、嵌入式計算平台、嵌入式程式設計與分析、嵌入式作業系統、系統設計技術、裝置操作、網路。本課程亦包含實習與學期專題作業。
description.en: Embedded systems are more and more popular today. It will affect the human life greatly. Portable devices like smart phone, PDA, and MP3 player, and so-called IA devices such as home gateway, DVR, and game machine are all categorized as embedded systems. In this course, we will discuss what an embedded system is, what it looks like, and how to build an embedded device. Since an embedded system involves hardware and software issues, we will discuss the related subjects. The prerequisite courses for this class include computer organization and architecture, the C programming language, data structure, system programming, and operating system. The major topics of this course are listed as follows: Introduction and Basic Concepts, The RISC Embedded Architectures, The ARM instruction Set, The Embedded Computing Platforms, Program Design and Analysis, The Embedded Operating Systems, System Design Techniques, Device Manipulation, Networks.

syllabi.outline:
本課程介紹以ARM CPU為核心之嵌入式系統。內容包含：ARM CPU介紹，ARM CPU指令集，ARM 之C 語言工具，ARM 發展環境，Linux核心之介紹。之後透過「樹莓派」作為本課程的實作系統，開發語音互動、影像處理、設備間通訊、雲端資料庫使用等的應用。同學可以從實務操作中，學習嵌入式系統之軟體開發與應用的能力，完成生活中各種嵌入式系統應用的製作，及期末專題。

This course covers the following topics: introduction to ARM CPU, instruction set of ARM CPU, C compiler of ARM CPU, debugging tools for ARM CPU, functions of the evaluation board, writing and running C language in the evaluation board, introduction to Linux kernel. This course also introduces the basic concepts of software and hardware of embedded systems, and then uses "Raspberry Pi" as the implementation system of this course to develop voice interaction, image processing, communication between devices. Applications such as cloud database usage. Students can learn the software development and application capabilities of embedded systems from practical operations, and complete the production of various embedded system applications and final-term project.

name.en: Advanced Properties of Materials and Related Practice

description.zh: 本課程將深入的討論材料之光電及表面性質，並經由實習實驗量測各種相關特性。尤其是在材料電子理論的應用方面。所涵蓋的主題包括有：電子理論、光學特性、繞射理論、表面科學、以及材料之磁性與熱力學性質。
description.en: After successfully completing this subject a student should be able to: (i) explain the fundamental aspects of electrical properties of materials, (ii) describe and understand energy method, (iii) describe and discuss nanoscale properties of materials, (iv) apply advanced properties of materials to engineering design problems, and (v) execute related measurements.

先修課程：負責教授同意
材料機械性質是強調材料巨觀性質與材料微觀結構, 鍵結及晶體結構之間的關係, 是一門實務性,基本且重要的課程。它包括彈性, 塑性行為, 差排理論, 單晶與聚晶材料之塑性變形, 複合材料, 高溫聚晶材料之變形, 非晶質材料之永久變形, 材料強化機構, 材料破壞, 潛變與氫脆性等問題之討論。
description.en: This course deals with the mechanical behavior of materials. It emphasizes the relationship among macroscopic properties, material microstructure, and fundamental concepts of bonding and crystal structure. Contents of this course include the elastic and elastic behavior , dislocation , plastic deformation in single and polycrystalline materials ,strengthening mechanism of crystalline materials, composite materials, high temperature of crystalline materials ,fracture , fatigue and embrittlement.

If you are unfamiliar with basic Mechanics of Materials, please carefully consider enrolling and ensure you review the material thoroughly before taking this course.

syllabi.schedule:
Week 1-2:
Introduction to Composite Material Components
複合材料元件介紹
Learn about the fundamental components and structure of composite materials.
學習複合材料的基本單元與結構。
Competency Indicator: C401
能力指標: C401

Week 3-4:
Analysis of Composite Material Properties
複合材料特性分析
Analyze the physical and mechanical properties of composite materials and their applications.
分析複合材料的物理與機械特性，探討其應用。
Competency Indicator: C402
能力指標: C402

Week 5-6:
Mechanical Behavior of Composite Materials
複合材料力學行為
Explore the mechanical behavior of composite materials under different stress and strain conditions.
探討複合材料在不同應力與應變條件下的力學行為。
Competency Indicator: C403
能力指標: C403

Week 7-8:
Stiffness of Unidirectional Composite Materials
單向性複合材料勁度
Learn how to calculate the stiffness of unidirectional composite materials and its applications.
學習單向性複合材料的勁度計算及其應用。
Competency Indicator: C404
能力指標: C404

Week 9:
Midterm Exam
期中考試
Assess students’ understanding and application of concepts covered in the first half of the course.
測試學生前半部分課程中的理解與應用能力。

Week 10:
Stress and Strain Transformation
應力與應變轉換
Study the transformation equations between stress and strain and their applications in composites.
學習應力與應變之間的轉換方程式及應用。
Competency Indicator: C405
能力指標: C405

Week 11:
Stiffness of Off-Axis Unidirectional Composite Materials
非軸向單向性複合材料勁度
Examine the mechanical properties and applications of off-axis unidirectional composite materials.
探討非軸向單向性複合材料的力學特性及其應用。
Competency Indicator: C406
能力指標: C406

Week 12:
Fatigue Failure
疲勞破壞
Understand the fatigue behavior and failure mechanisms of composite materials, and how to prolong material life.
了解複合材料的疲勞行為及其破壞機制，並學習如何延長材料壽命。
Competency Indicator: C407
能力指標: C407

Week 13-14:
Applications of Composite Materials in Railway Systems
複合材料於鐵路系統之應用
Explore the use of composite materials in railway systems, including vehicle structures and railway infrastructure.
探討複合材料在鐵道系統中的應用，包含車輛結構及鐵路基礎設施的具體案例。
Competency Indicator: C408
能力指標: C408

Week 15-16:
Lightweight Railway Design with Composites
鐵道輕量化與複合材料
Learn how composite materials can be used to achieve lightweight design in railway systems, improving energy efficiency and performance.
學習如何利用複合材料實現鐵道系統的輕量化設計，提升能源效率和性能。
Competency Indicator: C409
能力指標: C409

Week 17:
Final Review and Application Exercises
期末複習與應用練習
Comprehensive review of course content, with practical problem-solving exercises.
綜合複習課程內容，並進行實際問題應用練習。

Week 18:
Final Exam
期末考試
Test students' overall understanding and ability to apply the course content.
測試學生對整個課程內容的綜合掌握與應用能力。

Full English Oral Presentation - 30%

Students will prepare and deliver an oral presentation in English, with a focus on assessing their communication skills and comprehension of the course material.
Homework - 15%

Students are required to complete homework assignments, which are intended to reinforce classroom learning and apply concepts to practical problems.
Midterm Exam - 15%

Final Exam - 20%

Assessment Rubrics
Basic Concepts of Mechanics of Materials

Competency Indicators: A101, A102, A103, A104, A105
Assessment Method: Semester Performance
Needs Improvement (0-59): Students show insufficient understanding of basic concepts and are unable to apply them.
Satisfactory (60-79): Students have a basic understanding of core concepts but with limited application.
Good (80-89): Students demonstrate a good understanding and application of core concepts.
Excellent (90-100): Students have mastered the core concepts and can apply them flexibly.
Integration of Railway Engineering Content

Competency Indicators: A106, A107
Assessment Method: Classroom Exam
Needs Improvement (0-59): Students have a weak understanding of railway-related concepts.
Satisfactory (60-79): Students have a basic understanding of railway-related concepts.
Good (80-89): Students show a good understanding and application of railway concepts.
Excellent (90-100): Students have a deep understanding and can apply railway concepts in real-world scenarios.
Prerequisite Knowledge in Statics and Dynamics

Competency Indicators: A108, A109
Assessment Method: Classroom Exam
Needs Improvement (0-59): Students are unable to grasp the basic knowledge of statics and dynamics.
Satisfactory (60-79): Students demonstrate basic proficiency in statics and dynamics.
Good (80-89): Students have a good grasp of concepts and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent (90-100): Students have mastered statics and dynamics and can analyze complex issues effectively.

期末考試綜合評估學生在整個學期內所學知識的掌握情況。

description.zh: 此課程旨在以使用者為中心的觀點，說明產品與服務之開發與設計相關概念，並以實作方式應用使用者研究的方法，收集、分析與呈現研究資料與成果，使學生具備使用者研究的執行與發表能力。
description.en: From the human-centered perspective, this course explains concepts about the development and design of products and services. By practicing user research methods, students will learn how to collect and analyze the data, and present the findings of user research.

syllabi.outline: 此課程旨在以使用者為中心作為出發點，透過實際召募受試者、建構模擬實驗等，真實的應用使用者研究中的數據採集方法，進行數據搜集與分析，最終以真實的使用者需求進行某特定產品、服務、流程、手工具、設備等進行改善建議與設計，進而提高使用者的舒適、安全與效率。在實際場域上，常常會有出現產品、設備未考慮到男女先天在生理或心理的差異，導致某一族群對產品產生抱怨或感到操作上的不便，若能夠在設計初期將這一因素納入考量，分別設計出符合各族群需求的產品，將能夠有效提升工作效率。本次課程將重點放在偏鄉族群中的男女性別差異，讓學生透在課程當中學習相關採集使用者需求的方法、問卷調查、3D足部掃描、產品分析等知識，搭配實際參與使用者實驗與儀器操作，讓學生在校培養具有相關能力後，將至實際場域進行數據採集與訪談。在完成數據採集後，後半段課程將進行數據分析、討論與找出以使用者為中心的改善建議與方案，進而提升以使用者為中心的應用來提昇用戶滿意度、舒適度。除此之外，也介紹使用者產品設計相關應用案例、國際論文分享，培養學生對使用者研究的興趣與能量。整個課程透過小組實作方式，每一組提案不同的議題，進行深入的使用者需求採集，以做中學來提升學生的相關專業知識。

description.zh: 本課程預計搭配中國工業工程學會的「永續工程師」證照檢定考試做授課，由工程面與管理面探討淨零排放趨勢下，企業永續下工業工程所需具備的能力與知識。其中管理篇包括：企業永續發展、永續發展與氣候變遷風險管理、碳中和浪潮與因應之道、綠色供應鏈管理、永續金融、氣候相關財務揭露建議、資源永續與產業共生、與永續經濟決策分析。工程篇則包括：永續供應鏈設計、永續與能源政策、排放權交易與碳定價、綠色產品設計與評估、綠色物流與綠色冷鏈、產品服務系統、綠色聰明生產與循環經濟、清潔生產等理論與案例實務。
description.en: This course is designed to cover the knowledge and skills required for sustainable industrial in the context of net-zero emissions. It will be taught in conjunction with the "Sustainable Engineer" certification exam of the Chinese Institute of Industrial Engineers. The course will explore the topics from both engineering and management perspectives, focusing on sustainable enterprise development. The management chapters will cover a range of areas such as climate change, sustainable finance, green supply chain, carbon-neutral strategies, climate-related financial disclosure, resource sustainability, and industrial symbiosis, as well as sustainable economic decision analysis. Meanwhile, the engineering chapters will delve into topics such as sustainable supply chain design, energy policies, carbon pricing, green product design and evaluation, green logistics, product-service systems, green smart production, circular economy, and clean production theories and case studies.

syllabi.outline: The class is to introduce some basic knowledge about optical design systems such as the matrix formalism of geometrical optics and aberrations. Moreover, this class is to provide the students with experience in modeling the theory and applications for optical system design, using commonly used software tools such as RSoft, LightTools and CODEV. Student will also learn more system design such as the solar dish receiver and laser system from professional specialist faculties from Synopsis.

4.時間：論文進行定期全班報告，由授課老師共同排定時間；其餘週次，各組帶開，由授課教師進行論文討論。

name.en: Interactive Installation and Performing Arts Technology

description.zh: 本課程介紹整合即時影像、即時音訊、實體裝置、及相關表演科技（如燈光控制、各類感應器應用等）之技術與應用實務，並藉由圖形化、物件導向程式設計系統，引導未有程式設計經驗的視覺設計者或輔助已有程式設計能力者，以更有效率的方式進行相關互動系統設計，藉以達成互動裝置、表演科技、與表演藝術之整合。
description.en: This course introduces the technology that help integrates real-time video, audio, installations, and associated performance arts technology (such as lighting control, the application of various types of sensors, etc.) into performing arts. Through a graphical, object-oriented programming system, the course is intended to help visual designers with no programming experiences or to assist experienced programmers to efficiently design the interactive systems that combine interactive installations, performance arts technology, and performing arts itself as a whole.

syllabi.outline:
This course will explore the possibilities and developments of using interactive technology in contemporary performing arts and installation design. It will introduce forms and aesthetics of interactive performance, computer vision and listening, real-time video processing, and real-time audio synthesis. Through proposing and executing actual performance projects and interdisciplinary collaboration, students will have the opportunity to integrate interactive technology, interactive installations, and performing arts. The course will emphasize project proposal and conceptualization, performance scripting, stage and interactive installation design, and interactive audio-visual application design.

本課程將探討互動科技運用於當代表演藝術、裝置設計之可能性與相關發展，並介紹互動表演形式與美學、電腦視覺與電腦聆聽、即時影像處理、即時音訊合成等，藉由實際展演計畫之提案與執行，透過跨領域合作，讓學生有機會將互動科技、互動裝置、表演藝術三者結合。本課程將注重展演計畫之提案與發想、表演之腳本安排、舞台與互動裝置設計、互動影音應用設計等。

description.zh:
以圖像語言的架構教授分析性繪圖 (Analytical Drawing Process) 的概念與操作，以及分析性繪圖在設計速寫上的應用。課程以課堂講解與實地速寫來進行，主題包括感知與理解層面的三維觀察與紀錄、圖解、與圖像筆記。
教學目標為：
1.介紹分析性繪圖與徒手草寫。
2.訓練以徒手草寫的過程來觀察、分析、與記錄結構、空間、與建成環境的三維特性。
3.熟悉感知與理解的圖學系統與速寫表現手法，能以圖像筆記來記錄設計主題。
description.en:
This course introduces the concept of analytical drawing process, and how to utilize it in design sketching.
The objectives are:
1.Introduce the concept of analytical drawing process and techniques of freehand sketch. 
2.Develop the ability to see and analyze the three-dimensional characteristics of an observed object and encountered environment through analytical drawing process. 
3.Familiar with both conceptual and perceptual form of representation, and be able to take a visual note to document an investigated subject.

syllabi.outline:
Seeing is a creative process that involves our eyes and mind to transform what we see into what we know, but sometimes the process is reversed—we rely on what we know to interpret what we are seeing. To draw what we see can, therefore, be a process of the interaction of seeing and understanding. The goal of this course will focus on this seeing, thinking, and drawing interaction while drawing architecture on location. This course introduces the concept of analytical drawing process, and how to utilize it in design sketching.

1. Introduce the concept of analytical drawing process and techniques of freehand sketch. 
2. Develop the ability to see and analyze the three-dimensional characteristics of an observed object and encountered environment through analytical drawing process. 
3. Familiar with both conceptual and perceptual form of representation, and be able to take a visual note to document an investigated subject.

name.zh: 人工智慧與工程應用實作
name.en: Artificial Intelligence for Engineering Applications in Practice

description.zh: 本課程探討人工智慧(AI)與工程應用相關議題，並討論其解決方案與技術發展趨勢。內容由淺入深，包含基礎python程式設計、資料預處理、資料探索、機器學習、深度學習、AI工程應用介紹(分子性質預測、設備預測性維護、混凝土強度預測，PM2.5預測、房價預測等案例應用分析)及專題製作。在本課程中，學生可了解AI之基本原理及AI在工程上的應用，本課程也藉由AI程式撰寫的實作實習，提昇工程背景學生撰寫與理解AI應用程式設計的技能，以幫助學生將人工智慧導入產業應用實務中。
description.en: This course will introduce artificial intelligence (AI) and its applications in engineering fields. Topics covered include basic python programming, data prepossessing, data exploration, machine learning, deep learning, AI applications in engineering fields (e.g. predicting molecular properties, predictive maintenance predicting compressive strength of concrete, prediction of PM2.5, and prediction of house price, etc.) and final project. Students can learn about the basic principles and engineering applications of AI. Coding will be required to improve their programming competence in AI. The course intends to help the students implement AI concepts in their industrial practices.

syllabi.outline:
在人工智慧與機器學習技術飛越成長的當代，人工智慧應用已經普及到了民間，其不再具有技術與設備上的高度門檻與進入障礙，只要擁有入門等級的程式語言基礎，以及尚佳的電腦硬體設備，再加以自備的資料集合，人人都能夠應用人工智慧來解決各式各樣的問題。

本課程以工學院的應用角度出發，先以數週進行基礎python程式語言的訓練，再逐步以案例及實作讓修課學生體驗各種基於影像、文字或結構化資料的人工智慧應用。讓修課學生能夠理解基礎的深度學習理論，標記自己準備的資料集合，並且善用python程式語言進行資料的前處理，完成訓練、進行預測與評估成果。

In recent years, with the rapid advancements in artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) technologies, AI applications have become widespread among the general public. People no longer have barriers on techniques and equipment. With basic programming skills and affordable computer hardware, along with self-prepared datasets, anyone can leverage AI to solve a variety of problems.

From the perspective of engineering applications, this course begins with fundamental Python programming training. After that, through case studies and hands-on projects, students will experience various AI applications based on images, text, or structured data. The course aims to enable students to understand fundamental deep learning theories, label their own datasets, and effectively use Python for data preprocessing, training models, making predictions, and evaluating results.

2-3	人工智慧的理論基礎與發展進程
3-6      MLP：類神經網路之初探
7-10     資料的前處理：結構化資料、文字與圖像	
9	期中提案報告
10-17    python人工智慧套件應用（散佈在10-17週，每週0.5-1小時）
11-12	CNN：捲積神經網路與其衍生模型
12-13	RNN：循環神經網路與其衍生模型
14-15	seq2seq與Encoder/Decoder
16-17	Attention機制與Transformer
18	期末報告

作業(30%)

description.zh: 本課程從礦物的化學成分、化學鍵及其晶體結構之理論詳細討論礦物的物理及化學性質。再就各項理化性質在選礦、冶煉、化工製造及其它物理加工等方面之應用分別舉例介紹。
description.en: Systematic Study of physical and chemical properties of minerals, and relationships of properties with chemical  compositions, chemical bonding mechanisms and crystal  structures. syllabi.outline: 此課程旨在以使用者為中心作為出發點，透過實際召募受試者、建構模擬實驗等，真實的應用使用者研究中的數據採集方法，進行數據搜集與分析，最終以真實的使用者需求進行某特定產品、服務、流程、手工具、設備等進行改善建議與設計，進而提高使用者的舒適、安全與效率。在實際場域上，常常會有出現產品、設備未考慮到男女先天在生理或心理的差異，導致某一族群對產品產生抱怨或感到操作上的不便，若能夠在設計初期將這一因素納入考量，分別設計出符合各族群需求的產品，將能夠有效提升工作效率。本次課程將重點放在偏鄉族群中的男女性別差異，讓學生透在課程當中學習相關採集使用者需求的方法、問卷調查、3D足部掃描、產品分析等知識，搭配實際參與使用者實驗與儀器操作，讓學生在校培養具有相關能力後，將至實際場域進行數據採集與訪談。在完成數據採集後，後半段課程將進行數據分析、討論與找出以使用者為中心的改善建議與方案，進而提升以使用者為中心的應用來提昇用戶滿意度、舒適度。除此之外，也介紹使用者產品設計相關應用案例、國際論文分享，培養學生對使用者研究的興趣與能量。整個課程透過小組實作方式，每一組提案不同的議題，進行深入的使用者需求採集，以做中學來提升學生的相關專業知識。
