description.zh: 本課程預計搭配中國工業工程學會的「永續工程師」證照檢定考試做授課，由工程面與管理面探討淨零排放趨勢下，企業永續下工業工程所需具備的能力與知識。其中管理篇包括：企業永續發展、永續發展與氣候變遷風險管理、碳中和浪潮與因應之道、綠色供應鏈管理、永續金融、氣候相關財務揭露建議、資源永續與產業共生、與永續經濟決策分析。工程篇則包括：永續供應鏈設計、永續與能源政策、排放權交易與碳定價、綠色產品設計與評估、綠色物流與綠色冷鏈、產品服務系統、綠色聰明生產與循環經濟、清潔生產等理論與案例實務。
description.en: This course is designed to cover the knowledge and skills required for sustainable industrial in the context of net-zero emissions. It will be taught in conjunction with the "Sustainable Engineer" certification exam of the Chinese Institute of Industrial Engineers. The course will explore the topics from both engineering and management perspectives, focusing on sustainable enterprise development. The management chapters will cover a range of areas such as climate change, sustainable finance, green supply chain, carbon-neutral strategies, climate-related financial disclosure, resource sustainability, and industrial symbiosis, as well as sustainable economic decision analysis. Meanwhile, the engineering chapters will delve into topics such as sustainable supply chain design, energy policies, carbon pricing, green product design and evaluation, green logistics, product-service systems, green smart production, circular economy, and clean production theories and case studies.

description.en: Geoengineering is planetary-scale environmental engineering, particularly engineering aimed at counteracting the undesired side effects of other human activities. Geoengineering covers a wide range of engineering disciplines related to geo-materials, such as foundation engineering, slope engineering, tunnelling, rock engineering, engineering geology and geo-environmental engineering. This course interests range from geological to geomorphological concept, to provide a firm fundamental background for the civil engineering and environmental engineering, and to manage and mitigate of natural hazards. Implicit in these pursuits is the stewardship of the earth, and the quest to harvest the most advanced fruits of scientific achievements as tools for our graduates to work with.

syllabi.outline:
Course Description 
Elements of ecosystems, biogeochemical cycling, environmental factor interactions, population dynamics, and community development. 

Course Goals 
This course is intended for students and will examine structure and function of ecological systems, including populations, communities, and ecosystems, role of evolution in structure and function of systems, and influence of society on the biosphere. By the end of the semester, students who complete all necessary assignments will be able to: 
1.	Understand major concepts and terminology in the field of ecology. 
2.	Identify reputable sources for ecological information. 
3.	Comprehend the methods and application of ecological research. 
4.	Evaluate human interactions with nature and effects on natural systems.

syllabi.outline:
生態系統為環境永續的根本。生態系統提供之自然資源與生態服務，也是人類社會中不可或缺的來源。本課程將使同學了解生態系統的運作，以及生態系統的各個組成，透過對生態系統的了解，未來在環境中所建構的各種設施，才能因應環境變化，且不破壞環境。本課程主要目的為在工程中學習與環境的互動，將環境生態因子納入工程建設設計與施作中，使未來硬體建設能更適應環境變異，提高韌性，成為環境所接受的工程。
Ecosystem is the foundation of the environmental sustainability. Ecosystem provides natural resources and ecological service, which are the major supplies for human system. This course is focus on the operation of ecosystem and the components. The understanding of ecosystem would be helpful to build the constructions that is resilient to variable environment and not bring damage to environment. The purpose of this course is to learn the interactions between engineering and environment, and to know how to incorporate ecological factors into engineering design and construction. The hard constructions with environmental considerations are expected to be accepted by the natural environment.

description.zh: 伴隨著台灣經濟高度發展， 地下水資源在民生、工業及民生用水所扮演的角色日益重要。地下水學科的領域涵蓋水量、水質及防災三方面。修習此課程，學生可以了解地下水文及水井水力學之基本原理，推估區域性地下水蘊藏量及安全出水量，以作為規劃與管理地下水資源之依據。
description.en: As the economy in Taiwan develops, groundwater resources play an increasingly important role in both industry and domestic water supply. The discipline of groundwater covers three aspects: water quantity, water quality and disaster prevention. This course mainly introduces the basic principles of groundwater hydrology and well hydraulics, and tackles how to estimate the amount of regional groundwater resources and determine their safe yield, as a basis for planning and managing groundwater resources.

syllabi.outline: 隨著台灣農工社會、經濟型態的轉變以及對水資源安全供應之要求日益增加情況下，地下水與地表水聯合運用成為整體水資源經營管理不可或缺之一環。而超抽地下水造成之各項災害也與氣候變遷下複合型災害相連結。對地下水文進行更深入之探討，將裨益於解決各項地下水資源應用與防災相關問題。地下水的領域涵蓋水量,水質及防災三方面,修習此一學科，可以了解地下水水文及水力學之基本原理，進而掌握地下水水理與污染傳輸之特性,以作為規劃與管理地下水資源及防災之依據。

description.en:
This course involves "Vocational Education and Training" and "Career Planning" two main topics. The "Vocational Education and Training" topic offers an introduction about vocational education and training, such as (a) flexible adjustment the system of vocational education and training in Taiwan; (b) emphasizing vocation education and training system; (c) establish solid theoretical foundation of the vocational education and training. description.en:
The object of this course is to introduce the educational psychology to the students who are receiving teacher education. It presents the students with the basic psychology theories of instructional process; mental-physical development; the principles of learning and instruction; cultivating of thinking and creative; motivation and interest in instructing process; the measurement of individual difference; proper instructions against differently mental students; teacher-student relationship and students behaviors; instruction evaluation. After finishing this course, students will have better understanding regarding the factors shaping the students’ behaviors, as well as can choose the best instructional ways for the teaching.

description.zh:
「輔導工作是所有教育工作者的責任」。任何人都會遭遇問題，成長中的學生尤其有各式各樣的問題。身為人師，在教學過程中應輔導學生解決問題，以培養健康進取，有能力解決問題，適應環境的學生為己任。在本課程的目標即在透過對青春期挫折徵候的了瞭以及學者心理分析輔導法、個體心理輔導法、存在主義輔導法、理情輔導法、認知輔導法、溝通分析輔導法、行為輔導法等輔導理論，並配合實例分析使未來之教育工作人員獲得工作時的輔導知能以及培養輔導工作的志趣。 
教育專業課程與教師專業素養指標，請參閱連結:
https://tec.ntut.edu.tw/p/412-1022-10857.php?Lang=zh-tw
description.en:
The teachers should keep in mind the duty to guide students to overcome the frustration or to solve difficult problems as to nurture students to be healthy, positive, with their own abilities to overcome difficulties and to be apt to the environment. The object of this subject is to help students with the willingness to be teachers get the knowledge and abilities of guidance on their teaching in the future, and develop willingness and interests of guidance. This course presents students with the units including  understanding the symptom of adolescent frustration, the method of person-center approach, the method of rational-emotive therapy, the method of cognitive therapy, the method of behavior therapy. In addition, this course also introduces many practical cases so that students can  effectively study the relevant theories. 
Indicators of Teacher’s professional competencies in professional education, please visit the link: https://tec.ntut.edu.tw/p/412-1022-10857.php?Lang=zh-tw

syllabi.outline: 「輔導工作是所有教育工作者的責任」。任何人都會遭遇問題，成長中的學生尤其有各式各樣的問題。身為人師，在教學過程中應輔導學生解決問題，以培養健康進取，有能力解決問題，適應環境的學生為己任。在本課程的目標即在透過對青春期挫折徵候的了瞭以及學者心理分析輔導法、個體心理輔導法、存在主義輔導法、理情輔導法、認知輔導法、溝通分析輔導法、行為輔導法等輔導理論，並配合實例分析使未來之教育工作人員獲得工作時的輔導知能以及培養輔導工作的志趣。 本課程擬培養之教師專業素養指標： 2-1了解並尊重學生身心發展、社經及文化背景的差異，以作為教學與輔導的依據。3-5應用多元教學策略、教學媒材與學習科技，以促進學生有效學習。4-2應用輔導原理與技巧進行學生輔導，以促進適性發展。(各項指標內容請點連結詳閱了解)

description.zh:
本課程的目標在培養學生瞭解教育與社會關係，從而能自教育的社會基礎理論觀點來從事教育決策，分析教育制度，探求教學原則，解決教育問題。 
教育專業課程與教師專業素養指標，請參閱連結:
https://tec.ntut.edu.tw/p/412-1022-10857.php?Lang=zh-tw
description.en:
The object of this course is to introduce the students the understanding of the relationship between education and society. It presents the students with the relation between education and the main sociological theories, such as socialization, social structure, social change. It also offers students with the social condition of schools, the teacher's role, the teacher groups and the teacher's social status. After finishing this course, the students can use the knowledge learned from this course to make educational decision, analyze educational systems, study the instructional principles and solve educational problems in view of the basic theories of sociology of education, and thus lead to achieve the educational goal.
Indicators of Teacher’s professional competencies in professional education, please visit the link:

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在協助學生探究教育社會學的理論與實務，探討主題包含:社會化、社會階層、教育機會均等、技職教育與社會發展等，並期學生運用相關論點對當前技職教育問題提出建議。

本課程擬培養之教師專業素養指標： 
1-2敏銳覺察社會環境對學生學習影響，以利教育機會均等。
2-1了解並尊重學生身心發展、社經及文化背景的差異，以作為教學與輔導的依據。
syllabi.schedule:
一、導論
二、教育社會學的起源
三、教育社會學主要理論
四、教育的功能
五、社會階層化
六、教育機會均等
七、學校文化
八、課程社會學
九、班級社會學

1.平時小考、課堂討論成績佔40﹪

3.依本校學則規定，未達出席次數不予通過。

syllabi.outline:
一、學習敏銳覺察社會環境對學生的學習影響，以利教育機會均等。
二、瞭解特殊需求學生的特質與鑑定歷程，以提供適切的教育與支持。
三、瞭解我國特殊教育的發展與趨勢，以及特殊教育相關法規。
四、能依據特殊需求學生學習特質，調整與設計課程教學內容。
五、能依據特殊需求學生學習特質，調整學生學習評量的方式。
六、能依據不同類型之特殊需求學生，提供適當的支持與輔導。
七、能遵照性別平等教育之教育原則，提供特殊需求學生適當課程內容。

授課方式：
一、課堂講授：講述基礎理論，並佐以教學現況的實例說明，增進理論理解。
二、課堂討論與分享：以問題導向學習法為教學方式，將實際教學的情況為主題，請學生以理論基礎設法提出解決方法。
三、分組報告與討論：以小組方式報告各組分配內容，報告後，由老師再詳加說明並請學生討論。
評量標準：
平時成績(含出缺席狀況)30%、分組報告30%、期末個人報告40%。

name.zh: 電子材料與元件技術特論
name.en: Special Topics in Electronic Materials and Devices

description.zh: 本課程探討電子材料性質、固態物理基礎、元件物理等相關內容，強化電子材料與半導體元件技術之關聯性，藉由剖析材料結構與元件電性，深入探討電子元件在實際應用時可能遭遇之材料議題。本課程將介紹多種半導體元件技術應用，內容包括p-n接面、發光二極體與太陽能電池等。
description.en: This course will introduce the material properties, the basics of solid-state physics, and semiconductor devices and physics to provide knowledge of electronic materials and modern semiconductor devices. To assess the material and device issues of electronics for practical use, analysis of the material structure and electrical performance are essential. The content will include various semiconductor device technologies, such as p-n junction, light emitted diodes (LEDs), and solar cells.

syllabi.outline:
This course facilitates students' comprehension of fundamental concepts in electronic materials, semiconductor physics and devices, and the modern theory of solids. Additionally, it encompasses the introduction to basic electronic devices and semiconductor processing technology employed in the contemporary semiconductor industry.
(Course taught in English)

name.zh: 雷射醫學的基礎與臨床應用

description.zh: 雷射乃20世紀三大發明之一，醫用雷射更已廣泛地應用在各個醫學領域。本課程將涵蓋的範圍包括：1. 雷射基本原理；2. 雷射安全標準；3. 雷射與組織的作用關係；4. 雷射在醫學的各種應用；5. 雷射於牙周病的應用；6. 雷射於口腔外科的應用；7. 雷射應用於牙齒美白；8. 低能量雷射的各種應用；9. 雷射實機操作與臨床示範。
description.en: The laser is one of the three major items invented in 20th century.  Medical laser applications have been widely used in many fields.  This lecture will cover: 1. Laser Physics; 2. Safety Standards; 3. Laser-Tissue-Interaction; 4. Laser in Medical Applications; 5. Laser in Periodontology; 6. Laser in Oral Surgery; 7. Laser Assisted Bleaching; 8. Low Level Laser Therapy; 9. Practical Hands-on and Live Patient Demonstration.

description.zh: 先修課程：3002010或負責教授同意。晶體結構、鋼之變態、相平衡原理、退火與正常化、淬火與回火、表面硬化處理、構造用鋼、工具鋼、其它鋼料及鑄鐵之熱處理。
description.en:
The contents of this course can be categorized as followings: 
1. fundamental metallographic concepts.
2. The effects of alloying elements in steel.
3. Hardenability 
4. General heat treatment processes: annealing, hardening, tempering, and normalizing. 
5. Special heat treatment process : tool steels hardening and tempering. Quenching and tempering of constructional steels, case hardening, nitriding, carbonitriding, induction hardening, and flame hardening.

description.zh: 本課程為財務會計領域之進階課程，針對已具初級會計學之學生深入講授財務會計之理論、觀念、方法及程序。本課程全面納入國際財務報導準則(IFRS)，內容包括：介紹財務報導觀念架構、主要財務報表編製、講解資產負債表中有關資產、負債、股東權益以及現金流量表與租賃會計等，修習本課程可使學生對IFRS有全面整體了解及運用之能力。亦有助於將來參加會計乙級、記帳士及公務人員高考等證照考試。
description.en: This course is an advanced course for financial accounting. It is to teach the financial accounting theory, concept, method and procedure for students with some basic accounting knowledge. The course covers all the materials to understand financial accounting based on IFRS. The course will help students for preparing advanced license examinations for accounting.

description.en: Introduction to the finite element method and its application to engineering problems.  Topics include Variational Formulation and Finite Element Formulations, 1-D, 2-D and 3-D Element Shapes, Numerical Integration, Applications to dynamic problem and Introduction to Commercial Finite Element Programs.

syllabi.outline:
Course Title: Finite Element Analysis (有限元素分析)
This course introduces the basic principles of the finite element method and its applications in various engineering problems. Topics include fundamental concepts of finite element analysis, establishing finite element models using variational principles, shape functions, and iso-parametric elements. It covers one-dimensional problems such as rods, trusses, beams, and frames; two-dimensional problems including plane stress, plane strain, and plate-shell problems; and three-dimensional problems involving general solids. Practical exercises and case studies using finite element analysis software are included for practice and research analysis.
This semester, the course integrates USR (University Social Responsibility) into the curriculum, guiding students to apply finite element analysis to the USR project. Students who heavily participate in the USR project can utilize finite analysis in their USR electrical vehicle designs and/or for systematic improvements.

name.zh: 人工智慧跨域金融之應用

description.zh: 本課程將從不同的金融服務領域應用幫助同學瞭解數位金融的發展以及生成式AI於金融科技之應用。本課程之教學目標包括：(1) 人工智慧跨域應用金融產品企劃與數位行銷：掌握虛擬通路與實體通路的差異與整合應用，導入通用式人工智慧搭配合適的使用者介面與體驗設計；(2) 智慧金融科技素養與創新應用：關注大數據、雲端運算、物聯網與人工智慧的各種創新應用，並了解機器學習於資金管理之應用與人工智慧於量化交易之應用；(3) 生成式AI導入與開發：透過課程整合微軟Azure Open AI雲端服務資源，讓學生具有導入ChatGPT及聊天機器人開發能力，並連結創新創業課程建立明確創業目標，導入跨領域創業課程，養成專業職能和研發實力，進而了解金融產業在數位轉型中，所面臨的困難與挑戰。
description.en:
英文概述
English Description 	This course will help students understand the development of digital finance and the application of generative AI in financial technology from different financial service applications. The objectives of this program include: (1) Financial product planning and digital marketing; (2) Intelligent financial technology literacy and innovative applications; (3) Generative AI Introduction and Development: Integrate Microsoft Azure Open AI cloud service resources through the course to provide students with the ability to introduce ChatGPT and chat robot development, and link to innovative entrepreneurship courses to establish clear entrepreneurial goals and introduce cross-disciplinary entrepreneurship courses to develop professional functions and R&D capabilities.

The course content includes third-party electronic payments, mobile payments, cross-domain payment applications, Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL), and encrypted currency payments. At the same time, the course will also explore related issues such as industry development context, operator strategies, and regulation.

name.zh: 人工智慧跨域金融之應用

description.zh: 本課程將從不同的金融服務領域應用幫助同學瞭解數位金融的發展以及生成式AI於金融科技之應用。本課程之教學目標包括：(1) 人工智慧跨域應用金融產品企劃與數位行銷：掌握虛擬通路與實體通路的差異與整合應用，導入通用式人工智慧搭配合適的使用者介面與體驗設計；(2) 智慧金融科技素養與創新應用：關注大數據、雲端運算、物聯網與人工智慧的各種創新應用，並了解機器學習於資金管理之應用與人工智慧於量化交易之應用；(3) 生成式AI導入與開發：透過課程整合微軟Azure Open AI雲端服務資源，讓學生具有導入ChatGPT及聊天機器人開發能力，並連結創新創業課程建立明確創業目標，導入跨領域創業課程，養成專業職能和研發實力，進而了解金融產業在數位轉型中，所面臨的困難與挑戰。
description.en:
英文概述
English Description 	This course will help students understand the development of digital finance and the application of generative AI in financial technology from different financial service applications. The objectives of this program include: (1) Financial product planning and digital marketing; (2) Intelligent financial technology literacy and innovative applications; (3) Generative AI Introduction and Development: Integrate Microsoft Azure Open AI cloud service resources through the course to provide students with the ability to introduce ChatGPT and chat robot development, and link to innovative entrepreneurship courses to establish clear entrepreneurial goals and introduce cross-disciplinary entrepreneurship courses to develop professional functions and R&D capabilities.

name.en: Foreign Exchange Markets: Theories and Practices

description.zh: 本課程教授內容包括外匯理論與實務操作，課程內容包括： 1. 探討有那些因素會影響匯率的波動以及均衡匯率的決定，並以實務案例，引導學生得以學習到外匯交易的知識，並懂得結合外匯交易的理論與實務來建置自己的外匯交易策略，進行正確的外匯投資操作。2. 透過對外匯市場交易之思考、探討、批判與洞察，來打造最適合的外匯交易策略，進而提升外匯專業之操作能力。
description.en: This course prepares students to effectively analyze, assess, and trade foreign currency in the FOREX spot market. Topics presented during the course include: models of success and historical evidence on buying and selling patterns, how to understand volatility of return on the foreign currency exchange, the price behavior of currency, and technical tools for analysis including Japanese Candlesticks and Bar charts. The course focuses on foreign exchange market, major players in the FOREX market, spot and forward market, currency futures and options, foreign exchange exposure and risk, FOREX traders and trading, technical analysis in the FOREX market, profiles of the world’s major currencies and their characteristics. Students will also explore and use the various trading platforms in use on the spot market today and will complete a project in which they will maintain and trade a practice account over the length of this course and track their performance, trading behaviors, and motivat

description.zh: 本課程以文化人類學的角度引導學生認識田野調查的發展背景，與當代社會科學研究中的應用現況。本課程分為田野調查相關理論介紹、田野調查的方法與倫理、大眾民族誌作品研讀與分析與田野調查實習三部份。透過基礎概念建立，搭配研讀相關作品，進一步思考田野調查之相關議題，最後依照擬定之田野調查場域或主題，進行實務操作練習，包含觀察、口訪與反思，並於期末進行分享與討論。
description.en: This course introduces the theories of anthropology and development of fieldwork as a research method. The ways to conduct a fieldwork are taught in the class, include participant observation and interview, and further, a practical workshop of fieldwork is offered, as an opportunity to practice fieldwork design, field observation and interview by students.

syllabi.outline:
本課程將分理論、作品研讀與實地操作三部份。首先介紹田野調查理論，之後透過研讀民族誌作品瞭解田野調查的意義與價值；後透過田野調查實務，擬定田野調查主題，進行操作練習，期末進行分享與討論。
This course is divided into theory, work study and field operation. Under the basis of theory and model demonstration, students will choose one topic and report it regularly. At the end of this semester, a final report is needed.

description.zh: 本課程旨在教授學生瞭解雲端環境及物聯網系統架構並進一步教授雲端環境及物聯網安全需求，課程內容除介紹雲端環境及物聯網系統的基本概念外，亦將由OWASP的雲端安全及物聯網安全的重點進行說明，培養學生有能力分析雲端及物聯網環境中的各式潛在安全威脅，並具備設計與實作具安全防護能力的雲端及物聯網系統。
description.en: This course aims to teach students to understand the cloud environment and IoT system architecture. Furthermore, the teach of the cloud environment and IoT security requirements are also introduced. In addition to introducing the basic concepts of cloud environment and IoT system, the course content will also include OWASP cloud security and IoT security. The main objective is on developing students' ability to analyze various potential security threats in the cloud and IoT environments, as well as cloud and IoT systems that are designed and implemented with security protection capabilities.

syllabi.outline:
雲端(Cloud)與物聯網(Internet of Things, IoT)重塑了整個計算世界對於事物的運行方式。除了為各行業提出了新的前沿應用外，也衍生更多在兩者融合對於管理、資訊安全與隱私保護等不得不重視的課題。本課程主要討論雲端與物聯網相關的安全性問題，包括由物聯網衍生出來的新威脅、弱點及兩者融合的相關安全議題。引領學生具備發展雲端與物聯網安全的重要觀念與技術，進而可以分析、設計與規劃未來物聯網與雲端運算融合之應用、與安全管理。
Cloud and the Internet of Things (IoT) have reshaped the way things are performed across the computing world. In addition to proposing new cutting-edge applications for various industries, there are also more issues that must be paid attention to in the integration of the two, such as management, information security and privacy protection. This course mainly discusses the security issues related to cloud and the IoT, including new threats and weaknesses derived when the two technologies converge. To lead students to understand important concepts and technologies for cloud and IoT security, and then to able to analyze, design, plan application and implement security management of the integration of the cloud and IoT.

description.zh: 本課程銜接上學期程式交易課程內容(限定修過上學期的同學才能選修)，我們將使用R語言進行更為精實的交易策略建構，包刮K棒分析、指標建構、訊號探勘、資金管理…等。此外，我們下半學期將邀請業師教授XQ程式交易軟體，撰寫XS程式語法進行回測以及模擬下單
description.en: This course connects with the last semester courses “program trading” (limited to last semester students to join). We will use the R language for more sophisticated trading strategy construction, including K-bar analysis, index construction, trading signal exploration, money management, and so on. In addition, we will invite the instructor to teach XQ program trading software in the last half-semester, usingXS program grammar to back-testing trading strategies.

syllabi.outline:
本課程介紹如何將金融操作的方式，以明確的演算法去定義、描述與執行。課程內容伴隨使用R語言進行 ，並探討如何運用時下最流行的機器學習技術於金融交易? 課程後半段邀請業師教學程式交易軟體使用，及期末論文與成果報告

This course introduces how to define, describe, and execute financial trading in a clear algorithm. The course content is accompanied by the use of the R language and explores how to use the most popular machine learning techniques for financial trading.
In the second half of the course, the lecturers are invited to teach the program trading software. Students have to present the final projects and reports.

description.zh:
先修課程:負責教授同意
基本觀念及其領域、非線性代數之數值解法、聯立方程式之數值解、多項式內外插、微分、積分、常微分方程、起始、邊界值問題之數值解法。
description.en:
Fundamental Concepts and Its Scope, Numerical Solution of Nonlinear Algebraic Equations and Sets of Equations, Interpolating Polynomials, Numerical Differentiation and Numerical Integration, Numerical Solution of Ordinary Differential Equations, Numerical Solution of Boundary-Value
Problems and Initial-Value Problems.

syllabi.outline:
先修課程:負責教授同意
本課程在應用計算方法來解決工程問題，重點將放在理解各種數值方法背後的基本概念，使用MATLAB環境來實現基本數值方法，以及利用複雜的數值方法來建構MATLAB函數。
This course is to teach you how to apply computational methodologies to solve engineering problems when no analytical solution exists. Emphasis will be placed on understanding the basic concepts behind the various numerical methods, implementing basic numerical methods using the MATLAB structured programming environment, and utilizing more sophisticated numerical methods provided as built-in MATLAB functions.
syllabi.schedule:
第01週 Introduction 課程簡介
第02週 Mathematical Modelings 數學模型
第03週 MATLAB Fundamentals MATLAB環境簡介
第04週 Roundoff and Truncation Errors 誤差分析
第05週 Roots: Open Methods 求根
第06週 Roots: Open Methods 求根
第07週 Optimization 最佳化
第08週 Linear Algebraic Equations 線性方程式
第09週 Midterm 期中
第10週 Gauss Elimination 高斯消去法
第11週 LU Factorization LU分解法
第12週 Matrix Inverse and Condition 反矩陣和條件數
第13週 Iterative Methods 迭代法 
第14週 Numerical Integration Formulas 數值積分
第15週 Numerical Differentiation 數值微分
第16週 Initial-Value Problems 初始值問題
第17週 Boundary-Value Problems 邊界值問題
第18週 Final Exam 期末考

name.en: Special Topics on Nano- Technology and Environment

description.zh: 這門課著重在探討奈米科技之基本原理與應用範疇，以及環境應用與安全相關主題，內容包含奈米之基本特性、各種量測方法、結構控制、以及"納米"對環境應用與安全問題。此外並包含奈米微粒之產生、收集、測量以及微粒動力學等主題。
description.en: This course will investigate the definition and theories of nanotechnology. Including basic properties, measuring methods, structural control, environmental, and safety issues of "Nano-". Topics about generation, collection, measurement and dynamics of nano-particle will also be covered.

syllabi.outline: This course introduces students to the environmental aspects of nanoscience and nanotechnology. We will study the fundamental physical-chemical properties, synthesis and characterization, environmental implications, health and environmental impact, and environmental applications of nanoparticles and nanomaterials. Topics about the generation, collection, and measurement of nano-particle will also be covered. Case studies from recent publications on engineered carbon nanomaterials and nanomaterials on catalysis will be discussed.

1. Introduction of Environanotechnology
2. Physicochemical Properties of Nanomaterials
3. Synthesis Methods and Generation of Nanomaterials (1)
4. Synthesis Methods and Generation of Nanomaterials (2)
5. Characterization and Measurement of Nanomaterials (1)
6. Characterization and Measurement of Nanomaterials (2)
7. Nanomaterials for Environmental Pollutions (1)
8. Nanomaterials for Environmental Pollutions (2)
9. Mid-term Exam
10. Nanomaterials for Air Pollution Control

description.en: This course focuses on introducing the meaning and principles of designing environmentally sound products. The theories and principles of Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) will be introduced extensively. Several sets of LCA computer software will be utilized in the classes for students to practice. To understand how Life Cycle Thinking and Life Cycle Management can solve environmental problems. Life Cycle Assessment (LCA), one of the most important tools for analyzing and assessing environmental problems, will be taught during the course of the semester. Students will also be learning a popular LCA software, SimaPro. Various applications related to LCA, such as carbon footprinting, carbon labeling, and eco-design, will also be practiced in the class.

description.zh: 許多現成的工程軟體並無法滿足所有客製化的需求，因此會開放作謂的「應用程式介面」（Application Programming Interfaces, API）供使用者進行二次開發，使其能自行拼湊、重組與創造需要的功能。本課程以建築資訊塑模（BIM）或人工智慧（AI）應用為主要示範案例，訓練學生有系統地理解API的規格說明文件，並且有效率地開發API應用程式，以達到各種工程應用軟體的客製化應用，並提升不同軟體間的交互操作性。
description.en: Many engineering software packages may not fully meet all customized requirements, thus they provide Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) for users to engage in secondary development. This course takes Building Information Modeling (BIM) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) applications as primary demonstration examples, and trains the enrolled students to systematically understand API documentations as well as efficiently develop API applications. It can help the enrolled students to customize their software for solving the engineering problems. In addition, it also enhances the  interoperability between different engineering software packages.

syllabi.outline:
企業經營最終的目標，就是賺錢。然企業常因不健全的財務運作，增加企業經營的困境，進而發生倒閉的情形。本課程主要介紹會計與財務管理的基礎知識，分析、診斷、控制與健全企業財務的方法。其中，主要內容包括如何閱讀、分析與診斷財務報表，如何評價「錢」與「時間」的價值，評估最適工程方案的決策，營建業投資開發財務分析與決策，財務風險的測度與應用等。本課程的目的，透過財務管理基礎知識的建立，與診斷分析控制方法的介紹，輔以實際案例的應用及說明，培養工程領域學生處理工程財務管理的能力，進而提昇工程管理的執行力。
The main objective of the course is to provide the students of the civil engineering the basic concept and theory of finance and helpful operational techniques. The content includes the overview of the basic financial concepts, the basic concepts of accounting, accounting equation, financial statements analysis, risk analysis, investment decisions, alternation evaluation, capital budget decision, urban redevelopment financial analysis and case study. Students will use these decision analyses to achieve financial management object in the future.

description.zh:
近年發生之福島核災、印度新德里爆炸案等各種天然及人為災害已顯著影響到人類的生活品質與安全。本課程目標有三：(1)了解各種災害形成原因及環境背景因素；(2)評估災害對社會、環境及人類之影響及因應措施；(3)新穎技術可擴大環境監測尺度並預警災害。較為代表性之災害會於課堂中案例講述，加深同學學習印象。工程背景較為薄弱之學生，亦適合選修此課程。
學習成效：學生可獲得：
(1)	災害管理內涵與重要觀念。
(2)	評估災害風險與危機管理。
(3)	研擬災前的災後復原重建計畫。
description.en:
The recurrent occurrences of various natural and manmade disasters like the December 2004 Tsunami, the bomb blasts in the cinema halls of Delhi and many such incidences have diverted our focus towards safety of one’s own life. The goals of this course are three-fold: (1) To educate students about the underlying natural process that give rise to hazards. (2) To emphasize how society evaluates and confronts the dangers posed by these natural processes from a political, social, and ethical perspective. (3) Expose students to the technological innovations that are allowing an increasing large human population to monitor, predict, and warn society about natural hazards and impending disasters. Case studies of recent and past natural disasters will be discussed. This course is designed for students without an extensive background in science or math and can be used to partly satisfy minor programs in Environmental Geosciences.
Learning Outcomes: Upon completion of this course, students will

syllabi.outline: Disaster is divided to natural and anthropogenic disaster. Either natural or anthropogenic disaster damage can be minimized by proper management, including pre- and post- management. Learning from the history, several disasters have been identified and more and more technologies have been developed to mitigate the possible disasters. In this course, natural disasters are focus because it is more difficult to predict and prevent. With the changing environment and climate, the intensity and frequency of natural disasters become more strong and unpredictable; therefore, the disaster management is very important. Real cases for different types of disaster will be chosen and discussed in this course. Facing these disasters, what we can do and how we can prepare is a survival issue. Through the comprehensive discussion, the students are expected to learn the structural and nonstructural solutions for the various disasters. Especially, the solutions are focus on ecological engineering and environmental friendly methods. A new and widely accepted idea, natural-based solutions (NBS) or ecosystem-based approaches, is increasingly applied to disaster management and will be discussed in this course.

description.en: This is a comprehensive course in probability and statistics for students in engineering and technology discipline.  It emphasizes modern statistical methods and data analysis using real data and examples to offer students exposure to practical applications.  This course will provide an opportunity to learn how probabilistic analysis and statistical reasoning and testing can be applied to a wide range of problems in civil engineering.  Topics to be covered will include data analysis, probability, random variables, probability distributions, estimation, hypothesis testing, sampling, linear regression, statistical process control and analysis of variance.

syllabi.outline: The objective of the course is to familiarize the students with statistical topics that frequently arise in engineering application. description.zh: 本課程將探討明渠中穩定流、非穩定流、均勻流、非均勻流之流體特性。
description.en: Open channel hydraulics treats the motion of water in conduits that have a free surface, that is, in which the flow of water is not completely bounded by the channel perimeter and one surface is exposed to atmospheric pressure.  The flows can be steady (time-invariant) or unsteady, uniform (space-invariant) or non-uniform (gradually, rapidly, or spatially varied).  For engineers, open channels are very common for the conveyance of natural waters, storm discharges, sewage collection systems, and aqueducts for water distribution systems. Knowledge of the mechanics of open-channel flow, then, is important for the proper design of these facilities.

8. Introduction to the control method of the converter

syllabi.outline:
無刷直流及永磁同步電動機具有高效率、高功率-質量比，在家電、工業設備、及電動車輛產業都已被廣泛的應用，為目前最主要的動力馬達。本課程從基本的磁路分析及永久磁鐵開始，首先介紹無刷直流的運轉原理及控制方法，然後探討永磁同步電動機之控制理論，及驅動電路技術，最後說明控制系統實現及無轉軸位置感測器控制的方法。
Brushless dc and permanent-magnet synchronous motor have higher efficiency and energy to mass ratio in comparison to the other motors. They are gradually replacing induction motor and widely used in industry. This course begins with the theory of basic electromagnetic energy conversion, followed by the modeling and vector control theory for permanent-magnet synchronous motor, design and control of brushless dc motors, and the driving circuit design for these motors. Finally, sensorless PM machine control techniques are introduced.

description.zh: 本課程介紹電腦科學中圖形識別的基本原理與相關技術，使學生了解各種圖形識別的分類方法，經由對分類問題的分析，瞭解如何將輸入樣本依不同特性加以分類，並熟悉圖形識別系統之相關議題如：分割、特徵擷取、分類、後處理、訓練、監督/非監督式學習、機器學習，進而了解分類問題，增進其解決實際圖形識別分類問題的能力。課程內容包括下列課題：圖形識別概論, Bayesian Decision Theory, Maximum-Likelihood, 非參數法學習, K-Nearest Neighbor Estimation, The Nearest-Neighbor Rule, Positive Boolean Function多分類器, Linear Discriminant Functions，高維資料分類, 分類正確率評估(Accuracy Assessments)及其他重要的應用，例如: 文件分析、生物辨識、影像監控、遙測影像分類、醫療診斷、資料探勘等概念，最後並透過相關論文的研讀及討論，了解近代圖形識別的最新發展趨勢。
description.en: The course includes: Introduction to Pattern Recognition, Bayesian Decision Theory, Maximum-Likelihood & Bayesian Parameter Estimation, Non-Parametric Classification - Density Estimation, K-Nearest Neighbor Estimation, The Nearest-Neighbor Rule, Multi-Classifier - Positive Boolean Function, Linear Discriminant Functions, Pattern Recognition of High Dimensional Data Sets, Pattern Recognition for Remote Sensing Images, Biometric Certification, Video Surveillance, Accuracy Assessments and Other Related Topics.

It is concerned that how reliable communication can be achieved and what is the capacity a channel can provide. Much attention will be focused on the newly developed technology, referred to as multiple-inputmultiple-output (MIMO) transmission.

description.zh: 本課程將有系統的介紹專業英文論文的寫作格式，以及文件編修的技巧，且用深入淺出的例子作為示範，並輔以實際寫作練習與錯誤訂正。學員學習研究論文組織寫作﹐包含修改本身論文結構之基本技巧﹐正確組織文章的各個片段﹐避免口語用字寫字的陋習﹐使所作之文章能掌握其涵意﹐亦即能更有效率的利用英文寫出科技論文之佳作。
description.en: The goal of English Technical Writing is to help students developing the writing skills through the manipulation of scientific and technical data. Students will learn a variety of rhetorical principles that guide the writing process, apply these principles to scientific and technical writing, and write papers in their own academic fields. Lectures on the writing principle, students' presentations on the reading sections and follow-up activities, pair and individual work on writing practice will be the major activities in the class.

In this course, we will take an interdisciplinary look at current research topics in machine learning covering Concept Learning, Decision Tree, Graphical Model, Neural Network, Bayesian Network, Instance-based Learning, and Support Vector Machine. Through the course, students can have the basic ideas and intuition behind modern machine learning methods.

syllabi.outline:

name.en: Circular Economy: theoretical approach and practical applications

description.zh: 循環經濟是一種與傳統線性經濟（開採-製造-丟棄）不同的產業經濟模式，循環經濟就像自然生態循環一樣，是封閉且循環的經濟系統，透過重新設計產品和商業模式，促進更好的能源與資源使用效率、消除廢棄物及避免污染自然環境。內容將包括發展及應用物質流分析及循環經濟的相關技術, 全球性的循環經濟議題及案例分析，不同領域的企業生態，及跨學科創造永續的解決辦法。
description.en: A circular economy is a regenerative system in which resource input and waste, emission, and energy leakage are minimised by slowing, closing, and narrowing material and energy loops. This can be achieved through long-lasting design, maintenance, repair, reuse, remanufacturing, refurbishing, and recycling. This is contrast to a linear economy which is a 'take, make, dispose' model of production. This course, further, contributes to the optimising systems rather than components, or the notion of ‘design for fit’. As a generic notion it draws from a number of more specific approaches including cradle to cradle, biomimicry, industrial ecology, and the 'blue economy. Additional benefit to students is learning of English language as medium of instruction is in English.

description.zh: (1)基本理論(2)光學薄膜設計之圖示法(3)分光鏡(4)高反射鏡(5)	截止濾光片(6)帶通濾光片(7)斜向入射薄膜
description.en: (1)Basic theory (2)Admittance diagrams for optical coating design(3)Beam splitter(4)High reflection coating(5)Edge filter(6)Band-pass filter(7)Tilted coatings

syllabi.outline:
(1)基本理論(2)光學薄膜設計之圖示法(3)分光鏡(4)高反射鏡(5)	截止濾光片(6)帶通濾光片(7)斜向入射薄膜

基本理論	 
1.單界面之反射係數(率)與透射係數(率)之計算。
2.探討單層膜各界面之穿透與反射情形。
3.多層膜之反射係數(率)與透射係數(率)之計算。
4.探討多層膜矩陣的一些特性。
5.非相干性之反射與透射之計算。                            

光學薄膜設計之圖示法         
1.利用向量法設計抗反射膜層以及一些膜層之設計。      
2.利用導納軌跡法得知其導納隨膜層厚度的變化有益設計各種不同特性之膜層。

分光鏡	
1.各種中性分光鏡之設計與應用。
2.雙色分光鏡之設計與應用。
3.偏振光分光鏡之設計與應用。

高反射鏡	
1.介紹常用的金屬膜。
2.金屬膜反射率提高及保護膜之設計。
3.利用全介電質四分之一膜堆設計高反射鏡。
4.全介電質膜高反射帶之拓寬設計。
5.探討膜層損耗對四分之一膜堆的影響。

截止濾光片	
1.非干涉型截止濾光片之設計。
2.介紹基本結構之對稱膜堆以及其光學成效進而設計干涉型截止濾光片。

帶止濾光片	
1.利用高低折射率膜堆法設計帶止濾光片。
2.利用折射率漸變膜及非均向膜法設計帶止濾光片。

帶通濾光片	
1.帶通濾光片之介紹。
2.寬帶濾光片與窄帶濾光片之設計。
3.利用對稱膜堆設計多腔窄帶濾光片並探討其吸收特性。
4.誘導透射濾光片之設計。

業界授課	
1.光學薄膜的製鍍方法與製鍍設備的介紹
2.各種光學薄膜之特性介紹與製鍍技術的改進。

name.en: Theoretical Research on Sustainable Planning and Design

description.zh:
永續規劃設計是格外需要跨學術領域訓練的過程，因此本課程將提供下列設計專業者必須學習的訓練：
1.	成長與浪費的觀念
2.	生態解法的設計
3.	永續文化與景觀的設計
4.	以設計體現與強化價值的規劃
5.	複合化社會系統的設計
6.	社區營造與健康的設計
7.	省能、輕量、減廢的設計
8.	生產力、土地與交通效能
9.	營建與環境法規
10.	規劃、設計與方案評估
description.en:
Sustainable planning and design is an exceptionally transdisciplinary process. Therefore, This course will provide the following trainings which design professionals must learned:
1.	The concepts of growth and waste
2.	Designing for eco-solutions
3.	Permaculture and landscape design
4.	Values embodied in and reinforces by design
5.	Design within complex social systems
6.	Design for community building and health
7.	Design with less energy, materials and waste
8.	Productivity, land and transport efficiency
9.	Construction and environmental regulation
10.	Planning, design and project assessment

description.zh: 本課程分為兩部分：（1）英文文法觀念的溫故知新，並引導學生將正確的文法觀念運用在閱讀與寫作上，學生可加強基本句型練習、句子改正及句型修正。相關討論包括直述句、引述句、句型變化與修飾;（2）英語修辭法：聽講溝通的有效原理原則。課堂討論主題包括：指稱、一致、倒裝等修辭觀念。修習本課後，學生對出現在相同邏輯意義語境中， 利用不同表達方式以凸顯各種語意的方式與內涵，當有更進一步的體認。
description.en: This course is divided into two parts: (a) The first part is designed for the students to  familiarize themselves with English grammatical framework in relation to reading and writing. A review of grammatical ideas at high level is reinforced by correcting sentence errors, and revising awkward usage of words or sentence structures. The main subjects include English sentence structures, verbal usages, conjunctions, and sequences. Related topics for class discussion cover direct and indirect speech, sentence transformation and modification of sentences; (b) The second half of the course focuses on English rhetoric--principles of effective written and spoken communication. Topics for class discussion include reference, coherence, reverse structures and some related rhetorical concepts. It is hoped that the students will know better the significance brought about by the variations of different expressions that occur in the similar linguistic contexts.

syllabi.outline: This course aims (1) to familiarize students with English grammatical framework in relation to reading and writing, and (2) to develop students’ rhetorical awareness. A review of grammatical ideas at the advanced level is reinforced by correcting sentence errors and revising awkward usage of words or sentence structures as well as by doing lively grammar practice exercises. The main topics covered include various parts of speech, tense, clauses, reporting, conjunction, punctuation, and the relationship between grammar and context.

description.zh: 本課程利用新聞教材加強英語字彙能力及聽力技巧, 	內容採用電台、報紙、電視的時事、深度報導和全球議題以增強學生英語知識。同時, 學生亦可獲得各種有用的聽力技巧以加強英語聽力。
description.en: This course is designed to increase vocabulary power and develop listening skills in English through up-to-date news. Current events, in-depth reports as well as global issues from radio, newspapers and T.V are provided to enrich the student's English knowledge. Effective listening skills are reinforced to enhance the student's listening comprehension.

syllabi.outline: This course aims to engage students in understanding current issues and events taking place in the world that are redefining our global reality and restructuring the world order. A greater goal of such studies of global issues and activities is to urge students to participate in the dialogues and actions to change and to make better of the world. The course content centers on listening, reading, discussing and debating on selected reports and news to uphold all that matters for the aforementioned pursuits.

description.zh: 本課程強調全方位的國際商用英語溝通。現今各領域上之商業活動多以英語進行，因此本課程注重發展學生以英語文進行流暢之溝通的關鍵能力，特別強調商業組織內外部常見的正式溝通之形式，包括商用英語寫作、簡報與會議技巧。課時也納入非正式溝通技巧，指導學生學習應對職場情境，因應相關之溝通需求。
description.en: This current course emphasizes a holistic view of business communication in a global context.  Given that business communication across from fields of business activities is now made possible by the English language, the course thus aims to develop the ability to use critical skills essential to successful communication in English, with particular emphases on forms of formal communications that are highly visible within and outside business organizations, including writing of business correspondence and reports, presentations and meetings. Informal communication skills are also incorporated to address workplace situations to identify the relevant communication needs.

description.zh: 本課程旨在讓學生具備國際新聞編譯之相關知識，並透過實務演練培養新聞編譯之能力。課程內容主要含括(一)國際新聞編譯之介紹（如新聞編譯現況、製作流程、專業條件與譯者相關知能）；（二）新聞編譯之策略與技巧（如刪除、重組、整合新聞訊息）；（三）新聞編譯之模擬與實務練習。
description.en: This course aims to help students build up the basic knowledge of news trans-editing and develop students’ trans-editing skills through practical training. The course covers the following areas: (1) an introduction to news trans-editing (e.g. the current state of the news trans-editing field, the production workflow, professional qualifications and personal traits of news translators); (2) strategies and skills of news trans-editing (e.g. the strategies of deletion, restructuring, abridgement and synthesis); (3) practical training of news trans-editing in a simulated or real environment.

syllabi.outline:
一、教學目標（Teaching Objectives）
本課程旨在讓學生具備國際新聞編譯之相關知識，並透過實務演練培養新聞編譯之能力。課程內容主要含括(一)國際新聞編譯之介紹（如新聞編譯現況、製作流程、專業條件與譯者相關知能）；（二）新聞編譯之策略與技巧（如刪除、重組、整合新聞訊息）；（三）新聞編譯之模擬與實務練習。
本課程提供閱讀新聞英語的練習機會，藉著閱讀報紙、雜誌英文新聞報導、評論、專欄、社論等，了解其中新聞字彙、文體，訓練閱讀新聞。
促使學生透過媒體識讀教學過程、瞭解新聞編採實務、國際現勢、配合原本的英文能力利基，強化國際觀，落實並活用英文。
本課程重要目標並包含著重加強應用英文系學生對國際新聞編譯實務的能力，培養學生敏銳的觀察力及組織力、並訓練學生對國際時事的新聞陳述與課堂討論，達到不同觀點的看法。有系統引導學生閱讀國際新聞，述說新國際聞編譯之寫作方式與要點，以及編譯技巧，培養未來可能於新聞職場服務的專業能力。

description.zh:
本課程的目的在介紹句子結構的研究，引導學生對語法形式有更深層的瞭解，包含各種描述性或理論性的分析方法。學生可透過這門課獲得以下的訓練：
一、熟悉句法學的核心概念，如合法度、語法範疇（如名詞、動詞、副詞、介詞）、語法關係（如主語、賓語、狀語）、詞組結構（如中心語、補述語、指示語）、語意角色（如主事、受事，歷事）、移位運作（如疑問、被動）。
二、培養分析英語基本句型的能力，如限定與非限定子句、簡單、並列與複合句式、主動與被動語態、直述、祈使、疑問與感嘆句型，以及分屬各類語法範疇的附屬子句（如名詞子句、形容詞子句、副詞子句）。
三、以「衍生理論」的架構為主軸，對現代句法理論以及句法分析的基本原則建立初步的認識。
四、透過實際語料的解析，應用上述的知識與能力。
description.en:

1. 	become familiar with the core concepts of syntax, such as grammaticality, grammatical categories (e.g. nouns, verbs, adverbs, and prepositions), grammatical relations (e.g. subjects, objects, and adjuncts), constituent structures (e.g. heads, complements, and specifies), semantic roles (e.g. agent, themes, and experiencers), and movement operations (e.g. interrogation and passivization).
2.	developed an ability to analyze the primary sentence structures of English, such as finite and non-finite clauses, simple, compound, and complex sentences, active and passive voices, declarative, imperative, interrogative, and exclamative sentence types, and embedded clauses belonging to distinct grammatical cat

description.en: This course is designed to enable students to develop the principles and skills necessary for public speaking. Included will be guidelines for giving a speech and displaying body language, and practices for prepared speech and impromptu speech.

syllabi.outline:
Course Title:		Public Speaking and Debates
Credit Hours:		2
Instructor’s Name:	Dr. Yun-Hua Yang
Contact E-Mail:	yhyang@ntut.edu.tw
Office: 	        General Education Building Rm.805 / Extension: 3941
Term Offered:		Fall, 2024
Course Description: 	This course aims to establish the foundation for English-major students to deliver public speeches in English. Students learn to select topics, collect essential information, analyze the audience, organize materials, improve delivery skills, distinguish different types of speeches, and further to evaluate their own and others’ speeches. Each student is expected to deliver at least 3-4 individual speeches, and 2-3 debates. Speech topics will be discussed and assigned to students. Any modifications of the speech topics will have to be approved by the instructor. All student speech sessions must be videotaped.(see note 1) 
Course Requirements: 	Students’ responsibilities in this class include:
(1)	Attending class regularly and to arrive on time: 
(2)	Delivering speeches as scheduled: 
i.	Students who are scheduled to give an in-class speech (for official grading) need to record a pre-speech on the scheduled day. (see note 2)
ii.	Make-up speech will be only allowed when the failure to perform is due to an officially excused absence or incidents under extreme circumstances
iii.	The ideal time duration for each speech is 4 to 6 minutes. The minimum length of speech time is 3 minutes, and the maximum 6. Violation of the time limit (less than 3 and more than 6) constitutes a failure w/o points awarded. The time length for debates will vary due to the different formats employed.
iv.	It is essential to comply with the prescriptive requirements for each speech. Failure to follow will result in disqualification to complete the speech 
(3)	Submitting to the instructor a speech file with inclusion of the outlined speech as well as the full-length speech script (with citation and references), the speech evaluation sheet, the self-evaluating commentaries of both the current and previous speeches, and also blank A-4 size lined sheets for notes and feedbacks(see Appendix 1 & 2) when presenting the speech. Students who do not have the file ready and fail to comply with the outline format requirements (sampled and specified below_Appendix 3) forfeit the right to deliver the speech and hence receive zero points.  
(4)	Student speakers are also required to display their outline slide(s) during the speech. 
(5)	Evaluating one’s own speech (by the self-evaluation guideline): Student speakers are required to watch their own videotaped speeches (both pre-speech and in-class speech) observe their own speeches, and compile all speech and debate evaluation for submission. Students are strongly advised to use their own videotaping devices for both the pre and in-class speeches. Post-class recordings will be arranged and produced in the Lab, if necessary. A complete portfolio (preferably on compact disc) including all recordings is required for submission at the semester end.

description.zh: 本課程介紹研究方法和論文寫作知識，期能培養學生獨立研究和撰寫學術報告、論文的基本能力。主要分為三部份：（一）研究內涵與步驟,（二）主要的研究方法,（三）如何撰寫英文論文及報告。涵蓋主題包括：運用圖書館資源選擇研究主題、研究計劃的撰寫、問卷調查法、訪問法、觀察法、田野工作研究方法、文獻資料分析法（內容分析法）、個案研究法、相關研究法、實驗法、文學研究法，研究報告論文格式與寫作要領，如何撰寫文獻探討，參考書目寫法等。
description.en: This course aims at providing students with the fundamental knowledge and competence that they will need in doing research and writing research papers.  Its main purpose is to familiarize students with methods, procedures, and techniques that are applicable to quantitative and qualitative research as well as to improve their ability to write research papers.  The main topics for instruction include: the research process; major research methods; and the structure of a research paper.  The research methods primarily studied include the experimental method, descriptive research, ethnography, case study, observation, survey research (questionnaire and interviews), content analysis/documentary analysis, and critical approaches to literature.

本課程介紹研究方法和論文寫作知識，期能培養學生獨立研究和撰寫學術報告、論文的基本能力。主要分為三部份：（一）研究內涵與步驟,（二）主要的研究方法,（三）如何撰寫英文論文及報告。涵蓋主題包括：運用圖書館資源選擇研究主題、研究計劃的撰寫、問卷調查法、訪問法、觀察法、田野工作研究方法、文獻資料分析法（內容分析法）、個案研究法、相關研究法、實驗法、文學研究法，研究報告論文格式與寫作要領，如何撰寫文獻探討，參考書目寫法等。
This course is primarily designed for students interested in working on a senior project in literature, film, popular culture, or cultural studies, but most of the material can be generally applied, so students who are uncertain whether their final project will be in literature/cultural studies or linguistics can benefit from the course. It aims at providing students with the fundamental knowledge and competence that they will need in doing research and writing research papers. The main topics for instruction include the research process, major research methods, approaches to literary and cultural studies criticism, and the structure of a research paper. Students will learn how to come up with a high-quality research question, best practices for evaluating source material, how to make use of the electronic and hard-copy sources that are available (including subscription and open-access sources), AI uses and pitfalls, and how to carry out a long-term research project, with the goal of avoiding the pitfalls that first-time research project students and writers may fall into. Students will also learn the circumstances under which MLA style is the best style to use, to use it correctly, and to distinguish it from APA style. This course is designed for English majors: while students from other disciplines may sign up, they must be prepared to do assignments designed for English majors preparing for their senior projects and to meet the same expectations.

description.en: Drawing upon modern literary criticism and cultural theory, this course aims to examine the difference between works of literature and the distinctive medium of the cinema. syllabi.outline:
本課程以當代文學批評和文化理論為基礎，探討小說與戲劇改編成電影的過程中，文字轉化成視覺意象之間的差異，期能提升多元化的思辯及表達能力。
Drawing upon modern literary criticism and cultural theory, this course aims to examine the difference between works of literature and the distinctive medium of the cinema. Students will be offered a variety of discussion which stimulates the kinds of critical thinking that lead to a better understanding of the process of transposition from literature to film.

In this course, we will watch films and film clips that approach the idea of literary adaptation from a variety of ways. By reading excerpts of the literature the film was based on, we will discuss the variety of ways in which adaption may be done and students will judge the extent to which the film is successful as film and the extent to which the film is successful as adaptation. 

For the final project, students may choose to write a formal film analysis or to do a group or individual creative project in which they make a short film adaptation (under ten minutes) or film trailer (i.e. something akin to the Doctor Faustus trailer we watched in the literature class--with a different text chosen—approximately three minutes but extremely well edited). The creative project is my preference. Students will introduce their film and/or trailer and explain their rationale and adaptation strategies. I will try to keep the workload as equal as possible for the two project options—thus, people working on the film analysis will have separate library and peer review assignments on the days that filmmakers are filming/editing. 

Why should you take this course? 
•	Many of you may be working with films, literature, or film adaptation for your senior projects. Some of the secondary sources we are reading will be quite helpful to you. 
•	The course will help you learn more about filming and editing and will allow you to explore your creative side.
•	You will (hopefully) feel accomplished when you complete your project and show it to your classmates. If you’re pleased with the product, the short film can be a line on your resume. 
•	You’ll read some great selections of literature and/or view interesting literary adaptations. This is the first time I’ve ever had the opportunity to teach the play Cyrano de Bergerac, which I love, and I hope you will love it too. (I have mixed feelings about the 2021 film, but I think it’s worth viewing.) The Two Towers is one of my favorite texts to teach, and, as Tolkien’s work comes back into the popular culture limelight with the Rings of Power series, it’s worthwhile to revisit some of the adaptations.) Shakespeare adaptations are always worth viewing, and the two we are watching are not usually taught in the Taipei Tech Shakespeare class. Jane Austen’s cultural afterlives show an interesting intersection between high and popular culture. It’s worthwhile to consider the peculiar perils of attempting to adapt a mystery on film with Agatha Christie’s Murder on the Orient Express, and Oh Brother Where Art Thou? is an extremely interesting transformation of Homer’s Odyssey, useful for any budding filmmaker or critic to see.

description.en: This course builds on Introduction to Chinese-English Interpreting and equips students with skills in business interpreting in both directions. Students continue with practical exercises aimed at reinforcing note-taking skills. The nature and characteristics of business interpreting are introduced. More emphasis is placed upon learning to zero in on the main idea under heavy time pressure and re-activate passive memories with the aid of note-taking. Students also learn essential SI strategies. The course seeks to acquaint students with the cognitive dimensions and extra-linguistic variables with regard to business interpreting.

description.zh: 英語語用學的研究關乎了解英語在各種情境下的使用。本課程首先回顧一些最常用於理解「言外之音」的重要觀念，例如「暗示」、「預設」、及「言談行為」。下個階段則是介紹一些重要語用學的議題，例如「禮貌理論」、「修辭語」、「言語幽默」、和「機構性談話」，並概述用於研究這些語用學議題的一些方法，包含「會話分析」、「言談分析」、甚或「批判性言談分析」。本課程旨在透過充足的英文例子來提升學生的語用學意識，從而鼓勵他們發揮語用學的知識來應對各種(英文)語言的實務操作。
description.en: The study of English pragmatics is about understanding the use of English in different types of context. The course begins by revisiting the ideas most commonly embraced to understand meaning beyond the linguistic code (e.g. implicature, presupposition, speech act). The next step is an overview of the key issues in pragmatics (e.g. politeness theory, figure of speech, verbal humor, institutional talk) as well as the various approaches to these issues (e.g. conversation analysis, discourse analysis, and critical discourse analysis). This course aims to raise students’ pragmatic awareness with ample English examples, and encourage them to apply pragmatic knowledge in various aspects of (English) language practices.

description.en: This course will acquaint students with fundamental concepts and principles of professional translation. Students will acquire a solid grounding in a range of ideas within translation studies (e.g. linguistic and functionalist approaches, discourse and register analysis, translation norms, cultural turn, sociology of translation, and translation technologies) and apply the theoretical knowledge to various English and Chinese translation activities. This course will also enable students to critically discuss the basic postulates of translation theories and use them in text analysis, the identification of translation problems, and the formulation of suitable strategies and techniques.

description.zh: 西方文化的交流是建立在故事上的。即使這些故事相當久遠，但每個人卻都非常熟悉，又或者是因為這些故事相當久遠，所以每個人都非常熟悉。本課程將探討近代主要西方作家—喬瑟及莎士比亞—作品中的核心主題及文化的意象。研讀這些近代西方主要作家的作品是發展西方文學素養及思想的基石，同時，也為任何概括了以西方文化為主體的研究提供了不可或缺的背景知識。
description.en: Conversation in Western culture is built on stories. Everybody knows the stories even though the stories are very old, or rather everybody knows them because they are very old stories. This course introduces students to some of the stories that have been most influential in the English-speaking world. Knowing these stories provides essential background knowledge for understanding Western culture in general.

description.zh: 應用語言學屬於邊緣交叉學科，與其他學科如語言學、心理學、教育學、人類學與社會學之間存在密切的關係。本課程著重在介紹第二語言與外語習得、第二語言與外語教學法、言談分析與社會語用學及社會文化學理論的研究，並探討這些領域與語言教學與學習之間的關連。本課程涵蓋各種不同觀點的理論與應用，回顧方法論的演進歷史，尤其強調現今廣受認同的方法論。
description.en: Applied linguistics is a large interdisciplinary field of study related to a range of academic fields, including linguistics, psychology, education, anthropology, and sociology. This course focuses primarily on research in the areas of second/foreign language acquisition, second/foreign language pedagogy, discourse analysis, and sociopragmatic and sociocultural theory, as well as their relevance to language teaching and learning. We will cover theories and applications from a variety of perspectives, tracing the history of methodologies with special emphasis on those currently in widespread use.

name.zh: 鐵道號誌與行車控制系統
name.en: Railway Signal and Traffic Control System

description.zh: 本課程為本校「智慧鐵道學程」的選修課程。課程開授之目標，是希望藉由課堂講授與實際場域參訪的方式，使修課學生能夠瞭解鐵道號誌系統的內涵。號誌系統是列車運行的控制系統。其功用必需兼顧整個鐵道運輸系統的「安全」、「迅速」、與「經濟」。由於號誌系統本身屬於跨管理、通訊與控制等專業領域的技術，因此，本課程是以同時段合院授課的方式、針對選讀學程之學生、邀請鐵道號誌系統專家、以業師的身份共同參與授課。本課程會要求修課同學於期末報告時，針對管理、通訊與自動控制等三部分提出號誌系統規劃與評估報告，並邀請鐵道號誌系統專家擔任評審。
description.en: This course is one of the optional courses for the Intelligent Railway Curriculum. The goal of this course is, via both in-class lecturing and field-trip visiting, to have participant students realize the contents of Railway Signal System. The signal system is the control system of train operation. To give consideration to safety, rapidness and economy of entire railway transportation system, this system will be required. Since the signal system is the technology including management, communication and automatic control, this course is a joint-lecture among departments inside our college with synchronized class hours. The industrial instructors for the participant students include experts on railway signal system from relevant fields in intelligent rail industry. In the student reports, they will demonstrate the railway signal system planning and evaluation report for the management, communication and automatic control.

name.zh: 全端網頁軟體系統實作

description.zh: 伴隨全球資訊網(Web)普及應用，可讓不同裝置、系統運行相同網路服務的網頁平台儼然成為當下資訊系統的主要潮流，過去網頁系統的建構可區分成1.網頁前端(Front-end)：主負責使用者看見的瀏覽器端，以及2.網頁後端(Back-end)：主負責運算、儲存資源的伺服器端，不同面向的軟體人才必須熟悉不同軟體實作技巧，然而，面臨物聯網(Internet of Things)、第5代行動通訊(5G)的挑戰，產業需要能夠同時精通前端與後端之軟體實作技術，並進一步延伸支援外部系統整合與介接的全端(Full Stack)軟體人才，本課程主旨為教授網頁前端、後端軟體實作技巧，並結合新一代網路協定，以及外部感測裝置，建構出全方位之網頁系統軟體。
description.en: With the growth of World Wide Web, the web platform can let different devices and systems operate the same network service. Thus, the web platform has become the key foundation of modern software implementation. In the past, it can be divided into (1) front-end, which represents the user-side browser, and (2) back-end, which represents the server of data processing and storage. Programmers need to learn different front-end or back-end techniques. However, regarding 5G and Internet of Things, industries need full-stack software programmers. The goal of this course is to teach the front-end and back-end software implementation. Furthermore, the course would introduce how to integrate new network protocols and connect embedded sensors. After learning in this course, students are expected to implement one comprehensive web software system.

syllabi.outline:
伴隨全球資訊網(Web)普及應用，可讓不同裝置、系統運行相同網路服務的網頁平台儼然成為當下資訊系統的主要潮流，過去網頁系統的建構可區分成1.網頁前端(Front-end)：主負責使用者看見的瀏覽器端，以及2.網頁後端(Back-end)：主負責運算、儲存資源的伺服器端，不同面向的軟體人才必須熟悉不同軟體實作技巧，然而，面臨物聯網(Internet of Things)、第5代行動通訊(5G)的挑戰，產業需要能夠同時精通前端與後端之軟體實作技術，並進一步延伸支援外部系統整合與介接的全端(Full Stack)軟體人才，本課程主旨為教授網頁前端、後端軟體實作技巧，並結合新一代網路協定，以及外部感測裝置，建構出全方位之網頁系統軟體。

1.	修課學生可從本課程學習Web前端(Front-end)軟體實作。
2.	修課學生可從本課程學習Web後端(Back-end)軟體實作。
3.	修課學生可從本課程學習新世代Web傳輸協定實作。

5. Smart grid standards
6. Smart grid control, communication and protection
7. Electrical components in smart grid
8. Power system analysis in smart grid

syllabi.outline:
This course aims to introduce the fundamental concepts and technologies of smart grids, covering the structure, functions, and applications of smart grids in modern power systems. Students will learn about smart meters, renewable energy integration, smart grid standards, and monitoring systems, among other core topics. Through case studies, students will deepen their understanding of smart grids.

description.zh:
本課程主要在教導學生深入探討最新的室內環境議題與人體健康間的關係，使學生具備創造健康室內環境的相關知識及操作能力，主要授課要點如下：
1.以單一類型的建築室內環境為探討主題；
2.探討環境影響人體健康之最新研究議題；
3.進行跨領域合作提出共同改善之策略及方法；
4.學習各項環境量測儀器之原理、操作與判讀能力；
5.具備診斷與改善特殊室內環境議題之專業知識及操作能力。
description.en:
In this course students are going to be taught how to discuss the relationship between indoor environment quality and human healthy in order to promote students' recognition and abilities to create healthy indoor environment.
Contents :
1. The indoor environment of single type of building.
2. The relationship between the artificial environment and human health.
3. Providing some strategies and methods to improve indoor environment quality through cooperating with other science field.
4. Learning how to use instruments to evaluate indoor environment quality.
5. Learning how to diagnose and improve the special topics of indoor environment quality.

syllabi.outline:
為追求「永續發展與人本健康」之目的，使既有與新建的居住環境，配合我國「室內空氣品質管理法」規範下運作，提昇民眾居住環境健康品質效益，針對病態建築之環境問題，其涵蓋醫療、法律、建築、化學、生物等領域，綜合診斷以進行改善。
本課程為第二階段之系列課程，其內容包括：一、疫學：探討關於病態建築症候群的因素與特定外來的致病物質與疫之關聯。二、家政事務：探討生活習慣、飲食生活的變化對環境、人體健康之影響。三、醫療領域：探討病態建築症候群與化學物質過敏症的差異與因應對策。四、日常領域：探討日常生活用品、居住行為對環境、人體健康之影響。

This course contains the properties of signals, systems, LTI systems, and basis linear transforms. This is a basic course in the field of communication and control.
The course introduces the properties of signals and systems, and is a fundamental course for those who are interested in communications, signal processing, control systems, and electronic circuits. The student will learn about the basic concepts of continuous-time and discrete-time signal processing. The covered topics are:

1. Signals and systems
2. Linear time-invariant systems
3. Fourier series representation of periodic signals
4. The continuous-time Fourier transform
5. The discrete-time Fourier transform
6. Sampling
7. Time and frequency characterization of signals and systems

syllabi.outline:
什麼是人體結構和功能？
人體結構與功能是一門非必修主要課程，旨在探索人體形式和功能之間的基本關係。解剖學和生理學是生命科學中兩個最基本的術語和研究領域。解剖學是指身體的內部和外部結構及其物理關係，而生理學是指研究這些結構的功能。本課程旨在定義瞭解剖學和生理學，並解釋了為什麼它們對生物醫學工程很重要。主要器官系統的解剖學和生理學將在正常和疾病狀態的背景下進行研究。學生將學習關鍵的生物過程，如中心教條，膜擴散和運輸，細胞信號傳導，氣體交換，血流，營養吸收，血液pH平衡以及動作電位的產生和傳播。然後，學生將應用這些知識來瞭解器官如何對維持體內平衡的各種輸入做出反應。課程將納入實踐演示，為課程中提供的資訊提供實用框架：
1.根據位置，功能，關鍵成分和解剖命名法確定主要的人體系統。  
2.展示對代謝功能和每個主要器官系統的生理控制的理解。
3.認識並綜合體內平衡的原理，即主要器官系統在生理上如何相互關聯以維持人類健康。

在學期階段，學生將廣泛瞭解身體系統如何在細胞，組織和器官系統水平上發揮作用，並能夠將簡單的生理過程聯繫起來，以更好地了解社會中高度流行的疾病和對生物醫學工程重要實用框架。

人體結構和功能的課程目標：
1.人體是一個實用的結構，它由四種主要類型的數十億個較小的結構組成：細胞，組織，器官和系統。
2.器官是幾種不同種類的組織，如此排列，以至於它們可以一起執行特殊功能。
3.系統是一個由不同數量和種類的器官組成的組織，它們如此排列，以至於它們可以一起為身體執行複雜的功能。
4.十個主要系統包括骨骼，肌肉，神經，內分泌，心血管，淋巴，呼吸，消化，泌尿和生殖系統。
5.身體功能是身體系統的生理或心理功能。身體的生存取決於身體維持或恢復其內部環境的體內平衡，這是一種相對恆定的狀態。
6.人類的生命過程包括組織、新陳代謝、反應性、運動、繁殖、生長、分化、呼吸、消化和排泄。所有這些過程在微調的平衡中協同工作，以維護個人的健康和維持生活。 
7.生命依賴於環境中的某些物理因素，包括水，氧氣，營養物質，熱量和壓力。

人體結構和功能課程的學習評估：
基於出勤以及課堂互動，每周提供一個帶回家的研究案例以突出所涵蓋系統的人體解剖學和生理學，每周測驗以及一個期中和期末測驗。  

人體的結構和功能的課程實踐體驗： 
如果人體解剖學和生理學的想法看起來很可怕，請不要擔心。本課程將通過以平易近人且相關的格式涵蓋這些主題來減輕您可能有的任何恐懼。本課程將使您對人體所有複雜的功能和系統如何協同工作更加自信，並將您從解剖學和生理學方面學到的知識與您已經瞭解的身體聯繫起來。將此視為人體使用者指南。有些人可能會說你不能沒有它！

本課程還將涵蓋身體的主要系統，並解釋它們是如何工作的，為什麼它們有時不起作用。此外，它還將檢查不同的疾病和紊亂，醫學的最新進展以及照顧身體的方法。課程包括現實生活中的例子和互動練習，讓你批判性地思考自己的經歷，並與課程建立聯繫。在整個課程中都使用全面綜合知識和理解，為您提供必要的學習材料，以便在您繼續接受教育或職業生涯時保留本課程及以後的內容。在本課程結束時，你將對人體的奇妙複雜性有更大的欣賞和理解。

We will cover many different fields including image classification, object detection, natural language processing, reinforcement learning and generative adversarial networks.

name.zh: 深度學習與類神經網路

description.zh:
深度學習探討如何能利用深層類神經網路，由觀測到的資料中自我學習，自我進化，而能有效進行預測，分類，偵測，辨認與決策，以建立人工智慧。
本課程為進階的機器學習課程，將會花相當多的時間深入探討各種不同的訓練方法不同結構的類神經網路。包括深層類神經網路，卷積類神經網路，遞迴類神經網路等等網路架構，與監督式學習，非監督式學習，強化式學習，對抗式學習等等訓練方法。
本課程並會要求學生實現各種不同類型的類神經網路，將其著應用在解決多種人本人工智慧服務設計問題。包時間序列預測，物體偵測與辨認，語音訊號處理、影像訊號處理、自然語言處理，音訊訊號處理等多種人本資訊處理。
description.en:
Deep learning is a branch of artificial intelligence that focuses on how to use deep neural networks to self-learn and self-evolve from observed data, as well as to effectively predict, classify, detect patterns and make decisions.

This course is an advanced machine learning course that delves into different neural network structures and training methods. Students will be asked to implement different neural networks to solve various human-centered artificial intelligent service design problems (e.g., time series prediction, object detection, image recognition, speech signal processing, video signal processing, natural language processing, audio signal processing, etc.).

syllabi.outline: 課程主要為介紹機器學習概念和基本原理，學習DNN/CNN/LSTM/transformer的神經網路架構和其他機器學習方法。

description.zh: 本課程為線性代數的深化與廣化。以理論的深化而言，本課程由高斯消去法談起，解釋四個向量空間，進而說明矩陣的正交性與投影。接著，本課程闡述行列式、特徵值與特徵向量、矩陣的乘冪與指數、頻譜分解，最終收尾於奇異值分解，以此定理統整這一學期的所有內容。以應用的廣化而言，本課程在上述理論說明之外，還會特別介紹科學、工程的應用實例，例如迴歸分析、線性規劃、圖論與網路、主成份分析。

syllabi.outline: This course is the deepening and broadening of linear algebra. In terms of deepening the theory, this course starts with the Gaussian elimination method, explaining the four vector spaces. Next, it explains the orthogonality and projection of matrices. In addition, this course explains the determinants, eigenvalues and eigenvectors, powers and exponents of matrices, and spectral decomposition, finally concluding with singular value decomposition, which is the theorem that unifies all the contents in this semester. In terms of broadening applications, this course introduces scientific and engineering applications, such as regression analysis, linear programming, graph theory and networks, and principal component analysis.

https://line.me/ti/g2/f94Z0tPo2ttOV2fJ5hIDjI3-sfrpjDtAonotuw?utm_source=invitation&utm_medium=link_copy&utm_campaign=default
=============================================================
In this course, you will embark on a journey to master fundamental programming concepts essential for solving engineering problems. We will cover key topics such as loops, conditional statements, input/output operations, and arrays, while applying these concepts to practical engineering scenarios. You’ll learn how to formulate and implement algorithms tailored to specific tasks, enhancing your problem-solving skills. Additionally, we will explore the use of Generative AI tools like ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, and Replit to assist in coding and algorithm development. You'll gain hands-on experience in using these tools to guide and refine your programming efforts, ensuring that you can effectively justify and apply the information they provide. This course is designed to build your programming proficiency and prepare you for advanced challenges in chemical engineering.
syllabi.schedule:
Part I: Theory and Tools (2-3 weeks)
1. Introduction to Programming and GenAI Tools: Overview of the importance of programming in engineering, introduction to Generative AI tools like ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, and Replit, and their role in coding. Discussing the choice of programming languages and fundamental programming concepts.
2. Development Environment: Introduction to the Linux platform, vim editor, compilers, interpreters, and data visualization tools such as gnuplot. Focus on data collection, analysis, and visualization techniques.
Part II: Fundamentals of Programming (7 weeks)
1. Input and Output: Techniques for reading from and writing to different data sources.
2. Variables and Declaration: Understanding data types, variable declaration, and scope.
3. Mathematical Functions: Utilizing built-in math functions for engineering calculations.
4. Control Structures: Implementing loops (do loops) and conditional statements (if statements) for flow control.
5. Arrays and Data Handling: Managing and manipulating arrays for efficient data storage and retrieval.
6. Subroutines and Modules: Creating reusable code with subroutines and modules; introduction to random number generation.
Part III: Algorithm Development (4-6 weeks)
1. Data Sorting: Techniques and algorithms for sorting data effectively.
2. Statistical Analysis: Implementing algorithms for statistical computations and data interpretation.
3. Probability and Histograms: Coding solutions for probability calculations and histogram generation.
4. Regression Analysis: Developing algorithms for regression analysis to model and predict data trends.

description.zh: 本課程將作為大一學生入學後第一門程式語言奠基課程，旨在提供學生們了解程式設計的基礎，並探索其與人工智慧的關聯。除了傳授基本的程式設計概念外，我們還將探討人工智慧在程式設計中的應用與意義。課程內容將包括電腦運作概念、程式設計原則、分支敘述、迴圈敘述、輸出輸入敘述、陣列處理、字元處理以及子程式等關鍵課題。同時，我們將特別強調人工智慧對於程式設計的重要性，以及它如何影響我們如何思考、解決問題和開發軟體。透過本課程的學習，學生們將能夠建立堅實的程式設計基礎，並了解人工智慧在這個領域中的關鍵作用。
description.en: This course serves as the first foundational programming language course for first-year students, aiming to provide them with a comprehensive understanding of the basics of programming and explore its relationship with artificial intelligence. In addition to imparting fundamental programming concepts, we will delve into the applications and significance of artificial intelligence in programming. The course will cover key topics such as computer operation concepts, programming principles, conditional statements, loop statements, input/output statements, array processing, character processing, and subroutines. Simultaneously, we will emphasize artificial intelligence's importance in programming and how it influences our thinking, problem-solving approaches, and software development. Through this course, students can establish a solid foundation in programming and grasp the pivotal role of artificial intelligence in this field.

description.zh: 有關建築歷史、理論、批評、構造、營建管理等相關主題討論。
description.en: A theme topic discussion on the field of architecture history, theory, criticism, structure, construction and management, etc.

syllabi.outline:
本課程主要以對於當代建築具有啟發性和創新性的建築經典著作 (或文學、哲學) 為範圍，透過修課者的精讀、研討交流、對話，以窺探形塑當代建築的重要觀念與內涵，結合與之相對應的建築作品進行作品的閱讀與詮釋。

        本課程希望訓練建築研究者理解建築學的物質和非物質面兩者係互為一體，培養研究生進一步的建築抽象性思考和分析能力，並期望研究生藉此拓展建築觀念。

        課程非以授課方式進行，而由修課者每周進行指定或非指定的閱讀，於上課時間進行閱讀報告與心得之討論，授課老師進行導讀，並就討論內容提出分析比較與歸納。
syllabi.schedule:
PART ONE       建築史論
PART TWO      名作與建築師之設計理論與哲學
PART THREE   地景與環境藝術 
PART FOUR     從理論到實務

This is to strengthen the ability of applying the knowledge of architectural histories to analyzing in depth the internal of the architectural works. Class will be carried on by seminar. Student needs to study a piece of architectural work which should be approved by the lecturer. The study and analysis of the piece of work will be then conducted under the lecturer's instruction.

name.zh: 基礎程式設計與人工智慧入門實作
name.en: Fundamental Programming and Introduction to Practical Artificial Intelligence

description.zh: 本課程為非資訊科系的程式設計入門課程，期能讓學生瞭解運算思維概念，並對資訊程式運作與設計方式有初步掌握。課程將以Python語言為實作演練工具，透過實際規劃、編寫、除錯與測試等階段，逐步培養學生基本程式設計能力。課程也將規劃人工智慧(AI)入門概念與基本做法，並由學生實際動手完成AI應用於文化發展領域議題的專題作品，讓學生能體會AI新科技對產業發展的現況，並思考面對未來AI新時代的準備方向。
description.en: This course is an introductory programming course for non-computer science majors, aiming to facilitate students understand the concept of computational thinking and gain a preliminary grasp of information program operation and design methods. The course will employ Python as the implementation and practice tool, gradually cultivating students' basic programming skills through practical planning, coding, debugging, and testing stages. Furthermore, the course will introduce the concepts and basic practices of Artificial Intelligence (AI). Students will have hands-on experience completing a project applying AI to cultural development issues. This allows students to appreciate the status of AI technology in industry and contemplate the preparation directions for the upcoming AI era.

name.zh: 文化研究與跨文化溝通

description.zh: 文化研究以文學，社會批評，通俗文化，人類學、科學、女性主義和種族批評等觀點，對文化現象做深入的觀察、思考、及批判。本課程著重應用文化研究之豐碩成果，啟發學生認識文化問題，並培養其觀察，思考，及批判能力。不僅能因之促成社會進步，更重要的是能藉由對本國及異國文化差異及價值觀的深入瞭解，將知識應用在跨文化溝通上，協助本國企業成功地國際化。
description.en: Cultural studies is emerging as one of the most inspiring and exciting fields in and out of the academy.  Drawing its energies from literary and social criticism, popular culture, anthropology and the sciences, feminism and critiques of race, cultural studies involves an infinite number of ingenious, politically contingent, and often popularly amusing subjects.  Hopefully, students taking this course are trained to become independent, critical thinkers who are able to observe, analyze, criticize, and ameliorate culture.  By addressing diverse cultural issues, students can not only deepen their understanding of different cultural values but also apply this knowledge to improve cross-cultural communication.  One of the practical purposes of this course is to enable students to help local enterprises boost their business on the global stage of commerce.

syllabi.outline: As an all-encompassing term, the word culture has multiple meanings. Anything involving human activity can be included in the domain of culture. Most importantly, culture is deeply connected with our sense of identity; our culture defines who we are. And culturally-determined identification can a blessing that empowers our subjectivity, but it can also be a confinement that we strive to be free from. In this course, we will approach important topics in cultural studies from the perspectives of gender, race, and violence, the three issues that most intrinsically connected to identity, by reading theoretical texts and critical essays and viewing related films. Ideally, the course will familiarize students with key concepts in cultural studies and cultivate their critical thinking. Furthermore, the instructor hopes that the course can help students identify potential topics of their senior projects and establish valid approaches.

name.zh: 數位科技與人工智慧導論
name.en: Introduction to Digital Technology and Artificial Intelligence

description.zh: 數位科技與人工智慧是資訊科技發展的兩大重要驅動力，本課程旨在培養本系學生在此領域學習的藍圖與概念建立。本課程將介紹數位科技與人工智慧的基本概念、原理與應用。在數位科技方面，將涵蓋IT基礎設施、網際網路、資訊安全、虛擬化與雲端，IoT等主題。在人工智慧方面，將涵蓋機器學習、深度學習、自然語言處理、電腦視覺等主題。
description.en:
Digital Technology and Artificial Intelligence are two major driving forces of the development of information technology. This course aims to cultivate students' learning blueprints and concepts in this field. This course will introduce the basic concepts, principles and applications of digital technology and artificial intelligence.
In the areas of digital technology, it will cover topics such as IT infrastructure, the Internet, information security, virtualization and cloud computing, and IoT. In the areas of artificial intelligence, it will cover topics such as machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing, and computer vision.

description.zh: 本課程以計算機硬體及軟體之基本介紹為始，逐步引入程式設計的觀念與方法，程式設計語言以Python及C語言為基礎，於熟習基本程式語法後，再導入C++程式語言。內容著重邏輯思考與程式設計能力之訓練及其在資訊工程上之應用，同時輔以程式設計過程所應注意之程式結構、偵錯、可攜性、軟體工程的基本概念，使修習者得以奠定程式設計專業之基礎。

syllabi.outline:
本課程作為進階物理化學課程，將集中於講授量子力學相關的部分。近代物理的發展，量子力學已成為如今對自然現象的主流描述理論，其扮演的角色就像過去的牛頓力學與古典熱力學。現今其理論的延伸與應用也已跨及其他的專業領域。本課程將會從基礎的量子力學的概念進行說明，逐步帶領學生了解這個在過去的專業訓練中較為缺乏的一塊。
課程內容將包含量子力學概念介紹、量子理論對運動描述、原子結構、分子結構，最後以統計熱力學將量子理論與古典熱力學進行理論銜接。

name.en: Taguchi Method on the Quality Design

description.zh:
(1)「田口方法」介紹
(2)完整的「田口方法」，包含以下三個主題：
(a) S/N比之理論基礎及進階應用；
(b)直交表之理論基礎及進階應用；
(c)變異分析。
(3)應用「田口方法」進行專案研究，並繳交專案主題與報告。
description.en:
(1) The course gives step-by-step to explaining the "Taguchi Method" for the students.
     (2) The course gives the fully "Taguchi Method" for the students during a short time, which including three topical subjects:
  (a) The basic theory of S/N ratio and its advanced applications.
  (b) The basic theory of Orthogonal Arrays and its advanced applications.
  (c) Analysis of Variance (ANOVA)
  (3) Students will use the "Taguchi Method" to proceeding a project study, and hand over their theme and report of project.

syllabi.outline:
本課程的學習目標是要讓學生學習「田口方法」的基本觀念，並且以實際案例做說明，讓學生學習專有名詞的定義及應用。課程內容包含：直交表實驗、品質計量方法(品質損失、S/N比之理論基礎及應用)、變異分析、案例說明。在學期結束時，應用「田口方法」進行專案主題研究，並繳交期末報告。
The learning goal of this course is to enable students to learn the basic concepts of the Taguchi Method. In addition, actual cases are used to explain, so that students can learn the definition and application of proper nouns. The course content includes: experiment with orthogonal arrays, quality measurement methods (theoretical basis and application of quality loss, S/N ratio), analysis of variance, and case description. At the end of the semester, apply the "Taguchi Method" to conduct project thematic research and submit the final report.

syllabi.notes:
提高決策品質:知識管理透過整合及應用組織內部的知識與資源，協助組織更準確的理解產業趨勢並預測未來變化，使企業能夠基於實際情況作出更明智、更具洞察力的決策，進而提升整體的決策品質。
改善營運效率:系統性的知識管理可以讓員工分享所掌握的企業資訊、知識至系統，使內部資訊能更有效的被收集、儲存和交流，從而減少重複性工作，幫助提高營運效率。
加速創新能力:企業可以透過知識管理系統中資訊，從現有技術中持續學習改進，以適應市場變化和競爭壓力，進而推動創新產品和服務的發展。
增強競爭優勢:建立知識管理系統可以改善營運效率、加速企業創新及提高決策品質，能幫助企業降低成本、提升技術能力與工作效率，靈活應對市場變化，從而獲得競爭優勢。

description.en: This course emphasizes the cultivation of basic aesthetics knowledge and the integration of digital technology. Through practical exercises in aesthetic techniques, students will learn how to apply software such as Photoshop, Illustrator, Indesign, After Effects, and 3D modeling software to multimedia technology. name.en: English Communication and Application I (ECA Courses)

description.zh: ECA 課程專為大一非英語母語的學生設計，加強英語語言技能，特別強調溝通能力和社會、文化、及專業實務應用。 通過整合四種語言技巧能力（閱讀、聽力、口語和寫作），將課堂英語文教學連結至與實務溝通情境之英語文使用。以下為課程設計及教學法之主軸：溝通語言教學（CLT）、任務型導向（TBL）和內容導向教學（CBI），培養學生的英語語言能力為進階專業英文之基礎。
description.en: The ECA courses are designed for the first-year (freshman), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English language skills, with particular emphasis on communicative competence and practical application in social, cultural and professional contexts. By integrating the four skills (reading, listening, speaking and writing), the primary objective is to connect the classroom ELT with the real-life communicative situations. To that end, the courses adopt the following approaches: communicative language teaching (CLT), task-based learning (TBL), and content-based instruction (CBI), building a holistic pedagogy to English instruction and developing students’ English language proficiency for the next level ESP courses.

syllabi.outline:
透過每週的閱讀和課堂討論，本課程將幫助培養學生的英語會話和閱讀技能。 在練習這些技能的過程中，我們將專注於理解西方語言和文化的核心理念，從而理解西方文化中的人（他們的價值觀、動機、原則）的核心理念。 [本課程過去的主題包括：怪物與人類；喜劇和幽默；善與惡的本質；西方英雄；棒球與社會；美的理念和重要性；探索與發現]。 透過審視圍繞這一主題的文章和電影，我們將思考這個重要的想法告訴我們關於西方社會及其人民的哪些資訊。
Through weekly readings and class discussion, this course will help develop students’ English conversation and reading skills.  In the course of practicing such skills, we will focus on an idea central to understanding the language and the culture of the West, and thus an idea central to understanding the people (their values, motivations, principles) of Western culture.   [Past topics for this course include: Monsters and the Human; Comedy and Humor; The Nature of Good and Evil; The Hero in the West; Baseball and Society; The Idea and the Importance of Beauty; Exploration and Discovery].   Examining essays and films centered around such a topic, we will consider what the significant idea tells us about Western society and its people.

description.en:
This course examines important social, political, ethical, and aesthetic ideas in contemporary culture by examining a variety of audio-visual and written texts, including news articles, editorials, research papers, academic essays, videos, websites, movies, and stories.  Students will practice observing and analyzing significant cultural phenomena in an effort to better understand how ideas, beliefs, and values develop and change over time, and are shaped by both longstanding traditions and by ever-changing popular trends.
The course introduces fascinating cultural stories, events, issues, and trends to be studied, in order to develop students’ critical thinking, analytic skills, and cultural literacy.
