description.zh: 本課程主要著重於讓學生瞭解在日常生活中，食衣住行育樂等活動與化學之相互關係。尤其對在生活中所接觸之食品、衣著、環境與用品應有所認識，並以化學觀點了解其與人體之關係。此課程主要內容包括(1)食品化學(Food Chemistry)，(2)衣著化學 (Cloth Chemistry)，(3)環境化學(Environmental Chemistry)，(4)核化學(Nuclear Chemistry)，(5)水化學 (Hydrochemistry)，(6)界面化學 (Interface Chemistry)，(7)家庭用化學品 (Household Chemicals)，(8)化粧品學(Cosmetic Chemistry)，(9)電化學 (Electrochemistry)
description.en: This course focuses on chemistry related to People`s Livelihood, including: Food Chemistry, Cloth Chemistry, Environmental Chemistry, Nuclear Chemistry, Hydrochemistry, Interface Chemistry, Household Chemicals, Cosmetic Chemistry, and Electrochemistry. Topics concerning about the manufacturing processes, application principles and recent developments of People`s Livelihood chemicals are also discussed in this course.

syllabi.outline: 本課程著重於讓學生瞭解在日常生活中，食衣住行育樂等活動與化學之相互關係。邀請系內老師及業師引導學生參與民生化學相關研發或商品開發可能遇到之問題，由授課教師帶領學生進行分組討論，目的在培養學生解決問題之能力，每組學生必須針對教師命題尋找可因應的解題方法。在一系列導讀課程之後(每單元之前30分鐘)，給予學生分組討論(40分鐘)，就單元導讀之日常生活中的科技應用提出團隊的觀察與問題省思，討論期間由授課教師或業師從旁進行觀察及指導，之後30分鐘由學生分組分享各組對於每單元導讀主題的發現與解決提案。

description.zh: 本課程介紹各種分析材料表面性質的方法。藉著利用光子、電子、原子、或離子與材料表面的物理或化學作用，來獲得有關材料表面的組成、結構、化學鍵結、電子組態於表面形貌等訊息。所要介紹的表面分析儀器包括；X光電子光譜儀(XPS)、歐傑電子光譜儀（AES）、低能電子繞射儀(LEED)、電子穿隧掃描儀(STM)、表面振動光譜儀(surface vibrational spectroscopy)、程式控溫脫附法(TPD)及真空技術。
description.en: The course introduces various surface analysis methods, including XPS, AES, LEED, STM, surface vibrational spectroscopy, and TPD.  From the physical and chemical interaction between photons、electrons、atoms and ions with surfaces, the surface properties, including surface composition, surface structure, surface topography, electronic structure, and chemical bonding will be probed.

syllabi.outline: The course introduces fundamentals of surface property and various surface analysis methods, including XPS, AES, LEED, STM, surface vibrational spectroscopy, and TPD. From the physical and chemical interaction between photons、electrons、atoms and ions with surfaces, the surface properties, including surface composition, surface structure, surface topography, electronic structure, and chemical bonding will be probed.

description.zh: 隨著電腦速度的提升，應用電腦模擬來做各種預測或與實驗結果比較，已經成為各領域發展的一種趨勢。因此，在化學上，計算化學也成為當代化學發展的一個領域。本課程以講述當代計算化學領域中的基本物理化學觀念，包含化學鍵結、分子力學、量子化學與分子動力學等。課程進行以使用費的計算軟體來進行實作為主。內容涵蓋 : 分子、高分子與固態結構的設計建構以及結構最佳化，能階計算，與光譜模擬比較。
description.en: Computer simulation for prediction or comparison with experimental results becomes very popular in many fields due to the progress of computer performance. Thus, computational chemistry also become one of important fields in modern science. This course is designed to include some basic concepts in computational chemistry and mainly focuses on practical. The basic concepts of physical chemistry will be illustrated such as chemical bonding, molecular mechanics, quantum chemistry and molecular dynamics. In practical, the molecular design from small molecules to polymers and even solid state will be included first. Then, the energy levels calculations, simulations of spectroscopy will be done in some free quantum chemistry packages.

description.en: The material in this course covers implantable, nonimplantable, and extracorporeal materials. Implantables include sutures, vascular grafts, artificial heart, artificial bones and ligaments, drug delivery device, artificial tissues, artificial liver,etc. Nonimplantable materials are : cloths in medical uses,  surgical dressings and gauze, injection device, diagonsis materials, etc. Extracorporeal materials are : dialysis fibers, artificial lung, catheters, etc.

description.zh: 染顏料(色料)雖已發展百餘年，唯部分現象與實驗結果仍須進一步的研究以獲得完整正確的解釋。本課程主要探討染料的吸收光譜與其分子結構式的關係，是為具有色料化學與有機化學基礎的同學所設計的。
description.en:
Although studies on synthetic colourants have been performed for more than 100 years, their detailed elucidation requires further extensive research.
This course reviews the absorption features of organic dyes and recent progress in their explanation in terms of molecular structure. This course is mainly intended for organic chemists and colour chemists which are interested in the spectral characteristics of dyes and their conceptual understanding.

name.zh: 文化資產保存理論與資源應用

description.zh: 本課程分為兩大部分，其一為理論和議題的探究，自文化資產概念出發，探究文資保存範疇下的各項議題，包含有形無形文化保存的真實性、文化價值的差異與認定、詮釋與再現、資源管理和應用；其二為講授文化資產資源應用所需的研究方法和工具－田野調查；同時透過國內外文化資產的案例作分析與討論，深度檢視文化資產的多元面貌。
description.en: This course aims to understand the concept of heritage from the context of Taiwan and UNESCO. Different issues related to heritage preservation are discussed in this course, include the value and authenticity of tangible and intangible heritage, the representation and interpretation of culture and history, and reuse and management of cultural spaces. Moreover, fieldwork, the research methods of doing heritage preservation and resource management is also taught in this course. Finally, international case studies of heritage reuse and management are examined, to understand different ways of heritage practice.

name.en: Exhibitions and the Intervention of Moving Images

description.zh: 隨著各類型博物館廣泛使用動態影像，本課程聚焦在動態影像的歷史、理論與實踐。探究博物館內的動態影像如何以當代藝術實踐手法，重塑空間敘事，挑戰展示傳統。課程主題包含：美術館的當代影像實踐、以物為中心的博物館的展示策略、動態影像技術、策展策略和數位媒體的影響。課程預計分析藝術作品、探索展覽空間，並探討科技技術、觀眾參與和藝術表達之間，彼此交互不斷演變的關係。
description.en: With various types of museums widely incorporating moving images, this course focuses on the history, theory, and experiential aspects of such imagery. It delves into how moving images within museums, employing contemporary artistic practices, reshapes spatial narratives and challenges traditional displays. Topics include contemporary image practices in fine art museums, object-centred museum display strategies, technology, curatorial strategies, and the impact of digital media. The course entails analyzing artworks, exploring exhibition spaces, and discussing the evolving relationship between technological advancements, audience engagements, and artistic expression to cultivate critical skills in curation and interpretation.

本課程旨在協助學生學習匹克球各項基本技巧，並學習球場禮儀及比賽規則。且在有效的學習過程中獲得成就感，同時達到鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。
教學目標：
1. 學習正確匹克球基本技巧，避動作錯誤造成運動傷害。 
2. 學會欣賞匹克球運動賽事，提升對於此運動項目之興趣。

5. 培養團隊合作與運動家的精神。

The purpose of this course is to assist students in learning the fundamental skills of pickleball, as well as understanding court etiquette and game regulations. Through effective learning processes, students will attain a sense of accomplishment while concurrently achieving physical and mental well-being, promoting overall development, cultivating sportsmanship, fostering teamwork, and establishing lifelong exercise habits.

Teaching objectives:

Acquire proper pickleball fundamental skills to prevent sports injuries caused by incorrect movements.
Develop an appreciation for pickleball events to enhance interest in the sport.
Understand the basic rules and etiquette of pickleball.
Cultivate regular exercise habits to achieve physical fitness benefits.
Foster teamwork and a sportsmanlike spirit.

name.en: Special Topics on Surface Analysis for Materials

description.zh: 本課程介紹各種分析材料表面性質的方法。藉著利用光子、電子、原子、或離子與材料表面的物理或化學作用，來獲得有關材料表面的組成、結構、化學鍵結、電子組態於表面形貌等訊息。所要介紹的表面分析儀器包括；X光電子光譜儀(XPS)、歐傑電子光譜儀（AES）、低能電子繞射儀(LEED)、電子穿隧掃描儀(STM)、表面振動光譜儀(surface vibrational spectroscopy)、程式控溫脫附法(TPD)及真空技術。
description.en: The course introduces various surface analysis methods, including XPS, AES, LEED, STM, surface vibrational spectroscopy, and TPD. From the physical and chemical interaction between photons、electrons、atoms and ions with surfaces, the surface properties, including surface composition, surface structure, surface topography, electronic structure, and chemical bonding will be probed.

syllabi.outline: The purpose of this course is to elucidate the gas-solid interfacial phenomena, principles and techniques of surface science and its application to meet the increasing demand for analysis of solid surfaces in both the “academic” and “technological” fields.

description.en: This course is concerned with the mixed-signal integrated circuit design. Its purpose is to deal with the analysis and design of mixed-signal CMOS integrated circuits, emphasizing fundamentals as well as new paradigms that students need to master in today's industry. The course covers the following topics. 1.Introduction to mixed-signal design 2.Continuous-time filters 3.Switched-capacitor filters 4.witched-current filters 5.D/A converters 6.A/D conerters 7.Oversampled Sigma-Delta A/D coverters 8.Pipelined A/D converter 9.Layout for mixed-signal integrated circuit

syllabi.outline: This course offers an in-depth exploration into the analysis and design of mixed-signal integrated circuits (ICs), with a particular emphasis on signal conversion and system modeling. The curriculum is structured around four main pillars (MLDS) : (1) Modeling - the development of mixed-signal circuits, (2) Language - proficiency in programming languages such as Verilog-A, Verilog-D, Python, C, and Matlab, (3) Data/Signal - thorough analysis of circuit performance and signal quality, and (4) System - mastery in adaptive optimization algorithms. Practical examples, including voltage regulators, Phase-Locked Loops (PLLs), and Successive Approximation Register (SAR) Analog-to-Digital Converters (ADCs), will be used to reinforce learning.

2024/3/4 MSD-HW1 PLL Linear Model Design
 
Topic : PLL Linear Model Design


Objective:
Design an integer Phase-Locked Loop (PLL) with an output frequency determined by the formula: 2 GHz + 0.01 GHz multiplied by the last two digits of your student ID number. For instance, if your student ID is 110368130, your target output frequency should be set to 2.3 GHz.

2024/3/18 MSD-HW2 Stability analysis of the PLL circuit

Topic : Stability analysis of the PLL circuit

Objective:
Design an integer Phase-Locked Loop (PLL) with an output frequency that is 2 GHz plus 0.01 GHz multiplied by the last two digits of your student ID. For example, if your student ID is 110368130, the target output frequency would be 2.3 GHz.

_______________________________________________________________________________
2024/4/1 MSD-HW3 Frequency hopping generation for  Bluetooth

Objective : Design a Frequency hopping PLL for the Bluetooth protocal.

________________________________________________________________________________
2024/4/21 MSD-HW4  Resistance Computation of a ResistorMesh Network

Topic: Resistance Computation of a ResistorMesh Network

Objective:
Determine the resistance between nodes A and B in a specified mesh network, where each resistor has a resistance of 10 Ω. Employ linear algebra techniques to calculate the resistance and validate the result using circuit simulation with Spectre.

________________________________________________________________________________
2024/4/21 MSD-HW5A / MSD-HW5B Mixed Signal Generation

MSD-HW5A :
Topic : Generation of Continuous Frequency-Shift Keying (FSK) Waveform

Objective:
Generate a continuous Frequency-Shift Keying (FSK) waveform. This modulation technique uses varying frequencies to represent different data values, essential for understanding digital signal processing and telecommunications.
________________________________________________________________________________
MSD-HW5B :
Topic: Sampled and Held (S/H) of the Triangular Spectrum

Objective:
- Generate an infinite-time domain single-cycle triangular waveform with a duration of 0.1 seconds, sample and hold the waveform at a rate of 0.01 seconds, and transform this signal into its spectrum using Fourier transform.

________________________________________________________________________________

description.zh: 本課程旨在提升學生在多媒體設計上的音樂製作與聲音設計之理論與實務訓練，透過 MIDI 概念講解、數位音樂製作流程介紹、作品欣賞、軟體操作、實務聲音設計與錄製、電腦輔助音樂製作實務，來強化學生在音樂與聲音設計上的審美能力、企劃能力、與實作能力。
description.en: This course aims to enhance students' theoretical and practical ability of music production and sound design in multimedia. It is intended to strengthen students' aesthetic, planning, and production ability of sound. Topics covered in this course include MIDI, music production, music appreciation, software operation, sound design, recording techniques as well as computer-assisted music arrangement.

syllabi.outline:
本課程提供給對於電子音樂、聲音藝術、數位音樂、遊戲配樂、以及聲音相關研究等有興趣的學習者們一系列有效工具的介紹與實務練習，並為學習者建立數位音樂、遊戲配樂、聲音設計的基本概念。本課程透過介紹音訊編輯的技術、相關聲音設計工具的使用，學習創意的聲音設計與電子音樂製作。課程當中，除了聲音設計的工具介紹之外，並教導學生使用 Ableton Live 序列器軟體，搭配 Max for Live 的聲音設計工具，讓使用者可以在序列器中使用自己所設計的軟體合成器與數位位效果器，進而可延伸至多媒體、遊戲、新媒體展演等之音樂與音效應用。此外，本課程亦將結合「自適性音樂」的技術，透過中介軟體 FMOD 與遊戲引擎 Unity 進行結合，建立自適音樂的雛形架構，作為互動設計的音樂設計依據。此外，本課程也加入 ＡI 音樂與音訊處理相關工具之介紹與應用。

This course mainly introduces sound design and electronic music production tools and skills. Through the introduction of audio editing technology and the use of related sound design tools, students can learn creative sound design. In the course, students are taught to use the Ableton Live sequencer software, combined with its sound design tools in Max for Live, to design their own software synthesizers and digital effects to be used in the sequencer. These skills may be used in multimedia design, game audio, new media performances, and etc. In addition, this course will also cover the concept and technology of "adaptive music", integrating the middleware FMOD into the game engine Unity to establish a prototype framework of adaptive music for interactive design.

description.zh: 本課程係探討纖維製品在非衣著終端領域之應用，例如電子電機，土木，材料，生醫，航空與車輛工程等之應用。其內容包括功能性與機能性纖維、複合紗、複合織物、編帶、非織物、纖維系複合材料與電線電纜、光纖電纜等之製造方法、原理與其終端應用領域。最後將討論微細加工技術與微細粉末在纖維與高科技工業上之應用。
description.en: The course is to interpret the application of the non-apparel textiles at the different end uses, such as application in electrical and electronic, civil, material, biomedical, aerospace, and vehicle engineering etc.  It includes fabrication methods, principles, and end application fields of the performance and functional fibers, composite yarns, composite fabrics, braid, nonwoven, textile composites, and cables and optical cables etc. Finally, the micro processing technology and powder in textile and high-tech industries will be discussed.

description.zh: 本課程旨在提升管理決策之心智、理論與技能，並在複雜企業環境下的實務管理決策案例分析應用，使了解在國際環境中科技進展及應用下，如何透過各種決策模式了解並分析複雜情境，達成經濟及有效的管理決策。另一方面，透過了解、認同領導統御的理念、特質及行為，建立學生全面性的傑出領導素養。
description.en: This course covers theoretical knowledge and practical skills providing the ability to develop managerial decisions based on the application of various methods in the international environment, including: studying and analyzing the process of making economic and managerial decisions. In the same time, this course is designed to provide a basic introduction to leadership by focusing on what it means to be a good leader. Emphasis in the course is on the practice of potential philosophy of leadership, traits, skills, behaviors, and develop students a great overall leadership proficiency.

description.zh:
隨著網際網路的盛行，電子商務迅速地蓬勃發展，使得傳統的商店與行銷環境受到衝擊。資訊科技改變了消費習慣與行銷通路，電子商務的效應已經開始影響商業活動的每個層面，從新產品的開發、銷售、到售後服務均受影響，為企業帶來了無限商機。根據資策會的報告顯示，網際購物市場目前正進入高成長期。網際網路的消費觀念逐漸普及，消費者端的網路交易市集，亦成為未來重要的網路商機。不僅B2C市場（企業對消費者）極具潛力，網友個體戶的開店創業風潮（C2C）更是在蓬勃發中。
面對網路商業的來臨，有著大量的網路商業的人才需求。只要有正確的網路商業經營獲利模式，網路是一個可以賺到大錢的管道，尤其低門檻、低成本的網路拍賣場更是最佳踏板。本課程講授網路創業及網路商業的必要實務經營能力，讓同學在本課程裡學得如何快速的以最少成本來DIY速成個人事業及就業的能力。
description.en: Following the prevailing of the internet, the vigorous development e-commerce has given great impacts on traditional tangible stores and the whole marketing environments. Information Technology has not only changed our lives, but also changed consumers' behavior and marketing channels; and the e-commerce effect has already started to permeate into every stratum of business activities, including the exploitation, marketing, and after-sales service of new products, brings the industries infinite business chances. According to the reports of Institute for Information Industry, the market of internet shopping is going into its high development period, and there are a lot of chances to establish a new enterprise on the internet. So this course will teach about the internet entrepreneurial management.

description.zh:
隨著網際網路的盛行，電子商務迅速地蓬勃發展，使得傳統的商店與行銷環境受到衝擊。資訊科技改變了消費習慣與行銷通路，電子商務的效應已經開始影響商業活動的每個層面，從新產品的開發、銷售、到售後服務均受影響，為企業帶來了無限商機。根據資策會的報告顯示，網際購物市場目前正進入高成長期。網際網路的消費觀念逐漸普及，消費者端的網路交易市集，亦成為未來重要的網路商機。不僅B2C市場（企業對消費者）極具潛力，網友個體戶的開店創業風潮（C2C）更是在蓬勃發中。
面對網路商業的來臨，有著大量的網路商業的人才需求。只要有正確的網路商業經營獲利模式，網路是一個可以賺到大錢的管道，尤其低門檻、低成本的網路拍賣場更是最佳踏板。本課程講授網路創業及網路商業的必要實務經營能力，讓同學在本課程裡學得如何快速的以最少成本來DIY速成個人事業及就業的能力。
description.en: Following the prevailing of the internet, the vigorous development e-commerce has given great impacts on traditional tangible stores and the whole marketing environments. Information Technology has not only changed our lives, but also changed consumers' behavior and marketing channels; and the e-commerce effect has already started to permeate into every stratum of business activities, including the exploitation, marketing, and after-sales service of new products, brings the industries infinite business chances. According to the reports of Institute for Information Industry, the market of internet shopping is going into its high development period, and there are a lot of chances to establish a new enterprise on the internet. So this course will teach about the internet entrepreneurial management.

description.zh: 本課程適用於一般大專之決策分析課程。其目的在說明決策理論之基本觀念，及其在真實世界裡相關決策問題之分析。本課程授課主題包括：不考慮機率之決策問題、與機率有關之決策問題、獲取額外資訊之決策分析、效益分析、遊戲理論。相關之授課內容包括：機率分配、期望值方法、貝氏分析、完全資訊與額外資訊之期望值。
description.en:

theory.The related studies includes prlbability distribution,expected value approach,Bayesian analysis,expected value of perfect informatin and sample information.

description.zh: 本課程旨在為學生提供創業和經營新創企業所需的基本知識和技能。 課程內容涵蓋當前各種形態的創業模式和創業家精神所具備的一些關鍵特質與必要的技能，學生將學習到如何識別市場機會並評估將想法商業化的可行性。本課程也將深入介紹行銷的核心概念與市場運作，包括市場細分，目標顧客定位和行銷組合，學生將學習到如何根據市場需求制定行銷策略並有效地實施。該課程還將涵蓋品牌策略、定價策略、推廣和銷售等主題。完成本課程後，學生將獲得關於創業以及經營企業的關鍵知識和技能，以及對行銷在創業過程中的作用有更深入的理解。
description.en: This course aims to provide students with the foundational knowledge and skills necessary to start and operate a new business venture. Students will learn about the various forms of entrepreneurship and entrepreneurship essentials, such as the characteristics, traits, and skills of successful entrepreneurs. Students will learn how to identify opportunities and assess the feasibility of a business idea. The course will then delve into the core concepts of marketing, including market segmentation, targeting, positioning, and the marketing mix. Students will learn how to develop a marketing plan and implement it effectively. The course will also cover topics such as branding, pricing strategies, promotion, and distribution. Upon completion of this course, students will have gained the knowledge and skills necessary to launch and operate a new business, as well as a deeper understanding of the role of marketing in entrepreneurship.

description.zh: 本課程針對幼稚園、國小、與國中階段的英語師資而設計，在教材與教法的搭配上提供學理的引介與實務上的訓練。本課程設計考量這些階段學生之身心發展程度與興趣，將屬於兒童與青少年文學範疇的文本（例如：希臘神話、哈利波特系列、波西傑克森系列等等）作創意運用，幫助老師們擷取並改編合宜的教材，經由活潑的教學活動（包括：改編戲劇演出、繪本製作、歌唱舞蹈等等），提高學生的英語能力，也在培養他們體察文化差異的深層素養。
description.en: Designed for kindergarten, elementary school, and junior high school English teacher, this course aims to provide practical training and theories in teaching materials and pedagogy. Students of this course will also learn to adapt children and teenager literary works such as Greek mythology, the Harry Potter series, and the Posey Jackson series into materials suitable for students at the above-specified age groups. Possible learning activities such as role-play, picture books, dancing/singing will also be explored as methods to both develop students' English proficiency and cultural awareness.

syllabi.outline: Objectives:It is the goal of the course to train our graduate students to learn and then to teach English language, with its inherent cultural significance, through children's and young adult literature.  The treasure of literature, especially suitable and meaningful for children and teenagers, will be explored in a variety of learning activities in the class, including reading, discussions, role plays, creating picture books, and analyzing film adaptations with the aim to cultivate students’ full language skills and to enrich their cultural literacy in order to build a sound foundation for their future studies.

description.zh: 以案例解析為主的方式，探究我國著作權法的重要課題，藉以協助同學了解審判實務適用法律的依據、判準或論證等，並適時補充國外相關學理、判決及著名案例等，以增進同學對國內外相關重要著作權案例之思辨及評析的能力。
description.en: This is a course focused on case analyses, in studying important issues relating to Taiwanese Copyright Act. Graduate students joining this course may find help on comprehension of the basis, rules or argumentation to the laws applied in trial practice.  Together with timely supplementation of relevant foreign academic interpretations, adjudications and noted cases, students may improve their ability of contemplation and analysis on related and significant copyright cases home and abroad.

syllabi.schedule:
第1週：介紹授課理念、課程綱要、上課方式與評分標準，並依多數同學的需求進行調整。

第2-18週：以案例討論的教學為主，並配合同學的興趣、專業及時事，選擇下列主題：

1. 著作人格權（姓名表示權、禁止醜化權、公開發表權及如何回復損害）
2. 著作財產權（新聞攝影著作及美術著作之抄襲、保護電視節目模式的界限）
3. 重製權、改作權（3D列印、AI生成物、報導照片侵權、金魚案、應用美術、學名藥仿單、同人誌）
4. 公開口述、播送、上映、傳輸權（戲謔仿作、youtube傳輸）
5. 出租權、散布權（色情光碟、遊戲軟體）
6. 輸入權、真品平行輸入（國際權利耗盡原則）
7. 鄰接權、製版權（表演人權利保護、AI創作）
8. 著作財產權讓與及授權（電子書、NFT藝術品交易）
9. 著作合理使用（判斷基準、嬌蕉包仿作、波奇貓VS. 妙可貓）
10. 網路服務業者與著作權保護（責任避風港條款）
11. 網路著作權保護（數位資料授權與合理傳輸、網際網路與著作權）
12. 資料庫保護（編輯著作與資料庫保護、大數據分析與保護）
13. AI訓練之機器學習、深度學習等可否創作？或受保護或涉及侵權？
14. AI創作之權利歸屬及保護的爭論
15. AI深度偽造的法律問題
16. Metaverse數位創作之爭議
17. ChatGPT發展趨勢及侵權爭議

※各單元主題分析或案例探討，將配合同學興趣及相關判決及時事等，調整進度，歡迎對著作權法有興趣或有基礎知識的同學修課。

※本於法體系的整合，本課程除英美法重要判決外，更重視日本、中國大陸及歐陸著作權法的法規及判決。

※期待選課者，課前已有著作權法的基礎知識，或選課前能擇一研讀下列參考書目。

name.zh: 科技壟斷與公平交易法
name.en: Technology Monopoly and Fair Trade Act

description.zh: 公平交易法是經濟憲法，也是維持市場交易秩序的根本大法。當現代企業與市場的結構愈趨複雜，公平交易法的角色也愈顯重要。本課程將以案例分析，帶領學生了解公平交易法的基本原則。最後，本課程將規劃呈現科技發展下的新興壟斷議題，帶領學生一起探討。
description.en: The Fair Trade Act is often considered as the economic constitution also a set of fundamental rules to maintain the order of market. This Act is getting more and more important in the modern economy while the market is getting more and more chaotic and complicated. This course is designed for students who intend to understand the principles of the Fair Trade Act by case studies, and who is interested to learn about emerging technology monopoly issues.

name.zh: 文化產業與智慧財產權
name.en: Cultural Industry and Intellectual Property Rights

description.zh: 本課程所定義的文化產業包括音樂產業、電視產業、電影產業、劇場產業和其他表演藝術有關的產業。這些產業區塊都存在相關的智慧財產權議題，例如所有權、權利轉讓、合理使用、侵權行為、契約爭議等等。本課程將透過法院判決的選讀與產業案例研究來讓學生認識文化產業的智慧財產權議題。學生將被要求參與討論。評分方式包括課堂參與和報告。
description.en: The scope of the cultural industry covered by this course includes the music industry, film industry, television industry, theatre industry, and other industries related to performing arts. Intellectual property issues do exist in these industrial sectors. The issues include ownership, title transfer, fair use, infringement, contract dispute, and so on. This course is intended to expose students to various IP issues in the cultural industry through studying court decisions and discussing industrial case studies. Students are required to participate in discussion. The grading policy is based on class participation and essay paper.

syllabi.outline:
本課程所定義的文化產業包括音樂產業、電視產業、電影產業、劇場產業和其他表演藝術有關的產業。這些產業區塊都存在相關的智慧財產權議題，例如所有權、權利轉讓、合理使用、侵權行為、契約爭議等等。本課程將透過法院判決的選讀與產業案例研究來讓學生認識文化產業的智慧財產權議題。學生將被要求參與討論。評分方式包括課堂參與和報告。
The scope of the cultural industry covered by this course includes the music industry, film industry, television industry, theatre industry, and other industries related to performing arts. Intellectual property issues do exist in these industrial sectors. The issues include ownership, title transfer, fair use, infringement, contract dispute, and so on. This course is intended to expose students to various IP issues in the cultural industry through studying court decisions and discussing industrial case studies. Students are required to participate in discussion. The grading policy is based on class participation and essay paper.

name.zh: 數位匯流與智財法律專題(二)
name.en: Intellectual Property Laws in the Age of Digital Convergence(II)

description.zh: 在數位匯流的趨勢下，網際網路不但即將成為各種傳統媒體的聚集之處，同時也不斷衍生新型態的媒體傳播方式。有鑑於此，本課程目的即在探討數位匯流時代的智財法律議題。將由實際案例為主，輔以相關分析文章及法律規定的解析，帶領同學了解數位環境的特性、數位媒體形式與媒體內容的發展，同時針對著作權、隱私權等實用智慧財產權議題，讓同學了解、並具備分析數位時代的媒體趨勢、以及智財法律策略的能力。
description.en: In the face of digital convergence, the internet seems will not only become the ultimate channel for all kinds of traditional media, but the birthplace of new types. In light of the challenges posed by the digital age, this course is aimed at helping students explore the IP legal issues with reference to the media evolution on the internet. It will begin with the introduction of the characteristics of the internet, the developments of the digital media formation and content, and followed by the discussions and analysis on the cases in the real life.

name.zh: 科技發展與法律策略:案例研析二
name.en: Technology Development and Legal Strategy: Case Study(II)

description.zh: 在科技發展快速的年代，有些人認為產業和市場需要更多新的法律規範，也有些人認為舊有法律需要鬆綁。但無庸置疑地，法律在科技、產業與市場的發展中，扮演著一個攸關重要的角色。基於此，本課程嘗試以設計案例討論，鼓勵不同背景的學生，經由案例分析得到綜合性的知識、從中了解科技發展如何影響法律變遷，並進而學習專業的法律策略。
description.en: In an age of rapid technology advancement, some people might insist more laws are necessary to regulate the industry and the market, on the contrary, others might think de-regulation is the best approach to encourage the free flow of the market. Nonetheless, it is beyond question that law and regulations play an vital role in the technology-driven economy today. Therefore this course is designed to help students from various backgrounds to engage in the group discussions on assigned cases. Students are expected to learn how the technology development shapes the legal environment and learn how to analyze the legal strategies.

Nonetheless, it is beyond question that law and regulations play a vital role in the technology-driven economy today. Therefore, this course is designed to help students from various backgrounds to engage in the group discussions on assigned cases. Students are expected to learn how the technology development shapes the legal environment and learn how to analyze the legal strategies. In fact, the class lectures will be in English 30% and in Chinese 70%, and the class materials are mainly in Chinese.

description.zh: 為保障商標權及消費者利益，維護市場公平競爭，促進工商企業正常發展，國家特制定商標法，本課程以介紹我國商標法為重點，主要內容包括商標規範之基本原理、商標之構成要素、商標之分類方式及各類型商標之特性與功能、申請商標註冊之程序、商標註冊之審查及核准、商標權之取得及行使、異議程序及紛爭處理、權利侵害之救濟等。
description.en: Trademark Act is formulated to safeguard trademark rights and the consumers' interest, maintain fair competition of markets, and facilitate normal development of industries and commerce. This course is focusing on the introduction of Trademark Act. Topics will mainly include the basic principle of trademark standard, the integrant part of trademark, the characteristic and the function of trademark, the application procedures, examination and approval, acquisition of the trademark rights and exercises, the procedure of opposition and the dispute processes, remedies for right infringement and so on.

name.zh: 專利佈局與專利策略專題研究
name.en: Seminar on Patent Portfolio and Patent Strategy

description.zh: 專利攻防已變成產業策略之一，越來越多的訴訟案件逼使廠商進行專利迴避設計。事實上台灣的產業界對於迴避設計、專利策略與專利佈局理論上並不陌生，但在實務上卻很少實際執行，所以每年仍然付出五十億美金的權利金。本課程將從專利範圍解讀開始，熟悉專利的權利範圍，然後介紹專利策略以及佈局的方向，提供專利佈局與專利策略理論及實務經驗。本課程的綱要如下： 1.專利權利項解讀 2.專利侵權分析流程 3.專利迴避設計要件 4.專利策略分析 5.專利佈局實務 6.案例研究
description.en: Patent litigation, either initiation or defense, has become one of the industrial strategies, and more and more patent suit cases have forced the manufacturers to undertake patent design around. In fact, the industrial fields in Taiwan, theoretically, do not feel strange on design around and patent strategies. However, in practice, they perform much less. That is the reason why Taiwan still has to pay more than five billion US dollars each year for royalty. This course will start from patent claim interpretation, getting patent claims well known, then following with introduction on orientation of patent strategies, and providing theory and practice on patent strategies. The outline of this course is given as follows: Patent claim interpretation; Process of patent infringement analysis; Requirements of patent design around; Patent strategy analysis; Practice on patent strategies; and Study on patent cases.

syllabi.outline: 專利攻防已變成產業策略之一，越來越多的訴訟案件逼使廠商進行專利迴避設計。事實上台灣的產業界對於迴避設計、專利策略與專利佈局理論上並不陌生，但在實務上卻很少實際執行，所以每年仍然付出五十億美金的權利金。因此本課程主要強調專利策略與專利布局分析在企業界的運用；值得強調的是，本課程內容完全與國考無關，係針對『專利技術分析』、『專利佈局』、『專利策略』與『科技管理』等主題作討論，故課程的設計會閱讀相關外文文獻，所以份量頗重，預期每星期均會花很多時間閱讀paper與課堂討論，所以較適合未來擬以相關主題作為論文研究方向之同學修習。

第13周 技術與功效分析
第14周 中國專利系統

第16~18周 期末報告

description.zh: 以案例解析為主的方式，探究我國著作權法的重要課題，藉以協助同學了解審判實務適用法律的依據、判準或論證等，並適時補充國外相關學理、判決及著名案例等，以增進同學對國內外相關重要著作權案例之思辨及評析的能力。
description.en: This is a course focused on case analyses, in studying important issues relating to Taiwanese Copyright Act. Graduate students joining this course may find help on comprehension of the basis, rules or argumentation to the laws applied in trial practice.  Together with timely supplementation of relevant foreign academic interpretations, adjudications and noted cases, students may improve their ability of contemplation and analysis on related and significant copyright cases home and abroad.

syllabi.schedule:
第1週：介紹授課理念、課程綱要、上課方式與評分標準，並依多數同學的需求進行調整。

第2-18週：以案例討論的教學為主，並配合同學的興趣、專業及時事，選擇下列主題：

1. 著作人格權（姓名表示權、禁止醜化權、公開發表權及如何回復損害）
2. 著作財產權（新聞攝影著作及美術著作之抄襲、保護電視節目模式的界限）
3. 重製權、改作權（3D列印、AI生成物、報導照片侵權、金魚案、應用美術、學名藥仿單、同人誌）
4. 公開口述、播送、上映、傳輸權（戲謔仿作、youtube傳輸）
5. 出租權、散布權（色情光碟、遊戲軟體）
6. 輸入權、真品平行輸入（國際權利耗盡原則）
7. 鄰接權、製版權（表演人權利保護、AI創作）
8. 著作財產權讓與及授權（電子書、NFT藝術品交易）
9. 著作合理使用（判斷基準、嬌蕉包仿作、波奇貓VS. 妙可貓）
10. 網路服務業者與著作權保護（責任避風港條款）
11. 網路著作權保護（數位資料授權與合理傳輸、網際網路與著作權）
12. 資料庫保護（編輯著作與資料庫保護、大數據分析與保護）
13. AI訓練之機器學習、深度學習等可否創作？或受保護或涉及侵權？
14. AI創作之權利歸屬及保護的爭論
15. AI深度偽造的法律問題
16. Metaverse數位創作之爭議
17. ChatGPT發展趨勢及侵權爭議

※各單元主題分析或案例探討，將配合同學興趣及相關判決及時事等，調整進度，歡迎對著作權法有興趣或有基礎知識的同學修課。

※本於法體系的整合，本課程除英美法重要判決外，更重視日本、中國大陸及歐陸著作權法的法規及判決。

※期待選課者，課前已有著作權法的基礎知識，或選課前能擇一研讀下列參考書目。

description.zh: 本課程主要敘述數位語音訊號的處理技術及語音相關應用。討論的課題主要包括語音分析的基本聲學原理如發音模型與語音特徵分析，以及語音編碼、語音合成、語音辨認等重要應用。
description.en: This course is intended to introduce the fundamentals of speech signal processing and related applications. The topics it will address include speech production model, extraction and evaluation of speech features, basic principles of speech analysis and synthesis, speech coding, and speech recognition, etc.

syllabi.outline:
This course introduces the applications of digital signal processing on speech signals. It contains the following topics:
1. The characteristic of speech signal
2. Single-channel speech enhancement algorithms
3. Multichannel speech enhancement algorithms
4. Speech recognition techniques
5. Speech counting estimation
6. Speech localization methods
7. Deep-learning techniques on speech signals
syllabi.schedule:
Week 1: Introduction of speech signals
Week 2-4: Review of discrete-time signal processing
Week 5-11: Speech enhancement algorithms (single channel)
Week 12: Beamforming techniques
Week 13: Speech counting estimation
Week 14: Speech localization methods
Week 15-16: Speech recognition techniques
Week 17: Deep-learning techniques on speech signals
Week 18: Final presentation
syllabi.assessment: Homework: 40%, Quiz: 30%, Final Project: 30%, Bonus
syllabi.materials:
1. C. P. Loizou, Speech Enhancement: Theory and Practice, Second Edition. CRC Press, 2013

3. A. V. Oppenheim and R. W. Schafer, Discrete-Time Signal Processing, Third Edition. PEARSON, 2010
4. Related paper for speech signal processing
5. Self-made PPT & notes

description.en: The goal of Advanced Product Design (II) is to train, under supervision, students in strategic areas of the product development process. In these projects, the students work alone or in groups. The projects are usually based on problems defined within different branches of industry and social sectors. Project work is usually done under realistic conditions, in collaboration with different industrial companies or public institutions. Students can contribute to this reality by developing sensible and usable products and systems which include qualities that speak to the heart and mind of people. We educate students as designers to have an open mind on both conceptual ideas and detailed realistic design solutions in order to develop higher quality products. Another important focus area of this course is to improve the students' capabilities in the use of modern design tools.

description.zh: 本課程介紹資料分析與圖示的工具與方法，包括如何以精確的模式來描述資料、利用各種指標與圖形來探索給定資料的特性、特徵、或是規律性，並且可以根據所建立的資料模型來進行估計與預測。此外，我們也將探討如何產生各種機率分布的隨機樣本，以及各種最佳化問題求解。本課程將以R程式語言為工具。
description.en: This course introduces tools and methods for data analysis and graphics. The main topics include models that are used to describe data, indices and plots for exploring data characteristics and patterns, and estimation and prediction based on the data models. In addition, we discuss how to generate random sample from probability distributions and how to solve optimization problems. The selected tool for this course is R.

description.zh: 日常生活中，科技和化學伴隨著人類的成長，除了吃、喝、玩樂外，[用]也是很重要的一部份，例如我們時時刻刻在用的洗面乳、洗髮乳、沐浴乳、洗碗精、洗衣精等等的民生用品。探討這些化學對於環境的影響，並透過簡易的化學實驗來了解到民生化學用品與環境的關聯。了解日常生活中拋棄的廢棄物，如何轉換成有效的資源，達到綠色循環的經濟概念。
description.en: In our daily lives, science and chemistry develop and progress along with people.  However, life is not just about eating, drinking, playing, and entertainment.  "Usage" is also very important, specifically when it comes to the facial cleansers, body washes, dish and laundry detergents, and other cleaning supplies that we use.  From simple tests to determine the effects of chemicals on the environment, we understand how discarded daily articles can be transformed into effective resources, thus putting into practice a green recycling economy.

description.zh: 環境保護是廿世紀的新課題，也是人類目前及未來所面臨的最大考驗。因為環境問題是超越國界的，因此環境的保護是每個人都必須瞭解的，也是每個人應盡的責任。本課程首先在了解環境與生活素質的關係，並了解環境問題的產生及其分類，再就台灣環境問題之所在分析其根源，最後了解台灣環境實施之現況後，並共同研究解決之道。
description.en: Introduction to Environmental Protection is a brand new issue of the 20th century; also, it is the biggest challenge of all human beings and our offspring. Because environmental protection is an international issue, everyone got to realize it's importance and take some action. This lesson is designed to help students understand: 1. the connection between our environment and our living condition; 2.the cause of environmental problems and their classification; 3.the cause of environmental problems in Taiwan; and 4.the solution to Taiwan's environmental problems.

name.en: Applications of Internet of Things ( IoT )

description.zh: 「物聯網（智慧聯網）」被視為繼個人電腦、網際網路之後，世界資訊產業的第三波浪潮。隨著科技的進步，網路早已成為人與人重要的溝通管道之一，而在未來的世界，透過物聯網技術，將賦予物件智慧並擁有與其它物件或人溝通的能力，換言之，未來網路不再只是人與人的溝通管道，更是聯繫全球物與物、人與物的橋樑。未來智慧型裝置有望相互連結、分享資料，進而改變人們的日常生活與企業的運作模式。
description.en:
The Internet of Things ( IoT ) is regarded as the third wave after the invention of personal computer and the Internet.
Through technological progress, the Internet has become an important way for people to communicate. In the future, the IoT technologies will enable objects to communicate with other objects, or human beings.
In other words, the Internet will not only become a bridge between human beings, but also between objects, or even between human beings and objects.
Future smart devices will be connected and shared across each other, changing how human beings live on a daily basis, and how enterprises operate.

Through the understanding of the worth and the tradition of the culture, the students might merge the cultural cultivation into their personal thinking.

description.zh: 數學是一種語言，藉著數學語言能與人溝通。數學是科學之母，在各領域被廣泛應用，它與我們的生活息息相關，它是抽象也是具體的。 如何讓數學與現實生活相結合，本課程將瞭解數學的起源與發展過程，進而體認數學對人類文明的提昇、生活品質的改善所作的貢獻。希望能提高同學學習的興趣，活用數學，使數學藝術化、生活化。
description.en: Mathematics is a special kind of language, through which people can communicate well with each other. Mathematics is the mother of science, and thus is widely applied in many fields of science. Mathematics-abstract as well as concrete--is closely related with our life.  How can we merge mathematics into our daily life? We will try to understand the origin and development of mathematics, the way how mathematics helps to advance human civilization as well as how mathematics contributes to the better world. This course will interest the students, teach them how to make full use this kind of science and finally make mathematics more artistic and more useful in life.

syllabi.outline:
提到「數學」，除了從小到大的數學課之外，數學到底有什麼用？
事實上，在我們的日常生活中，數學無所不在，數字塞滿了我們的日常生活，例如:到7-11買東西、睡眠分鐘數、餐廳評分、看電影評分，BMI符合標準嗎? Instagram收到多少顆愛心? 還包括各種數據、績效、演算法，所以，數學不但與生活息息相關，數字也控制著我們每一天、深埋在我們的腦海中，甚至還影響到我們的心理層面，例如，當你聽到年齡的數字，就會覺得已經長大或是變老了，這就是數字所形成的心理年齡、個人認知。而且還不只如此，因為就連我們的人際關係、社會上的一切觀感，也都會無形中受到數字的影響。
這門課在課程設計上，是針對非數學系同學的學習需要，以深入淺出方式介紹日常生活中跟數學息息相關的生活大小事，讓同學了解數字頻率如何影響我們的頭腦與身體、思考與感受，甚至影響到你所做的每個決定，也讓同學能夠藉由數字的學習來解決生活中各種令人困擾的問題。
相信上完這門課之後，同學會發現----原來數學這麼好用!

name.en: An introduction to virology and unusual infectious agents

description.zh: 病毒可說是介於無生命和有生命之間的物質。它小至用光學顯微鏡看不見除非在電子顯微鏡下。儘管看不見卻無所不在，與人類關係異常密切。人類基因體約8%是從病毒來的。目前最難解決的傳染病問題也是由病毒引起。病毒結構看來似乎很簡單，但為了生存也進化出非凡的策略。人類從研究病毒得到非常多重要的知識和研究工具。讓我們能夠對分子、細胞和生物體的結構和功能得到更深地了解，進而對疾病問題得到解決。本課程將以深入簡出的方式讓同學認識病毒: 從病毒的起源，病毒如何進入宿主細胞與複製，並在宿主群體間存活和傳播所必須具備的機制。通過一系列較具代表性的人類病毒為例子進行介紹病毒複製的基礎、人類與病毒的相互作用以及如何導致疾病。同時認識人體4006的疫系統如何對抗病毒。了解為什麼新興病毒的出現並造成疫情。人類應如何應對。最後介紹兩種不尋常的傳染因子- 類病毒和狂牛病蛋白。它們與病毒似乎都是在生命起源中在化學演化時期殘留下來的分子。
description.en: This course will emphasize the mechanisms necessary for the virus to successfully enter and reproduce in the host cell, and survive and spread in the host population. Through a series of representative examples of human viruses, I will introduce the general basis of virus replication, the interaction between the virus and the host, and how these factors cause diseases and our immune system against virus. Finally, I will briefly introduce two unusual infectious agents- viroid and prion.

syllabi.outline:
病毒可說是介於無生命和有生命之間的物質。它小至用光學顯微鏡看不見除非在電子顯微鏡下。儘管看不見卻無所不在，與人類關係異常密切。人類基因體約8%是從病毒來的。目前最難解決的傳染病問題也是由病毒引起。病毒結構看來似乎很簡單，但為了生存也進化出非凡的策略。人類從研究病毒得到非常多重要的知識和研究工具。讓我們能夠對分子、細胞和生物體的結構和功能得到更深地了解，進而對疾病問題得到解決。本課程將以深入簡出的方式讓同學認識病毒: 從病毒的起源，病毒如何進入宿主細胞與複製，並在宿主群體間存活和傳播所必須具備的機制。通過一系列較具代表性的人類病毒為例子進行介紹病毒複製的基礎、人類與病毒的相互作用以及如何導致疾病。同時認識人的疫系統如何對抗病毒。了解為什麼新興病毒的出現並造成疫情。人類應如何應對。最後介紹兩種不尋常的傳染因子- 類病毒和狂牛病蛋白。它們與病毒似乎都是在生命起源中在化學演化時期殘留下來的分子。
Virus is between life and no-life substances. It is Invisible to the naked eye unless under an electron microscope. However, virus is existed everywhere and has a very close relationship with humans. 8% of the human genome comes from viruses. At present, the most difficult to solve infectious disease problem is caused by virus. Although the structure and composition seems simple, virus has evolved an extraordinary strategy for survival. Virology enable us to insight the structure and function of molecules, cells, and organisms. From studying virus, people has gained a lot of important knowledge and research tools, which help people solving disease problems. This course will emphasize the mechanisms necessary for the virus to successfully enter and reproduce in the host cell, and survive and spread in the host population. Through a series of representative examples of human viruses, I will introduce the general basis of virus replication, the interaction between the virus and the host,and how these factors cause diseases and our immune system against virus. Finally, I will briefly introduce two unusual infectious agents- viroid and prion.

description.zh: 新經濟與舊經濟的分野不是在有『e』還是沒有『e』，而是在有『i』還是沒有『i』，而『i』就是『Innovation，創新』。二十一世紀的『腦力經濟』最重要的戲規則就是『智慧財產權』，同時也是WTO會員國必須遵守的重要規範之一。課程內容主要包括三個最基本的智慧財產權課題：專利權，商標權，以及著作權；而為配合本校學生學科背景，本課程將較著重於『專利』方面的實務知識，並且講授『如何激發創意，以培養學生日後能好好應用『智慧財產權』的保護。
description.en: The difference between New-economy and Old-economy is not caused by having "e" or not having "e", but caused by owining "i" or not owning "i". where "I" means "Innovation:.  Intellectual Property is not only the most importance business rule of the :Brain economy era:, but also one of the most important agreements among WTO members.  This course includes the basic three subjects of Intellectual Property:Patent, Trademark, and Copyright.  In order to accommodate the learning background for most of NTUT students, the contents of this course will focus more on the practical practice of the Patennt.  In addition, it also includes the subject of "how to activate your creativeness:so as to make students can use what they learn, "Intellectual Property:, to protect their intellectual work.

syllabi.outline:
一、智慧財產權（IPR）近年來，為世界各國所重視。我國自從加入WTO以來，更與世界各國的智慧財產權之保護與取締，產生非常密切的連動，我國甚至為特別設立智慧財產權法院，專責處理智慧財產權的相關案件，其重要性可見一斑。
二、智慧財產權之法律，包括：著作權法、專利法、商標法營業秘密法、植物品種及種苗法、公平交易法等。上開法律雖有各別獨特的法理，我國採各別獨立立法，但相關法律間卻又關係密切，是以全盤整體的了解，有其必要性。
三、智慧財產權法的了解，為現代公民所必備，更是日後職場生涯應具備的法律知識，期能透過本課程讓同學一窺法律的不同面貌，並增進相關基礎能力。

description.zh: 面對各種數位化革新技術浪潮的衝擊，零售業者必須置入各項智能科技進行數位行銷與商業模式的開發，例如零售業者使用無人商店、智能支付系統、擴增/虛擬實境、元宇宙、物聯網 (IoT)、消費數據分析、人工智慧 (AI)、機器學習等先進技術，將傳統零售環境轉變為更智慧、更便捷、更個性化的消費體驗。甚至利用這些新興數位科技與和數據資源實踐零售業態的升級和轉型，進而不斷涌現出新型業態和新型商業模式的品牌體驗與管理。據此，本課程將以介紹當代智慧零售個案為主軸，介紹智慧零售實務的同時，也帶出其背後運作的主要理論基礎，藉此以促進實務與理論並重的學習效益。
description.en: Faced with the impact of various digital innovation waves, retailers must integrate various smart technologies to develop digital marketing and business models. For example, retailers use advanced technologies such as unmanned retail stores, smart payment systems, augmented/virtual reality, the metaverse, the Internet of Things (IoT), consumption data analysis, artificial intelligence (AI), and machine learning to transform the traditional retail environment into more intelligent, more convenient and more personalized consumption experience. Retailers use these emerging digital technologies and data resources to implement retail upgrading and transformation and then emerge with new business models for brand experience and management. Accordingly, this course will focus on introducing contemporary smart retail cases. Introducing smart retail cases will also bring out the main theoretical foundations, resulting in learning benefits that emphasize practice and theory.

description.en: This course introduces principles and techniques of thermal management and cooling design of electronic equipments.  Subjects of this course include: thermal and physical properties of electronic components, thermo-fluid phenomena and principles of thermal management for electronic devices, and the evolution of cooling devices such as heat pipes and micro fans, discussion of analysis methodologies and computer software of thermal management problems including thermal resistances, temperature gradient, and thermal stress.

description.zh: 實驗是進行科學與工程研究不可或缺的工具，實驗方法的設計與實驗數據的分析更是決定實驗結果品質優劣的關鍵，本課程將介紹實驗過程所必須具備的各項知識，以數據的量測與分析為開始，並介紹量測各類物理量的感測元件，如壓力、溫度、流量及聲波等，以建立學生具備實驗量測的基礎。課程主要內容包含有基本量測、量測標準、量測單位、訊號讀取、資料簡報、數據的準確性與變異性、類比訊號量測、數位訊號量測、系統響應、感測器。
description.en:
Introduction of Experiment and Measurement Method
Experiment is the essential tool for the research of science and engineering. The design of experiment and the analysis of data are the keys of the high quality of experiment. The course will introduce the materials of experiment and measurement. The procedures of measurement and the analysis method of data will be detailed investigated. And then the sensors to measure the interested physical parameters of pressure, temperature, flow rate and acoustic will be introduced. The technology of measurement and analysis of experiment will be built up in the course. The contents of the course are basic measurement, standards of measurement, dimension of measurement, access data, data presentation, accuracy and uncertainty of data, analog signal measurement, digital signal measurement, system response, and sensors.

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意。膜披覆製程是近年來高科技產業技術一項前途被看好的製程技術之一，廣用於刀具、模具、光學元件、感測器及半導體工業等等。此門課程將提供此項技術之介紹、相關配備、原理與能量提供方式、將包括：沉積技術與應用、化學氣相沉積法、物理氣相沉積法、電鍍技術、真空工程、直流電源、射頻電源、微波、熱燈絲等各種能量介紹、以及膜的成核與生長理論。
description.en: The technology of films coating has advanced dramatically. This advancement was driven primarily by the need for new products and devices in the electronics and optical industries etc.. The rapid progress in various devices would not have been possible without the development of new files coating technology, improved film characteristic and superior file qualities. This course is intended to serve us a guide for the student or practitioner in the field, as a review and overview of this rapidly evolving technology for the graduate students in several branches of science and engineering.

syllabi.outline:
鍍膜製程為近代製造業廣泛利用之表面處理技術，常用於刀具、模具、光學元件、感測器及半導體裝置等。本課程提供物理、化學法鍍膜技術之原理、設備之介紹。並講述膜成核、生長理論與近代薄膜科技於能源、光電、生醫與環境領域之應用。
Film deposition process, a surface treatment technology, has been widely used in modern manufacturing. It is commonly applied in the development of cutters, molds, optical component, sensor and semiconductor devices, etc. This course provides an introduction regarding the basic principle and apparatus of the coating technology (physical and chemical routes). Besides, the film nucleation, growth theory and their applications in energy, optoelectronic, biomedical and environmental fields are described as well.

description.en: It is a fundamental course concerning the theories of robotic manipulators. Topics contain frame transformations, manipulator kinematics, inverse kinematics, dynamics, trajectory planning, manipulator design, control of manipulators, robot programming languages.

syllabi.outline: 使同學們瞭解手臂機器人的運動學分析方式、軌跡運動技術、動態系統分析與力量控制方式等，作為深入機器人技術研究與應用的學習。課程首先簡介各種固定式機械臂機器人的可能架構與產業應用，當同學們對機器人技術有適當的概念後，可進入細部技術的介紹：運動學分析、動力學分析、動態控制器設計與分析、路徑與軌跡規劃等。

description.zh: 課程內容包括：課程分為三部分，第一、接合技術之基礎：材料表面結構和接合力學。第二、介紹一般工程用接合技術：機械接合、銲接、銲接冶金、軟硬銲、金屬-陶瓷接合、擴散鍵結、和膠合。第三、接合應用：真空系統和微電子接合和密封結構介紹。
description.en: This course is divided into three sections. The first three chapters deal with those chapters which are the principles of joining, including: Introduction, Surface science, and The mechanics of joining. The next six chapters describe the engineering options currently available for the joining and assembly of the components of an engineering system, including: Mechanical bonding, Welding, Welding Metallurgy, Soldering & Brazing, Metal-Ceramic Joints & Diffusion Bonding, Adhesives, and Structural Adhesives. The last two chapters take two areas of special interest, vacuum system and microelectronics, and survey the range of resolutions to joining problems which have been developed for these specific application.

description.zh: 3D列印（英語：3D printing），又稱加法製造、積層製造（Additive Manufacturing，AM），可指任何列印三維物體的過程。3D列印主要是一個不斷添加的過程，在電腦控制下層疊原材料。3D列印的內容可以來源於三維模型或其他電子資料，其列印出的三維物體可以擁有任何形狀和幾何特徵。本課程將介紹其原理及配合實機操作，使學生能對3D列印技術有正確的認識。(本課程鼓勵學生參加經濟部iPas的3D列印工程師考試)
description.en: 3D printing, also known as additive manufacturing (AM), refers to processes used to create a three-dimensional object in which successive layers of material are formed under computer control to create an object. Objects can be of almost any shape or geometry and are produced using digital model data from a 3D model or another electronic data. This course will introduce the principle knowledge of 3D printing and giving the opportunity to practice the use of 3D Printing.

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹有效研發/創新管理的概念、原則、與標準，這些概念、原則與標準將成為知識密集型的組織與企業的關鍵競爭優勢。本課程將介紹一些相關企業個案和練習活動，用以連結國家、產業和企業的研發或創新活動，並選定方法和工具進行有效的整合功能、企業業務、研發和創新活動。
description.en: This course is intended to introduce the concepts, principles, and standards for effective R&D/innovation management that is becoming the critical competitive advantages for the knowledge-intensive organizations and firms. The course will introduce a number of related cases and exercises with a view to bridge the national, industrial and corporate R&D/innovation activities, along with the presentation of selected approaches, methods and tools to effectively integrate functional, business and corporate R&D and innovation activities as a whole.

name.zh: 數位轉型與創新商業模式
name.en: Digital Transformation and Innovative Business Models

description.zh: 本課程在於協助同學了解數位轉型的浪潮趨勢，以及適應新科技所改變的商業模式。課程將介紹創新的商業模式例如共享經濟、金融科技、線上至離線、使用者生成內容等平台模式應用。每個模式將會連結到實務中企業個案，以協助同學進一步深入了解與分析創新的模式概念。本課程將涵蓋數位轉型與創新模式的基本概念，以數位轉型與科技適應角度，透過實務案例來了解創新商業模式。
description.en: This course aims to help students understand the trend of digital transformation and technology adaption in business models. The innovative business models will be introduced such as sharing economy, FinTech, online-to-offline, user-generated content, and so on. The matched cases will be selected to elaborate and analyze the innovative business models. This course will provide comprehensive knowledge of innovative business models by digital transformation and technology adaption (information and communication technology).

syllabi.outline:
This course aims to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of digital transformation and its impact on business models. Students will explore how emerging technologies are reshaping industries and driving innovation in business strategies. Through case studies, practical exercises, and theoretical frameworks, participants will learn to analyze, design, and implement digital transformation initiatives that align with organizational goals. The course will also focus on developing students' ability to apply digital twin technologies to enhance value creation, competitiveness, and customer engagement through innovative business models.
本課程旨在教授學生可以全面了解數位轉型及其對商業模式影響的知識。學生將探討新興技術如何重塑產業並推動創新的商業策略中。透過個案研究、實際操作和理論框架，學生將學習如何分析、設計和實施符合個案公司目標的數位轉型計劃。課程還將著重培養學生應用數位雙生之技術，以創建運用數位技術提升價值創造、競爭力和客戶參與度的創新商業模式。

description.en: Degree of Freedom, (2D and 3D) Kinematic Analysis, Springs, Dampers, Force Analysis, Compliance, Computer Aided Analysis and Design of Suspension Systems.

syllabi.outline:
這是一門和「車輛動力學」相關之應用性課程，主要係論述懸吊機構之幾何特徵如何影響車輛的動態行為。內容包括利用機構學之自由度分析歸納出所有懸吊系統的種類、利用瞬心法分析懸吊機構之幾何特徵和車輛轉向特性(轉向不足、轉向過度)的關係。
接著利用靜力學的概念分析路面作用於輪胎上的力量(縱向力、轉彎力和荷重)如何藉由懸吊機構傳遞至車身，以及懸吊機構的設計對於輪胎荷重變化的影響等。最後則說明如何在兼顧車輛舒適性和操控性下，有程序的執行彈簧剛性的設計。

description.zh: UX（User Experience）使用者經驗設計師，是一種特別需要橫向與縱向技能的設計師。本課程從物件 (objects) 、流程 (processes)、體驗 (experiences)、敘事(narratives) 四個不同的脈絡切面，讓學生了解使用者經驗設計師的必備知識、技能與工具。並隨著生成式AI的趨勢，介紹生成式AI如何輔助UX設計師進行使用者研究與設計。同時，培養學生未來能在特定專業領域持續發展使用者體驗設計師職能的視野和態度，以及UX設計師在職場上的角色定位。 學生將學會結合使用者研究的質性和量化方法及其工具來塑造實體與數位產品或服務的資訊架構。此外，他們將掌握如何利用簡報和視覺化溝通來促進組織內的設計決策。課程將涵蓋UX、LEAN UX、Agile UX與Scrum等不同設計開發流程的實踐。學生也會學習Prototype設計規劃與實施易用性測試，使用實體與遠端工具。課程中也將介紹如何運用生成式AI輔助UX研究與設計。
description.en: UX (User Experience) designers require both broad and specialized skills. This course provides students with a comprehensive understanding of the necessary knowledge, skills, and tools for UX designers through the context of four different aspects: objects, processes, experiences, and narratives. Students will learn to integrate qualitative and quantitative user research methods and tools to shape the information architecture of both physical and digital products or services. Additionally, they will master how to use presentations and visual communication to facilitate organizational design decisions. The course covers practical processes of various design development workflows, such as UX, LEAN UX, Agile UX, and Scrum. Students will also learn prototype design planning and how to conduct usability testing with both physical and remote tools. The course will also illustrate the use of generative AI in assisting UX research and design.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在為有志於成為 UX 設計師的學生提供全面而實用的學習體驗。學生將深入了解 UX 設計的理論基礎，掌握實用技能，並獲得寶貴的實踐經驗。學生將透過完成一個綜合性專案來展示他們的學習成果。這個課程將涵蓋從使用者研究研究到最終設計的整個 UX 設計流程。

學生將學習：
1. 理解 UX 設計師的角色、職責及其在產品開發中的重要性
2. 掌握使用者研究研究、資訊架構、原型設計等核心 UX 設計技能
3. 運用設計思考方法解決複雜的使用者研究體驗問題
4. 熟練使用行業標準的 UX 設計工具和技術
5. 理解並應用 UX 設計的最佳實踐和設計模式
6. 策劃和執行有效的可用性測試，並基於結果進行設計迭代
7. 了解 UX 設計在敏捷開發環境中的應用
8. 探索生成式 AI 在 UX 設計中的應用及未來趨勢

---
This course is designed to provide a comprehensive and practical learning experience for students aspiring to become UX designers. Students will gain an in-depth understanding of the theoretical foundations of UX design, acquire practical skills, and gain valuable practical experience. Students will demonstrate their learning by completing a comprehensive project. This project will cover the entire UX design process from user research research to final design, providing students with a practical case that can be incorporated into their professional portfolio.

Students will learn:
1. Understand the role, responsibilities and importance of UX designers in product development
2. Master core UX design skills such as user research, information architecture, and prototype design
3. Use design thinking methods to solve complex user research experience problems
4. Proficient in using industry-standard UX design tools and techniques
5. Understand and apply UX design best practices and design patterns
6. Plan and execute effective usability testing and conduct design iterations based on the results
7. Understand the application of UX design in agile development environments
8. Explore the application and future trends of generative AI in UX design

description.zh:
UX（User Experience）使用者經驗設計師，是一種特別需要橫向與縱向技能的設計師。本課程從物件 (objects) 、流程 (processes)、體驗 (experiences)、敘事 (narratives) 四個不同的脈絡切面，讓學生了解使用者經驗設計師的必備知識、技能與工具。學生將學會結合使用者研究的質性和量化方法及其工具來塑造實體與數位產品或服務的資訊架構。另一方面，本課程也深入探討UX於學術研究上的趨勢，讓學術與實務層面兼備。
此外，學生將掌握如何利用簡報和視覺化溝通來促進組織內的設計決策，並學習Prototype設計規劃與實施易用性測試，使用實體與遠端工具。課程中也將介紹如何運用生成式AI輔助UX研究與設計。
description.en: User experience designers are designers who particularly require horizontal and vertical skills. This course allows students to understand the necessary knowledge, skills, and tools of user experience designers from four different aspects: objects, processes, experiences, and narratives. Students will learn to combine qualitative and quantitative methods and tools of user research to shape the information architecture of physical and digital products or services. In addition, students will master how to use briefings and visual communication to promote design decisions within the organization and learn to prototype design planning and implement usability testing using physical and remote tools. The course will also introduce how to use generative AI to assist UX research and design. On the other hand, this course also profoundly explores the trends of UX in academic research, integrating both academic and practical aspects.

syllabi.outline:
The "User Experience Research and Practice" course is designed to equip master's students with comprehensive UX design knowledge and practical skills. By utilizing an open-access online textbook, the course covers a broad spectrum of topics, from the fundamentals of interaction design to cutting-edge subjects. Through reading, reflection, and class presentations, students will explore key areas of UX design, including human-computer interaction, visual design, affective computing, and usability evaluation. The course emphasizes the integration of theory and practice, encouraging students to apply concepts from the textbook to real-world design challenges.

A distinctive feature of the course is integrating interdisciplinary knowledge from fields such as neuroscience, anthropology, and philosophy into UX design. Students will learn to apply theoretical frameworks like phenomenology and semiotics to deepen their understanding of user experience and translate these insights into innovative design solutions. The course also covers emerging areas like social computing and open-user innovation, providing students with a broader perspective on the societal implications and opportunities within UX design. Ultimately, this course aims to develop UX professionals with critical thinking, innovative spirit, and interdisciplinary perspectives, ready to create products and services that meet user needs and drive technological and societal progress.

Students will learn…
1. Master core UX design theories and apply interdisciplinary knowledge to solve complex design problems.
2. Utilize various UX research methods, such as contextual design and user story mapping.
3. Integrate theories from neuroscience and phenomenology to deepen the understanding of user experience and design.
4. Learn techniques to evaluate and measure user experience, optimizing design solutions and decision-making processes.
5. Explore emerging UX fields like social computing and open innovation to expand design perspectives.
6. Cultivate critical thinking by integrating UX design into broader social and technological contexts.

description.zh: 本課程以實踐機器人和人工智慧應用為核心，採用美國麻省理工學院（MIT）的專案任務導向學習模式。透過結合講授、討論、實際應用和案例分析，課程將會幫助學生深入理解人工智慧和機器人技術。學生有機會積極參與小組項目，透過情境思考實際應用所學知識，並親自操作機器學習工具和機器人平台，以培養實際技能。
description.en: This course is designed for the practical application of robotics and artificial intelligence (AI). It adopts the project-based learning model inspired by the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT). The course combines lectures, discussions, and case studies to give students an in-depth understanding of AI technology and robotic applications. Students can engage in group projects, apply their knowledge in real-world scenarios, and gain hands-on experience with machine learning tools and mobile robot platforms.

課程大綱: 
這是個由麻省理工學院教授所設計的課程。同學們將循序漸進的了解機器人作業系統與AI的運用。本課堂業界最先進的四足機器人——波士頓動力公司研發的AI狗, Spot。透過這堂課程，學員將了解最新的AI技術。透過AI狗的運作原理、相關機構設計，馬達設計，機電架構，高階控制軟體。課程將提供最新的SPOT軟體與API的運用。同學們將不僅有機會親手操作SPOT，還將為SPOT開發各類自動控制與AI應用。

機器人的控制軟體ROS2將隨著機器人的普及越來越重要。ROS2涵蓋各式傳感器的運用，如LiDAR、Radar、IMU、相機等機器人領域的硬體。ROS2也是很多高階機器人運用的標準，如地圖建構、定位、導航，路徑規劃，模擬工具，AI影像辨識與機器學習等應用。透過小組協作，Spot實機操作與課程互動。課程結束後同學能具備ROS2的基礎知識，並期許能整合AI機器人相關技術，將上課習得的知識需轉化成解決問題的技能。挖掘知識如何應用。

description.zh: 當代都市議題經常為跨領域、開放性的複雜問題，在資料蒐集與分析上，需要整合地理空間、時間的維度；在分析與對策上，須平衡公部門、私部門、民眾等多重利害關係者的，是一門相當複雜但重要的學問。本課程從真實的都市議題出發，教導學生掌握地理空間資訊、資料分析、資料建模、資訊視覺化、策略論述等綜合能力，培養學生對於都市複雜議題的觀察與剖析，進而對真實環境提出洞見與創意。
description.en: Contemporary urban issues are complex, requiring the integration of geographical, and temporal dimensions in data collection and analysis. Balancing the interests of stakeholders like the public, and private sectors is crucial. This course focuses on real urban issues, teaching skills in geographical information, data analysis, modeling, visualization, and strategic discourse. It aims to cultivate students' ability to observe, analyze urban issues, and propose insights for real environments. It's an advanced course, requiring basic programming and GIS concepts. Through group projects, students learn API usage, geographic computation, model building, and data visualization. The course includes one midterm report and one final project report.

description.en: This course is designed to delve into the transformative role of artificial intelligence (AI) robots in shaping the future of urban development. Participants will gain foundational knowledge in robotics, engaging in hands-on projects, experiments, and collaborative efforts to pinpoint and tackle urban challenges. Through the creation of robotic prototypes, students will not only devise innovative solutions but also learn the practical application of their theoretical knowledge to real-world problems. This curriculum encourages a deep understanding of how AI can contribute positively to urban environments, equipping students with the skills to make impactful changes in the field of urban development.

description.zh:
使用 Unity 3D 建立專業的  VR/AR/MR   應用程序，Unity 3D 是一款功能強大的跨平台 3D 引擎，可提供用戶友好的開發環境。 在本課程中，學生將學習如何從頭開始建立 VR 引擎，以便學生充分了解從 3D 模型到 VR 顯示器中的像素的整個3 D圖形顯現管道。 學生還將學習如何在 Unity 中實現最重要的 VR 互動概念，例如選擇、操作、旅行、尋路、選單和文字輸入。

學生在本課程中學到的  VR/AR/MR   程式設計知識將有助於學生編寫  VR/AR/MR   遊戲、建築演練、工程模擬、3D 數據檢視器、醫療培訓應用程式等。
description.en:
Build professional VR/AR/MR apps using Unity 3D, a powerful cross-platform 3D engine that provides a user-friendly development environment. In this course, students will learn how to build a VR engine from the ground up, so students fully understand the entire rendering pipeline from 3D model to pixels in the VR display. Students will also learn how to implement the most important VR interaction concepts such as selection, manipulation, travel, wayfinding, menus, and text input in Unity.

What students learn about  VR/AR/MR   programming in this course will help students write  VR/AR/MR   games, architectural walkthroughs, engineering simulations, 3D data viewers, medical training applications, and many more.

name.zh: 計算生物學及醫學資訊

description.zh: 本課程主要教授與計算生物學及醫學資訊學相關之重要主題。 學生能夠了解如何正確分析生物和醫學數據所衍伸的問題及應用。 希望透過課程協助同學了解和學習如何組裝基因體資料和醫學數據分析中經常使用的演算法技術內容，閱讀最新相關生醫技術論文及使用開放工具，增進實際操作之經驗或自行建構分析生醫相關資料之應用系統。
description.en: This course is designed to provide important topics in computational biology and medical informatics. Students are able to learn about problems involved in the generation and analysis of biological and medical data. The course intends to provide good understanding of the commonly used algorithms and public tools in the analysis of genomic and medical data, to read updated scientific reports, and to increase hands-on experiences with accessing and using relevant databases.

syllabi.outline:
本課程主旨在介紹計算生物學及醫學資訊學相關之重要主題，目的在於提供學生漸進式的介紹，理解當代最新之各項生醫分析技術。本課程主要為有志於跨領域學習之學生所設計，內容包含基礎生物學的核心知識與基礎Linux操作，以及生醫領域的經典演算法、常用資料庫與工具的介紹，奠定基礎後開始進入次世代分析技術的應用，主題將包含DNA定序、RNA定序與總體基因體學分析。希望透過這些內容讓學生在分析各種基因資料之前，先了解這些分子在細胞和個體中的重要性。接著，透過研究實例和分析操作，讓學生接觸到實際實驗測量產生的數據，體會真實研究的過程。藉由實際操作相關分析工具，使學生體會基因數據在實務上的重要性，達到將生物理論與實務應用緊密結合的目標。
This course aims to introduce important topics related to computational biology and medical informatics. The objective is to provide students with a gradual introduction to understanding the latest contemporary biomedical analysis techniques. This course is primarily designed for students interested in interdisciplinary learning. The content includes concept knowledge of basic biology, fundamental Linux operations, classic algorithms in the biomedical field, and introductions to commonly used databases and tools. After establishing this foundation, the course will progress to the application of next-generation sequencing technology, covering topics such as DNA sequencing, RNA sequencing, and metagenomics analysis. The goal is to help students understand the importance of these molecules in cells and organisms before analyzing various genetic data. Subsequently, through research case studies and analytical operations, students will engage with data generated from actual experimental measurements, experiencing the real research process. Through the actual application of relevant analytical tools, students will have a comprehensive understanding of the process of interpreting genetic data. This will enable them to integrate biological theory with real-world scenarios effectively.

description.en: Gamification is a technique that can stimulate users’ motivation and engagement in various non-game contexts such as education, business, health, workplace, and so on. This course is divided into two parts. The first part provides the theoretical background, consisting of the gamification definition/taxonomy, and behavioral design. In the second part of this course, students will organize a participatory design workshop to gain insights from the stakeholders to develop delightful products and services based on game mechanics.

syllabi.outline: Gamification is a technique that can stimulate users’ motivation and engagement in various non-game contexts such as education, business, health, workplace, and so on. This course is divided into two parts. The first part provides the theoretical background, consisting of the gamification definition/taxonomy, and behavioral design. In the second part of this course, students will organize a participatory design workshop to gain insights from the stakeholders to develop a gamified product, service, or system that are fun, engaging, and rewarding.

Week	Topics
1	Course objective, structure, syllabus, and grading
2	Introduction: Why gamification 	
3	Theoretical basics	
4	Individual presentation: Case studies in game applications 	
5	PART I: Examine the real-world gamification examples
6	Discussion: Intrinsic extrinsic rewards	
7	The core drives of gamification 
8	Gamification mechanic and elements 	
9	PART II: Develop design project proposal 	
10	Discussion: Player’s journey	
11	Discussion: Player’s type
12	Group presentation 
13	YODEX young designers' exhibition 
14	Discussion: Social good and behavior change	
15	Discussion: Onboarding and offboarding
16	Discussion: Ethical issues in gamification  
17	Discussion: Reflecting on the design framework 
18	Final video and group presentation

Please note that the course schedule is subject to change based on the instructor's discretion, students' progress, and specific class dynamics.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的在促進學生進一步瞭解檔案策展與加值應用之概念與方法，並著重於檔案典藏單位及其所典藏檔案之展示規劃及應用。透過本課程之授課內容，學生可培養以下幾個能力：（1）認識檔案策展之基本概念；（2）理解檔案加值應用之原則與倫理；（3）具備檔案評估、規劃及檔案資料應用之專業素養。
description.en: This course will introduce the basic concepts and practical issues in archives curating and value added. And then, focus on the exhibition planning and application of archives and archival material. By attending the class students will: (1) Understand basic concepts and methods of archives curation. (2) Gain in-deep understanding the principles and ethics of archives value added. (3) Possess the archival intelligence to use, evaluate and curate the archival material.

name.en: English Communication and Application I (ECA Courses)

description.zh: ECA 課程專為大一非英語母語的學生設計，加強英語語言技能，特別強調溝通能力和社會、文化、及專業實務應用。 通過整合四種語言技巧能力（閱讀、聽力、口語和寫作），將課堂英語文教學連結至與實務溝通情境之英語文使用。以下為課程設計及教學法之主軸：溝通語言教學（CLT）、任務型導向（TBL）和內容導向教學（CBI），培養學生的英語語言能力為進階專業英文之基礎。
description.en: The ECA courses are designed for the first-year (freshman), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English language skills, with particular emphasis on communicative competence and practical application in social, cultural and professional contexts. By integrating the four skills (reading, listening, speaking and writing), the primary objective is to connect the classroom ELT with the real-life communicative situations. To that end, the courses adopt the following approaches: communicative language teaching (CLT), task-based learning (TBL), and content-based instruction (CBI), building a holistic pedagogy to English instruction and developing students’ English language proficiency for the next level ESP courses.

description.en: The ECA courses are designed for the first-year (freshman), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English language skills, with particular emphasis on communicative competence and practical application in social, cultural and professional contexts. By integrating the four skills (reading, listening, speaking and writing), the primary objective is to connect the classroom ELT with the real-life communicative situations. To that end, the courses adopt the following approaches: communicative language teaching (CLT), task-based learning (TBL), and content-based instruction (CBI), building a holistic pedagogy to English instruction and developing students’ English language proficiency for the next level ESP courses.

description.en: The ECA courses are designed for the first-year (freshman), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English language skills, with particular emphasis on communicative competence and practical application in social, cultural and professional contexts. By integrating the four skills (reading, listening, speaking and writing), the primary objective is to connect the classroom ELT with the real-life communicative situations. To that end, the courses adopt the following approaches: communicative language teaching (CLT), task-based learning (TBL), and content-based instruction (CBI), building a holistic pedagogy to English instruction and developing students’ English language proficiency for the next level ESP courses.

syllabi.outline:
課程重點：(1)藉由適合其程度的教材加強學生必備的基礎文法觀念和句型結構；(2)使學生確切把握閱讀要領以及充分瞭解寫作的各種技巧，重心在生字、片語、句法的解釋和基本寫作技巧的分析；(3)熟悉英語人士日常生活情境及與學生將來就業環境相關之會話及適當之應對方式；(4)透過練習加強聽、說、讀、寫的知能及表達。
This course is designed (1) to strengthen students' previously required knowledge in English with basic grammatical ideas and sentence patterns reviewed through reading materials appropriate to their levels; (2) to develop reading skill by giving explanation of difficult words, phrases, and syntax, as well as analysis of basic writing skill; (3)to  familiarize students with useful expressions in conversation and build up their confidence in cross-cultural communication; (4)to reinforce the competence and performance of listening, speaking, reading and writing by practice.

name.en: Basic English Reading and Vocabulary I

description.zh: 本課程著重教導學生閱讀文章，並藉由文章訓練學生字彙建構、語言解析及聽力會話、思維啟發能力。課中延展活動將閱讀內容與聽力、會話、寫作做進一步的連結，並引導學生將所學做有效的應用。
description.en: The course provides students with explicit skills-based instruction in learning how to process, and decipher the readings that serve as springboards for reading skills development, vocabulary building, language analysis, and thought-provoking discussions. The readings include a variety of viewpoints on global topics centered around social issues, the environment, psychology, business, and technology. Extension activities are designed to encourage students to go beyond the reading text, and to put what they acquire from the readings into listening, speaking and writing practices.

description.zh: 本課程提供學生及職前專業人士必備之英語文語言技巧，強調機電專業領域之英文溝通能力之訓練。課程內容依學院專業內容區分並整合英語文之聽說讀寫之能力為未來全球化移動及以英語專業溝通人才培育為目標。
description.en: This course aims to provide pre-service Mechanical & Electrical Engineering students/professionals with the adequate skills of the English language and communicative competence to facilitate their current academic and future career pursuits. Students are encouraged to utilize their domain expertise to participate in professional communication in English. Centered on the training of professional use of the English language, the ESP curriculum as the crux of a highly-integrated work of domain knowledge and the English learning development embodies the indispensable credentials required for a global profession.

syllabi.outline: This course aims to develop students’ reading and speaking abilities in the fields of science, technology and engineering. The course will be focusing on reading strategies, communication skills and vocabulary building. Selected readings will be centered around science, technology, and engineering. Extension activities are designed to improve students’ technical English skills to be used in the fields of science, technology, and engineering. Class activities include class discussion, group discussion, presentation and so on. Students are required to express their thoughts in English during the class.

description.zh: 本課程旨在帶領學生讀、理解並分析國際時事,提高學生之英文能力，透過對多元主體之解析，讓學生了解單字用法，句型結構，特殊術語和慣用俚語等，提升閱讀能力，另外配合聽力技巧學習，提升理解能力。本課程著重英文閱讀，聽力與口說能力，鼓勵學生以英文討論國際時事，發表見解，拓展對世界的認識。
description.en: This course intends to enhance students’ reading, speaking and listening abilities by using quality newspapers, journals, interviews and podcast. It will help students enrich their vocabulary and acquire key English expressions and sentence patterns used in different realms like politics, arts, entertainment, science & technology, sports, business and health. Students learn to read, discuss and debate global issues through diverse forms of activities. This course familiarizes students with world affairs and broadens their perspective of the world.

description.en: This course is designed for students who are interested in improving English skills in the field of information technology. It aims to increase students’ reading fluency and improve their speaking skills needed to function and succeed in classroom settings and in future career. Students will discuss topics, such as artificial intelligence and the World Wide Web, in order to expand vocabulary and language skills.

syllabi.schedule:
Week 1-2: Introduction to Business Communication
Topic: Professional Business Communication
Objectives: Understand basic concepts and the importance of business communication.
Reading: Book 1, Chapter 1: Professional Business Communication
Activities: 
- Watch an introductory video on business communication.
- Group discussion on the importance of communication in business.
Task: 
- Read and summarize sections on communication components and responsibilities.
- Write a short essay on the role of communication in business.

Week 3-4: Verbal and Nonverbal Communication in Business
Topic: Effective Verbal and Nonverbal Communication
Objectives: 
- Learn principles of verbal and nonverbal communication.
- Identify obstacles to effective communication and ways to overcome them.
Reading:
- Book 1, Chapter 2: Delivering Your Message
- Book 1, Chapter 4: Nonverbal Communication
Activities:
- Listen to a podcast on effective communication.
- Watch examples of nonverbal communication in business settings.
- Role-play exercises to practice verbal and nonverbal communication.
Task: 
- Read and discuss the principles of verbal and nonverbal communication.
- Write a reflection on how to improve personal communication skills.

Week 5-6: Teamwork in Business
Topic: Group Communication and Teamwork
Objectives:
- Understand the importance of teamwork in business settings.
- Learn strategies for effective team communication and leadership.
Reading: Book 1, Chapter 11: Group Communication, Teamwork, and Leadership
Activities:
- Watch a video on effective teamwork.
- Group discussion on the benefits and challenges of teamwork.
Task: 
- Read and summarize key points on group communication and teamwork.
- Participate in a group activity to solve a business problem.

Week 7-8: Presentation Skills
Topic: Developing and Delivering Presentations
Objectives: Learn methods and strategies for creating and delivering effective presentations.
Reading: Book 1, Chapters 6-7: Developing Presentations, Presentations to Inform
Activities:
- Watch examples of effective business presentations.
- Practice delivering short presentations.
- Read and discuss strategies for successful presentations.
Task:
- Write a script for a business presentation.

Week 9-10: Midterm Presentation
Task: 
- Prepare and deliver a presentation on a chosen business communication topic.
- Submit a written report accompanying the presentation.

Week 11-12: Entrepreneurship Fundamentals
Topic: Entrepreneurial Mindset and Opportunity Recognition
Objectives: Understand the entrepreneurial mindset and identify business opportunities.
Reading: 
- Book 2, Chapters 1: The Entrepreneurial Perspective, Creativity, Innovation, and Invention 
- Book 2, Chapters 4-5: Identifying Entrepreneurial Opportunity
Activities:
- Listen to an entrepreneur's story or interview.
- Group discussion on creativity and innovation in business.
Task: 
- Read and summarize sections on the entrepreneurial mindset and opportunity.
- Write a brief on a potential business opportunity.

Week 13-14: Entrepreneurial Marketing Strategies
Topic: Entrepreneurial Marketing and Sales
Objectives: Learn fundamental marketing and sales strategies for entrepreneurs.
Reading: Book 2, Chapter 8: Entrepreneurial Marketing and Sales
Activities:
- Watch a video on effective marketing strategies.
- Group activity to design a marketing plan for a new product.
- Read and discuss different marketing techniques.
Task: 
- Write a marketing strategy for a hypothetical business.

Week 15-16: Introduction to Business Plans
Topic: Business Planning Essentials
Objectives:
- Understand the basic structure and purpose of a business plan.
- Learn to write simple sections of a business plan.
Reading: Book 2, Chapter 11: Business Model and Plan (Select sections)
- Introduction
syllabi.assessment:
- 11.1: Avoiding the “Field of Dreams” Approach
- 11.2: Designing the Business Model (First few paragraphs)
- 11.4: The Business Plan (Focus on the overview and structure of a business plan)
Activities:
- Watch a short video explaining the basics of a business plan.
- Group discussion on the importance of business planning.
- Read and discuss the simplified sections on business models and plans.
- Group activity to outline a simple business plan for a hypothetical business.
Task: 
- Write a summary of each section of the business plan.

Week 17-18: Final Presentation
Task: 
- Prepare and deliver a final business plan presentation.
- Submit a detailed written business plan.

description.zh: 每天許多人規律運動、觀賞及討論賽事，若具備暢談體育以及運動相關俚語的英文能力，將十分有益於與英語人士交流。本課程將介紹學生適用於體育以及其他社交場合的英語單字（包含許多用於職場專業場合、不同於字面意思的運動俚語）。本課程能幫助學生更清楚地理解英語體育新聞、更周全地與英語人士談論體育、用更加批判性的思維來思考運動在英語世界的文化、語言、日常生活中扮演著怎樣重要的角色。
description.en: Because many people play, watch, and discuss sports every day, being able to talk about sports and to understand sports idioms is very helpful when interacting with English speakers. This course introduces students to English vocabulary that is useful for talking about sports, but also useful in other social situations. (For example, many sports idioms -- such as “to play hardball” and “to strike out” -- are used by businessmen in professional situations not directly related to sports).  The class helps students to understand more clearly English news about sports, to talk more thoughtfully with English speakers about sports, and to think more critically about the important role that sports play in the culture, language, and everyday life of people in the English-speaking world.

description.en: The course provides students with explicit skills-based instruction in learning how to process, and decipher the readings that serve as springboards for reading skills development, vocabulary building, language analysis, and thought-provoking discussions. Extension activities are designed to encourage students to go beyond the reading text, and to put what they acquire from the readings into listening, speaking and writing practices.

description.zh: 本課程旨在帶領具進階英文能力學生讀、理解並分析國際時事，提高學生之英文能力，透過對多元主體之解析，讓學生了解單字用法，句型結構，特殊術語和慣用俚語等，提升閱讀能力，另外配合聽力技巧學習，提升理解能力。本課程著重英文閱讀，聽力與口說能力，鼓勵學生以英文討論國際時事，發表見解，拓展對世界的認識。
description.en: This course intends to enhance students’ advanced-level reading, speaking and listening abilities by using quality newspapers, journals, interviews and podcast. It will help students enrich their vocabulary and acquire key English expressions and sentence patterns used in different realms like politics, arts, entertainment, science & technology, sports, business and health. Students learn to read, discuss and debate global issues through diverse forms of activities. This course familiarizes students with world affairs and broadens their perspective of the world.

syllabi.outline: This course aims to engage students in understanding current issues and events taking place in the world that are redefining our global reality and restructuring the world order. A greater goal of such studies of global issues and activities is to urge students to participate in the dialogues and actions to change and to make better of the world. The course content centers on reading, discussing and debating on selected reports and news to uphold all that matters for the aforementioned pursuits.
