syllabi.schedule:
Topic and Tentative Schedule: This class aims to have a balance between improving your professional speaking, writing, and grammar *in general* and providing you with particular vocabulary that will be useful to you. The units from American Headway, listed below, are advisory. I will assign additional homework in class. All listed assignments are due on the day they are listed. 

Course Introduction
Week 1: Unit One—American Headway: What makes us Human?
Please buy the American Headway 5 textbook before next week. Also, please make sure to have bought (and brought) your other class supplies. (See p. 1) Bring them each class each day.

Week 2: Unit One (cont.)
(As always, make sure to finish any listed assignments before you come to class.) 
Read “Why Clay Shirky Banned Laptops, Tablets and Phones from His Classroom” and do the related vocab homework (both are on MS Teams). Choose ten words from the vocabulary that you really want to learn and put a start next to them. Prepare, if time allows, “The Stages of Your Major” presentation.

Week 3: Unit One (cont.)
Present “The Stages of Your Major,” with costumes/props.

Week 4: First Reading/Viewing Groups (about something related to your major that you spend time on on your own—not in class) (Later presentations scheduled throughout the semester)

Week 5: Unit 2: In So Many Words (Accents and Grammar)

Week 6: Unit 2 (cont.)
Halloween Dialogs due

Week 7: Unit 3: Enough is Enough? (Sustainability) 

Week 8: Unit 3 (cont.)
Start-up company projects (in-class work).

Week 9: Midterm exam and Proficiency Test, Tuesday at 10:10 a.m. Please remember that you must bring your NTUT ID to the exam. Please remember that you cannot take the exam if you are more than twenty minutes late.

Week 10: Start-up company presentations 

Week 11: Start-up company interviews. 
Resume due. 
(An exam on units 1–3 may be given anytime between now and 12/7. I will keep you posted.) 

Week 12: Unit 4: Not All it Seems
Unit 4, cont./Sherlock Holmes/Deductions

Week 13: Unit 5 (Culture Clashes) and 6 (Fruits of War--things that have been designed during wars)

Week 14: Unit 5 continued/Unit 6: Fruits of War

Week 15: Unit 5/6 continued

description.en: The welding metallurgy course in the graduate program delves into metal welding techniques and metallurgical processes, cultivating students' expertise in material handling and welding technologies. The curriculum covers welding methods, selection of welding materials, heat-affected zones, metal structures and properties, welding defects, and incorporates real-world cases to enable students to comprehend and apply them in engineering practice.

name.zh: 科技發展與法律策略:案例研析二
name.en: Technology Development and Legal Strategy: Case Study(II)

description.zh: 在科技發展快速的年代，有些人認為產業和市場需要更多新的法律規範，也有些人認為舊有法律需要鬆綁。但無庸置疑地，法律在科技、產業與市場的發展中，扮演著一個攸關重要的角色。基於此，本課程嘗試以設計案例討論，鼓勵不同背景的學生，經由案例分析得到綜合性的知識、從中了解科技發展如何影響法律變遷，並進而學習專業的法律策略。
description.en: In an age of rapid technology advancement, some people might insist more laws are necessary to regulate the industry and the market, on the contrary, others might think de-regulation is the best approach to encourage the free flow of the market. Nonetheless, it is beyond question that law and regulations play an vital role in the technology-driven economy today. Therefore this course is designed to help students from various backgrounds to engage in the group discussions on assigned cases. Students are expected to learn how the technology development shapes the legal environment and learn how to analyze the legal strategies.

syllabi.outline: 在科技發展快速的年代，有些人認為產業和市場需要更多新的法律規範，也有些人認為舊有法律需要鬆綁。但無庸置疑地，法律在科技、產業與市場的發展中，扮演著一個攸關重要的角色。基於此，本課程嘗試以設計案例討論，鼓勵不同背景的學生，經由案例分析得到綜合性的知識、從中了解科技發展如何影響法律變遷，並進而學習專業的法律策略。事實上，本課程之進行，以中文講授為主，並使用中文課堂教材。

description.zh: 本課主旨在培養學生職場英語文溝通能力，如提案、企劃案提寫、時事討論、公司產品行銷、書信寫作，希冀能夠藉由本課程之修習，加強學生進入職場前的競爭力。
description.en: This course is designed to provide students with a firm foundation in business communication skills. Students will learn how to present a proposal, start a discussion, and promote company products in English. It is hoped that by the end of this course, students are equipped with sufficient knowledge of general and business English.

syllabi.outline:
通過“職場英文溝通”這門課，化英文單字能力，熟記字彙片語。除了拼寫及發音外，協助學生用單字片語，熟記字彙片語。除了拼寫及發音外，協助學生用單字片語造句。熟悉會話後，學生做角色扮演活動或課堂討論，增加師生互動機會。教師在課堂上指導學生分組搜集傳統產業現況，將實際職場情況融入于課堂學習。

嘗試從“商業溝通”角度，探討個人如何從溝通角度建造職場人完整的競爭籌碼，以溝通力創造個人職場價值與優勢，協助個人在職場不同角色扮演中，培養受人信任，溝通無礙的職場性格，建立屬於自己的職場口碑與競爭力。溝通是所有人與人之間互動與建立關係的基礎。商業溝通是職場成功的黃金武器；優質的溝通能力是職場人邁向成功舞臺的關鍵能力。

This course is designed to provide students with a firm foundation in business communication skills. Students will learn how to present a proposal, start a discussion, and promote company products in English. It is hoped that by the end of this course, students are equipped with sufficient knowledge of general and business English.

description.zh: 本課主旨在設計課程，提供練習，俾使學生嫻熟各式的英語測驗，如全民英檢、托福測驗、TOEIC 測驗或類似性質的測驗，希冀能夠藉由本課程的修習，提升學生不斷的學習外國語的興致，並且，藉由通過考試取得證照，增加未來職場的競爭力。
description.en: This course is designed to familiarize the students with various kinds of language proficiency tests such as GEPT, TOEFL, TOEIC and many others to the same end. It is our hope that the students who finish taking the course will go on with their enthusiasm on studying foreign languages; besides, through the acquisition of the certificate when the students pass the tests, they are sure to enhance their capability in the increasingly competitive job markets.

name.en: Special Topics in Molecular Cell Biology

description.zh: 本課程討論細胞培養與基因工程技術之原理與應用，課程內容包涵下列主題：(1) 微生物、植物、昆蟲及動物細胞之特性 (2)細胞於生物反應器的培養，包括各式生物反應器介紹、生物反應器動力學、生物反應器之操作與控制 (3)基因重組蛋白之表現，將包涵不同的細胞載体表現系統 (4)實例探討，如單株抗體、生物高分子材料、基因治療載体等之生產。
description.en: This course discusses the principle and applications of cell culture and molecular biology.  The course covers the following topics: (1) characteristics of microbial, plant, insect, and mammalian cells; (2) cell culture in bioreactors, including descriptions of bioreactor types, operation modes, bioreactor kinetics, and instrumentation and control; (3) expression of foreign genes in various cell systems; (4) case studies, such as production of monoclonal antibody, biopolymers, and gene therapy vectors.

syllabi.outline: 本課程介紹微生物細胞培養之技術與應用，課程內容涵蓋下列主題：(1)微生物細胞之結構與特性 (2)微生物的培養，包括各式生物反應器的介紹 (3)微生物的代謝 (4)微生物培養在工業上的應用 (5) 胺基酸與蛋白質(6) 酵素， 課程內容取材自教科書與期刊文獻

description.zh:
本課程主要係介紹資料壓縮的原理以及當前幾項重要的壓縮標準。
本課程內容將涵蓋以下主題
01. 霍夫曼編碼
02. 算數編碼
03. 純量量化與向量量化
04. 線性預測與預測編碼法（DPCM，ADPCM，JPEG-LS）
05. 轉換編碼（KLT，DFT，DCT，DST以及Walsh-Hadamard轉換）
06. 分頻編碼法（G.722 Speech coding，MPEG audio coding）
07. 小波編碼法（SPIHT，JPEG2000）
08. 字典模式編碼法
09. 跑長編碼法
10. 主題探討
description.en:
This course is mainly focused on the principles of data compression techniques as well as the state-of-the-art compression standards. The course content includes
01. Huffman codes
02. Arithmetic codes
03. Scalar quantization and Vector quantization
04. Linear prediction and Predictive coding（DPCM，ADPCM，JPEG-LS）
05. Transform coding（KLT, DFT, DCT, DST, and WHT）
06. Subband coding（G.722 Speech coding，MPEG audio coding）
07. Wavelet-Based Compression（SPIHT, JPEG2000）
08. Dictionary techniques
09. Runlength coding
10. Selected topics

本課程教授日語基礎語法，以期建立自學興趣與啟發閱讀日文資料之能力。前階段教授五十音、助詞、形容詞及動詞變化等基礎；後半階段將學習句型結構及產業界實務日文。本教學著重日語基礎之語法架構練習,學成後亦能自行取得日本新科技知識，語言是持續不斷的自我精進和與時俱進的學習,以期未來可廣泛應用於未來工作及日常生活中.

This course teaches Japanese basic grammar, in order to establish students' ability to read and understand Japanese technical articles. The first half of the course teaches Japanese syllabary, auxiliary words, adjectives and verb conjugations, and then introduces Japanese grammar structure, common sentence patterns, etc… Focusing on the concepts and methods necessary for Japanese reading so that students can still enhance themselves and apply in work and daily life to read instructions and manuals of equipment or products.

description.zh: 「太空軟體系統設計」課程旨在培養學生在太空任務中設計、開發和操作軟體系統的專業能力。學生將深入了解太空環境對軟體系統的特殊要求，包括真空、輻射、溫度等因素對系統性能的影響。課程將探討飛行軟體的設計和架構，學生將學習如何設計出能夠在極端條件下穩定運行的飛行軟體系統，確保太空任務的順利執行。此外，課程將涵蓋軟體驗證和確認技術，學生將學習如何確保軟體系統的功能性和安全性，並掌握各種測試方法和工具的應用。課程還將關注容錯和自我修復能力的設計，學生將學習如何設計具有容錯和自我修復功能的軟體系統，以應對可能的故障情況。最後，課程將介紹太空軟體系統的專案管理和實施，學生將學習如何有效地管理軟體開發專案，確保項目按時交付並符合品質標準。此外，課程還將包括深度學習在太空軟體系統中的應用，學生將探索如何利用深度學習技術來改進太空任務中的軟體系統設計和性能，以及酬載資料處理軟體的設計和開發，以支援太空任務中的資料收集和分析。通過本課程的學習，學生將具備設計和開發太空軟體系統所需的技能和知識，為未來在太空工程或相關領域的工作做好準備。
description.en: The course "Space Software System Design" aims to cultivate students' professional abilities in designing, developing, and operating software systems for space missions. Students will gain in-depth understanding of the special requirements that the space environment imposes on software systems, including the impact of factors such as vacuum, radiation, and temperature on system performance. The course will explore the design and architecture of flight software, teaching students how to design flight software systems that can operate stably under extreme conditions, ensuring the smooth execution of space missions. Additionally, the course will cover software verification and validation techniques, enabling students to ensure the functionality and safety of software systems and master various testing methods and tools.

syllabi.assessment:
Evaluation and Grading Policy
1. Grading Components
Assignments: 30%
Midterm Exam: 20%
Final Project: 30%
Final Exam: 10%
Class Participation: 10%

2. Assignments (30%)
Weekly assignments will be given based on lecture topics and practical labs.
Each assignment will be graded out of 100 points.
Late submissions will incur a penalty of 10% per day late, up to a maximum of 5 days.
The lowest assignment grade will be dropped.

3. Midterm Exam (20%)
The midterm exam will cover topics from Weeks 1-9.
It will consist of multiple-choice questions, short answer questions, and problem-solving questions.
The exam will be graded out of 100 points.

4. Final Project (30%)
The final project will be a comprehensive application of course concepts.
Project proposal (5%): Due in Week 10. The proposal should outline the project scope, objectives, and methodology.
Project implementation and report (20%): Due in Week 16. The report should detail the design, development, and testing of the project.
Project presentation (5%): Presentations will be held in Weeks 17-18. Each student/group will present their project and answer questions.
Projects will be evaluated based on creativity, technical accuracy, completeness, and presentation skills.

5. Final Exam (10%)
The final exam will cover topics from the entire course, with a focus on Weeks 10-18.
It will include multiple-choice questions, short answer questions, and a few comprehensive problem-solving questions.
The exam will be graded out of 100 points.

6. Class Participation (10%)
Active participation in class discussions, labs, and activities is expected.
Participation includes asking questions, contributing to discussions, and engaging in peer reviews.
Attendance will also be a component of the participation grade.

description.zh: 太空科技應用課程旨在探討太空技術在各種應用領域的應用，與太空科技如何影響人類生活和科學研究。課程涵蓋的主題包括：太空探索，地球觀測，通訊和衛星導航，太空工程和材料科學，太空生物學和醫學，太空經濟和商業。通過這些主題的專題演講與小組討論，學生將了解太空科技在各個領域的應用和未來發展方向，並能夠掌握相關技術和知識。
description.en: The aim of the Space Science & Technology Seminar is to enable students to understand and master practical skills and knowledge in the field of space engineering, as well as to cultivate their teamwork, problem-solving, and innovative thinking abilities. Students will undertake a practical space engineering design project to understand the design, testing, implementation, and management processes of space engineering through practice, and demonstrate project outcomes through reports, presentations, and assessments. Through this course, students can understand the latest developments in the field of space engineering, master relevant skills and knowledge, and enhance their teamwork and project management abilities. This course can also provide practical exercises through industry-academia collaboration.

syllabi.outline:

The Space Technology Application Course aims to introduce the application of space technology in various fields, and explore how space technology impacts human life and scientific research. The course covers topics including space exploration, Earth observation, communication and satellite navigation, space engineering and materials science, space biology and medicine, and space economy and business. Through the introduction of these topics, students will understand the application of space technology in various fields and future development directions, and be able to master relevant technologies and knowledge.

description.zh: 太空科技應用課程旨在介紹太空技術在各種應用領域的應用，並探討太空科技如何影響人類生活和科學研究。課程涵蓋的主題包括：太空探索，地球觀測，通訊和衛星導航，太空工程和材料科學，太空生物學和醫學，太空經濟和商業。通過這些主題的介紹，學生將了解太空科技在各個領域的應用和未來發展方向，並能夠掌握相關技術和知識。
description.en: The Space Technology Application Course aims to introduce the application of space technology in various fields, and explore how space technology impacts human life and scientific research. The course covers topics including space exploration, Earth observation, communication and satellite navigation, space engineering and materials science, space biology and medicine, and space economy and business. Through the introduction of these topics, students will understand the application of space technology in various fields and future development directions, and be able to master relevant technologies and knowledge.

description.zh:
這門課程著重於對立方衛星設計系統工程與實作的知識傳授，以全面了解整個系統整合與發展的過程。在這門課程中，學生將學習如何依衛星規格需求將系統分解為不同的子系統，如何將這些不同的子系統整合到一個完全功能的系統中，以及組裝整合完成後，如何進行測試與太空環境驗證流程。

本課程由立方衛星EDM工程發展平台學習步驟組成，配備立方衛星課堂使用的衛星套件、元件講解。主要配備了六個主要子系統 – 衛星電力供應管理(EPS)、衛星命令和數據處理(C&DH)、衛星通訊次系統(TT&C)、衛星飛行軟體(F.S.W)、衛星姿態控制感測器(ADCS)和衛星結構(SMS)。

通過體驗立方衛星組裝、整合（包括軟體編程和系統組裝）和測試的過程，學生可以了解每個衛星組件和次系統的功能，以及如何將各次系統整合到衛星系統中，最後進入衛星太空環境驗測，透過實務學習加深學生對衛星設計和開發的理解，以獲得寶貴的技能與知識。
description.en:
This course puts it focus on establishing the knowledge of cubeSAT systems engineering by going through the whole process of system integration. During the course student will learn how the system is broken down into different subsystem (requirement), how to integrate those different subsystem (requirement) into a fully functioning system, and how to test/debug it once it has been integrated.

The course consists of a EDM learning steps with CubeSat type classroom satellite kit. It is equipped with six primary subsystems – Electrical Power Supply, Command and Data Handling, Communication, Ground station, Sensor and Structure.

You can learn how each component and subsystem functions and how to integrate components and subsystems into a satellite system through experiencing the process of assembly, integration including programing & system implementation and test.

description.zh: 本課程以簡要方式介紹我國專利法，內容主要涵蓋：專利申請、可專利標的、專利要件、專利審查流程、專利權之實施、專利侵害判斷、專利檢索及專利說明書之撰寫，尚包括專利訴訟流程、專利行政救濟流程以及專利法與其他智慧財產權法關係之簡介。
description.en: This course briefly introduces the patent law of our country, which covers the filing of the patent application, patentable subject matter, patentability, patent examination procedures, patent enforcement, patent infringement, patent search and patent specification drafting. Other subjects such as patent litigation proceedings, patent administrative remedy proceedings, and the introduction of the correlation of the patent law and other Intellectual Property laws are also included.

description.zh: 本所與美國新罕布夏大學富蘭克林皮爾斯法學院，已於112年5月10日簽署國際學術交流MOU，而本所為響應學校推動國際化之政策，特別增開1門1學分之國際雙師課程。本課程乃由美國新罕布夏大學富蘭克林皮爾斯法學院院長Megan Carpenter教授、該學院智慧財產權中心主任Micky Minhas教授親自來台密集授課，主要提供給欲深入了解美國法律制度、美國智慧財產權法律體系之本所學生、校外實務界人士或欲對赴美留學有興趣人士來選修。而本課程之內容，共分成兩個部分，前半部將以美國法律(包括法院、普通法、各部門法律等)之介紹為主，至於後半部則詳細介紹美國智慧財產權各部門法律(包含著作權法、專利法、營業秘密法、資料保護、商標法等)。而本課程之開課時間，以每學年度上學期之10月上旬，並為期1週為原則。當然，本課程開設之目的，乃以增強學生實際應用英語之能力，並以加強學生美國智慧財產權法律之知能為主，除了強化本所與美國新罕布夏大學富蘭克林皮爾斯法學院之學術交流關係外，更能夠擴展休課學生之國際人脈及視野。
description.en: Graduate Institute of Intellectual Property, National Taipei University of Technology (hereafter called this institute) had made a MOU of international academic cooperation with Franklin Pierce School of Law, University of New Hampshire on May 10, 2023. This institute wants to promote the international policy from the University, so this institute will open a one unit course for international double professional teachers. This course is personally and intensively taught by Professor/Dean Megan Carpenter and Professor/Director Micky Minhas of Franklin Pierce School of Law, University of New Hampshire, and it is mainly provided for this institute’s students, legal practitioners, or someone who are interested in studying in the U.S. for further understanding the U.S. legal and intellectual property law systems. Moreover, contents of this course are divided into two parts: the former part is introductions of the U.S. laws, including courts, common laws, and all aspects of laws, etc. But,

syllabi.outline:
本所與美國新罕布夏大學富蘭克林皮爾斯法學院，已於112年5月10日簽署國際學術交流MOU，而本所為響應學校推動國際化之政策，特別增開1門1學分之國際雙師課程。本課程乃由美國新罕布夏大學富蘭克林皮爾斯法學院院長Megan Carpenter教授、該學院智慧財產權中心主任Micky Minhas教授親自來台密集授課，主要提供給欲深入了解美國法律制度、美國智慧財產權法律體系之本所學生、校外實務界人士或欲對赴美留學有興趣人士來選修。而本課程之內容，共分成兩個部分，前半部將以美國法律(包括法院、普通法、各部門法律等)之介紹為主，至於後半部則詳細介紹美國智慧財產權各部門法律(包含著作權法、專利法、營業秘密法、資料保護、商標法等)，甚至還介紹現今最熱門的人工智慧法律議題。而本課程之開課時間，以每學年度上學期之11月上旬，並為期1週為原則。當然，本課程開設之目的，乃以增強學生實際應用英語之能力，並以加強學生美國智慧財產權法律之知能為主，除了強化本所與美國新罕布夏大學富蘭克林皮爾斯法學院之學術交流關係外，更能夠擴展休課學生之國際人脈及視野。

Graduate Institute of Intellectual Property, National Taipei University of Technology (hereafter called this institute) had made a MOU of international academic cooperation with Franklin Pierce School of Law, University of New Hampshire on May 10, 2023. This institute wants to promote the international policy from the University, so this institute will open one unit course for international double professional teachers. This course is personally and intensively taught by Professor/Dean Megan Carpenter and Professor/Director Micky Minhas of Franklin Pierce School of Law, University of New Hampshire, and it is mainly provided for this institute’s students, legal practitioners, or someone who are interested in studying in the U.S. for further understanding the U.S. legal, intellectual property law systems, and laws of artificial intelligence.
syllabi.schedule:
A.課程暫定時間與內容 (每週一早上第4節並不上課，而本課程之上課時間集中於11/4(一)~11/8(五)，且詳述如下)：
1.11/4 (星期一) 17:10-21:10 美國法律制度 (政府架構、司法體系、普通法、行政法、契約法案例與侵權行為法、財產法–智財和科技視野)
2.11/5 (星期二) 17:10-21:10 美國智財權介紹 (I) (總則、營業秘密、數據資料及專利權)
3.11/6 (星期三) 17:10-21:10 美國智財權介紹 (II) (美國專利複審程序與著作權) 
4.11/7 (星期四) 17:30-21:30 美國智財權介紹 (III) (商標權及智慧財產權訴訟)；課堂案例模擬口試、小組討論或課後作業
5.11/8 (星期五) 09:30-11:30 美國智財權介紹 (IV) (美國人工智慧法制)

A.Course Tentative Dates and Contents (There is no class in the fourth class each Monday, and the date of this course is focused from Monday, November 4 to Friday, November 8, and they are described as followed):
1.11/4 (Monday) 17:10-21:10 U.S. legal system (branches of government, judicial system, common law, administrative law, examples from contracts, torts, and property – IP and tech lens)
2.11/5 (Tuesday) 17:10-21:10 Introduction to the U.S. intellectual property (I) (principle, trade secret, data, and patent)
3.11/6 (Wednesday)	17:10-21:10 Introduction to the U.S. intellectual property (II) (Inter Partes Review (IPR) and copyright)
4.11/7 (Thursday) 17:30-21:30	Introduction to the U.S. intellectual property (III) (trademark and litigation); practical simulation exercise, group discussion, or homework 
5.11/8 (Friday) 09:30-11:30 Introduction to the U.S. intellectual property (IV) (U.S. artificial intelligence)

1.課堂案例模擬口試/小組討論/課後作業 80%
2.上課出席 20%

1.Practical simulation exercise/group discussion/homework 80%
2.Class attendance 20%

本課程授課教師是由美國新罕布夏大學富蘭克林皮爾斯法學院院長Megan Carpenter教授、富蘭克林皮爾斯智財中心主任Micky Minhas教授，親自來本所授課。

This course is personally taught by Dean/Prof. Megan Carpenter and Director of Franklin Pierce Intellectual Property Center/Prof. Micky Minhas of the University of New Hampshire, Franklin Pierce School of Law in the Graduate Institute of Intellectual Property, Taipei Tech.

description.zh:
本課程為本校「智慧鐵道學程」的課程。課程開授之目標，是希望藉由實務傳承與實際場域參訪的方式，使修課學生能夠瞭解鐵道產業的內涵，並對國內鐵道產業的運作現況，有全面性的認識。
本課程是以同時段合院授課的方式、針對選讀學程之學生、邀請鐵道事業單位（包括鐵道局、台鐵、北捷、桃捷、高鐵、鐵道建設規劃顧問公司等）、具十年以上相關工作經驗的專業人員、以業師的身份共同參與授課。
本課程會安排實際場域（台鐵、北捷、桃捷）參訪交流行程，並會要求修課同學於期末報告時，針對國內鐵道產業現況提出具體建言。
description.en:
This course is one of the courses for the Intelligent Rail Curriculum. The main purpose of this course is, via practical technology lecturing and on-site field visiting, to provide the students an overall understanding of the contents and the operational situation of domestic rail industry.
This course is a joint lecture among departments inside our college with synchronized class hours. The industrial instructors to our participant students include senior professional practitioners with more than 10-year experiences from Ministry of Railway, Taiwan Railway Bureau (TRB), Taipei MRT, Taoyuan MRT, Taiwan High Speed Rail, and Consultant Agencies for Railway construction, etc. Field trips to operation sites such as TRB, Taipei MRT and Taoyuan MRT, will be scheduled. Each student will also need to submit a term paper regarding the review and suggestion for the domestic rail industry.

description.zh:
資訊都市主義（informatical urbanism或informational urbanism）為一跨領域學科，旨在透過資訊環境與流程之輔助，推動政策、規劃、發展、策略行動、設計之都市與社區進程。
本課程主要在協助學生，以都市與社區問題為基本導向，建立資訊環境與流程之規劃能力。
授課主要涵蓋面向：1.資訊與知識基礎設施 2.經濟面向 3.都市治理與公共行政 4.都市空間之資訊化 5.地點因子 6.使用者行為 7.特殊議題。
description.en:
Informatical urbanism (or informational urbanism) is an interdisciplinary area of knowledge, and it mainly utilize the facilitation of informatical environments and procedures for the progression of policy, planning, development, strategic initiative, and design within cities and communities.
During this course, student will acquire the planning capability of establish such applicable informatical environments and procedures, based upon explorations of urban and community issues.
Main contents of this course: 1. Information and knowledge infrastructures, 2. Economic aspects, 3. Urban governance and administration, 4. Informaticalization of urban space, 5. Location factors, 6. User behavior, 7. Focus area of problem.

description.zh: 介紹各種潔淨且高效率的先進車輛動力系統的型式及其工作原理並分析技巧。項目包含車輛能源所面臨的一些問題及可能的解決方案、優良動力源的特性、電動系統、複合電動系統、複合氣動系統、氫燃料電池動力系統、金屬燃料電池動力系統、各種替代性燃料的特性及優缺點、太陽光電輔助動力系統等。
description.en: This course introduces various kinds of clean and high-efficiency vehicular power systems, their operation principles, and analytical skills.  Topics include: problems and possible solutions the vehicular power system faces, characteristics of a good vehicular power system, electric power system, hybrid electric power system, hybrid pneumatic power system, fuel cell power system, metallic fuel-cell power system, substitutive fuels, and solar-energy auxiliary power system.

description.en: Degree of Freedom, (2D and 3D) Kinematic Analysis, Springs, Dampers, Force Analysis, Compliance, Computer Aided Analysis and Design of Suspension Systems.

syllabi.outline:
這是一門和「車輛動力學」相關之應用性課程，主要係論述懸吊機構之幾何特徵如何影響車輛的動態行為。內容包括利用機構學之自由度分析歸納出所有懸吊系統的種類、利用瞬心法分析懸吊機構之幾何特徵和車輛轉向特性(轉向不足、轉向過度)的關係。
接著利用靜力學的概念分析路面作用於輪胎上的力量(縱向力、轉彎力和荷重)如何藉由懸吊機構傳遞至車身，以及懸吊機構的設計對於輪胎荷重變化的影響等。最後則說明如何在兼顧車輛舒適性和操控性下，有程序的執行彈簧剛性的設計。

聯合國教科文組織於1972年通過了《世界遺產公約》，旨在保護世界文化和自然遺產，並將保護和保存文化財產的概念連結起來。五十年來，世界遺產經歷多次變革，觀念與行動與時俱進，1992年，文化景觀概念正式確立，承認人與環境的相互作用和共生關係，縫合了長街以來自然和文化的割裂。2001年，全球文化多樣性宣言的通過，文化在不同時代和不同地方具有各種不同的表現形式，這種多樣性的具體表現，構成人類各群體和各社會具有的獨特性和多樣化。受此影響，文化景觀、無形遺產、水下遺產、產業遺產、文化路徑、聖山遺產、天文遺產紛紛出現。本課程屬建築保存應用課程，將介紹不同主題的世界遺產案例，其目的除了引領同學認識世界遺產觀念及思潮變遷外，亦對國內文化資產保存的學習有所啟發與反省。
Heritage is our legacy from the past, what we live with today, and what we pass on to future generations. Our cultural and natural heritage are both irreplaceable sources of life and inspiration. UNESCO adopted the World Heritage Convention in 1972 to protect world cultural and natural heritage and link the concepts of protection and preservation of cultural property. Over the past fifty years, World Heritage has undergone many changes, and concepts and actions have kept pace with the times. In 1992, the concept of cultural landscape was formally established, recognizing the interaction and symbiotic relationship between people and the environment, and sewing up the separation between nature and culture since the Long Street. In 2001, the Global Declaration on Cultural Diversity was adopted. Culture has different forms of expression in different times and places. The specific manifestations of this diversity constitute the uniqueness and diversity of various human groups and societies.

description.en:
This course evaluates the carbon footprint of a building's life
cycle. Through standardized and transparent building
information, the impact of various stages of the building life
cycle on the environment is analyzed step by step. This
course not only evaluates the carbon footprint of the entire
building life cycle but also further identifies carbon hotspots
and provides carbon reduction strategies, hence understanding carbon savings potential of buildings.

description.zh: 本課程主要是介紹金屬、陶瓷、高分子材料之先進製造技術，以利修課學生能了解各種材料製程之原理、限制及其應用領域。另外，課程中也將介紹真空製程在材料製造所扮演的角色，並介紹基礎真空技術及理論。課程後半段將聚焦在材料的3D列印(積層製造)技術，包含美國材料試驗協會(ASTM)所分類的七大類3D列印技術，如粉體床熔化成型、黏結劑噴塗等製程技術。
description.en: This course mainly introduces advanced manufacturing technologies of metals, ceramics, and polymer materials, so that students can understand the principles, limitations and application fields of various material manufacturing processes. In addition, the course will also introduce the role of the vacuum process in material manufacturing and introduce basic vacuum technology and theory. The second half of the course will focus on 3D printing (additive manufacturing) technology of materials, including the seven major categories of 3D printing technologies classified by the American Society for Testing and Materials (ASTM), such as powder bed fusion, binder jetting, and other AM technologies.

name.zh: 人工智慧的基礎與創新(一)
name.en: Foundations and Advances in Artificial Intelligence I

description.zh:
本課程深入探討人工智慧領域的基礎知識和最新技術，包括機器學習、深度學習、自然語言處理、生成對抗網絡等領域。學員將從人工智慧的概述和歷史開始，逐步深入了解機器學習和深度學習的基礎概念和演算法，並探討其在不同領域的應用。課程還介紹了最新的AI技術趨勢，包括注意力機制、自監督學習、大型AI通用模型和元學習等。
課程運作模式：每週講授一個主題，包括理論授課和實習操作。學員將參與課堂討論和小組活動，以促進想法交流和知識分享。
description.en:
This course delves into the fundamentals and latest advancements in the field of artificial intelligence, covering topics such as machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing, and generative adversarial networks. Participants will begin with an overview of artificial intelligence and its historical development, progressively delving into the foundational concepts and algorithms of machine learning and deep learning, along with their applications across various domains. The course also introduces the latest trends in AI technology, including attention mechanisms, self-supervised learning, large-scale AI models, and meta-learning.
Course Execution: Each week covers a specific topic, including theoretical lectures and practical exercises. Participants will engage in classroom discussions and group activities to facilitate idea exchange and knowledge sharing.

113-1 Class Rubrics: 
1.	The class roster will be called twice during each class session.
2.	Those present in the classroom, both before the class begins and before the class ends, and with their class material in paper form, will be considered attending the required class session and be rewarded one bonus point.
3.	Those who are not present in the classroom before the class begins but are present before the class ends will be considered late for the class session and will not be rewarded any bonus points.
4.	Those who are present in the classroom before the class begins but are not present before the class ends will be considered as having left early for the class session and will not be rewarded any bonus points
5.	Those not present in the classroom, either before the class begins or before the class ends, will be considered absent from the class session and will not be rewarded any bonus points.
6.	A bonus point will only be awarded to those with class materials.
7.	It is the discretion of an exam proctor to decide whether academic misconduct has occurred. 
8.	If an exam proctor identifies academic misconduct, a zero will be given on the exam.
9. The final semester grade is composed of the average of the total number of tests, including the midterm and final exam, plus the bonus points for total attendance in class and extra credits on outstanding class performance or homework
10. Make-up test rules: Those who qualify for a make-up exam but do not show up on time will be considered as having been allowed to take the make-up exam, and their final grade will be their original grade.
A: To make up Test 1: During the midterm exam (when taking Test 2), make up Test 1; those who missed it will be unable to make up Test 1.
B. To make up Test 2: When taking Test 3, make up Test 2; those who missed it will not be able to make up Test 2.
C. To make up Test 3: When taking the final exam, Test 4, make up Test 3; those who missed it will not be able to make up Test 3.
D. To make up Test 4: During week 18, make up Test 4; those who missed it will be unable to make up Test 4.	
11.	The make-up exam score will be counted as 70% of the original score if it exceeds 60, but it will remain as it was when it is below 60. And the semester final grade for those who take the make-up exam will be 70 at most even if it exceeds 70 after make-up exam score is taken into account. 

12.	After presenting the school absence note to the class teacher, Those who missed their exam(s) due to official absences will receive their original score instead of 70% on make-up exams.

13. Late registrators are responsible for their grade point loss

description.en: To encourage and help students using new technologies or new business models to solve problems in the society and the business world, this intense, pre-accelerator, 18-week course invites different professors and mentors with entrepreneurship experiences to help students develop their start-up ideas through workshops and startup competitions. The goal of this course is to help students realize their ideas and create actionable business solutions that can change the society.

syllabi.outline:
為了鼓勵以及幫助學生用技術或者商業模式，聯合學校老師或是跨校同學，用商業的手段共同解決社會或者商業問題，本課程將以衝刺班的形式，邀請有創業經驗的老師、業師，透過工作坊的形式，幫助學生逐週的推進創業進度以及創業競賽演練，目標是幫助學生落實創業想法，應用在社會中並且帶來改變。

如果你想體驗創業前該具備的專業與過程，如果你想學習在未來不論是升學(簡報設計、創業計畫書)或就業(Wix網站、Line官方帳號)或探索自己(行銷、財務)，任何一項能力都能讓你在未來年薪百萬甚至創業，因此這堂課絕對不是輕鬆可及的營養學分，但絕對是你人生經歷中的營養學分。

To encourage and help students use technology or business models, collaborate with school teachers or cross-school classmates, and jointly solve social or business problems through business methods, this course will be conducted in a sprint class format. We will invite teachers and industry professionals with entrepreneurial experience to help students progress weekly through workshops and entrepreneurship competition drills. The goal is to help students implement their entrepreneurial ideas, apply them to society, and bring about change.

If you want to experience the professional skills and processes required before starting a business, or if you want to learn skills that will be valuable whether you pursue further education (presentation design, business plan writing), employment (Wix website, Line official account), or self-exploration (marketing, finance), any of these abilities can help you earn a million-dollar annual salary in the future or start your own business. Therefore, this course is not an easy elective but a valuable life experience.

description.zh:
隨著高齡化社會的來臨與國家對於身心障礙者生活福祉的重視，輔助科技相關資源與人才需求日益倍增，各類輔具產品使用已成為這些族群在醫療照護上與生活品質提升上不可或缺的一環。本門課程為「生醫輔助科技跨域微學程」之入門基礎課程，建立學生對輔助科技有基本的通盤認識，期許未來具備相關能力投入輔助創新產品研發。若未來有志投入輔助科技相關產業工作，建議微學程可由此門課程開始選修。
由於輔助科技涵蓋醫學與工程相關領域專業知識技術的整合，故由本校與臺北醫學大學攜手合作，兩校多位教師一同共授，提供兩校各20位學生選修，以促進學生或教師間的交流合作，本課程上課地點除了在本校，將有部分週次於北醫校園上課。
description.en: With the advent of aging society and the country's emphasis on the well-being of people with physical and mental disabilities, the demand of assistive technology resources and manpower is getting increased. The use of various assistive products has become an indispensable part for these people in medical care and quality of life. Assistive technology covers and integrates expertise in medicine and engineering related fields. The aims of this course are to let students have the comprehensive understanding of the current status and future trends of assistive technology. This course is the basic course for the “Assistive Technology Interdisciplinary Program”. If students consider to involve assistive technology-related industries in the future, we encourage students to enroll this course.

description.zh: 介紹汽機車上各控制系統之硬體及控制策略，包含引擎系統之空燃比、怠速、冷起動、爆震、廢氣，傳動系統之變速、傳動，煞車系統之ABS、TCS、SRS，懸吊系統之半主動及主動式懸吊，智慧型道路系統之頭燈、環境、巡航、跟隨、夜視等控制系統。
description.en: This course introduces hardware and control strategies used in each control systems in a vehicle.  These control systems include engine system (AF ratio, idle speed, cold start, knocking, exhaust), transmission system, brake system (ABS, TCS, SRS), suspension system (semi-active and active), intelligent transportation system (headlight, environment, cruise, following, night vision) etc..

syllabi.outline:
本課程針對車輛控制系統的理論與實務相關內容進行介紹，並聚焦在自動駕駛車輛的發展技術，課程內容包括雷達及視覺感測、導航與定位技術、運動控制與控制決策以及自動駕駛車輛的能源動力系統。此外課程內容也會探討車聯網技術、自駕車產業化以及從自駕車對智慧交通的轉變與影響。
This course introduces the theories and practical aspects related to vehicle control systems, focusing on the development technologies of autonomous vehicles. The course content includes radar and vision sensing, navigation and positioning technologies, motion control and decision-making, and the energy power systems of autonomous vehicles. Additionally, the course will explore vehicle-to-vehicle communication technology, the industrialization of autonomous vehicles, and the transition and impact of autonomous vehicles on e-mobility in smart cities.

syllabi.outline:
隨著科技不斷進步，人工智慧技術逐漸成熟，無論在生產流程、企業管理及分析決策等方面都陸續開始導入生成式AI工具，應用場景橫跨企業營運、數據應用以及產品與服務創新等。本課程將介紹生成式人工智慧原理並結合實作方式，透過實際案例和演練來教授生成式AI技術和應用。課程內容包括人工智慧的基礎知識，如深度學習、自然語言處理、圖像處理、推薦系統、預測分析等，並導入人工智慧在企業管理和決策、金融、數據分析、智慧製造等領域等應用案例。課程中將結合Azure OpenAI雲端服務資源，並以人工智慧跨域應用學習模式來跨域應用至數據分析、智慧運算、智慧製造及物流、商情預測、經營管理、金融等領域，以培育學生具備領先同儕之人工智慧跨域應用專業能力。
This course introduces the principles of generative artificial intelligence and combines practical exercises regarding the technology and applications of generative AI through real case studies and drills. The course covers fundamental knowledge of AI, such as deep learning, natural language processing, image processing, recommendation systems, predictive analytics, and introduces the application cases of AI in enterprise management and decision-making, finance, data analysis, intelligent manufacturing, among others. The course will also utilize Azure OpenAI cloud service resources and cross-domain application learning mode to cultivate students’ technical abilities in AI cross-domain applications, spanning across data analytics, intelligent computing, intelligent manufacturing and logistics, business forecasting, management, finance, etc., leading them to stand out among their peers.

syllabi.schedule:
1. 課程主題：人工智慧
課程內容包括：人工智慧簡介、人工智慧於金融之應用發展、人工智慧的風險與挑戰、人工智慧發展對金融產業發展衝擊、反思與影響

2. 課程主題：生物辨識技術
課程內容包括：生物辨識的緣起、生物辨識技術種類現況、導入何種最適生物辨識技術之評估、生物辨識在金融創新之運用現況與趨勢

3. 課程主題：保險科技創新模式及發展趨勢
課程內容包括：保險科技定義、保險科技簡介、保險科技之應用與發展、保險科技的影響與挑戰

4.課程主題：聊天機器人介面設計與AI 簡介
課程內容包括：什麼是人工智慧?人工智慧發展的歷史、聊天機器人介面設計、人工智慧應用與實作

5.業師專題演講：互聯網金融創新模式發展與應用
課程內容包括：互聯網金融定義、互聯網金融的應用、互聯網金融的發展趨勢及應用案例

6.課程主題：Blockchain(區塊鏈)的發展與應用
課程內容包括：區塊鏈定義、區塊鏈的形成、特性、制度類型、優點以及在金融上與商業上的應用

description.zh: 隨著科技的發展與產值快速成長，網路、電商、商業新模式等各式創業大行其道，成為許多創業者的新選擇，本課程邀請國內知名創業楷模或創業成功典範之企業經理人分享創業成功之經驗。以真實具體的創業經驗為教材，讓學生更深刻體驗創業家之精神。希冀以觀摩學習典範企業的具體經驗，帶領學生學習企業創新與創業的思維，進而激發學生追求成就的渴望，強化青年學子對人生願景的規劃。
description.en: Along with the prosperous development of Internet, the output value of E-commerce is growing fast. Launching a business on the internet has become a new choice for many entrepreneurs. We invite the domestic business manager, as the model of outstanding and successful enterprise, to share his experiences of achievement with students. By offering the real and specific examples, business manager will make students learn further about the enterprisers' entrepreneurship. Through their experiences, we hope students can learn innovations and creations of enterprise; furthermore, students can be inspired to pursue their ambition to strengthen their wills to plan the future.

description.en: To encourage and help students using new technologies or new business models to solve problems in the society and the business world, this intense, pre-accelerator, 18-week course invites different professors and mentors with entrepreneurship experiences to help students develop their start-up ideas through workshops and startup competitions. syllabi.outline:
為了鼓勵以及幫助學生用技術或者商業模式，聯合學校老師或是跨校同學，用商業的手段共同解決社會或者商業問題，本課程將以衝刺班的形式，邀請有創業經驗的老師、業師，透過工作坊的形式，幫助學生逐週的推進創業進度以及創業競賽演練，目標是幫助學生落實創業想法，應用在社會中並且帶來改變。

如果你想體驗創業前該具備的專業與過程，如果你想學習在未來不論是升學(簡報設計、創業計畫書)或就業(Wix網站、Line官方帳號)或探索自己(行銷、財務)，任何一項能力都能讓你在未來年薪百萬甚至創業，因此這堂課絕對不是輕鬆可及的營養學分，但絕對是你人生經歷中的營養學分。

To encourage and help students use technology or business models, collaborate with school teachers or cross-school classmates, and jointly solve social or business problems through business methods, this course will be conducted in a sprint class format. We will invite teachers and industry professionals with entrepreneurial experience to help students progress weekly through workshops and entrepreneurship competition drills. The goal is to help students implement their entrepreneurial ideas, apply them to society, and bring about change.

If you want to experience the professional skills and processes required before starting a business, or if you want to learn skills that will be valuable whether you pursue further education (presentation design, business plan writing), employment (Wix website, Line official account), or self-exploration (marketing, finance), any of these abilities can help you earn a million-dollar annual salary in the future or start your own business. Therefore, this course is not an easy elective but a valuable life experience.

description.zh:
隨著高齡化社會的來臨與國家對於身心障礙者生活福祉的重視，輔助科技相關資源與人才需求日益倍增，各類輔具產品使用已成為這些族群在醫療照護上與生活品質提升上不可或缺的一環。本門課程為「生醫輔助科技跨域微學程」之入門基礎課程，建立學生對輔助科技有基本的通盤認識，期許未來具備相關能力投入輔助創新產品研發。若未來有志投入輔助科技相關產業工作，建議微學程可由此門課程開始選修。
由於輔助科技涵蓋醫學與工程相關領域專業知識技術的整合，故由本校與臺北醫學大學攜手合作，兩校多位教師一同共授，提供兩校各20位學生選修，以促進學生或教師間的交流合作，本課程上課地點除了在本校，將有部分週次於北醫校園上課。
description.en: With the advent of aging society and the country's emphasis on the well-being of people with physical and mental disabilities, the demand of assistive technology resources and manpower is getting increased. The use of various assistive products has become an indispensable part for these people in medical care and quality of life. Assistive technology covers and integrates expertise in medicine and engineering related fields. The aims of this course are to let students have the comprehensive understanding of the current status and future trends of assistive technology. This course is the basic course for the “Assistive Technology Interdisciplinary Program”. If students consider to involve assistive technology-related industries in the future, we encourage students to enroll this course.

name.en: Corporate's Favorite: High-quality Communication and Presentation Ability

description.zh: 課程將以體驗式教學訓練，提升學員表達技巧、舞台技巧、臨場反應。本課程主要目的在教授學生以設計思考思維與策略，運用主題式課程實戰小組簡報及個人簡報，快速釐清簡報製作及表達過程中重點，提升修課學員個人簡報製作能力及表達能力，幫助學生在未來創業及就業上以出色之個人簡報能力獲得面試者及投資者的青睞，領先於起跑點取得優勢。
description.en: The course will use experiential teaching training to improve students' expression skills, stage skills, and on-the-spot reactions. The main purpose of this course is to teach students establishing design thinking strategies. During the course practice group presentations and personal presentations training students to quickly clarify the key points in the process of presentation production and presentation, to improve the students' personal presentation production and presentation skills. Furthermore, assist students' entrepreneurship and employment in the future. Students who finished this course will be favored by interviewers and investors with his excellent personal presentation skills. And he will gain an advantage over the starting point.

name.en: Entrepreneurship Lectures- The persistance that makes the great entrepreneur

description.zh: 隨著科技的發展與產值快速成長，網路、電商、商業新模式等各式創業大行其道，成為許多創業者的新選擇，本課程邀請國內知名創業楷模或創業成功典範之企業經理人分享創業成功之經驗。以真實具體的創業經驗為教材，讓學生更深刻體驗創業家之精神。希冀以觀摩學習典範企業的具體經驗，帶領學生學習企業創新與創業的思維，進而激發學生追求成就的渴望，強化青年學子對人生願景的規劃。
description.en: Along with the prosperous development of Internet, the output value of E-commerce is growing fast. Launching a business on the internet has become a new choice for many entrepreneurs. We invite the domestic business manager, as the model of outstanding and successful enterprise, to share his experiences of achievement with students. By offering the real and specific examples, business manager will make students learn further about the enterprisers' entrepreneurship. Through their experiences, we hope students can learn innovations and creations of enterprise; furthermore, students can be inspired to pursue their ambition to strengthen their wills to plan the future.

description.zh:
氣膠為懸浮在空氣中的微小固體或液體粒子。本課程深入探討氣膠科學（微塵學）及其工程上之應用。
．氣膠理化特性，粒徑分布
．氣膠運動學：擴散和布朗運動，過濾機制，荷電性質，熱泳等
．光學特性及其應用
．氣膠的測量原理與方法
．大氣氣膠及生物氣膠
description.en:
．Indroduction:characterization of aerosols,shape and size distributions
．Particle transport:Brownian motion and diffusion, centrifugation, intertia and filtration, convective diffusion,extermal forcr fields, thermal force
．Optical properties:visibility, light scattering
．Aerosol dynamics:coagulation, formation and growth
．Atmospheric Aerosois and Bioaerosols
．Measurement of aerosol

description.zh: 本課程旨在協助學生探究教育社會學的理論與實務，探討主題包含:社會化、社會階層、教育機會均等、技職教育與社會發展等，並期學生運用相關論點對當前技職教育問題提出建議。
description.en: This course is designed to assist students understanding the theory and practice of the sociology of education and applying sociological views to solve the problems. Topics include socialization and education, social change transition and education, equity of educational opportunity, collaboration between social development and technical-vocational education, etc.

description.zh: 校務研究（Institutional Research，以下簡稱IR）可說是針對校務所進行的各項研究，透過資料蒐集、分析、報告，以及教職員行動，以促進高等教育機構的運作與決定。同時IR的發展和大學評鑑的發展脈絡息息相關，最終的目的就是要提升學校辦學品質，促進學校良善發展。本課程主要希望加強同學對IR的了解及發展實作能力。
description.en: Institutional research is a broad category of work done at schools, colleges and universities to inform campus decision-making and planning in areas such as admissions, financial aid, curriculum, enrollment management, staffing, student life, finance, facilities, athletics, and alumni relations. Its mission is to foster a culture of evidence by facilitating the management, analysis, and reporting of institutional data and information in support of planning and decision-making. This curriculum is expected to provide all students understand the theory and practice of IR.

syllabi.outline:
The mission of Institutional Research is to support the evidence-based decision-making in education institutions. Therefore, in this course, the classmates would be asked to learn the programming language to deal with the real data and provide solid evidence to the leadership. You would be asked to fully engage in the data analysis during this semester. By the end of this course, you should be able to conduct complicated data analysis with confidence. Meanwhile, you should be able to provide productive suggestions for your supervisor's consideration.
This course not only prepare you as a qualified IR officers. It also lead you as a professional data analytician.
syllabi.schedule:
Week 1: the introduction of the syllabus and course requirement
Week 2: the foundation of Institutional research 
Week 3: the working environment in Stata
Week 4: data cleaning & data manipulation
Week 5: Project Task I
Week 6: data visualization
Week 7: data modeling: multiple regression, logistic regression, quantile regression 
Week 8: data reporting
Week 9: Project Task II
Week 10: team work in PIAAC data
Week 11: team work in PISA data
Week 12: team work in administration record data
Week 13: Advanced topic I:panel data, fixed effect and random effect
Week 14: Advanced topic II: instrument variable
Week 15: quasi-experiment I: Difference in Difference, Synthetic Control
Week 16: quasi-experiment II: Regression discontinuity, Coarsened Exact Matching, Propensity Score Method
Week 17: Special talk: Geographic Information System, Social network analysis
Week 18: Project Task III
syllabi.assessment:
1.Project task I: 30%
2.Project task II: 30%
3. Project task III: 30%

description.zh: 本課程希望讓學生了解如何正確選擇與使用多變項統計方法，並能閱讀、呈現與解釋多變項統計報告或結果。課程包括因子設計、實驗設計、共變數分析、複迴歸等主題，以探討教育研究中多重且同時的影響因素。
description.en: This curriculum lets students understand how to choose and use multi-variance statistics methods exactly.  It also includes that reading, presenting and explaining the report or result of multi-variance statistics analysis exactly.  The topics of the curriculum include that factor design, experimental design, covariance analysis, and multi-regression, al etc. to explore the influence of multi and simultaneous factors in the educational research.

syllabi.outline: This course will focuse on the application of principles of linear modeling in the context of linear regression analysis to exploring questions about mediated (i.e., indirect) and moderated (i.e., interaction) effects. We will spend part of the course talking about partitioning effects into direct and indirect components and how to quantify and test hypotheses about indirect effects, part talking about estimating, testing, and probing interactions in linear models, and part integrating moderation and mediation as “conditional process analysis” by discussing and how to conceptualize and test the contingencies of a mechanism. Computer applications will focus on R using off-the-shelf code and the PROCESS macro available through www.processmacro.org and documented in the text for the course. It is assumed that you have taken a course in multiple regression and have done well or are otherwise comfortable with the principles of multiple regression analysis. No knowledge of matrix algebra is required or assumed.
syllabi.schedule:
week 1-2: Oview of the course and a gentle introduction to R

week 3: Overview and review of regression concepts

week 4-6: Statistical mediation analysis

week 7-8: Moderation analysis

week 9: Mid-term

week 10: Moderation analysis

week 11-12: Condtional process analysis I

week 13-14: Statistical mediation and moderation analysis II

week 15-16: Advanced topics in conditional process analysis

week 17: That’s a lot to process! Pitfalls of popular path models

week 18: Final
syllabi.assessment:
Attendance 20%
Final presentation and report 80%

Course materials will be prepared by the instructor.

description.en: To make better use of the training resources, the curriculum expects to make students understand that any enterprise should objectively and carefully evaluate the training program before its employment, and keep track of its effect after its employment to make sure the effectiveness of the training program.

syllabi.outline: In this course, students will gain a conceptual understanding of ways to implement a training program, different models of evaluation, and the rationale for evaluating a program or the objectives and intent of the organization. Students will identify whether and where evaluation is needed, and how the evaluation contributes to the overall goals of the organization as well as the learning identified as necessary. Students will gain practical experience with the notion of evaluation as well as what is to be done with the evaluation’s findings.

To allow students to prepare enough background knowledge for entering the field of medical materials in the future, and to further extend the optoelectronic capabilities that students in this department have learned to the application of biomedical optoelectronics for cross-field learning. The content mentions the principles of computed tomography, magnetic resonance imaging, ultrasound, nuclear medicine, endoscopy, etc.

This curriculum is expected to make students understand how administrative psychology affect their life and work, and how to use the management skill to effectively deal with the personnel and matter in the enterprise.

description.zh: 這門課程將深入探討ESG概念及其在國際趨勢中的地位，包括CBAM、CCA、TCFD等法規，亦將闡述國際評比、CSRD、IFRS S1/S2等要求，以及國內主管機關的法規，尤其關於公司治理藍圖的要求。透過工作坊形式，我們將聚焦氣候變遷和財務相關揭露的重點，並以案例分享產業實務。從國際法規如SB253、CBAM到國際標準ISO 20400，我們也將討論供應鏈管理和永續採購的趨勢。此外，將涵蓋人權相關議題，如TIFD和DEI，以及永續報告書撰寫注意事項。最後，我們將介紹永續金融和責任投融資，並討論金融業永續法規對企業的影響。
description.en: This course explores ESG concepts and global trends like CBAM, CCA, and TCFD. We'll cover international ratings, CSRD, IFRS S1/S2, and domestic regulatory requirements, focusing on corporate governance. Through workshops and case studies, we'll highlight climate change and financial disclosures. We'll discuss supply chain management trends, ISO 20400, and human rights issues like TIFD and DEI. Additionally, we'll cover sustainability reporting guidelines and introduce sustainable finance and responsible investment, examining their impact on businesses and financial regulations.

name.zh: 運動追求卓越與個人健康管理
name.en: Exercise for excellent and health fitness management

description.zh:
本課程名稱為「運動追求卓越與個人健康管理」，是一門結合理論與實踐的課程，將透過探討運動科學與健康管理的基礎與實務參與，建構修課學生對運動在個人健康應用的實際體悟，並提升自我健康與體能管理，促進長期健康。
課程內容涵蓋運動對健康的重要性、運動智能APP、運動訓練安排、運動與營養、水分補充、傷害防護、運動與恢復等主題。
透過本課程的學習，修課學生不僅能增進個人體能與相關運動知能， 並能由實務運動參與的過程，達到個人健康管理的益處。
description.en:
This course “Exercise for excellent and health fitness management” combines theory and practice. By exploring the fundamentals of exercise science and health management, and through practical participation, it aims to build students' practical understanding of how exercise applies to personal health, and to enhance their self-health and physical fitness management to promote long-term health.
The course covers topics such as the importance of exercise for health, exercise smart apps, training plan, exercise and nutrition, hydration, injury prevention, and recovery.
Through this course, students will not only improve their physical fitness and sports-related knowledge but will also experience the benefits of personal health management through practical exercise participation.

透過本課程的學習，修課學生不僅能增進個人體能與相關運動知能， 並能由實務運動參與的過程，達到個人健康管理的益處。
This course “Exercise for excellent and health fitness management” combines theory and practice. By exploring the fundamentals of exercise science and health management, and through practical participation, it aims to build students' practical understanding of how exercise applies to personal health, and to enhance their self-health and physical fitness management to promote long-term health.
The course covers topics such as the importance of exercise for health, exercise smart apps, training plan, exercise and nutrition, hydration, injury prevention, and recovery.
Through this course, students will not only improve their physical fitness and sports-related knowledge but will also experience the benefits of personal health management through practical exercise participation.

description.zh: 課程的目標期待透過理論與案例研究幫助學生理解「金融科技」，包括改變付款方式的破壞力、分析不斷變化的監管環境，並對人工智慧、區塊鏈、上雲、行動銀行、開放銀行、機器人顧問、眾籌、P2P借貸等金融科技議題有著更深入的了解；此外，也介紹資訊安全與目前監管機構在金融科技的角色。
description.en: The objective of the course is to help students understand "Financial Technology" through theory and case studies, including the disruptive impact of changing payment methods, analyzing the constantly evolving regulatory environment, and gaining a deeper understanding of financial technology topics such as artificial intelligence, blockchain, cloud computing, mobile banking, open banking, robo-advisors, crowdfunding, peer-to-peer lending, etc. Additionally, it introduces information security and the role of current regulatory agencies in financial technology.

description.zh: 本課程的重點在於闡述管理學之基本概念，主要的內容涵蓋四個領域：(1)瞭解管理學之理論與相關學者之研究報告；(2) 討論企業界管理應用實務案例；(3) 探討多國化管理之趨勢與差異及(4) 如何落實管理理論研討與趨勢。另外一有管理相關功能實務應用之討論與介紹
description.en: The purpose of Management has four distinct objectives:(1) to introduce a new management paradigm；(2) to effectively combine the basic concepts of management and organizational behavior into a single volume, including the management functional and departmental descriptions；(3) to discuss business management applications in practice and (4) to effectively implement the management basic ideas. The planning, organization, decision, leadership and monitoring among variety culture will be covered and discussed in the class as well.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在介紹和探討管理學的基本概念、原理和應用，培養學生在組織管理領域的專業知識和技能。課程包括概論、管理和應用三個部分。概論部分涵蓋管理的意義、功能、技能和環境。管理部分深入探討規劃、策略管理、組織結構、組織行為、領導理論、溝通與激勵，以及控制與績效管理。應用部分涵蓋人力資源管理、組織變革、創新與創業精神，以及企業倫理與社會責任。教學方法包括講授、案例分析和小組討論，評估方式包括報告和考試。本課程旨在培養學生成為具備全面管理能力的優秀管理者。
This course aims to introduce and explore the fundamental concepts, principles, and applications of management, cultivating students' professional knowledge and skills in the field of organizational management.The course consists of three parts: Introduction, Management, and Applications.The Introduction part covers the meaning, functions, skills, and environment of management.The Management part delves into topics such as planning, strategic management, organizational structure, organizational behavior, leadership theories, communication and motivation, as well as control and performance management.The Applications part covers human resource management, organizational change, innovation and entrepreneurship, as well as business ethics and social responsibility.Teaching methods include lectures, case analysis, and group discussions, while assessment methods include reports and exams.This course aims to cultivate students to become excellent managers with comprehensive management abilities.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在介紹和探討電子商務的基本概念、原理和實踐。學生將瞭解電子商務的發展背景、關鍵技術、商業模式和相關法律法規等方面的知識。課程內容包括電子商務的基礎概念、網站設計與開發、電子支付系統、網絡營銷、電子商務安全和隱私保護、供應鏈管理以及電子商務的社會和經濟影響等主題。透過案例分析和小組討論，學生將學習如何在電子商務環境中建立和管理成功的網上業務。此外，學生還將進行電商平台的實務操作，瞭解電子商務系統的建置和運營。同時，學生也將探討未來電子商務趨勢和創新。通過本課程的學習，學生將獲得在數字時代運營和成功利用電子商務的能力和知識。


This course aims to introduce and explore the fundamental concepts, principles, and practices of e-commerce. Students will gain an understanding of the development background, key technologies, business models, and relevant laws and regulations in e-commerce. The course covers topics such as the basics of e-commerce, website design and development, electronic payment systems, internet marketing, e-commerce security and privacy protection, supply chain management, and the social and economic impacts of e-commerce. Through case studies and group discussions, students will learn how to establish and manage successful online businesses in the e-commerce environment. Additionally, students will engage in practical exercises on e-commerce platforms to understand the setup and operation of e-commerce systems. Furthermore, students will explore future trends and innovations in e-commerce. By the end of this course, students will acquire the knowledge and skills to operate and leverage e-commerce effectively in the digital era.

description.zh: 本門課程是財務、電腦、與數學的結合，其主要目標為啟發學生如何設計電腦演算法來解決財務或經濟上的問題。一開始，此課程會複習一些基本的知識，如利率期間結構、選擇權評價理論、隨機過程模型、數值方法、與寫程式時所需的資料結構。之後，會講到一些新奇選擇權的演算法，包括亞洲式選擇權，障礙選擇權、回顧選擇權、重設選擇權、彩虹選擇權、可轉換公司債。
description.en: The major goal of this course is to provide students with complete understanding of many financial markets and products. Topics such as forward and futures, swaps, and options will be fully covered. In addition, the basic pricing methods of these innovative products will be emphasized in this course. Finally, even to a MBA student, the knowledge mentioned in this course is sure to be helpful for his (or her) future career.

syllabi.outline: This course will shed light on the methodology for evaluating derivatives, hedging and managing investment risk. The pricing algorithm will be implemented in C language and Matlab. The problems that will be dealt with include the approximation of internal rates of returns via the bisection and Newton method,  and the calculation of spot rate curves via the bootstrap method.

description.zh: 本門課程是財務、電腦、與數學的結合，其主要目標為啟發學生如何設計電腦演算法來解決財務或經濟上的問題。一開始，此課程會複習一些基本的知識，如利率期間結構、選擇權評價理論、隨機過程模型、數值方法、與寫程式時所需的資料結構。之後，會講到一些新奇選擇權的演算法，包括亞洲式選擇權，障礙選擇權、回顧選擇權、重設選擇權、彩虹選擇權、可轉換公司債。
description.en: The major goal of this course is to provide students with complete understanding of many financial markets and products. Topics such as forward and futures, swaps, and options will be fully covered. In addition, the basic pricing methods of these innovative products will be emphasized in this course. Finally, even to a MBA student, the knowledge mentioned in this course is sure to be helpful for his (or her) future career.

syllabi.outline: This course will shed light on the methodology for evaluating derivatives, hedging and managing investment risk. The pricing algorithm will be implemented in C language and Matlab. The problems that will be dealt with include the approximation of internal rates of returns via the bisection and Newton method,  and the calculation of spot rate curves via the bootstrap method.

description.zh: 本課程主要介紹資料探勘與大數據分析的理論方法與應用，課程內容涵蓋資料探勘的基本概念，如資料準備、資料探勘的方法與實證、資料探勘的進一步運用，並加入商業等各領域的實務案例介紹，具體說明如何應用資料探勘與大數據分析技術以解決真實問題。 另外在工具方面則透過相關分析軟體操作與實作範例輔以說明，讓學生學習資料的準備、工具的應用及分析判斷，透過實作課程，使學生能容易應用資料探勘方法，進而提升大數據分析和數位決策能力。
description.en: This course explores the rapidly developing fields of big data for the efficiency of decision making in various fields. description.zh: 本課程將深入探討比特幣作為一種加密貨幣的獨特經濟特性。我們將從貨幣的基礎概念開始，接著介紹比特幣，探討其背後的區塊鏈技術以及去中心化的運作方式。然後，我們將探討比特幣的價值形成機制、供需動態、市場波動等相關議題，並探討其對傳統金融體系的影響，以及可能的未來發展趨勢。此外，再針對比特幣逐漸成為全球大南方新興市場國家的普惠金融方案之一的現象探討其原因與未來發展。
description.en: This course delves into the unique economic characteristics of Bitcoin as a cryptocurrency. We Start from the fundamental concepts of money, fiat currency, and then discuss the Bitcoin. We explore the underlying blockchain technology and decentralized operations. We then examine Bitcoin's value proposition, supply-demand dynamics, market volatility, and its impact on traditional financial systems, along with potential future trends. On top of that, Bitcoin is also gaining traction to become one of the financial inclusion solution in global south emerging countries, we also examine the reasoning and future development of this phenomena.

description.zh: 因應全球淨零碳排趨勢，能源管理與碳管理為國家各產業提升競爭力的重要環節。本課程將從ISO50001能源管理與ISO14064碳管理制度出發，講授能源管理、能源績效評估、碳管理、和績效提升/減碳計算之量測與驗證方法學。講授內容涵蓋：關鍵觀念、節能/減碳技術、績效/減碳量測與驗證方法、節能/減碳統計分析方法學、和案例EXCEL操作與討論。
description.en: In response to the global trend of net-zero carbon emissions, energy management and carbon management are important links in improving the competitiveness of various industries in the country. This course will start from the ISO50001 energy management and ISO14064 carbon management systems and teach the measurement and verification methodologies of energy management, energy performance assessment, carbon management, and performance improvement/carbon reduction calculations. The teaching contents cover: key concepts, energy saving/carbon reduction technology, performance/carbon reduction measurement and verification methods, energy saving/carbon reduction statistical analysis methodology, and EXCEL case practice and discussion.

description.zh: 本課程的重點在於闡述管理學之基本概念，主要的內容涵蓋四個領域：(1)瞭解管理學之理論與相關學者之研究報告；(2) 討論企業界管理應用實務案例；(3) 探討多國化管理之趨勢與差異及(4) 如何落實管理理論研討與趨勢。另外一有管理相關功能實務應用之討論與介紹
description.en: The purpose of Management has four distinct objectives:(1) to introduce a new management paradigm；(2) to effectively combine the basic concepts of management and organizational behavior into a single volume, including the management functional and departmental descriptions；(3) to discuss business management applications in practice and (4) to effectively implement the management basic ideas. The planning, organization, decision, leadership and monitoring among variety culture will be covered and discussed in the class as well.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在介紹和探討管理學的基本概念、原理和應用，培養學生在組織管理領域的專業知識和技能。課程包括概論、管理和應用三個部分。概論部分涵蓋管理的意義、功能、技能和環境。管理部分深入探討規劃、策略管理、組織結構、組織行為、領導理論、溝通與激勵，以及控制與績效管理。應用部分涵蓋人力資源管理、組織變革、創新與創業精神，以及企業倫理與社會責任。教學方法包括講授、案例分析和小組討論，評估方式包括報告和考試。本課程旨在培養學生成為具備全面管理能力的優秀管理者。
This course aims to introduce and explore the fundamental concepts, principles, and applications of management, cultivating students' professional knowledge and skills in the field of organizational management.The course consists of three parts: Introduction, Management, and Applications.The Introduction part covers the meaning, functions, skills, and environment of management.The Management part delves into topics such as planning, strategic management, organizational structure, organizational behavior, leadership theories, communication and motivation, as well as control and performance management.The Applications part covers human resource management, organizational change, innovation and entrepreneurship, as well as business ethics and social responsibility.Teaching methods include lectures, case analysis, and group discussions, while assessment methods include reports and exams.This course aims to cultivate students to become excellent managers with comprehensive management abilities.

description.zh: 組織行為是採用分析的方法，了解研究解個體行為在個人、團體、組織三個層次中的行為表現，並應用相關學理知識提高組織效能，尤其將焦點放在如何提高員工的生產力、降低離職率與曠職率，增加滿意度等四個變項上。
description.en: Organizational behavior (OB) is a field of research that investigates the impact that individuals, groups, and structure have on behavior within an organization, and then it applies that knowledge to make organizations work more effectively.  Specifically, OB focuses on how to improve productivity, reduce absenteeism and turnover, and increase employee citizenship and job satisfaction.

description.zh: 本門授課之目的在於介紹奈米材料及其製程(包括化學法及物理法奈米材料法)，並探討奈米材料的未來發展及應用。所包括的課程主題如下：1.奈米材料與奈米化學簡介。2.奈米材料與結構分析3.量子力學; 4.奈米材料自我組成5. 奈米材料模擬6.碳化奈米材料7奈米材料製成 8.奈米材料的應用; 9.奈米材料的遠景與未來發展。
description.en: The course introduces nanomaterials and their preparation processes (including chemical method and physical methods). Future development and applications are also discussed. This course will cover the following topics:1. Introduction of nanomaterials and Nano-chemistry; 2. Nanomaterials: structure and analysis; 3. Quantum mechanics; 4. Nanomaterials: self-assembly; 5. Nanomaterials: simulation; 6. Carbon-based nanomaterials; 7. Synthesis and processing 8. Growth and application of semiconductor nanoparticles; 9. Prospective future of nanomaterials.

description.zh: 本課程旨在提升學生資訊領域的英語文能力，加強學生於該領域課堂學習與未來職業所需的閱讀與口說技巧。本課程中，學生將經由研讀資訊領域相關文章以及針對相關主題的討論，增加資訊領域的字彙，並加強英語能力與溝通技巧。
description.en: This course is designed for students who are interested in improving English skills in the field of information technology. It aims to increase students’ reading fluency and improve their speaking skills needed to function and succeed in classroom settings and in future career. In this course, authentic reading texts related to information technology will be used. Students will discuss topics, such as artificial intelligence and the World Wide Web, in order to expand vocabulary and language skills.

syllabi.outline:
課程重點：(1)藉由適合其程度的教材加強學生必備的基礎文法觀念和句型結構；(2)使學生確切把握閱讀要領以及充分瞭解寫作的各種技巧，重心在生字、片語、句法的解釋和基本寫作技巧的分析；(3)熟悉英語人士日常生活情境及與學生將來就業環境相關之會話及適當之應對方式；(4)透過練習加強聽、說、讀、寫的知能及表達。
This course is designed (1) to strengthen students' previously required knowledge in English with basic grammatical ideas and sentence patterns reviewed through reading materials appropriate to their levels; (2) to develop reading skill by giving explanation of difficult words, phrases, and syntax, as well as analysis of basic writing skill; (3)to  familiarize students with useful expressions in conversation and build up their confidence in cross-cultural communication; (4)to reinforce the competence and performance of listening, speaking, reading and writing by practice.

description.zh: 著作權法係為保障著作人著作權益，調和社會公共利益，促進國家文化發展，所特別制定之法律。該法所稱著作包括：語文著作、音樂著作、戲劇、舞蹈著作、美術著作、攝影著作、圖形著作、視聽著作、錄音著作、建築著作、電腦程式著作等。著作權的保障內涵則包含因著作完成所生之著作人格權及著作財產權。本課程將兼顧實例與理論進行探討，來深化同學對於著作權的瞭解。
description.en: Copyright Act is specifically enacted for the purposes of protecting the rights and interests of authors with respect to their works, balancing different interests for the common good of society, and promoting the development of national culture. "Works" of this act, include the following:1.Oral and literary works.2.Musical works.3.Dramatic and choreographic works.4.Artistic works.5.Photographic works.6.Pictorial and graphical works.7.Audiovisual works.8.Sound recordings.9.Architectural works.10.Computer programs. "Copyright" means the moral rights and economic rights subsisting in a completed work. The discussion in the course covers theory and examples, to enhance a deeper understanding of Copyright for the students.

description.zh: 本課程主要關注台灣發明、新型與設計專利申請的程序觀點。由於涵蓋範圍較廣，故分為專利申請實務(1)與專利申請實務(2)兩門課講授，本課程為先行之專利申請實務(1)。其相關的主題包括發明人身份、專利權人（專利申請權人）身份、優先權、申請格式、發明人訪談、專利標的、專利要件、專利分類與檢索、專利說明書及請求項之閱讀與撰寫等。此外，國際專利申請的實務觀點也會在課堂上討論以做為比較。本課程教材包括專利申請教科書、各國專利申請實務與審查基準、和法院判決等。
description.en: This course focuses on the procedural aspect of invention patent, utility model and design patent prosecution in Taiwan. As a wide range of different topics are designed to be covered, two courses named “Practice in Patent application (1)” and “Practice in Patent application (2)” are being offered and this is the first course (1). The topics cover inventorship, ownership (including a right to file a patent application), priority, formality, inventor interview, patentable subject matter, patentability, patent classification and search, patent specification and claim reading and writing, etc. In addition, the practical aspect of international patent prosecution is presented for comparison. The class materials include a patent prosecution textbook, patent prosecution and examination guidelines from different counties, and court decisions.

description.zh: 本課程旨在向修課同學作刑法之概括介紹，包括刑法總則及刑法分則。再者，此一介紹包含下列四個重點：一、刑法之背景及理論；二、刑法之解釋；三、刑法於案例事實之適用；四、刑法與刑事訴訟法之結合。參與本課程乃理解刑法之關鍵一步，修課同學將受益匪淺。
description.en: This course aims to give participants a general introduction to "Criminal Law", including "General Provisions" and "Specific Offenses". Furthermore, the introduction contains the following four points: 1. Background and theories of Criminal Law. 2. Interpretation of Criminal Law. 3. Application of Criminal Law to the facts. 4. Combination of Criminal Law and Criminal Procedure Law. Attending this course is the critical step to understanding Criminal Law, and it benefits participants a lot.

description.zh: 新經濟與舊經濟的分野不是在有『e』還是沒有『e』，而是在有『i』還是沒有『i』，而『i』就是『Innovation，創新』。二十一世紀的『腦力經濟』最重要的戲規則就是『智慧財產權』，同時也是WTO會員國必須遵守的重要規範之一。課程內容主要包括三個最基本的智慧財產權課題：專利權，商標權，以及著作權；而為配合本校學生學科背景，本課程將較著重於『專利』方面的實務知識，並且講授『如何激發創意，以培養學生日後能好好應用『智慧財產權』的保護。
description.en: The difference between New-economy and Old-economy is not caused by having "e" or not having "e", but caused by owining "i" or not owning "i". where "I" means "Innovation:. Intellectual Property is not only the most importance business rule of the :Brain economy era:, but also one of the most important agreements among WTO members. This course includes the basic three subjects of Intellectual Property:Patent, Trademark, and Copyright. In order to accommodate the learning background for most of NTUT students, the contents of this course will focus more on the practical practice of the Patennt. In addition, it also includes the subject of "how to activate your creativeness:so as to make students can use what they learn, "Intellectual Property:, to protect their intellectual work.

syllabi.outline:
二十一世紀的「腦力經濟」最重要的戲規則就是「智慧財產權」，同時也是WTO會員必須遵守的重要規範之一；為配合本校為頂尖科技大學，有強調技術發展之傳統，課程內容以與技術特性最為相關的「專利法」為主軸，並於相應主題帶入著作權、商標權及營業秘密等重要智慧財產之觀念，以建構出智慧財權產之整體知識。

One of the most important rules in the 21st-century "knowledge economy" is intellectual property rights, which is also a crucial requirement for WTO members to comply with. To align with our university's emphasis on technological development as a top-tier technology institution, the course content focuses on "Patent Law," which is highly relevant to technology. Additionally, concepts related to copyright, trademark rights, and trade secrets, which are significant aspects of intellectual property, will be integrated into relevant topics to construct a comprehensive understanding of intellectual property rights.

description.zh: 本課程將深入我國專利法，同時簡介美國及大陸專利法。本課程內容主要涵蓋：專利申請、可專利標的、專利要件及要求、專利審查流程、專利權之實施、專利侵害判斷、專利檢索及專利說明書之撰寫。其他內容尚包括簡介專利訴訟流程、專利行政救濟流程、法院及智慧財產局之角色以及專利法與其他智慧財產權法之關係。
description.en: This course will go through R.O.C. (Taiwan) patent law in detail, and introduce to the U.S. and China patent laws. Topics will mainly include patent filing, patentable subject matter, patent conditions and requirements, patent examination procedure, patent enforcement, patent infringement assessment, patent search, and patent drafting. Other topics include introduce to patent litigation procedure, patent administrative suit procedure, the roles of the court and the Intellectual Property Office and the relationship between patent law and other Intellectual Property laws.

description.en: The General Principle of the Civil Law serves to introduce the common concept and fundamental principle of the Civil Law.  In short, the General Principle of the Civil Law predominates as a learning basis for the whole Civil Law and all legal study.  Through learning on the General Principle of the Civil Law, students can be familiar with the model of legal thought and the framework of norm.  This course aims to assist students learning from both theory and practice.

name.zh: 光電材料於再生能源之應用
name.en: Optoelectronic Materials in Renewable Energy Applications

description.zh: 光電材料具備將光轉換為電能的能力，因此在當前的再生能源研究中中引起了廣泛與極大的關注。本課程著重介紹光電材料應用在光伏元件、發光二極體、光電感測器和薄膜電晶體。課程內容也包括半導體物理基礎知識、材料的分子結構、光吸收能力、載流子遷移率以及元件的穩定性和衰退的探討。
description.en: Optoelectronic materials have attracted much attention on a wide range of applications in renewable energy systems due to their ability to convert light into electricity. This course focus on introducing optoelectronic materials utilized in such kind of devices, photovoltaics, light-emitting diodes, photodetectors, and thin-film-transistors. This course also includes the fundamentals of semiconductor physics, materials’ molecular structures, light absorption capacity, carrier mobility and device’s stability and degradation.

description.en: All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

syllabi.outline:
The class will be taught in-person. In-person sessions will include active gameplay with another student or coach. This is an introductory course teaching the fundamental skills of table tennis. It is assumed that students enrolled in the class have little or no experience in table tennis. Class will be focusing on developing the following skills: racket grip, possible racket holding angles, basic strokes, rules, scoring, strategy, etiquette, practice drills, spin, singles play.
Not limited to a students with advance level would like to join. For those of who should notice, some advance techniques would not be included in the course.

Present the student fundamental skills and knowledge of table tennis.
Improve each student's skills in hitting all of the basic strokes: forehand counterhit; backhand
counterhit(drive); backhand flick(flip); backhand block; service return, and footwork.
Introduce each student to the basic rules, scoring, and footwork.
Offer each student an opportunity to apply their skill and knowledge in match play.
Make each student aware of the primary differences in strategies for singles and doubles and provide an
opportunity to implement this information in actual match play.
Provide each student with information about current table tennis trends, specifically regarding local
table tennis programs, professional tournaments and equipment selection.
Encourage each student to pursue table tennis as a lifetime leisure activity.

**Consistent attendance and participation are extremely important in order to develop the necessary skills for improvement. All students will be held accountable for any work missed when absent. Please be prepared each day with proper equipment and attire.
syllabi.schedule:
#1~4weeks 
Introductory phase: learning fundamental skills and knowledge.
  EX., racket holding,  techniques of forehand, backhand, server.

#5~10weeks
Gameplay phase: game rules introduction and practicing.
During this phase, all students are required to play with other classmates in both single and double game match to familiar processes of the play.

#11~18weeks
Matching phase: single an double game competitions.
In this period, all students are randomly assign to a groups for competitions. For the final grade, to 40 points in total is requires for student to pass the class.

Attendance:
*All classes should not be missing and unnoticed absent !!!!

2) Able to show different styles of serve
3) Able to control the ball landing while strike back.

Game matching: 40%
1) All students required to attend every game in random assignment.
2) Paper test

Learning codes:15%

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在協助學生學習網球各項基本技巧，並學習球場禮儀及比賽規則。且在有效的學習過程中獲得成就感，同時達到鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。
教學目標：
1. 學習正確網球基本技巧，避動作錯誤造成運動傷害。 
2. 學會欣賞網球運動賽事，提升對於網球運動之興趣。
3. 了解網球運動的基本規則與禮儀。
4. 培養規律運動習慣，進而達到強身體魄之效果。
5. 培養團隊合作與運動家的精神。

The aim of this course is to assist students in learning the basic skills of tennis, as well as understanding court etiquette and game rules. Through effective learning processes, students will gain a sense of achievement while simultaneously achieving holistic physical and mental development, fostering sportsmanship, promoting teamwork, and cultivating lifelong physical activity habits.

Teaching objectives:

Learn correct basic tennis skills to avoid sports injuries caused by improper movements.
Develop an appreciation for tennis events to enhance interest in the sport.
Understand the basic rules and etiquette of tennis.
Cultivate regular exercise habits to achieve physical fitness benefits.
Foster teamwork and sportsmanship.

syllabi.schedule:
教學目標與內容
一、綜合目標:增強健康適能，內容含肌肉適能、心肺適能、柔軟度:進而了解身體組成，提高運動適能；並藉由舞蹈作品展演體現肢體美感，與提升現代人所需之”3Q-智商、情商、挫商”等人性內涵的素質。
二、單項目標與內容:
(一)彼拉提斯(Pilates mat work ):
*提升肢體覺察力與覺知力，進而正確運用肢體達到健康安全的行為模式；並增強肢體協調性、敏捷性、反應力與專注力。
*核心肌群的訓練，針對肌肉的控制與穩定，增強與維持肌肉適能。
(二) 基礎律動(Basic rhythm)藉由基礎節奏與律動增加身體協調性，反應與敏捷能力。
(三)現代舞(Modern Dance)
*體驗現代舞並能展演:學生舞蹈創作時，從學習皮拉提斯肌肉控制與柔軟度中，發展肢體美感。
*藉由舞蹈作品排練與練習過程:學習團隊合作與人際溝通。提升自我表達能力與創意。養成耐心、毅力、受挫力及克服心。
三、補充教材:歌舞電影、表演藝術欣賞或文章閱讀等。
提昇對藝術的鑑賞能力,豐富美感經驗。

教學進度:
第一週
1-教學規劃說明，含目標、內容、進度、應備知識基礎、評量方式。
2-測驗基礎肌肉適能與柔軟度。
第二週
1-身體評估。
2-了解肌肉、骨骼及神經關係。
3-剖析及了解自己日常生活時身體姿勢的狀況，躺、坐、站、走、跑、跳的正確姿勢。
第三週肢體觀察與覺知能力培養
1-練習Pilates呼吸法與健康正確的身體姿勢。
2-Pilates Mat Work初級分解動作。學習保養身體及改善不良的體態（肌肉適能）。 
3-基礎律動(增進協調性）。
第四週
1-練習健康正確的身體姿勢（脊椎矯正操）
2-Pilates Mat Work初級分解動作，學習保養身體及改善不良的體態（肌肉適能）。 
3-基礎律動（增進協調性）
第五週
1-練習健康正確的身體姿勢（脊椎矯正操） 
2-Pilates Mat Work初級分解動作，學習保養身體及改善不良的體態（肌肉適能）。

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在協助學生學習網球各項基本技巧，並學習球場禮儀及比賽規則。且在有效的學習過程中獲得成就感，同時達到鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。
教學目標：
1. 學習正確網球基本技巧，避動作錯誤造成運動傷害。 
2. 學會欣賞網球運動賽事，提升對於網球運動之興趣。
3. 了解網球運動的基本規則與禮儀。
4. 培養規律運動習慣，進而達到強身體魄之效果。
5. 培養團隊合作與運動家的精神。

The aim of this course is to assist students in learning the basic skills of tennis, as well as understanding court etiquette and game rules. Through effective learning processes, students will gain a sense of achievement while simultaneously achieving holistic physical and mental development, fostering sportsmanship, promoting teamwork, and cultivating lifelong physical activity habits.

Teaching objectives:

Learn correct basic tennis skills to avoid sports injuries caused by improper movements.
Develop an appreciation for tennis events to enhance interest in the sport.
Understand the basic rules and etiquette of tennis.
Cultivate regular exercise habits to achieve physical fitness benefits.
Foster teamwork and sportsmanship.

曠課第一次扣2分、第2次扣4分、第3次扣8分…，以此類推。

二、運動習慣 : 50%
1. APP使用成績 (40%)：
從第7周至第15周，有氧運動須累積完成30KM  (20%)，重訓或居家肌力與體能訓練需每周一次 (20%)。完成門檻即獲得80%分數，超標者分數加上去。
2. 身體活動量紀錄 (10%)：
有按照本門課完成2周一次的身體活動紀錄，有完成紀錄即獲得分數。共3次

三、期末學術科測驗與心得: 20% 
1. 心肺耐力測驗 (10%)
10分鐘跑步測驗或10分鐘划船測驗，由同學自選擇一來進行考試。

2.心得與回饋 (10%)
針對本學期運用之教學策略撰寫上課心得與建議，以文字填寫至北科 i學園平臺，心得撰寫方向以體育課經驗比較、教學方法與策略、學習歷程收穫、持續學習之意願與課程建議為主:
a. 本學期的體適能課程與你先前修專項體育課的經驗有何不同之處?
b. 你認為這學期的修課，是否有提升你在日常的身體活動量?
c. 你認為這學期的修課，是否有幫助你身體組成的進步?
d. 經過這學期的課程，你是否已建立運動習慣 (除體育課外，至少每周運動2次，每次大於30分鐘)?

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技一、二年級實施專項分組教學，由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

syllabi.schedule:
貳.課程說明
一、教學目的
（一）藉由籃球競賽做為培養個人競爭、合作的社會化過成程。
（二）培養籃球課程高階技術能力、享受競賽所給予的樂趣。

二、主要內容
（一）職籃與業餘(FIBA)規則、歷史、介紹
（二）基本動作、綜合技術、規則常識。
(三) 小組攻防配合、團隊戰術（區域防守）、競賽理論與操作。
（四）隨機分組3*3和5*5比賽(採FIBA規則)
（五）裁判實務。

三、教學進度
(一)第1週
1.課程導論與介紹
2.師生相見歡，建立line群組
3.籃球課程體驗~以利加退選。

(二))第2週
1.分組基本動作練習(運球、傳球與投籃)
2.基本關觀念及個人技術介紹

(三)第3週
1.基本關觀念及個人技術複習
2.加退選確認後進行3*3隨機分組
3.業餘籃球比賽三對三規則講授(FIBA)

(四)第4週
1.基本關觀念及2人小組技術複習（擋切、傳切）
2.籃球3*3比賽

(五)第5週(上課地點:中正樓室內球場)
1.基本關觀念及2-3人技術介紹 （擋切、傳切）
2.籃球專項運動傷害防護研討 
3.籃球3*3比賽

(六)第6週
1.基本關觀念及2-3人技術複習 （擋切、傳切）
2.籃球專項運動傷害防護研討
3.進行5*5隨機分組
3.業餘籃球比賽五對五規則講授(FIBA)

(七)第7週
1.基本關觀念及籃球攻防戰略技術分析（走位路線） 
2.5人團隊防守隊形及球員位置研討練習(如何進攻1)
3.籃球專項運動傷害防護研討
4.5*5分隊開打

(八)第8週
1.基本關觀念及2-3人技術複習（擋切、傳切、走位路線） 
2.5人團隊防守隊形及進攻走位研討練習 (如何進攻2)
3.籃球專項運動傷害防護研討
4. 5*5分隊續打

(九)第9週
1.基本關觀念及2-3人技術複習（擋切、傳切、走位路線） 
2.5人團隊防守隊形及進攻走位研討練習(如何進攻3)
3.籃球專項運動傷害防護研討
4. 5*5分隊續打

(十)第10週(上課地點:中正樓室內球場)
1.期中考試(術科測驗)
2.期中考週規則研討

(十一)第11週
1.基本關觀念及2-3人技術複習（擋切、傳切、走位路線）
2.3人團隊防守隊形及進攻走位研討練習 (如何進攻4)
3.籃球專項運動傷害防護研討 
4. 5*5分隊續打

(十二)第12週
1.區域防守隊形及球員位置研討練習(一二二防守)
2.隨堂技能測驗
3.組隊挑戰賽

(十三)第13週
1.區域防守隊形及球員位置研討練習(二一二防守)
2.隨堂技能測驗
3.組隊挑戰賽

(十四)第14週
1.區域防守隊形及球員位置研討練習(三二防守)
2.綜合課程內容練習比賽
3.組隊挑戰賽
4.裁判實習

(十五)第15週(上課地點:中正樓室內球場)
1.區域防守隊形及球員位置研討練習(一二二防守)
2.綜合課程內容練習比賽 
3.裁判實習

(十六)第16週
1.區域防守隊形及球員位置研討練習(二三防守)
2.綜合課程內容練習比賽 
3.術科技能補測驗(佔學期成績40%)

(十七)第17週
1.綜合研討各項區域防守隊形及球員位置練習
2.綜合課程內容練習比賽 
3.線上認知測驗(佔學期成績20%)

(十八)第18週
1.期末術科測驗 (補測驗)
2.練習比賽
syllabi.assessment:
參.評量方式
一.給分標準
(一)技能學習（包括運動技術）：佔總分百分之四十（40﹪）。
(二)情意學習（包括學習態度、體育服裝的穿著、上課出席率及參與活動）：佔總分百分之四十（40﹪）
(三)認知學習（包括運動理論與常識）：期末運動理論與常識測驗佔總分百分之二十（20﹪）
包含:
(1)體育服裝的穿著、上課出席率及參與活動
(2)缺課
(3)遲到早退
(4)無故不參與學習活動視同缺課
(5)代替簽名
(6)基本運動常識認知

3.其他加分
(1)擔任體育股長並主動借用器材及整理場地等服務工作（加學期成績5分至10分）
(2)非擔任體育股長並主動借用器材及整理場地等服務工作（加學期成績3分至8分）
(3)參加校內獲校外各項運動競賽（需提出證明）（加學期成績3分至5分）
(4)參加校內獲校外各項運動競賽並獲得優成績（需提出證明）（加學期成績5分至8分）
(5)主動協助同學學習並互相合作（加學期成績5分至10分）

4.其他扣分
(1)製造或遺留垃圾（一次扣學期成績3分至5分）
(2)蓄意遺失或損毀器材或場地（一次扣學期成績3分至5分）
(3)違反體育室規定於館內飲食或吸菸（一次扣學期成績3分至5分）
(4)刻意欺瞞老師或同學（一次扣學期成績3分至5分）
(5)出言不遜或肢體暴力（一次扣學期成績30分至50分）

第四週 扯鈴：望月組合招式；跳繩：前後開叉跳、前後交叉跳、雙人單繩。
