syllabi.materials:
教材：
本課程主要針對國際金融市場與國際企業等相關外文平面媒體報導及國際組織發布之報告為素材，講授金融與財務專業領域的專業用語、撰文結構、報導觀點及評論分析等進行討論，所選用的平面媒體將以經濟學人、新聞周刊為主要選取對象；國際組織則主要美國證管會、歐洲央行、國際證監會組織及新加坡金融管理局等為選取對象。
Course materials:
This course collects the clipped news and reports from financial magazines, including the Economist and Global Finance, and international organizations, including U.S. Security Exchange Commission, European Central Bank, the International Organization of Securities Commissions and Monetary Authority of Singapore.

description.zh: 此課程之目標為多媒體系統整介紹，包含介紹所有影像和視訊的標準格式、視訊的壓縮基本原理，目前主流的視訊壓所標準格式，讓學生了解到1.多媒體簡介2.多媒體發展平台3.多媒體資訊系統設計4.多媒體資訊系統實體建置。課程內容包含: 1.多媒體資料簡介2.多媒體發展平台3.多媒體資料處理4.多媒體壓縮技術5.多媒體標準架構6.多媒體系統設計7.多媒體實體建置
description.en: This course is mainly aimed at introducing the Multimedia Systems, including: (1) Introduction to Multimedia Systems (2)Multimedia Platforms for developers (3)Digital Signal Processing for Multimedia Systems (4) Data and Image Compression for Multimedia Systems (5) Multimedia Frameworks (6) Design of Multimedia Systems (7) Develop and Manage Multimedia Systems

name.en: Internship of practical technology research and development

description.zh: 本課程之目的為讓技術導向博士班學生於學期間至本所各分組專業相關之企業、政府單位或具規模之其他機構從事全職實務技術研發工作，讓技術導向博士生除發展學術理論外，更擁有業界實務經驗，以成為學養精湛且具有實務技能之高階專業人才。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to elevate an all-round ability for the technique-orientated Ph.D. students . During the semester, students are required to go to government-based organizations or industry / business-oriented agencies working as a full-time R & D practical job. Course takers are in addition to developing technology-oriented doctoral level academic theory, but also has practical experience in the industry, to become a highly specialized personnel with practical professional skills.

description.zh: 同學們在修過第一年所開的所有的必修課之後，從第三個學期開始，在指導老師的引領下，必須開始著手準備碩士論文的撰寫: 選擇論文題目，收集資料，通過論文大綱審查，開始撰寫論文. . .等等的步驟。從第三個學期開始須修二期之「論文」課程。在論文口試委員們接受該論文並在文件上簽名後，同學們可同時拿到六個學分，完成本碩士課程"論文"這一項的要求。
description.en: After completing all the required courses in the first year, every student is encouraged to initiate the working process toward the completion of his/her MA thesis under the supervision of an advisor. Starting from the third semester, it is required for the student to register for "Thesis" for two semesters.  The "Thesis" courses aim to lead graduate students through the process of preparing, writing and completing an MA thesis.  After the committee members agree on the acceptability of the thesis and sign the official document, the student will get a total of 6 credits for "Thesis," fulfilling part of the requirement for a MA degree.

description.zh:
為培養大學部學生自主學習能力，由學生主動積極創造並實現自己有興趣之主題。學生於特定主題之創造與實現中，學習到思考批判與問題解決等能力。教師擔任輔助指導角色，引導學生從實踐中學習問題解決能力。
    學生根據自己的興趣與能力訂定自主學習計畫，並於開學前向各系提出申請，由本系專任老師擔任指導教師，審查計畫及評核學期成績。
description.en: This course aims to develop undergraduates’ active learning skills by making students engage in the creation and realization of topics of students’ own interest. In the process of specific topic creation and realization, students will proactively learn critical-thinking and problem-solving skills. Instructors cultivate the active engagement of students in problem solving, without actually participating in it.

syllabi.outline:
為培養大學部學生自主學習能力，由學生主動積極創造並實現自己有興趣之主題。學生於特定主題之創造與實現中，學習到思考批判與問題解決等能力。教師擔任輔助指導角色，引導學生從實踐中學習問題解決能力。學生根據自己的興趣與能力訂定自主學習計畫，並於開學前向各系提出申請，由本系專任老師擔任指導教師，審查計畫及評核學期成績。
This course aims to develop undergraduates’ active learning skills by making students engage in the creation and realization of topics of students’ own interest. In the process of specific topic creation and realization, students will proactively learn critical-thinking and problem-solving skills. Instructors cultivate the active engagement of students in problem solving, without actually participating in it.

description.zh: 本課程是為了培養學生自主學習的能力，由學生主動提出自己有興趣之主題。學生於特定主題中，學習到思考與問題解決的能力。教師擔任輔助指導角色，引導學生從實踐中學習。學生根據自己的興趣與能力訂定學習計畫，於開學前向辦公室提出申請。由專任老師擔任指導教師，審查及評核學期成績。
description.en: This course is to cultivate students' self-learning ability, and students take the initiative to put forward topics they are interested in. Students learn the ability to think and solve problems in specific topics. Teachers play the role of auxiliary guidance to guide students to learn from practice. Students formulate learning plans based on their interests and abilities, and apply to the office before the start of the semester. The full-time teacher acts as the instructor to review and evaluate the semester results.

description.zh: 為培養學生自主學習能力，透過學生自發性蒐集資料擬定研究主題，由學生自行建構課程內容，從中學習規劃與執行專案實務，培育學生在特定主題研究中，學習到團隊合作、溝通表達、思考批判與問題解決等能力，由教師擔任輔助指導角色，引導學生從實踐中學習問題解決能力。本課程的評量以書面報告或口頭報告進行。
description.en: To help students cultivate the ability of self-learning, this course allows students to engage themselves in developing course content, to plan and to execute a real-world project. "Active learning" encourages students to learn by interaction, communication, collaboration, critically analyzing arguments, and problem-solving. Instructors will assist to guide and to support in the process of learning. Students are expected to develop a process to solve real-life problems collaboratively. Written reports and oral presentations are required for course evaluation.

syllabi.outline:
(1)	藉由學生主動實現自己有興趣之主題，培養自我學習能力。

(1)	Develop self-learning skills by actively implementing topics of interest to students

(3)	Teachers act as mentors and guide students to learn and grow from practice

description.zh:
為培養大學部學生自主學習能力，由學生主動積極創造並實現自己有興趣之主題。學生於特定主題之創造與實現中，學習到思考批判與問題解決等能力。教師擔任輔助指導角色，引導學生從實踐中學習問題解決能力。
    學生根據自己的興趣與能力訂定自主學習計畫，並於開學前向各系提出申請，由本系專任老師擔任指導教師，審查計畫及評核學期成績。
description.en:
This course aims to develop undergraduates’ active learning skills by making students engage in the creation and realization of topics of students’ own interest. In the process of specific topic creation and realization, students will proactively learn critical-thinking and problem-solving skills. Instructors cultivate the active engagement of students in problem solving, without actually participating in it.  
In this course, students are required to draw up self-learning plans based on their own interests and capabilities and then submit their plans to the departmental office for approval by the beginning of the semester.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為讓學生可以利用暑期或其它時間至學校認可之校外公私立機構進行或參與實習，以增進學生之實務能力。學生於學校認可之校外機構實習總累計時數不得低於320小時。學生實習期滿後，應依據各系規定繳交相關實習相關成果報告，彙交所屬系保存，並作為成績核定之依據。學生校外實習學期成績之評定比例原則：實習單位占50%，輔導老師占50%，各系得依其屬性調整之。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to elevate an all-round ability for the students at NTUT. During the summer break or other periods of time, students are required to go to government-based organizations or industry/business-oriented agencies with respect to promoting practice of ability. The course takers will need to stay in the same individual organization or agency with an accumulated amount of time of no less than 320 hours. After the students complete the requirements in question, these organizations and agencies will offer them certificates -- or proof of any kind -- in accordance with the real performance on site. The grading principle will be equivalently decided by the thesis advisor (50%) and the on-site organization or agency (50%), respectively. The individual department or graduate institute may make proper adjustments according to the situations in need.

name.zh: 部份工時學期校外實習

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為增進學生之實務能力，學生須於學期中至光電工程相關機構連續實習18週，每週不得低於2.5天。實習期滿後須由實習機構出具實習證明及成績考核，學生應於校外實習完成後一週內繳交校外實習報告，由實習輔導老師評定實習成績。
description.en: This course is designed to enhance students' on-job practical experiences. Students will work at an electro-optical engineering related company or research organizations for 18 weeks(20 hours per week) during the semester. Through the program, students would learn the hands-on professional technology. Each student would be required to submit a written report right after the end of the internship for grading.

name.zh: 彈性工時學期校外實習

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為增進學生之實務能力，學生須於學期中至光電工程相關機構連續實習18週，工時可彈性安排週間但每週不得低於32小時。實習期滿後須由實習機構出具實習證明及成績考核，學生應於校外實習完成後一週內繳交校外實習報告，由實習輔導老師評定實習成績。
description.en: This course is designed to enhance students' on-job practical experiences. Students will work at an electro-optical engineering related company or research organizations for 18 weeks(flexible working hours and 32 hours at least per week) during the semester. Through the program, students would learn the hands-on professional technology. Each student would be required to submit a written report right after the end of the internship for grading.

description.zh: 本課程主要是讓學生在畢業之前即獲得短期體驗光電產業的職場經驗，此經驗包括有職場倫理外，也讓學生意識到學校教育與現實職場間的差異、產業對人才的選擇標準、自我能力基本要求的考驗、和未來可就業的相關企業。進而檢討自我的未來生涯規劃。
description.en: The course is designed to help students' career developments and to enhance their working experiences prior to their graduation. Students will work at a electric-optic engineering related company or research organization on-site. The duration is one full-time semester. Students would learn the real-life operations of professional technology, acknowledge the differences between the school and working environments, understand the business needs, and develop their professional ethics. Through the program, students would be able to self-evaluate the gaps between their own capabilities and the professional needs, and establish or adjust their career development plans accordingly. A student would require to work full-time on-site the company and submit a full semester paper to fulfill the program requirements.

description.zh: 本課程主要是讓學生在畢業之前即獲得短期體驗車輛產業的職場經驗，此經驗包括有職場倫理外，也讓學生意識到學校教育與現實職場間的差異、產業對人才的選擇標準、自我能力基本要求的考驗、和未來可就業的相關企業。進而檢討自我的未來生涯規劃。
description.en: The course is designed to help students' career developments and to enhance their working experiences prior to their graduation. Students will work at a vehicle engineering related company or research organization on-site. The duration is one full-time semester. Students would learn the real-life operations of professional technology, acknowledge the differences between the school and working environments, understand the business needs, and develop their professional ethics. Through the program, students would be able to self-evaluate the gaps between their own capabilities and the professional needs, and establish or adjust their career development plans accordingly. A student would require to work full-time on-site the company and submit a full semester paper to fulfill the program requirements.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為讓研究生可以利用學期中、暑期或寒假至指導教授認可之校外公私立機構進行或參與實務研發，以增進研究生之實務研究能力。研究生於指導教授認可之同一校外研發機構的累計研究時數不得低於320小時，研究生於校外實務研發期滿後，由校外研發機構出具研究生於該機構之實務研發證明與實務研究成績；研究生並且必須繳交實務研發紀錄及實務研究報告予指導教授，指導教師依據研究生之實務研發紀錄及心得報告，指導研究生撰寫成實務研究成果報告，彙交所屬系所保存，並作為成績核定之依據。研究生校外實務研究學期成績之評定比例原則：校外實務研發機構占50%，研究生指導教授占50%。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to promote an all-round ability for the graduate students at NTUT. During either the summer/winter break or the regular semester term, graduate students are required to go to the organizations or agencies with respect to their individual research topics and future development by undergoing the on site research. The course takers will need to stay in the same individual organization or agency with a time span of no less than 320 hours. The students will also need to present to the thesis advisor the on-site research documents - which will thus be collected and deposited in the individual departmental or graduate institute office. The grading principle will be equivalently decided by the thesis advisor (50%) and the on-site organizations or agencies (50%), respectively.

name.zh: 國際學術專題交流與實踐（一）
溫室氣體減量政策專題

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為增進學生之實務能力，學生至機械相關機構實習（實習實際天數依「校外實習」實行辦法另訂之），參與校外合作機構所提供之訓練，觀摩學習專業工廠之實際運作。實習期滿後須由實習機構出具實習證明及成績考核；學生必須撰寫實習心得報告，彙交系上保存。
description.en: The course is developed to increase students' capability of on-job practice. Participation in one of the corporative mechanical engineering company, practice and learn the real operation of the mechanical engineering related fields. A practice intern and a well-prepared report must be completed to the course requirement.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為讓研究生可以利用學期中、暑期或寒假至指導教授認可之校外公私立機構進行或參與實務研發，以增進研究生之實務研究能力。研究生於指導教授認可之同一校外研發機構的累計研究時數不得低於320小時，研究生於校外實務研發期滿後，由校外研發機構出具研究生於該機構之實務研發證明與實務研究成績；研究生並且必須繳交實務研發紀錄及實務研究心得報告予指導教授，指導教師依據研究生之實務研發紀錄及心得報告，指導研究生撰寫成實務研究成果報告，彙交所屬系所保存，並作為成績核定之依據。研究生校外實務研究學期成績之評定比例原則：校外實務研發機構占50%，研究生指導教授占50%。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to promote an all-round ability for the graduate students at NTUT. During either the summer/winter break or the regular semester term, graduate students are required to go to the organizations or agencies with respect to their individual research topics and future development by undergoing the on site research. The course takers will need to stay in the same individual organization or agency with a time span of no less than 320 hours. The students will also need to present to the thesis advisor the on-site research documents - which will thus be collected and deposited in the individual departmental or graduate institute office. The grading principle will be equivalently decided by the thesis advisor (50%) and the on-site organizations or agencies (50%), respectively.

description.zh: 在管理決策中，要如何做行銷管理才能使得公司的產品賣得出去並增加公司收入。要如何做資金管理才能使得公司可以正常營運並將資金做適當的管理決策配置。透過國內外相關公司案例的討論，讓學生可以瞭解消費者行為、市場區隔、產品策略、通路、數位(含AI)行銷等議題，以及對財管的投資、融資、營運資金、公司理財等議題有進一步的理解，讓高階經理人可以有更全面的策略營運方針。
description.en: In management decisions, how should marketing management be conducted to ensure that a company's products sell and increase company revenue? How should financial management be handled to ensure the company operates smoothly and makes appropriate management decisions regarding the allocation of funds? Through discussions of relevant domestic and international company cases, students can gain an understanding of topics such as consumer behavior, market segmentation, product strategy, distribution channels, and digital (including AI) marketing, as well as develop a deeper understanding of financial management topics like investment, financing, working capital, and corporate finance. This will enable senior managers to develop more comprehensive strategic operational guidelines.

description.zh: 本課程主要在介紹高階管理的理論與實務。將透過學校老師與企業高階管理者與學生一起探討當前管理重要議題。本課程以哈佛個案教學方法進行，在每個個案討論當中，同時由行銷管理、財務管理、科技管理、生產管理領域老師教授。可以讓學生在學管理工功能之外，還可以學習這些管理功能的整合，學期末並有分組個案競賽，促進團隊互動與學習。
description.en: This course focuses on the introduction and discussion of theories and practices of contemporary management topics. Besides university professors, renowned top manager will be invited to share the best practice experiences of the workplace in the lecture. The Integrated Management Case Studies would be taught by case methods from Havard Business School’s cases. Every case will be taught from Marketing, Financing, Technology Management, and Operation Management areas faculty. This course focus on the integration of management functions. The case contest will be hold on the final week to encourage team building and learning.

syllabi.outline:
本課程主要在介紹高階管理的理論與實務。將透過學校老師與企業高階管理者與學生一起探討當前管理重要議題。本課程以哈佛個案教學方法進行，在每個個案討論當中，同時由行銷管理、財務管理、科技管理、生產管理領域老師教授。可以讓學生在學管理工功能之外，還可以學習這些管理功能的整合，學期末並有分組個案競賽，促進團隊互動與學習。
This course focuses on the introduction and discussion of theories and practices of contemporary management topics. Besides university professors, renowned top manager will be invited to share the best practice experiences of the workplace in the lecture. The Integrated Management Case Studies would be taught by case methods from Havard Business School’s cases. Every case will be taught from Marketing, Financing, Technology Management, and Operation Management areas faculty. This course focus on the integration of management functions. The case contest will be hold on the final week to encourage team building and learning.

description.en: The main purpose of this course is to promote an all-round ability for the graduate students at NTUT. During either the summer/winter break or the regular semester term, graduate students are required to go to the organizations or agencies with respect to their individual research topics and future development by undergoing the on site research. The course takers will need to stay in the same individual organization or agency with a time span of no less than 320 hours. After the students finish the requirements in question, these organizations and agencies will offer them certificates -- or proof of any kind -- in accordance with the real performance on site. The students will also need to present to the thesis advisor the on-site research documents - which will thus be collected and deposited in the individual departmental or graduate institute office, showing what they have actually learned and accomplished with this work/research experience.

Week1
Transfer(1) 
1. EFEM元件動作與功能 介紹

3. Load port

1. 前開式晶圓傳送盒 (FOUP)的種類與演進 
2. TSMC- Load port 
3. 晶圓震動感測器 
Week 2
Gas/MFC 
1. 質量流量控制器(MFC) 介紹

3. MFC校正實作
Chemical 
1. 流體幫浦介紹
2. 化學過濾器的種類與原理
3. 化學材料介紹 
4. Chemical valve 
Week 3
Plasma 
1. 電漿的形成原理
2. 電漿設計的種類與原理 3. DC bias原理
4. 電漿的應用

1. 溫度作用與元件種類 
2. Chiller/ Heat-changer 
3. 致冷晶片/ 冷卻液種類

Week 4 
Specialty 
1. 塗佈(Coating)技術介紹

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為讓研究生可以利用學期中、暑期、或寒假至指導教授認可之校外公私立機構進行或參與實務研發，以增進研究生之實務研究能力。研究生於指導教授認可之同一校外研發機構的累計研究時數不得低於320小時，研究生於校外實務研發期滿後，由校外研發機構出具研究生於該機構之實務研發證明與實務研究成績；研究生並且必須繳交實務研發紀錄及實務研究心得報告予指導教授，以作為成績核定之依據。研究生校外實務研究學期成績之評定比例原則：校外實務研發機構占50%，研究生指導教授占50%。(各系所得依其屬性調整之)
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to promote an all-round ability for the graduate students at NTUT. During either the summer/winter break or the regular semester term, graduate students are required to go to the organizations or agencies with respect to their individual research topics and future development by undergoing the on site research. The students are urged to take an active part in the training programs as well as observe and emulate the genuine research and development operations in respective manufacturers. The course takers will need to stay in the same individual organization or agency with a time span of no less than 320 hours. After the students finish the requirements in question, these organizations and agencies will offer them certificates or proof of any kind in accordance with the real performance on site. The students will also need to present to the thesis advisor the on site research documents, showing what they actually learn and accomplish with this work exp

description.en: The main purpose of this course is to promote an all-round ability for the graduate students at NTUT. During either the summer/winter break or the regular semester term, graduate students are required to go to the organizations or agencies with respect to their individual research topics and future development by undergoing the on-site research. The course takers will need to stay in the same individual organization or agency with a time span of no less than 320 hours. The students will also need to present to the thesis advisor the on-site research documents - which will thus be collected and deposited in the individual departmental or graduate institute office. The grading principle will be equivalently decided by the thesis advisor (50%) and the on-site organizations or agencies (50%), respectively.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為讓學生可以利用暑期或其它時間至學校認可之校外公私立機構進行或參與實習，以增進學生之實務能力。學生於學校認可之校外機構實習總累計時數不得低於320小時。學生實習期滿後，應依據各系規定繳交相關實習相關成果報告，彙交所屬系保存，並作為成績核定之依據。學生校外實習學期成績之評定比例原則：實習單位占50%，輔導老師占50%，各系得依其屬性調整之。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to elevate an all-round ability for the students at NTUT. During the summer break or other periods of time, students are required to go to government-based organizations or industry/business-oriented agencies with respect to promoting practice of ability. The course takers will need to stay in the same individual organization or agency with an accumulated amount of time of no less than 320 hours. After the students complete the requirements in question, these organizations and agencies will offer them certificates -- or proof of any kind -- in accordance with the real performance on site. The grading principle will be equivalently decided by the thesis advisor (50%) and the on-site organization or agency (50%), respectively. The individual department or graduate institute may make proper adjustments according to the situations in need.
